article.articleHeadline: India's TB Fight: How Indigenous Innovation Can Drive Tuberculosis Elimination
article.articleSummary: India bears about 25% of global TB patients. Under the National TB Elimination Programme, incidence fell 21% (237 to 187 per lakh) from 2015–2024; mortality down 25%; treatment coverage rose from 53% to 92%, aided by Ni-kshay digital platforms, Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana nutrition support, TB Mukt Bharat campaigns, and expanded molecular diagnostics. Drug-resistant TB remains a major threat, with longer, costlier regimens. New medicines—Bedaquiline, Delamanid, Pretomanid—improve outcomes; research pursues vaccines, rapid diagnostics, and host-directed therapies. ICMR/NIRT, with DBT and BIRAC, lead indigenous R&D; industry players like Macleods, Lupin, Cipla, Cadila, and Molbio’s Truenat expand affordable diagnostics and medicines for India and export. Explorations into plant-derived immunomodulators (Ashwagandha, Turmeric, Giloy, Black Pepper) are ongoing. The next phase targets nutrition, sanitation, genomic surveillance, and biotech leadership to eliminate TB and strengthen health security.

triage.headline_ja: インドの結核対策：国産イノベーションが結核撲滅を推進する方法
triage.triage_reason: 国家プログラムの成果報告・政策解説記事であり、新規の異常な発生や急性の公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 結核の既知の慢性疾病負荷に関する進捗報告記事であり、急性のアウトブレイクや新規異常事象ではないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: 买海鲜混入毒蟹险酿大祸 螃蟹季食鲜小心这些海洋"毒物"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Buying seafood contaminated with poisonous crabs could trigger a major disaster; during crab season, beware these marine toxins.
article.articleSummary: Crab season warning highlights a squid dish contaminated with a tiny red-spotted crab carrying tetrodotoxin, a deadly neurotoxin; high heat cannot destroy it. This and related crabs can harbor toxins, with distribution across Japan, the Philippines, Singapore, East Africa, and China’s Guangdong and Hainan. Toxins include tetrodotoxin and paralytic toxins; symptoms start with numbness of lips and extremities, gait instability, and may progress to respiratory failure. Spoiled seafood can harbor Vibrio parahaemolyticus. Other hazardous marine life listed include toxic shellfish, the woven snail that accumulates tetrodotoxin and paralytic toxins, the heart cowry, blue-ringed octopus, and box jellyfish. Practical safety tips: avoid unfamiliar seafood, buy from reputable markets, keep raw and cooked items separate, ensure thorough cooking to at least 100°C for several minutes, and limit raw intake for the elderly, children, pregnant women, and those with weak digestion.

triage.headline_ja: 海鮮購入時に毒ガニが混入し大惨事になりかけた事例、カニのシーズンに注意すべき海の「毒物」
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、カニ・貝類等の毒素や腸炎ビブリオに関する一般的な食品安全啓発記事であるため、シグナルとして扱う根拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事は食品安全に関する季節的な注意喚起であり、Vibrio parahaemolyticus感染症の具体的な発生報告やアウトブレイク事例は記載されていない。地理的分布は毒性生物の生息域の一般説明であり、特定国での発生事例ではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Minas Gerais investiga mortes por febre maculosa após caso confirmado em Jeceaba : Linkezine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais investigates deaths from Brazilian Spotted Fever after a confirmed case in Jeceaba: Linkezine.
article.articleSummary: Minas Gerais authorities are investigating a death from Brazilian Spotted Fever (febre maculosa) in Jeceaba, central Minas Gerais, with two additional cases under investigation. Authorities intensified surveillance after capybaras were seen along a river, prompting the temporary closure of public spaces near tick-prone areas since Thursday (3). Acaricide applications and informational signage were deployed; city health staff were trained to recognize compatible symptoms and investigate exposures to ticks. The state's health department monitors the situation; overall in Minas Gerais, through August, there were 36 confirmed cases and 11 deaths from Brazilian Spotted Fever, a tick-borne illness that can become severe. Early symptoms include fever, severe headache, muscle pains, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain. Prevention guidance emphasizes long clothing, closed shoes, repellents, and careful tick removal; treatment is provided free of charge through Brazil's Unified Health System (SUS).

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州、ジェセアバでの確定例後にブラジル紅斑熱による死亡を調査
triage.triage_reason: ミナスジェライス州で紅斑熱（ダニ媒介性）の死亡例が確認され、州全体で36例・11死亡と重症度が高いため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: ブラジル紅斑熱（Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever相当）はダニ媒介性で人-人感染はないが、致死率が高く（11/36）、州保健当局が調査・監視・薬剤散布などの対応を実施中。地域内の風土病的発生であり国際的拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: DR콩고·접경 9개국 중점검역관리지역 관리...에볼라 확산대비
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo and nine neighboring countries: management of priority quarantine zones... to prevent the spread of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) risk management: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency designates DR Congo and nine neighboring countries as priority quarantine management areas in Q3 2026, applying risk-based, dual-track measures. WHO classifies DR Congo as high risk and its border neighbors, including Uganda and South Sudan, as high risk; Kenya is deemed low risk and will be de-listed. Following a surge in DR Congo’s outbreaks since mid-July, Uganda’s outbreak was declared over on Aug 27, 2026, but cross-border reintroduction remains possible. Incoming travelers who visited risk areas must complete health status forms or use Q-CODE; SMS guidance is provided at departure and arrival, and overseas travel history data link to local health networks to activate community surveillance. For DR Congo entrants from large outbreaks, pre-registered transit passenger lists enable gate screening and post-entry active surveillance for up to 21 days. Ethiopia, Korea’s direct-flight partner, remains a priority risk region.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴおよび国境を接する9か国を重点検疫管理地域に指定…エボラ拡大に備える
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴでエボラ出血熱の症例が7月中旬以降急増しWHOが高リスクと分類、国境を越えた再流入リスクも指摘されており、複数のIHR基準（深刻性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航対策）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国政府の検疫対応策が主題だが、DRコンゴでのエボラ流行拡大とWHOによる高リスク分類、周辺国への越境拡散リスクという実際の感染症イベントを背景としている。ウガンダ・ケニア・エチオピア・南スーダン・韓国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: "에볼라 유입 막는다"...DR콩고·접경국 검역 차등 강화
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Prevent Ebola importation"... DR Congo and border countries strengthen differentiated quarantine measures.
article.articleSummary: KDCA designated the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and nine neighboring border countries as Ebola-focused quarantine management regions, implementing differentiated border controls by country risk. From mid-July to late August, DRC confirmed Ebola cases rose from 1,926 to 6,186 with 3,007 deaths, and the outbreak expanded to six provinces; contact-tracing coverage remained under 25%. Although WHO declared Uganda’s Ebola outbreak ended, Uganda borders DRC, leaving reimport risk. WHO rated DRC risk as very high and its land-border neighbors as high. Kenya is removed from the quarantine region; Ethiopia remains a core focus due to its status as Africa’s largest air-transit hub and its direct flights to Korea, making entrants from risk areas transit through it. Entrants from risk countries must report health status via Q-code or health questionnaire; DRC entrants receive targeted gate screening and 21-day active surveillance. KDCA has activated SMS health-status reporting and the DUR-ITS system.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラ流入を防ぐ」...DRコンゴ・接壌国の検疫、差等強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ症例が1,926件から6,186件（死者3,007人）へ急増し6州に拡大、接触追跡率が25%未満と管理が不十分であり、国際的な検疫強化措置が取られていることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ拡大と韓国当局（KDCA）による検疫対応強化に関するもの。ウガンダ・エチオピア・ケニアも言及されるが対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Suvendu Adhikari shares curb-dengue report card, three-day sanitation drive spotlights breeding hubs
article.articleSummary: West Bengal faces ongoing dengue concerns as monsoon rains threaten fresh breeding grounds. In a three‑day statewide cleanliness and vector-control drive, the Swachhta Sankalp Abhiyan targeted 1,600 wards across 128 municipalities in 22 districts, aiming to curb dengue during the August–October peak. Officials reported desilting 6,065 clogged drains, clearing 1,608 garbage spots and 4,511 roadside dumping points, and treating 27,378 potential breeding sites with larvicidal spraying. The operation extended to high‑footfall areas: 1,106 markets, 1,304 educational institutions, 544 government offices, and 315 health facilities. Over 35,000 IEC materials were distributed, with 118 NGOs participating. Dengue cases in August reached 4,035 with seven deaths; by September 1, year‑to‑date cases were slightly above 4,000, far below last year’s ~7,600 at the same point. Districts Calcutta/Kolkata, Howrah, North 24-Parganas, South 24-Parganas and Murshidabad require intensified surveillance as Aedes aegypti remains the primary vector.

triage.headline_ja: スヴェンドゥ・アディカリ氏、デング対策の成果報告を公表　3日間の衛生活動で発生源に焦点
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州における季節性デングへの通常の行政対応（清掃・防蚊活動）の報告であり、症例数は前年同期比で減少傾向にある。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デングはインド（西ベンガル州）で毎年季節的に発生する既知の風土病であり、本記事は行政による防除活動の成果報告。症例数（年初来約4000件、死亡7名）は前年同期（約7600件）より減少しており、公衆衛生上の重大な逸脱は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: 콩고민주공화국 입국자 선별검역·추적관리...사망자 3천명 넘어
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Arrival screening and quarantine for entrants, and contact tracing and management... Death toll exceeds 3,000.
article.articleSummary: DRC and nine neighboring countries designated as Ebola-focused quarantine management regions by Korea's KDCA to prevent domestic entry of Ebola virus disease. Quarantine measures will be tiered by country risk: entrants from the Democratic Republic of the Congo will undergo screening at arrival and post-arrival contact tracing; travelers who have visited or stayed in high-risk areas such as Uganda and South Sudan must report health status. Kenya has been removed from the quarantine region as Uganda's Ebola outbreak is deemed over, reflecting updated risk assessments. As of 2026-09-07, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola confirmed cases have surged since July, with the death toll exceeding 3,000, and the World Health Organization rates the country’s risk level as very high. Ongoing surveillance and cross-border risk-based measures are emphasized to curb imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：入国者選別検疫・追跡管理…死者数3000人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱死者数が3000人を超え、WHOがリスクを「非常に高い」と評価しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 韓国KDCAによる検疫措置は対象国国内の話であり、実際の感染発生国はDRC（および周辺国だが対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当）。ウガンダの流行は終息と記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: DR콩고 에볼라 확진 6000명 돌파...입국자 검역 강화
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo Ebola-confirmed cases surpass 6,000... entry screening intensified.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola virus disease cases surged to 6,186 as of July 31, from 1,926 in mid‑July, with 3,007 deaths, and spread to six provinces. WHO rated DR Congo’s risk as ‘Very High,’ while nine neighboring land-border countries—Angola, Burundi, Central African Republic, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, Uganda, Zambia, and the Republic of Congo—were classed as High. In response, DR Congo and these neighbors are designated as key quarantine management regions with border-specific controls. Entrants from DR Congo undergo airport screening; upon arrival, health status is reported via electronic Q-CODE and a health-status questionnaire, and 21 days of active surveillance follow. DUR-ITS enables sharing of travel history with healthcare facilities. Transit arrivals are screened at entry gates. Uganda’s outbreak end on July 27 led to inclusion in high-risk zones; Kenya is low risk and excluded, while Ethiopia remains a quarantine region due to its role as a major African air hub and a direct route to Korea.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ、エボラ確定症例が6,000人を突破…入国者検疫を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴでエボラ確定症例が6,186人、死亡3,007人に急増し6州に拡大、WHOが「非常に高い」リスク評価を行い周辺国も高リスクに分類、複数国で検疫措置が強化されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事内でザンビア・アンゴラ・中央アフリカ・エチオピア・ルワンダ・タンザニア・ケニア・ブルンジ・ウガンダは『リスク分類（周辺国としての高リスク評価）』として言及されているのみで、実際の症例発生は確認されていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Las exportaciones de cerdo de EE. UU. caen en julio por Aujeszky
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. pork exports fall in July due to Aujeszky's disease.
article.articleSummary: U.S. pork exports in July fell to 224,305 tonnes (−6% YoY) and $641.8 million (−6%), after restrictions tied to Aujeszky’s disease found in pig viscera. Restrictions were lifted mid-to-late July, but monthly results remained weak. Exports rose to Japan, Central America, Colombia, and Canada, yet declined to Mexico (which rebounded in July but stayed below year-ago levels as production resumed) and to China, Korea, Oceania, and the ASEAN region. The per-head carcass value was $62.53, below the prior year but $3 above June. Through July, year-to-date shipments reached 1.73 million tonnes valued at $4.86 billion, up ~2% in volume and ~1% in value versus the same period last year, keeping annual pace above 2025. USMEF president Dan Halstrom credited lifting the viscera restrictions as critical, noting China’s earlier stricter inspections creating delays, which have been resolved.

triage.headline_ja: アウエスキー病の影響で7月の米国豚肉輸出が減少
triage.triage_reason: 米国産豚の内臓から検出されたアウエスキー病（偽狂犬病）による貿易制限とその後の豚肉輸出統計に関する経済記事であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の影響は認められない。対象国での疾病発生も確認されない。
triage.notes: Pseudorabies（アウエスキー病）は豚の疾病でヒトには感染しない動物疾病。記事は米国産豚肉の輸出統計・貿易動向に関する経済記事であり、中国・韓国・日本等は輸出先国として言及されているのみで、疾病発生国ではない。対象国での発生事例は確認されず、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: 질병청, 아프리카 에볼라 확산에 '국가별 위험도' 따라 검역 차등화
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: KDCA to Differentiate Quarantine Measures by Country-Specific Risk Levels Amid Ebola Outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa prompts Korea's KDCA to tier quarantine by country risk. As of the end of last month, DR Congo has 6,186 cumulative Ebola cases and 3,007 deaths, while Uganda has declared the outbreak over since July 16 following the last patient discharge. WHO rates DR Congo risk as Very High. Consequently, arrivals from DR Congo will face strengthened screening: health status declaration, entry screening at gates, and 21-day active surveillance. Travelers from nine neighboring countries—Uganda, Rwanda, Tanzania, and others—face comparatively relaxed checks, requiring only a health-status declaration on entry. Kenya is de-listed from the elevated risk category, now deemed Low risk. Ethiopia remains a Special Quarantine Management Area due to its role as Africa’s largest air hub and direct link to Korea. KDCA Director Im Seung-kwan emphasizes low domestic import risk for now but notes ongoing monitoring and urges travelers to follow precautions and report symptoms via 1339 or local health centers.

triage.headline_ja: 疾病管理庁、アフリカでのエボラ拡大を受け『国別リスク評価』に基づき検疫措置を差別化
triage.triage_reason: DRCで累計6,186例・死亡3,007例という大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、WHOがVery Highと評価、複数国が渡航制限・検疫強化措置を実施している国際的公衆衛生上の懸念事象である。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国の検疫対応に関するものだが、根底にあるDRCでの大規模エボラ流行（累計6,186例、死亡3,007例、WHO評価Very High）が国際的な公衆衛生上の重大事象であるためPICKUPと判定。ウガンダは7月16日をもって流行終息を宣言済み。ケニアはリスク区分から除外され低リスクに変更。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみで、他の言及国（ウガンダ、ルワンダ、タンザニア、ケニア、エチオピア、韓国）はリスト対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 开学季，传染病防控知多少？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Back-to-School Season: How Much Do You Know About Infectious Disease Prevention and Control?
article.articleSummary: Back-to-school season in China highlights prevention of respiratory, mosquito-borne, and gastrointestinal infections. COVID-19 remains common due to Omicron variants, with symptoms including fever, sore throat, myalgia, and dry cough; most cases are mild, but prompt diagnosis helps prevent severe illness. Seasonal influenza (Victoria B lineage, H3N2 A) presents with fever and cough; seek care for suspected cases. Prevention emphasizes isolation of ill individuals, ventilation, hand hygiene, masking when needed, and vaccination for COVID-19 and influenza. Mosquito-borne diseases include dengue fever, peaking in summer–autumn with imported cases reported across provinces such as Guangdong, Yunnan, Fujian, Zhejiang, Guangxi, and Hainan; symptoms include fever, myalgia, rash, and possible hemorrhage. Japanese encephalitis is also in season; transmission via Culex after livestock amplification; high fever, confusion, seizures; JE vaccine recommended; no dengue vaccine. For gastrointestinal infections, bacterial dysentery and acute gastroenteritis rise in warm months, causing abdominal pain, diarrhea, and fever; hand-foot-mouth disease affects children under 5, with hygiene and EV71/dysentery vaccines where available.

triage.headline_ja: 開学シーズン、感染症予防対策をどれだけ知っていますか？
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な感染症予防啓発記事であり、新規性・異常性のある特定のアウトブレイクを報告するものではないため、通常の公衆衛生広報として見送り。
triage.notes: 季節性の感染症（COVID-19、季節性インフルエンザ、デング熱、日本脳炎、手足口病など）に関する予防啓発記事であり、特定の異常な発生や急増を報告するものではない。デング熱の輸入症例が複数省で報告されているが、通常の季節的パターンとして記載されており緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Punjab records 1st suspected swine flu death amid 220 confirmed cases
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) in Punjab, India: 220 confirmed H1N1 cases this year; an 85-year-old man from Jamsher Khas, Jalandhar, died during treatment at Jalandhar Civil Hospital, marking the first suspected swine flu fatality of the season. The patient had COPD and was immuno-compromised; the exact cause will be determined after a health audit. He tested positive for H1N1 after an initial admission for breathing difficulties, following a Sept 2 hospitalization at Government Medical College Amritsar and discharge Sept 4 before deterioration and readmission in Jalandhar. Punjab has tested 1,513 suspected cases since January; 14 new cases were reported on Friday. District-wise cases: Ludhiana 72, Mohali (SAS Nagar) 36, Patiala 16, Moga 11, Jalandhar 10, Rupnagar 9, Fazilka 1; other districts report 2–8 each. Ongoing rise in infections indicates active transmission.

triage.headline_ja: パンジャブ州、確認症例220件の中で最初の疑い豚インフルエンザ死亡例を記録
triage.triage_reason: インド・パンジャブ州における季節性H1N1の国内流行で、感染拡大は続いているが国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められず、社会的・政治的関心の高まりも確認できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)のパンジャブ州における継続的な流行報告。高齢で基礎疾患（COPD、免疫不全）のある患者の死亡例であり、重症度・拡大リスクの評価には追加情報（他地域への波及、致死率の推移等）が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: la province du Nord-Kivu confrontée à une forte hausse des nouveaux cas d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: the North Kivu Province facing a sharp rise in new Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's North Kivu province intensified from Aug 30 to Sep 3, 2026. Confirmed cases rose from 836 to 969, a gain of 133. About 422 cases were added nationwide in that period, nearly one third from North Kivu. From Aug 31, the province reported 20–32 new confirmations daily, with 16 of 34 health zones now affected, including Kayna—the only province to gain a new zone in the five-day window. Case fatality reached about 66% (638 of 969 diagnosed) versus 48% nationally. The 220 beds in treatment centers were over capacity (>100%) on all six days observed, and on Sept 3 more than half of NK patients were treated in facilities not dedicated to Ebola. Ituri remains the national epicenter, but North Kivu now shows the strongest expansion signals.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：北キブ州でエボラ新規感染者が急増
triage.triage_reason: エボラ感染者数が5日間で133例増加し、致死率66%、病床占有率100%超という深刻な公衆衛生上の危機であり、新規保健区域への拡大も確認されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 北キブ州で1日20〜32例の新規確定例が続き、34保健区域中16区域に拡大。治療センターの病床（220床）は観測期間全日で定員超過となり、患者の半数以上が専用施設外で治療されている。国全体の致死率48%に対し北キブ州は66%と高く、対応能力が逼迫している可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 广州多人用餐后呕吐腹泻 专家提醒_央广网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many people in Guangzhou experience vomiting and diarrhea after meals; experts warn.
article.articleSummary: Guangzhou's Da Le Food Industry Co. apologized after several diners at the Da Le restaurant in Panyu's Tianhe City Mall reported vomiting, diarrhea and fever; one child was admitted to ICU with suspected food poisoning. On Sept 5, health authorities inspected the site; environmental and food samples were collected, and a child’s stool sample reportedly tested positive for Salmonella. The restaurant temporarily suspended operations as investigations continue. An infectious-disease physician from Sun Yat-sen University Third Hospital explained that Salmonella is an enteric bacterium transmitted via contaminated food and water; eggs can be a key source when contamination occurs before shell formation, and meat, eggs, and dairy are high-risk. Preventive measures include storing raw meat at -18°C or below and ready-to-eat eggs/dairy at ≤4°C, cooking poultry to >100°C for at least 15 seconds, and ensuring eggs are fully cooked. Discard leftover high-risk items such as homemade mayonnaise, tiramisu, mousse, Eggs Benedict, and battered foods. Seek hospital care for fever, abdominal pain, or watery diarrhea to confirm infection.

triage.headline_ja: 広州で複数人が食事後に嘔吐・下痢、専門家が注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 単一レストランでのサルモネラ食中毒の局地的発生であり、公衆衛生上の広範な脅威や国際的拡大の兆候はないが、重症例(ICU入院)があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 疾患名にParatyphoid/Typhoidとあるが、記事本文はサルモネラ食中毒（単一レストランでの集団食中毒事案）に関するもので、腸チフス・パラチフスの症例は言及されていない。BluedotのAI分類ミスの可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Bị chó nhà cắn, xét nghiệm ra dương tính với vi rút dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bitten by a domestic dog, tested positive for the rabies virus.
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak in Dong Thap Province, Vietnam: A man, Nguyen Tan Duong, was bitten by a domestic dog while feeding it on August 30. The dog died a few hours later; testing by the National Center for Veterinary Diagnosis and Testing II confirmed rabies. This marks the 11th dog rabies outbreak in Dong Thap this year, with 12 infected or culled dogs to date. Earlier in August, a family’s pet dog bit a boy; the animal died August 23 and tested positive for rabies. By early September 2026, Vietnam recorded 51 rabies deaths nationwide, with 27 in the southern region. Dr. Nguyen Ba Trieu, Deputy Head of Planning at Tien Giang General Hospital, warned that once clinical rabies appears, survival is unlikely, and vaccination after exposure must not be delayed. Immediate wound cleaning and medical evaluation are essential; pet owners should vaccinate, avoid free-roaming dogs, and enforce vaccination programs.

triage.headline_ja: 飼い犬に噛まれ、狂犬病ウイルス陽性と判明
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ドンタップ省で狂犬病による死亡例が継続的に発生しており重症度は高いが、国内の風土病的な繰り返し事例であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムで風土病化しており、ドンタップ省では今年11件目の犬狂犬病発生。全国で51人の死亡が報告されているが、記事は個別事例と国内統計の紹介にとどまり、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: 婴幼儿RSV病毒常年潜伏，秋冬高发！专家：9月为最佳注射单抗期
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RSV persists year-round in infants and young children, with a peak in autumn and winter! Experts: September is the best time to administer monoclonal antibodies.
article.articleSummary: RSV remains a year-round threat to infants in Hunan, China, with a peak from October to April; it causes bronchiolitis and pneumonia, leading to hospitalizations and potential long-term respiratory problems in very young children. The long-acting monoclonal antibody, nirsevimab, first launched in Beijing and Shanghai in 2024 and landed in Hunan on September 1, is a passive immunization that provides immediate protection after a single injection and is voluntary/self-paid. The best window is September to cover the autumn-winter peak; all infants under 1 year may be evaluated for eligibility. The aim is to prevent severe disease and hospitalization, though it does not block all mild RSV infections. Ongoing precautions—hand hygiene, ventilation, reducing crowded indoor settings, isolating sick family members—remain important. Availability is at major centers such as Hunan Maternal and Child Health Hospital and Hunan Children’s Hospital; global use exceeds 11 million infants.

triage.headline_ja: 乳幼児のRSVウイルスは年間を通じて潜伏し、秋冬に流行のピーク！専門家：9月がモノクローナル抗体接種の最適時期
triage.triage_reason: 季節性RSVに関する予防啓発・医療情報記事であり、異常な流行やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、IHR・WPRO基準ともに該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性RSVの予防接種（モノクローナル抗体nirsevimab）に関する健康啓発情報であり、感染症の異常発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Bhutan Is the First South-East Asian Nation Declared Rabies-Free by WHO
article.articleSummary: As of 7 September 2026, Bhutan becomes the first country in WHO South-East Asia Region to be validated for eliminating dog-transmitted human rabies as a public health problem. The achievement stems from a One Health strategy aligning human and veterinary services: mass dog vaccination, disease surveillance, laboratory diagnosis, and community engagement, with field investigations and rapid response to exposures. WHO conducted a two-phase technical review (Aug 17–22) with WOAH support, visiting facilities and the Bhutan-India border to confirm sustained systems for detection and prevention. Rabies remains fatal after symptom onset, but dog-mediated transmission is preventable through vaccination and timely post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). Bhutan plans to maintain vaccination coverage, surveillance, lab capacity, and access to PEP, financed by the Bhutan Health Trust Fund and partners, acknowledging continued reintroduction risks at borders.

triage.headline_ja: ブータン、WHOにより東南アジア地域で初の狂犬病撲滅認定国に
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の排除達成を伝えるポジティブな公衆衛生成果の報道であり、公衆衛生上の脅威や異常事態ではないため対応不要。
triage.notes: ブータンは対象国リストに含まれず、インドは記事の主題（狂犬病流行）ではなく国境確認の文脈で言及されているのみのため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue Control Measures Scaled Up in Floral Units in Kovai
article.articleSummary: As of 7 September 2026, dengue control measures have been scaled up in Coimbatore (Kovai) with inspections of 57 ornamental plant and croton units across five zones by the Coimbatore Corporation. Officials checked whether hygienic practices were followed in nurseries and floral sellers, part of intensified mosquito eradication activities being conducted citywide. The inspections targeted prevention of Aedes breeding around nurseries and in related water-holding items. Nurseries and ornamental plant sellers were instructed to ensure that water does not stagnate in trays, pots, and similar items, and to maintain day-to-day vigilance to prevent mosquito proliferation. The effort underscores a proactive push to curb dengue transmission by eliminating breeding sites in commercial horticulture areas within the corporation limits.

triage.headline_ja: コンバトールの生花業者でデング対策強化
triage.triage_reason: これは通常の予防的な蚊媒介対策活動の報道であり、大規模な感染拡大や異常な公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による定例的なデング熱予防活動（園芸業者への衛生指導・蚊の発生源対策）に関する報道であり、症例数や流行状況についての言及はない。対象国リストのIndiaが発生地域だが、内容が予防措置に限定されるためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Manila declares leptospirosis epidemic as cases surge
article.articleSummary: Manila declares leptospirosis epidemic after cases surpass epidemiologic threshold; attack rate rises to 3.48% from 1.27% week-on-week. Data from the Manila Health Department show rapid case growth, with district hospitals Ospital ng Maynila, Sta. Ana Hospital, and Justice Jose Abad Santos General Hospital at full capacity amid ongoing patient inflow. Mayor Isko Moreno Domagoso orders an intensified leptospirosis campaign, including public information efforts and free doxycycline capsules in 44 health centers and seven district hospitals. City health officials plan to mobilize the Manila Health Department and its 896 barangays to reach residents affected by flooding in recent weeks and distribute doxycycline to those potentially exposed. OIC-City Health Officer Dr. Grace Padilla reported the epidemic level to the mayor, prompting alert and resource allocation to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: マニラ、症例急増によりレプトスピラ症の流行を宣言
triage.triage_reason: マニラ市がレプトスピラ症の流行を公式宣言し、罹患率が週単位で急増（1.27%→3.48%）、複数病院が満床となるなど公衆衛生への影響が大きく、市長主導の大規模対応が行われているため社会的・行政的関心が高い。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は洪水後にフィリピンで季節的に発生する人獣共通感染症であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はないため国際的拡大リスクは低い。ただし症例急増と医療機関の逼迫を受け、市当局が正式に流行を宣言し大規模な対応（doxycycline配布、896のバランガイでの啓発活動等）を行っている点で公衆衛生上の懸念は高い。

article.articleHeadline: "Chặn" bệnh tay chân miệng từ trường học trong những ngày đầu năm học mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Preventing Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease from Schools in the Early Days of the New School Year
article.articleSummary: As of 7 September 2026, Vietnam’s surveillance reports nearly 100,000 hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) cases in the first eight months, about 2.5 times higher than the same period last year. In the last four weeks, new cases have remained high in Ho Chi Minh City, Dong Nai, Dong Thap, Tay Ninh, Lam Dong, Da Nang, and Hanoi. HFMD mainly affects children under 5, especially those in nurseries and kindergartens, which account for roughly 87.3% of cases. The Ministry of Health calls for stronger hygiene and early detection in educational settings, coordinating with the Ministry of Education and local authorities. Measures include ongoing handwashing promotion, ensuring clean environments, well-ventilated, well-lit classrooms, and the “3 clean” principle (eat clean, live clean, hands clean) in child care centers. Schools should routinely clean surfaces and report suspected cases promptly to health authorities; outbreaks in one class should trigger local guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 新学期初旬、学校からの手足口病を「阻止」
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでのHFMD症例数が前年同期比約2.5倍に急増し、保健省と教育省が学校での対策強化に乗り出すなど、異常な増加と多部門の関心が確認されるためフルRRAでの精査が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はEnterovirus71関連のタグがあるが、重症例・死亡例の記載はなし。今後の症例重症度や地域拡大の続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Fever spike grips Hyderabad, but dengue cases remain low
article.articleSummary: Hyderabad is experiencing a fever surge over the past two to three weeks, with clinics reporting 25-30 fever patients daily and high-grade fevers of 104-105°F. Despite the spike, dengue positivity remains low, with only about one positive dengue case in every 40-50 tests and most patients testing negative for dengue markers while platelet counts are typically normal. The symptomatic presentation - persistent fever, severe body and joint pain, headaches, fatigue lasting several days - suggests a viral fever circulating in the community. Families are falling ill, likely linked to seasonal viral infections, fluctuating weather, travel, and crowded public spaces. Public health officials note that the overall fever trend this year is lower than last year (IHIP data) and continue fever surveillance, testing, and sanitation efforts. Clinicians warn against self-medication and urge early evaluation to rule out dengue, typhoid, and other infections.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバードで発熱患者が急増するも、デング熱の陽性率は低いまま
triage.triage_reason: 季節性ウイルス性発熱の流行であり、デング熱・腸チフスの陽性率はむしろ低く、公衆衛生当局も前年より発熱傾向は低いと評価しているため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の疾患の異常な流行ではなく、原因不明のウイルス性発熱の季節的増加を報告している。デング熱・腸チフスは除外診断として言及されているのみで、実際の陽性率は低い。

article.articleHeadline: В Иркутском округе уничтожат почти сотню коров из-за вспышки дерматита
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Irkutsk District, nearly a hundred cows will be culled due to a dermatitis outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Bovine nodular dermatitis (Lumpy Skin Disease) outbreak in Irkutsk Municipal District, Russia. Over 20 infected private farms identified as of 7 September 2026. A cull will destroy 96 cows in the villages of Butyrki and Koty. A state of emergency is declared. Quarantine zones are defined: core zone within 3 km including Oyok, Butyrki, Koty; risk zone within 10 km extending to Khomutovo, Maksimovshchina, Galki, Pozdnyakova, Revykina, Sosnovy Bor, Cheremushka, Zherdovka, Kashtak, Zykova. In Butyrki, grazing is forbidden; movement restricted; meat, milk, and feed transport prohibited. Entrance is limited to local residents and state veterinary staff only. Unscheduled vaccination of livestock is planned in affected areas. Governor Igor Kobzev pledged compensation to farmers for cattle losses. Public health officials emphasize strict quarantine boundaries to prevent spread via transport and people.

triage.headline_ja: イルクーツク管区で皮膚炎の発生により約100頭の牛が殺処分される
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州における牛のランピースキン病（動物疾病）の発生であり、対象国リストに該当する国での人への健康影響は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本疾患は動物（牛）のみに影響するランピースキン病であり、ヒトへの感染性はない。発生地域リストにIndonesia(West Nusa Tenggara)が含まれるが、記事本文はロシア・イルクーツク州の事案のみを扱っており、インドネシアでの発生は確認できないため対象外。ロシアは評価対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Cao điểm mùa mưa, TPHCM liên tục tiếp nhận trẻ sốt xuất huyết nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Peak of the rainy season, Ho Chi Minh City continues to admit children with severe dengue.
article.articleSummary: On 7 September 2026, Ho Chi Minh City hospitals report rising severe dengue admissions among children. Two TP. HCM cases illustrate dengue shock syndrome with multi-organ failure. H.C.K., 7, from Tan Tao, was admitted after 5 days of fever with dengue shock, coagulopathy, GI bleeding, and hepatic injury (ALT/AST >1,500 U/L). He required IV fluids, colloids, albumin, vasopressors, abdominal drainage, mechanical ventilation, blood products, and liver support; developed ascites and pleural effusions, and improved after ~2 weeks with normalised liver function. D.T.T.V., 10, from Mỹ Đức, An Giang, had fever for 4 days; on day 5 developed shock with cold extremities. ALT >2,000 U/L; creatinine >400 μmol/L. He needed intubation, continuous renal replacement therapy and plasma exchange, with four CRRT sessions and three plasmaphereses over nearly 3 weeks, then recovered and was extubated. A 23-year-old pregnant dengue patient required four surgeries including hysterectomy for hemorrhage, liver failure, and shock. Public health advice stresses mosquito control and seeking care for fever lasting >2 days.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季のピーク、ホーチミン市で重症デング熱の小児患者受け入れが相次ぐ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は同地域で毎年流行する既知の疾患で異常性は低いが、重症例（ショック、多臓器不全）が続いている点は注視が必要。国際的拡大や渡航制限の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムの雨季における季節性流行であり、既知のパターン。ただし重症例（多臓器不全、集中治療を要する症例）の集積は医療体制への負荷を示唆し、続報の確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: دخول 7 مدارس جديدة وحملة للتطعيم ضد الحصبة الألمانية بالأقصر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Opening of seven new schools and a rubella vaccination campaign in Luxor.
article.articleSummary: Luxor Governorate prepares for the 2026/2027 academic year with seven new schools entering service, delivering 111 classrooms as part of expansion, replacement, and refurbishment of existing facilities. The seven campuses span Qurna, Esna, Al-Tod, Armant, Beiya, and Al-Zinia, including Nag Hassan Primary (Qurna) with 7 rooms; Esna Secondary Vocational (15); Al-Adisat in Al-Tod (12); Khaled bin Al-Walid in Al-Dobaya, Qurna (16); Al-Hurriya Primary in Armant (12); Al-Nasr Preparatory in Beiya (30); Al-Hurriya Primary in Al-Zinia (19). Administrative handover has been completed and equipment procurement finalized prior to school start. On the health front, Luxor Health Directorate is launching a three-week national vaccination campaign against measles and rubella targeting Egyptian and non-Egyptian children within the specified ages, with teams deployed outside clinics to centers, mosques, churches, and community sites. Public awareness campaigns via media and loudspeakers will facilitate access to remote areas. The governor urged coordinators to remove obstacles to ensure a smooth, safe school opening.

triage.headline_ja: ルクソールで新校舎7校の開校と風疹ワクチン接種キャンペーン
triage.triage_reason: エジプト・ルクソールでの定期的な麻疹・風疹予防接種キャンペーンの案内記事であり、対象国（中国・エジプトは対象国リスト外）でのアウトブレイク報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はエジプト・ルクソールでの学校開校と定期予防接種キャンペーンであり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当する発生国はない。発生地域に中国（Gansu Sheng, Beiya）が含まれるが、記事内容はエジプトの地名（Beiya, Armant等）と重複しており、実際には中国での事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh giác cúm, RSV ở người bệnh tim mạch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be vigilant for influenza and RSV in patients with cardiovascular disease.
article.articleSummary: Influenza and RSV infections markedly affect patients with cardiovascular disease. Fever, tachycardia, dyspnea and hypoxia can destabilize heart failure and coronary artery disease. WHO notes higher severity risk for influenza in people with chronic conditions; RSV infection raises hospitalization risk in those with pre-existing heart disease. A NEJM study shows the first seven days after influenza confirmation carry about a sixfold higher risk of hospitalization for acute myocardial infarction; a JAMA Network Open study reports increased cardiovascular events after RSV, especially among those with CVD. Vaccination and infection control are essential: the American Heart Association endorses annual influenza vaccination for coronary artery disease and includes vaccination in heart failure care. In Vietnam, the Vietnamese Respiratory Society advises RSV vaccination for people 60+, especially with heart disease, after assessment. World Heart Day health program, Sep 18, 2026, at Ho Chi Minh City University of Medicine and Pharmacy Hospital.

triage.headline_ja: 心血管疾患患者はインフルエンザ・RSVに注意
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクではなく、心血管疾患患者に対するインフルエンザ・RSV感染への注意喚起と啓発イベントの案内であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や緊急性を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性インフルエンザ・RSVと心血管疾患の関連性に関する医学的啓発記事および世界心臓デー啓発イベントの告知であり、感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: மாநகராட்சி சார்பில் சிறப்பு முகாம்கள் மூலம் 2 லட்சம் தெரு நாய்களுக்கு ரேபிஸ் தடுப்பூசி செலுத்த இலக்கு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Municipal Corporation targets vaccinating two lakh street dogs against rabies through special camps
article.articleSummary: Chennai Municipal Corporation launched a mega drive to vaccinate two lakh stray dogs against rabies via special camps, begun August 11. Four zones—Thiruvottiyur, Manali, Tiruvottiyur? (Thiruvottiyur), Tondiarpet, and Royapuram—have administered rabies vaccines and anti-flea/anti-tick medicines to all street dogs, with Madhavaram and Ambattur zones subsequently joining the effort across streets, schools, and hospitals. To date, 60,216 street dogs have been vaccinated. The highest progress is 12,684 in Tondiarpet and 11,895 in Ambattur. Currently, Madhavaram and Ambattur zones operate ten teams per day; other zones will implement similar camps. The initiative targets completion within 50 working days and aims to reach about 200,000 dogs, moving Chennai toward a rabies-free status, per the press release.

triage.headline_ja: 市が特別キャンプを通じて野良犬20万匹に狂犬病ワクチンを接種する目標を設定
triage.triage_reason: これは予防的な動物ワクチン接種活動に関する行政広報であり、ヒトへの感染拡大や異常な公衆衛生事象を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は動物（野良犬）へのワクチン接種の予防活動を報じる行政発表であり、ヒト感染症例の報告はない。対象国リストにインドは含まれるが、内容が疾病発生ではなく予防事業のためDISMISSと判断。

article.articleHeadline: गाय कम दे रही है दूध? कहीं इस बीमारी की चपेट में तो नहीं है आपकी मवेशी, जानें
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is your cow producing less milk? Could your livestock be affected by this disease? Find out.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is impacting dairy cattle in Palamu district, India, with sudden milk yield reductions in cows and buffaloes. Infected animals may develop fever (up to 105–106°F), mouth ulcers, and hoof lesions; severe cases can weaken animals, reducing milk production. FMD is highly contagious, so early detection and isolation are essential. Veterinary authorities advise diligent oral care, including neem-leaf decoctions, clean water, soft fodder, and home measures like alum and turmeric. Hoof wounds require a clean, dry enclosure and veterinary care if infection or parasites appear; avoid applying turpentine oil or unverified ointments. Vaccination remains the most effective prevention, with six-monthly FMD vaccines distributed under government programs. Timely diagnosis, treatment and vaccination help protect animal health and dairy output.

triage.headline_ja: 牛の乳量が減っていませんか？その家畜、この病気にかかっているかも――知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫はインド・パラム県の家畜（乳牛・水牛）における一般的な農業向け情報記事であり、ヒトへの健康影響や公衆衛生上の緊急性は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は動物衛生・農業向けの一般的な予防啓発情報であり、ヒトの公衆衛生リスクは記載されていない。口蹄疫はヒトへの感染例が稀であることからもリスクは低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: 抗菌薬効かない薬剤耐性菌、北海道で渡り鳥ふんから検出　摂南大など
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Antibiotic-resistant bacteria that are not affected by antibiotics detected in migratory bird droppings in Hokkaido, Setsunan University and others.
article.articleSummary: Antibiotic-resistant Stenotrophomonas maltophilia was detected in droppings from migratory great black-backed gulls breeding in Akkeshi, Hokkaido, that travel between Hokkaido and East Asia, by a team including Setsunan University; findings were reported in a U.S. scientific journal by September 7, 2026. The bacterium, known to cause pneumonia and bloodstream infections in immunocompromised individuals and linked to severe COVID-19 outcomes, showed resistance to two antibiotics commonly used against it. Genetic analyses indicated some strains possess traits that help them evade drugs via protective membranes and enhanced motility. Several detected strains are of types not previously reported in Japan, suggesting possible introduction from overseas. The gulls are omnivorous and forage widely, potentially acquiring bacteria from diverse environments. The researchers argue that antibiotic resistance issues should account for migratory birds in cross-border spread and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 抗菌薬効かない薬剤耐性菌、北海道で渡り鳥ふんから検出　摂南大など
triage.triage_reason: 北海道の渡り鳥ふんからの薬剤耐性菌検出に関する学術研究報告であり、実際のヒト感染事例や急性の公衆衛生イベントではない。また発生国（日本）は対象国リストに含まれない。
triage.notes: 本記事は薬剤耐性菌の環境モニタリング研究であり、ヒトの感染事例発生を報じるものではない。発生地域は日本（北海道）であり対象国リストに含まれず、中国は渡り鳥の渡来ルートとして言及されているのみで実際のイベント発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 開學後腸病毒單週就診破8千人 估疫情持續攀高
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enterovirus-related visits exceed 8,000 in a single week after schools reopen; outbreak expected to continue rising.
article.articleSummary: Last week in Taiwan, enterovirus activity remained high after schools reopened, with ED/clinic visits over 8,300—up 17% from the prior week—and officials warn the outbreak may continue rising; whether weekly visits exceed 12,000 (the epidemic threshold) remains under watch. Enterovirus D68 drives most severe domestic cases, second only to EV71 in risk. Seven severe cases have been recorded this year, including five D68, one Coxsackie A4, and one A16, with one death. D68 commonly causes fever, runny nose, and cough, but can progress to pneumonia, encephalitis, acute flaccid weakness, and rare respiratory failure. No vaccine or specific antiviral exists; prevention centers on thorough soap-and-water handwashing (10–20 seconds) and avoiding crowded places. Children under 5 are high-risk. Nearby Vietnam, Thailand, Singapore are rising; Korea has peaked and declined; Vietnam nears 100,000 cases this year with 10 deaths. Severe signs include drowsiness, confusion, limb weakness, seizures, persistent vomiting, rapid breathing, or tachycardia—seek hospital care.

triage.headline_ja: 開学後、腸病毒（エンテロウイルス）関連受診が週8000件超え　疫病流行は今後も上昇の見込み
triage.triage_reason: 台湾で腸病毒（エンテロウイルスD68/EV71等）の流行が拡大し重症例・死亡例が発生、周辺国（ベトナム・タイ等）でも同時に流行拡大がみられ地域的拡大の懸念があるためIHR基準2つ該当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（対象国リスト外）だが、周辺国としてベトナム（年間約10万例、死亡10例）とタイ（増加傾向）について具体的な数値言及があるため両国をverified_locationsに含めた。台湾自体は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Doc Talk | Dengue Can Affect The Brain And Nerves: Watch Out For These Warning Signs
article.articleSummary: Dengue can involve the brain and nerves, causing neurological manifestations such as encephalitis, encephalopathy, acute seizures, transverse myelitis, and Guillain-Barré syndrome. Warning signs warranting neurological evaluation in current or recent dengue or flu-like illness include severe, persistent headaches; confusion or disorientation; excessive drowsiness; a seizure; new weakness; and difficulty walking, balancing, or speaking. Early assessment matters, as Guillain-Barré can progress over days and outcomes improve with prompt intervention before respiratory or autonomic involvement. No dengue-specific antiviral exists; management is supportive—hydration, treating the underlying infection, and close monitoring. Prevention relies on vector control, early diagnosis, and awareness across emergency departments and clinics. In July 2026, India’s CDSCO approved the first dengue vaccine—a live, attenuated tetravalent vaccine given in two doses three months apart for ages 4–60—yet it complements, not replaces, vector control or immediate protection this monsoon.

triage.headline_ja: Doc Talk｜デング熱は脳と神経に影響を及ぼす可能性—これらの警告サインに注意
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の神経症状に関する医療啓発記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象を報じるものではないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱の神経学的合併症に関する医学解説記事であり、具体的な発生地域・症例数・アウトブレイク情報は含まれていない。インドでのワクチン承認情報も背景説明として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: 開學後腸病毒單週就診破8千人 估疫情持續攀高
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After school starts, enterovirus-related clinic visits in a single week exceed 8,000; the outbreak is expected to continue rising.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports enterovirus activity after the new school term, with 8,300+ clinic visits last week (up 17% WoW) and a projected rise. Domestic severe cases this year total seven, including one death, with five Enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) and one each Coxsackie A4 and A16 identified. EV-D68 carries a high risk of severe disease, second only to Enterovirus 71; typical EV-D68 symptoms are fever, runny nose, and cough, less often hand-foot-mouth disease, and complications may include pneumonia, meningitis, acute flaccid paralysis, or respiratory failure. No vaccine or antiviral exists; prevention relies on thorough soap-and-water handwashing for 10–20 seconds and avoidance of crowded places. Five-year-olds and younger are high risk; seek urgent hospital care if signs of severe disease appear (somnolence, confusion, lethargy, limb weakness, seizures, persistent vomiting, rapid breathing, or tachycardia). Neighboring Vietnam, Thailand, Singapore report rising activity, with Vietnam approaching 100,000 cases and 10 deaths this year.

triage.headline_ja: 開学後、腸病毒（エンテロウイルス）の受診者数が週8000人を突破、流行は今後さらに拡大する見込み
triage.triage_reason: 台湾で学校再開後にエンテロウイルス（EV-D68含む）の受診者数が急増し重症例・死亡例も発生。ベトナム・タイなど近隣国でも症例増加が報告され、地域的な拡大傾向がみられるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 台湾・シンガポールはBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが対象国リスト外（台湾）または記事で詳細データなし（シンガポール）のためverified_locationsから除外。ベトナムは症例数・死亡者数の具体的言及があり、タイも活動増加の言及があるため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Scrub typhus bacteria found in chiggers and ground birds
article.articleSummary: Scrub typhus, caused by Orientia tsutsugamushi, sickens tens of thousands annually in the Asia-Pacific. A Malaysia–UK–Thailand study provides the first convincing molecular hints that ground-dwelling birds can carry Orientia-related material and that bird-associated chiggers may harbor related genetic elements. Across 14 sites in Peninsular Malaysia and Sarawak, chiggers were collected from red junglefowl, domestic chickens, and rails; pools were screened for the htrA gene by nested PCR and a subset underwent Illumina metagenomic sequencing. Validation with infected Leptotrombidium chiangraiensis chiggers showed near-complete Orientia genome recovery, confirming method viability. In field samples, most chigger pools from birds were negative by both approaches. One pool of Blankaartia acuscutellaris from Lewinia striata yielded Orientia-related contigs but could not assemble core genes, leaving infection unconfirmed. Ongoing evidence in bird tissues showed O. tsutsugamushi DNA in one red junglefowl and one domestic chicken, suggesting potential exposure or carriage and a possible new dimension to scrub typhus ecology.

triage.headline_ja: チガーとジネズミ類の鳥からツツガムシ病菌が発見される
triage.triage_reason: 学術研究レベルの報告であり、公衆衛生上の即時対応事案ではないが、ツツガムシ病の生態学的知見として今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事はマレーシア・英国・タイの共同研究による科学論文の紹介であり、実際の感染事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。マレーシアが研究のフィールド地であるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。タイは共同研究機関として関与しているが、感染発生地ではなく研究協力国としての言及のみ。学術的知見としてツツガムシ病の生態研究の進展を示すもので、直接的な公衆衛生上の緊急対応は不要と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Malawi passenger intercepted with dried rodents, 10kg raw beef at Chicago airport
article.articleSummary: Malawi passenger intercepted at Chicago O'Hare International Airport with more than two pounds of dried African rodents and 22 pounds of raw beef in luggage during routine inspection. Federal agents confiscated and destroyed the items under US agricultural biosecurity rules to prevent introduction of infectious diseases. The passenger's identity has not been released, and no criminal charges have been filed. The seizure underscores restrictions on bushmeat and wildlife products, enforced by CBP, USDA, and CDC to reduce the risk of pathogens such as Ebola. In a similar case last year, a traveler arriving at O'Hare from the Democratic Republic of Congo carried four pounds of wild monkey meat, 11 pounds of insect-infested beans, and 17 pounds of unregistered plant material; these items were confiscated and destroyed, and the traveler was fined $300 after claiming unawareness of import restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: マラウイ人乗客、シカゴ空港で乾燥ネズミ・生牛肉10kgを押収される
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、空港での検疫・密輸品押収に関する報道であり、対象国での感染症発生は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は米国シカゴ空港での密輸品（野生動物由来食品）押収に関するニュースであり、エボラ等の実際の感染症発生事例ではない。DRCは過去事例の言及のみで今回の発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola burial teams battle community anger, fatigue and fear of infection
article.articleSummary: EBOLA burial teams in Ituri, Congo, confront fatigue and community anger as the Bundibugyo virus outbreak spreads across six eastern provinces. Since mid-May, the epidemic has killed nearly 3,200 people among more than 6,500 cases. Burial workers, paid about $20/day, handle bodies exclusively to prevent transmission via blood or bodily fluids; families are barred from traditional rites, fueling attacks and tensions. The true scale is likely three times official reports. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo virus; Evrebo vaccine is used for frontline workers, but its effectiveness against this virus is not proven. The outbreak areas suffer from conflict in Ituri, weak healthcare, and limited contact tracing and laboratory testing, complicating containment and increasing risk of further spread through displacement and movement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ埋葬チーム、地域住民の怒りと疲労、感染への恐怖と戦う
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部6州に拡大し致死率約49%（6500症例中3200人死亡）の大規模エボラ（ブンディブジョウイルス）流行であり、承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、紛争地域で封じ込めが困難なためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 報告数は実際の規模の約3分の1と推定されており、過小評価の可能性が高い。使用中のEvreboワクチンはブンディブジョウイルスに対する有効性が未確認。紛争、医療体制の脆弱性、接触者追跡・検査能力の限界が封じ込めを困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Tiga Pramuria di Warung Remang-remang Kuansing Positif Penyakit Menular Seksual, Satu Masih 15 Tahun
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three sex workers in a dimly lit warung in Kuansing test positive for sexually transmitted diseases; one is still 15 years old.
article.articleSummary: Three sex workers from a dimly lit warung in Kuantan Singingi Regency (Kuansing), Riau, tested positive for syphilis after health screening by Puskesmas on 5 September 2026; the results were reported on 7 September 2026. All three reportedly originated from North Sumatra, with one of the three still 15 years old. The Health Office (Dinkes Kuansing), led by Helma Muliani, notes the STI outbreak linked to late-night venues closed by Satpol PP-PKP Kuansing. The trio will undergo further medical assessment and treatment. Two adult workers refused repatriation to North Sumatra and chose to stay for treatment in Kuansing, while authorities will ensure the 15-year-old is sent home to her family, who have been contacted. The case highlights STI risks associated with sex work venues in the region.

triage.headline_ja: クアンシンの薄暗い酒場の売春婦3人が性感染症陽性、うち1人はまだ15歳
triage.triage_reason: 個別の性感染症（梅毒）事例で、国際的拡大リスクや公衆衛生上の重大な脅威は認められず、既存の枠組みで対応可能な局所事例である。
triage.notes: 未成年者(15歳)の性的搾取・人身売買の可能性があるため公衆衛生以外の観点での対応が望まれるが、感染症危機管理の観点からはシグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO การันตีไทยพิชิต "หัดเยอรมัน" สำเร็จ สธ. ตั้งเป้าลุยสกัด "โรคหัด" ต่อ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO confirms Thailand has conquered rubella (German measles); the Ministry of Public Health sets its sights on continuing to curb measles.
article.articleSummary: Thailand has been officially recognized by the World Health Organization as having eliminated endemic rubella (German measles) and congenital rubella syndrome (CRS). The WHO confirmation, announced on September 5, 2026, follows Thailand’s August 25, 2026 notification and shows no endemic rubella transmission for more than 36 months. Elimination reflects decades of vaccination and surveillance: rubella vaccine was added to the national schedule in 1986, initially for schoolgirls, expanding to all children by 1993, alongside robust surveillance, laboratory capacity, and outbreak response. CRS incidence declined sharply, with no endemic clusters detected since 2021. However, Thailand remains at risk from imported cases via international travel, requiring continued high vaccine coverage, closing immunity gaps, and strong surveillance and response systems. The government will now focus on accelerating measles elimination to sustain the gains.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがタイの風疹排除を認定、保健省は次に麻疹対策の加速を目指す
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はタイが風疹（先天性風疹症候群含む）の排除をWHOに認定されたという肯定的な達成報告であり、公衆衛生上の脅威やアウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 疾患排除の達成報告であり、シグナルトリアージ対象となる感染症アウトブレイクではない。輸入症例による風疹再燃リスクへの言及はあるが、現時点で具体的な事例は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತಿದೆ ಎಚ್‌ಐವಿ ಆತಂಕ: ದೇಶದಲ್ಲೇ 3ನೇ ಸ್ಥಾನ, 2 ಲಕ್ಷಕ್ಕೂ ಅಧಿಕ ಸೋಂಕಿತರು!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV panic on the rise in Karnataka: third highest in the country, over two lakh infected people!
article.articleSummary: Over 260,000 people in Karnataka live with HIV, with Bengaluru city and Belagavi district bearing the highest burden. Karnataka ranks third nationally for HIV infections. Of the estimated PLHIV, about 205,350 are on government-provided free ART. Approximately 56,406 individuals are unaware of their infection, increasing transmission risk. HIV testing is not mandatory under the 2017 HIV and AIDS Act; testing occurs only with informed consent. There is no cure for HIV. Experts point to shifting sexual behaviors and dating-app use as key drivers, along with more unprotected sex. Public health efforts include awareness programs in 7,700 schools/colleges, flash mobs at marketplaces, bus stands, and railway stations, and QR code–based anonymous self-assessment for youth to gauge sexual health risk.

triage.headline_ja: カルナタカ州でHIV懸念が増大：全国3位、感染者20万人超
triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性感染症であるHIVの流行状況報告であり、急性の公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: HIVは既知の慢性感染症であり、地域統計・啓発活動の報告記事。急性のアウトブレイクや新規異常事象ではないためDISMISS。

article.articleHeadline: 14名客人嘔吐發燒 廣州大家樂門店停業
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 14 customers vomited and developed fever; Guangzhou Cafe de Coral branch suspends operations.
article.articleSummary: 14 people linked to Cafe de Coral, Guangzhou, Panyu District, Tianhe City branch fell ill with vomiting and fever by September 4, 2026, including one child admitted to PICU for severe dehydration and shock. Most cases were children; one adult had more severe symptoms. Preliminary diagnosis is Salmonella infection, likely from contaminated egg fried rice. The store has suspended operations for rectification; implicated dish samples were collected and sent for testing. As of the morning of September 5, four children remained hospitalized, with others treated in hospitals; some recently moved from intensive care to standard wards. The operator apologized, and investigations continue. Salmonella is a common cause of foodborne illness found in poultry and other animals; symptoms include abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, fever, and headache, with higher risk of severe disease in young children. This incident underscores food safety concerns in Guangzhou.

triage.headline_ja: 14名の客が嘔吐・発熱、広州の大家楽(Cafe de Coral)店舗が営業停止
triage.triage_reason: 単一店舗での食中毒（サルモネラ疑い）事案であり、限定的な集団発生。重症例（PICU入室）はあるが、国際的拡大リスクは低く、続報（検査結果）を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 疾患名タグはParatyphoid/Typhoidだが、記事内容はサルモネラ感染症疑いの食中毒事案であり、タグと本文内容に乖離がある。単一飲食店からの食品由来感染で、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは考えにくい。

article.articleHeadline: 14名客人呕吐发烧 广州大家乐门店停业
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 14 guests with vomiting and fever; Guangzhou Dajia Le store suspended operations.
article.articleSummary: As of Sept 7, 2026, 14 people have fallen ill after dining at Dajia Le restaurant in Tianhe City Mall, Guangzhou. Most cases are children; one adult is severely ill and a child previously required PICU. Symptoms include vomiting, fever, abdominal pain, diarrhea, and dehydration. Preliminary investigations point to Salmonella infection, with eggs suspected as the contamination source via an egg fried rice dish consumed by all cases. Four children remained hospitalized as of Sept 5; others are in ordinary wards. The restaurant has suspended operations pending rectification; disinfection is ongoing and samples of the implicated dish have been sent for laboratory testing. Guangzhou's Panyu District Market Supervision Bureau has been notified and is investigating. Salmonella is a common cause of foodborne gastroenteritis, particularly dangerous for young children.

triage.headline_ja: 14名の客が嘔吐・発熱、広州の大家楽（Dajia Le）店舗が営業停止
triage.triage_reason: 単一レストランでのサルモネラ疑いの食中毒事案で、一部重症例（PICU入室）があるものの、感染源は特定済みで店舗閉鎖・消毒対応済みのため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、続報（検査結果・感染者数推移）を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 疾患タグは腸チフス/パラチフスとなっているが、記事内容はサルモネラ感染疑いの食中毒（卵料理が原因）であり、単一飲食店における局地的な食品衛生事案。ヒト-ヒト感染や地域拡大の兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: [헬스&라이프] 치명률 높은 에볼라 유입 '철벽 방어'...검역망 가동
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Health & Life] High-fatality Ebola influx "Ironclad Defense"... Quarantine network activated.
article.articleSummary: Quarantine system activated as Ebola virus disease (EVD) influx risk prompts Korea to tighten controls at Incheon Airport. Korea's disease-control authorities designate nine neighboring states—DR Congo, Angola, Burundi, Central African Republic, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, Uganda, Zambia—as Focused Quarantine Management. WHO lists DR Congo Very High risk (Aug 24); neighboring nine countries High, others Low. July–August: DR Congo reported 6,186 confirmed cases and 3,007 deaths; about 25% are under contact management. Uganda’s outbreak ended after 42 days with no new cases post last discharge on Aug 27, but reintroduction risk remains due to DR Congo border. EVD features fever with hemorrhagic symptoms; incubation 2–21 days; CFR 25–90% (Bundibugyo 30–50%). Korea’s two-track system requires inbound travelers from risk regions to report health status; pre-departure SMS alerts; post-entry symptom reporting; travel-history data integrated; DR Congo entrants undergo gate screening with up to 21 days of active surveillance. Kenya excluded; Ethiopia remains high-risk as a transit hub.

triage.headline_ja: [ヘルス＆ライフ] 致死率の高いエボラ流入『鉄壁防御』…検疫網稼働
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認例6,186人・死亡3,007人という大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、WHOがVery High riskに指定、韓国が検疫体制を強化するなど国際的な拡大懸念と渡航対応が生じているためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 韓国（仁川）は水際対策実施国であり発生国ではないため除外。ザンビア等近隣9カ国はWHOによる注意対象国（High risk）として言及されているが、実際の症例発生国ではなく監視対象に過ぎないためverified_locationsから除外し、実際に感染者・死者が報告されているDRCのみを計上。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため記載せず。

article.articleHeadline: WHO รับรองประเทศไทย 'กำจัดหัดเยอรมัน' สำเร็จ มุ่งต่อกำจัดโรคหัด
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO certifies Thailand's elimination of rubella as achieved, aiming to continue eliminating measles.
article.articleSummary: Thailand has achieved endemic rubella elimination, confirmed by WHO, becoming the seventh SEARO country to do so after Bhutan, North Korea, Maldives, Nepal, Sri Lanka, and Timor-Leste. Certification requires more than 36 months with no endemic rubella transmission and a robust surveillance system capable of detecting, investigating, and responding to cases. CRS (Congenital Rubella Syndrome) risk persists if maternal infection occurs during pregnancy, causing congenital heart defects, hearing/vision impairment, and other lifelong disabilities. Thailand began immunization in 1977, introduced rubella-containing vaccine into the national program in 1986 (targeting schoolgirls) and expanded to all children by 1993, supported by strong surveillance, laboratory capacity, and outbreak response. Ongoing risk remains from imported cases due to international travel, necessitating sustained high population immunity, closure of vaccination gaps, and continued readiness of rash surveillance, laboratories, and epidemiologic investigation to sustain rubella elimination and advance measles elimination.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがタイの風疹排除達成を認定、麻疹排除を目指す
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はタイが風疹排除をWHOに認定されたという達成報告であり、公衆衛生上の脅威やアウトブレイクではないため、いずれの基準にも該当しない。
triage.notes: この記事は風疹排除の達成報告であり、アウトブレイクや感染拡大のイベントではない。発生地域として挙げられた他国（ネパール、モルディブ等）も過去の排除達成国として言及されているのみで、いずれも対象国リストには含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolas vīruss Kongo DR joprojām plaši izplatās; miruši vairāk nekā 3000 cilvēku
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus in DR Congo remains widespread; more than 3,000 people have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains widespread, with 6,342 confirmed infections and 3,072 deaths; 1,475 people have recovered. The World Health Organization notes the outbreak is in an intense transmission phase with high mortality and broad geographic reach. Health authorities and partners have expanded treatment capacity, establishing 49 medical facilities housing about 1,300 beds, with plans to increase to 3,000 beds in coming months. Journalists were allowed to visit a newly created facility fully funded by an organization, where tents have been erected, along with showers and toilets, and a laundry, wastewater drainage, and power supply system are being developed. The article underscores ongoing widespread transmission and rising clinical capacity to improve patient care across affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスが依然として広範に拡大、死者3000人超
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで大規模流行し死者3000人超、高い致死率と地理的拡大が続いており、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: WHOが強い伝播フェーズと報告し、国際支援団体による医療施設拡充が進行中。致死率・拡大規模ともに深刻で継続的モニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 大家乐食安事件初步怀疑鸡蛋受污染 多名儿童食物中毒住院
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cafe de Coral food safety incident: preliminary suspicion that eggs were contaminated; several children hospitalized for food poisoning.
article.articleSummary: Aug 28–29, 2026: Several children in Guangzhou’s Panyu District, after dining at Da Jia Le’s Tianhe City store, experienced vomiting, diarrhea, and fever. Preliminary suspicion: contaminated eggs. Fecal samples reportedly showed Salmonella in some cases; one child was recorded with bacterial infection but not Salmonella. By Sep 2, Guangzhou Panyu Market Supervision Administration and the district CDC conducted outbreak investigations, on-site inspections, disinfection, and halted operations for remediation; the store is closed. As of Sep 5, 4 children remain hospitalized, with the most severely ill previously in Panyu Central Hospital PICU; total cases reported by Da Jia Le were 14, with 12 hospitalized. The company has sent representatives to hospitals and offered support; authorities continue laboratory confirmation and outbreak assessment.

triage.headline_ja: 大家楽（カフェ・デ・コーラル）食品安全事件：初歩的に卵の汚染が疑われ、複数の子供が食中毒で入院
triage.triage_reason: 単一店舗での食中毒事案で既に当局が調査・是正措置を実施済みだが、サルモネラ感染確定や感染源特定が未完了であり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 疾患名はParatyphoid/Typhoidとされているが、記事本文ではサルモネラ感染が疑われており、腸チフス菌との関連は不明。単一レストランでの局所的な食中毒事案であり、既に店舗閉鎖・消毒等の対応が取られている。

article.articleHeadline: Africa: Ebola and Africa's Preparedness Dividend - From Crisis to Capability
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo strain outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo were declared on 15 May 2026, marking Africa's 17th Ebola outbreak. WHO and Africa CDC have classified it as a public health emergency. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed rapid diagnostic, therapeutic, or vaccine. Africa's response architecture - built, run, and coordinated on the continent for five decades - delivers the containment, though financing is constrained as Abuja Declaration 15% health budget thresholds remain unmet and overseas development assistance declines. Past milestones include 2014–2016 West Africa outbreaks (28,600 cases), Uganda's 2022 Sudan strain outbreak contained in under four months, and Africa CDC operational since 2017 with rVSV-ZEBOV vaccine. The response relies on frontline communities, VillageReach-supported COUSP interface, rapid sample transport across 15 countries, and a new Mweka laboratory (2025) to shorten lab turnaround. 7-1-7 surveillance framework and cross-border coordination (ECCAS, EAC) underpin the plan led by WHO and Africa CDC.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：エボラ出血熱とアフリカの備え配当―危機から能力へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクがWHO/Africa CDCにより公衆衛生上の緊急事態と分類され、当該株には承認済み診断・治療・ワクチンが存在しないため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事は主にコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのブンディブギョ株アウトブレイクとアフリカ全体の対応能力向上について論じている。ウガンダ・アンゴラは地域協力・過去事例の文脈で言及されているのみで、当該国での発生の主題ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: नेपाल त्रासदी के बाद जहरीला हुआ पानी..... लोगों के शरीर में फेल रहा इंफेक्शन
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Poisoned water after the Nepal tragedy... infection spread in people’s bodies.
article.articleSummary: Contaminated floodwaters from Nepal’s disaster have spilled into India, turning water supplies poisonous and triggering infections. In Uttar Pradesh, the districts of Kushinagar and Maharajganj report itching and skin lesions after contact with polluted water. Senior dermatologist Dr. A.K. Dwivedi notes that E. coli and other fecal bacteria in the water can weaken the skin’s outer layer, enabling infection to spread between people, with elderly farm workers returning home most affected. Ramayan Singh of Piprighat recalls leg exposure to contaminated water during field work; Rambha Devi’s daughter has developed rashes. Separately, Nepal’s flood crisis persists twelve days on, with relief operations ongoing. Official counts: 1,344 deaths, about 5,000 missing, 7,570 homes damaged; 55 km of roads washed and 37 bridges collapsed. Rasuwa and Nuwakot are the worst-hit of Nepal’s 77 districts; others include Dadhing, Chitwan, Gorkha, Tanahun, and Nawalparasi. Nepal asks neighbors to limit travel advisories to affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: ネパールの大災害後、水が有毒化…人々の体内で感染が広がる
triage.triage_reason: ネパールの洪水汚染水がインド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州に流入し、E.coliによる皮膚感染が報告されているが、重症度や規模に関する情報が不足しており、続報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: ネパールの洪水災害自体は甚大（死者1,344人、行方不明約5,000人）だが、これはIHR/WPRO評価対象の感染症事象ではなく、E.coli感染による皮膚症状（かゆみ・発疹）が主な報告内容。人-人感染の可能性が医師により示唆されているが、重症例や死亡例の報告はなく、詳細情報待ちの段階。ネパールは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Vaccination, screening, and prevention: Gastroenterologist Dr Anurag Sachan's guide to beating hepatitis
article.articleSummary: Dr. Anurag Sachan of Paras Health Kanpur outlines vaccination, screening, and prevention for hepatitis in India. Hepatitis B vaccination, given in three doses, protects >95% and should be given at birth to unvaccinated infants and to adults up to 59; adults 60+ with risk factors should be vaccinated. A two-dose hepatitis A vaccine protects toddlers, travelers to endemic areas, drug users, MSM, and those with chronic liver diseases. For newborns of HBsAg-positive mothers, both hepatitis B vaccine and HBIG are required within 24 hours, with completion of the series and testing by age one. Screening is crucial: HBsAg and anti-HCV tests, with CDC recommending one-time screening for 18–79. Prevention includes safe injection practices, screened blood products, harm reduction, safe sex, avoiding unsterile tattoos/piercings, and public health measures for clean water and sanitation to prevent HAV. Antivirals control HBV; DAAs often cure HCV; early diagnosis and follow-up remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: 予防接種、スクリーニング、予防：消化器内科医アヌラグ・サチャン博士による肝炎克服ガイド
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクではなく、医師による肝炎予防・啓発に関する一般的な健康情報記事であり、緊急性のある感染症イベントではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定のアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、肝炎の予防接種・検査・予防に関する一般的な啓発情報であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: 香港季節性流感致300名長者病亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seasonal influenza in Hong Kong claims 300 elderly lives.
article.articleSummary: Seasonal influenza has surged in Hong Kong since late June, with 16 children admitted to intensive care for severe influenza, including 1 death; more than 450 elderly patients have been hospitalized with severe illness, among them 300 deaths. Health authorities urge vaccination, especially for children and the elderly, stating the influenza vaccine is the most effective method to reduce the risk of severe disease and death. A new vaccination campaign is planned to start on September 17. Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau, joined by other senior officials from the Department of Health and the Centre for Health Protection, received vaccines to lead by example. The update underscores the ongoing outbreak and the need for high vaccination coverage to curb fatalities, especially among seniors.

triage.headline_ja: 香港の季節性インフルエンザで高齢者300人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザにより高齢者300人が死亡、小児にも重症例が発生しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響とIHR基準の複数該当が認められるため。
triage.notes: 香港は対象国リストのChinaに含めて分類。季節性インフルエンザの流行としては死亡者数が多く、重症化リスクの高い高齢者・小児への影響が顕著。ワクチン接種キャンペーンなど政府対応も報じられている。

article.articleHeadline: TP.HCM: Bệnh viện liên tiếp nhận trẻ mắc sốt xuất huyết nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City: Hospitals repeatedly admit children with severe dengue.
article.articleSummary: Severe dengue with shock and multi-organ failure is stressing Ho Chi Minh City’s pediatric services. On Sept 7, two notable cases are highlighted. A 7-year-old boy, H.C.K., from Tân Tạo Ward, presented after five days of fever with shock, coagulopathy, GI bleeding, and marked liver injury (liver enzymes >1,500 U/L). He received aggressive fluid resuscitation, colloids, vasopressors, abdominal drainage, blood products, and ultimately recovered after about two weeks, with liver function normalizing and ventilatory support withdrawn. A 10-year-old girl, D.T.T.V., from An Giang province, endured four days of fever; by day five she was in deep shock with cold extremities, liver enzymes >2,000 U/L, and creatinine >400 µmol/L, developing respiratory failure and multi-organ dysfunction. She required ventilation, abdominal drainage, four dialysis sessions, and three plasmapheresis, with recovery over nearly three weeks. Authorities warn that monsoon boosts Aedes aegypti; parents should eliminate standing water, use nets, and avoid self-medicating—seek care urgently if warning signs arise.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市:病院が重症デング熱の子どもを相次いで受け入れ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は同地域で毎年流行する疾患であり、重症例2件の報告だが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。ただし季節性の流行拡大の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムの季節性流行病であり、記事は個別の重症例2件を報告。地域全体の症例数増加や死亡率上昇などの疫学データは示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: बंगाल में डेंगू का कहर, मरीजों की संख्या 4500 पार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue wreaks havoc in Bengal as the number of patients crosses 4,500.
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak in West Bengal during the monsoon has surpassed 4,500 cases, with Kolkata ranking second and Murshidabad leading at 870 cases as of September 2, and 96 new cases in the prior week. Cumulative totals show 770 cases by April 30, 1,946 by July 31, and 3,966 by August 31, with activity continuing. In Kolkata, 402 cases were recorded by September 2, with 62 new cases in the past seven days. District tallies include North 24 Parganas (346), Malda (331), South 24 Parganas (324), Nadia (316), Hooghly (293), Howrah (276), Purba Bardhaman (233), and Paschim Bardhaman (140). In Nadia’s Novada block, door-to-door fumigation and awareness campaigns are underway but infections persist. Health authorities plan to intensify campaigns from September 7, including video-recorded activities; schools are urged to require full-sleeve shirts. Emphasis remains on eliminating breeding sites and regular spraying.

triage.headline_ja: 西ベンガル州でデング熱が猛威、患者数4500人を突破
triage.triage_reason: 季節性（モンスーン時期）のデング熱流行で、インド国内では例年発生するパターンであり突発性は低いが、症例数増加と当局の対応強化が続くため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 西ベンガル州（コルカタ、ムルシダバードなど）でのモンスーン期の季節性デング熱流行。死亡者数や重症度に関する具体的情報は記事に記載されておらず、地方自治体レベルでの防蚊対策強化が報告されている。国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは見られない。

article.articleHeadline: DR콩고·접경 9개국 에볼라 중점검역...위험도 따라 차등 대응
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo and nine neighboring countries implement targeted Ebola border screening... differential response according to risk level.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak reached 6,186 confirmed cases and 3,007 deaths as of July 31, across six provinces; contact tracing targets remain under 25%. WHO rates DR Congo risk as Very High, with Angola, Burundi, Central African Republic, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, Uganda, Zambia, and Republic of Congo labeled High; other countries Low. On 2026-09-07, Korea’s Disease Control Headquarters designated DR Congo and nine neighboring countries as priority quarantine areas. DR Congo entrants face gate screening and up to 21 days of active surveillance; Kenya is removed from priority status; Ethiopia remains a focus quarantine area due to Africa’s largest transit hub and direct routes to Korea. All travelers from high-risk countries must report health status via Q-CODE or health declarations; outbound travelers receive SMS; inbound travelers report symptoms to 1339 or health centers. DUR-ITS screens travel history; DR Congo arrivals undergo targeted entry screening and post-entry monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴおよび国境を接する9カ国、エボラ出血熱の重点検疫を実施…リスクに応じた差別化対応
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴでのエボラ大規模流行（6,186症例、3,007死亡）がWHOにより最高リスクと評価され、複数国境国への波及と韓国を含む国際的な渡航制限措置が取られており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国の検疫対応が主題だが、根底にあるDRコンゴのエボラ大規模流行（WHO Very High評価）が事実上の主要イベント。ザンビアはWHOによりHighリスク国として明記されており対象国リストに含まれるため列挙。その他の国境国（アンゴラ、ルワンダ等）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: 해외여행·유학 앞뒀다면... '수막구균' 예방접종 점검해야
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: If you're planning to travel overseas or study abroad, you should check your meningococcal vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal disease risk rises with overseas study, travel, especially in dormitories. Domestic cases in Korea were about 12 last year, but overseas outbreaks persist. The illness is a bacterial meningitis spread by sneezing, coughing, and close contact, with a case fatality of 10–15% and up to 20% sequelae (skin necrosis, hearing loss, neurological damage). Most global cases involve serogroups A, B, C, W, X, Y. In the UK’s Kent outbreak (March), 21 cases and 2 deaths occurred. In the US, dormitory entrants are high-risk and many universities require or recommend vaccination. In Vietnam, last year saw 95 cases; as of April this year, 24 cases, with simultaneous circulation of serogroups A, B, C, W, Y. Vaccines available in Korea cover A, B, C, W, Y; Bexsero (B) and Menveo (A, C, W, Y) can provide protection. Counsel travelers and students to assess destination and stay conditions with healthcare providers.

triage.headline_ja: 海外旅行・留学を控えているなら…「髄膜炎菌」予防接種を確認すべき
triage.triage_reason: 特定の新規アウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、渡航者・留学生向けに髄膜炎菌ワクチン接種を一般的に啓発する記事であり、既知のリスク情報の紹介にとどまる。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国メディアによる一般啓発記事で、英国ケント（対象国外）や米国の事例も紹介されているが、いずれも既存データの引用。ベトナムについては昨年95例、今年4月時点で24例という具体的な数字が示されているためverified_locationsに含めた。新規の緊急シグナルとは言えずDISMISS相当。

article.articleHeadline: नैनीताल के इन गांवों में 'पानी' से डर रहे लोग,100 से ज्यादा बीमार और 2 मौतों से मचा हड़कंप
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In these villages of Nainital, people are afraid of 'water'; more than 100 are ill and two deaths have sparked panic.
article.articleSummary: As of September 7, 2026, in Uttarakhand's Nainital district, including JyoliKot, Ganja, and Sariatal villages, more than 100 residents have fallen ill with jaundice and diarrhea, triggering panic over drinking water. Several patients have been referred to hospitals in Nainital and Haldwani, with some transferred to Bareilly and Delhi for treatment. Two deaths occurred during treatment: 26-year-old Nima Joshi and 16-year-old Gina; reports also mention a teen's death at Delhi's Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital. Villagers blame contaminated drinking water, suspecting sewer-line effluent entering water sources and feeding the supply tanks; authorities have isolated the suspected source from the water tank. Health teams have launched camps and plan house-to-house health checks; water samples from all sources and supply lines will be tested, and regular monitoring of affected families urged. Ten schools and five Anganwadi centers in JyoliKot, Ganja, and Sariatal are closed as a precaution until the source is identified.

triage.headline_ja: ナイニタールのこれらの村で人々が「水」を恐れている、100人以上が病気になり2人が死亡してパニックが広がる
triage.triage_reason: 汚染された飲料水によるとみられる黄疸・下痢の集団発生で100人以上が罹患し2人が死亡、学校閉鎖や住民パニックを伴う社会的関心の高い事案であるため。
triage.notes: 汚染水源による黄疸・下痢の集団発生（推定A型/E型肝炎の可能性）。原因究明中で、下水混入疑いの水源は隔離済み。学校・保育施設が予防的に閉鎖。国際的拡大の兆候はないが、地域住民への継続的曝露リスクとパニックの拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 盧寵茂接種流感疫苗　稱流感仍活躍籲盡快打針 (13:40) - 20260907
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lo Chung-mau receives the influenza vaccine, says influenza remains active, and urges people to get the shot as soon as possible (13:40) - 2026-09-07
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong authorities announced a large influenza vaccination push as influenza remains active. The government has purchased 1.3 million doses for the season, with the first batch already arrived. To boost uptake, electronic consent via the eHealth platform is available, with about 80,000 students submitting; the public can use it from Sept 17. School outreach vaccination kicks off Sept 18, with approximately 80 outreach events planned in September, far higher than last year. Across districts within two months, more than 100 community vaccination activities are planned, with cross-department collaboration to bring outreach vaccination to elder centers and elder housing projects. The Doctors Vaccine Procurement Pilot Scheme has been expanded from 100,000 to 300,000 doses to support private vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 盧寵茂氏がインフルエンザワクチンを接種、流感は依然活発と述べ早期接種を呼びかけ (13:40) - 2026年9月7日
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種キャンペーンに関する行政広報であり、異常な流行や重症化の情報はなく、通常の公衆衛生対策として実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事は香港政府による季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種推進策の広報であり、疾病の異常な拡大や重症例増加についての言及はない。香港はChina(1814991)に含めて分類。

article.articleHeadline: 国家重点研发项目团队驰援青海乌兰 织密高原人畜共患病防控网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National Key R&D Program team rushes to Wulan, Qinghai, to bolster the plateau's zoonotic disease prevention and control network.
article.articleSummary: Nine-member team from China’s National Key R&D Program on Monitoring, Early Warning and Integrated Control of Major Zoonoses visited Wulan County, Haixi Prefecture, Qinghai, Aug 27–28, 2026, to bolster plateau zoonotic disease prevention. Leveraging an integrated demonstration base, they coordinated with the county CDC, Animal Epidemic Prevention Center, and local authorities, outlining 2026 monitoring tasks and technology promotion. Fieldwork in Kekex Town’s Nansha Gou Village and Shirigou Town collected 200 animal samples, 80 high-risk human samples, and 30 food samples to trace Brucellosis and Tuberculosis, with attention to Anthrax and Echinococcosis. Community outreach educated herders on prevention, early detection, and treatment; distributed over 100 educational materials and 150 bottles of doxycycline hydrochloride. The team hosted the Colorful Wulan lecture series and the ZhiHui Wulan talent session, and on Aug 28 submitted findings and preventive measures to county leaders to support green, organic livestock production and disease control efforts on the plateau.

triage.headline_ja: 国家重点研究開発プロジェクトチームが青海省ウラン県に急行、高原地域の人畜共通感染症予防管理ネットワークを強化
triage.triage_reason: 研究チームによる定例のサーベイランス・予防活動の報告であり、アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象は確認されない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存の人畜共通感染症（炭疽・結核・ブルセラ症・エキノコックス症）に対する定例的なモニタリング・啓発活動を報じたものであり、新規感染や流行の兆候は記載されていない。地域は青海省であり対象国リストのChinaに該当するが、イベント自体がアウトブレイクではないためverified_locationsは空とした。
