Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: ग्वालियर में स्वाइन फ्लू और डेंगू के बीच चिकनगुनिया की दस्तक, तीनों बीमारियों में बढ़ाई स्वास्थ्य विभाग की चिंता
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Gwalior, Chikungunya emerges amid swine flu and dengue, heightening the health department's concern over all three diseases.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 September 2026, chikungunya has emerged in Gwalior amid ongoing Swine Flu (H1N1) and dengue cases, heightening public health concerns. The GRMC Microbiology Lab tested three samples, with one from a 26-year-old trainee at Gangangar PTS Tighra positive for chikungunya. In response, the health department activated its measures. A malaria department team visited the patient’s home and conducted a larval survey in the surrounding area, advising residents to take precautions to reduce mosquito breeding. The development underscores the simultaneous circulation of chikungunya, H1N1 swine flu, and dengue in the city and emphasizes vigilant surveillance and vector-control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: グワリオルでスワインフルーとデングの間にチクングニアが出現、3疾患すべてに保健当局の懸念高まる
triage.triage_reason: 地域的な媒介蚊媒介性疾患（チクングニア・デング・H1N1）の同時流行だが、症例数は限定的で国際的拡大の兆候はなく、地方保健当局による通常の対応にとどまる。
triage.notes: インド・グワリオル市（マディヤ・プラデーシュ州）における局地的な複数媒介蚊感染症の同時発生。保健局は幼虫調査・媒介対策を実施しており、地方レベルの通常対応の範囲内。続報での症例数増加や重症化の有無を注視。

article.articleHeadline: В России с начала года выявили 500 случаев завоза опасных инфекций
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Russia, since the beginning of the year, 500 cases of importation of dangerous infections have been detected.
article.articleSummary: Russia registered almost 500 imported cases of dangerous infections in 2026, with no domestic transmission reported, according to Rospotrebnadzor head Anna Popova. This is up from about 300 imported cases in 2025. The infections cited include malaria, typhoid fever, various fevers, Zika, dengue, and chikungunya. Border controls have been strengthened to prevent domestic spread, with officials saying these cases reflect global instability. In the summer, Rospotrebnadzor urged Russians returning from Bali to monitor health due to dengue, a mosquito-borne viral disease; since the start of the year, more than 100 dengue infections have been identified in Russia. The report emphasizes that these infections are imported and not circulating domestically.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで年初来500件の危険な感染症の輸入例を検出
triage.triage_reason: ロシア国内での輸入症例増加が報告されているが国内伝播はなく、対象国であるインドネシア(バリ)は渡航先として言及されているのみで発生地域とは言えないため、継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシアにおける輸入感染症例の増加であり、バリ(インドネシア)は渡航先として言及されるのみで現地での発生イベントではないため対象国リストからは除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Serious human illness transmitted by ticks has been identified
article.articleSummary: Researchers from Beijing's State Key Laboratory of Pathogen and Biosecurity identified a novel pathogen, Asian longhorned tick nairovirus (ALTNV), in the blood of patients with tick exposure, linked to Haemaphysalis longicornis ticks. In screening 3,163 individuals with Dabie bandavirus (DBV)–like illness, 10.4% tested negative for DBV, revealing ALTNV as a distinct tick-borne orthonairovirus causing fever, fatigue and gastrointestinal upset akin to influenza A. ALTNV and DBV share the same vector and co-circulate in the same areas across China, underscoring the need for improved differential diagnosis. DBV, also known as severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS), has a fatality rate up to 30% and is not treatable with antibiotics. Notably, 38 patients were co-infected with ALTNV and DBV and showed more severe respiratory issues and kidney impairment; seven deaths occurred. Findings published in the New England Journal of Medicine.

triage.headline_ja: マダニによって媒介される重篤なヒト感染症が新たに同定された
triage.triage_reason: 中国でSFTS類似の新規ダニ媒介性ウイルス(ALTNV)が同定され、DBVとの共感染例で死亡7例を含む重症化が確認されており、NEJMに掲載された新規病原体としてIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 本記事は疫学的アウトブレイク報告ではなく、NEJMに掲載された新規病原体（ALTNV）同定に関する学術研究の報告。既存のSFTS(DBV)流行地域と重複する点、共感染例で重症化・死亡が確認された点が公衆衛生上の懸念材料。ヒト-ヒト感染の有無やアウトブレイクの規模については不明であり、続報の確認が必要。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A

article.articleHeadline: मोगा में स्वाइन फ्लू की दस्तक, 3 नए पॉजिटिव केस मिलने से स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट, घरों का सर्वे शुरू - moga swine flu 3 new positive cases health department alert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine Flu Hits Moga; Three New Positive Cases Detected, Health Department on Alert, House-to-House Survey Begins
article.articleSummary: Three new swine flu (influenza A) cases detected in Moga district, Punjab, with patients from Moga city, Bagha Purana, and Kot Isse Khan. Health authorities have issued an alert and begun house-to-house surveys, testing family members and contacts; patients are stable and recovering at home. Civil Surgeon Dr. Ashok Singla said home surveys are complete and no serious symptoms were found among those exposed. Two days earlier, three other swine flu positives from Basurana, Kot Isse Khan, and Moga city were reported and are now healthy. The disease spreads via droplets from coughing, sneezing, or breathing. Symptoms include high fever, chills, persistent cough, sore throat, breathing difficulty, chest heaviness, headache, muscle/joint pain, and weakness; vomiting or diarrhea may occur rarely. Preventive measures: avoid crowds, wear masks, wash hands, avoid touching the face, maintain at least one meter from the sick, and get annual flu vaccination for at-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: モガでスワインフル発生、新たに3件の陽性例確認、保健当局が警戒、戸別調査を開始
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA（H1N1）の散発例で、重症例はなく患者は回復中。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方保健当局（Civil Surgeon）による通常の監視・対応（家庭訪問調査）が実施されており、重症例なし。季節性インフルエンザの範囲内の事象と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: New dengue cases in Bengal cross 500 mark in last seven days
article.articleSummary: As of Sept 7, 2026, West Bengal reports over 500 new dengue cases in the past seven days, pushing the current calendar/monsoon total to just over 4,500. Murshidabad is the worst-affected district with 96 of the week’s cases and 870 of the year’s total; Kolkata is second with 62 new cases in seven days and 402 total this year. Since April, infections rose from 770 (Apr 30) to 1,946 (Jul 31), 3,966 (Aug 31), and a little over 4,500 to date. A Sept 2 standard operating procedure prompted door-to-door monitoring and immediate blood testing for those with dengue symptoms. Health officials insist the year’s figures are 100% authentic and not underreported as unknown fever, per Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari. Authorities urge calm despite the serious situation.

triage.headline_ja: 西ベンガル州、過去7日間で新規デング熱症例500件超
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱増加ではあるが、週500件超・年間4500件超という規模で行政がSOPを発動し戸別調査を実施しており、社会的・行政的関心が高いためフルRRAでの経過確認が妥当。
triage.notes: モンスーン季の季節性デング熱増加であり、死亡や重症例数の言及なし。行政（州首相含む）が対応を強調しており、続報のモニタリングを推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Стало известно число случаев завоза опасных инфекций в Россию в 2026 году
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of cases of importation of dangerous infections into Russia in 2026 has become known.
article.articleSummary: Russia reported about 500 imported infections in the first eight months of 2026, with none triggering domestic transmission, per Anna Popova, head of Rospotrebnadzor. The eight-month tally exceeds roughly 300 imported cases observed in the same period of 2025. Diseases among imported cases include malaria, typhoid fever, various fevers, Zika, dengue, and chikungunya. Popova attributed the rise to the strained epidemiological situation in many countries and said Russia has tightened border controls and reinforced sanitary protections. Separately, the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over Ebola outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Ebola, first identified in 1976 in Sudan and Zaire and named after the Ebola River, is typically carried by animals such as bats. The current DRC/Uganda outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo, a less-studied strain, with two prior outbreaks (2007, 2012) and about 30% fatality.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年にロシアへ持ち込まれた危険な感染症の件数が判明
triage.triage_reason: 記事後半でWHOがウガンダ・DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行に対しPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言したことが報じられており、致死率約30%と深刻で国際的拡大が懸念されるためIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシアへの輸入感染症統計だが、付随情報としてWHOによるDRC/ウガンダのエボラ出血熱PHEIC宣言が含まれており、これが重大なシグナルとなる。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ロシア国内の輸入感染症増加自体は対象国に該当せずトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: सितंबर में बढ़ सकता है फीवर, टाइफाइड और पाचन का खतरा; डॉक्टर से जानें पेट और इम्यूनिटी सुरक्षित रखने वाले 5 फूड्स
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever, typhoid, and digestive problems may rise in September; learn from a doctor the five foods that protect the stomach and boost immunity.
article.articleSummary: September in India sees higher risk of seasonal fever, typhoid, and digestive issues as monsoon wanes, humidity and temperature fluctuate, and contaminated water/food heighten infections like typhoid and cholera. Dr. J. T. Hema Pratim emphasizes a preventive diet: mung dal for easy protein and fiber; turmeric milk with black pepper to boost curcumin absorption (up to ~20x); soaked almonds (phytic acid reduced); fresh yogurt with live cultures; and seasonal fruits such as papaya, guava, apples, and pears for fiber and antioxidants. Ginger can aid digestion and nausea; lemon provides vitamin C and improves iron absorption when paired with meals; ensure ample water. Maintain hygiene and avoid open street foods and undercooked or long-stored dishes. Emphasize clean water and adequate sleep to support immunity during this transitional period in India (reference to Bengaluru’s St. John’s Medical College study supporting turmeric–black pepper interaction).

triage.headline_ja: 9月は発熱、腸チフス、消化器系トラブルが増加する可能性；医師が教える胃腸と免疫を守る5つの食品
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の健康アドバイス記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや症例報告ではなく、一般的な予防啓発コンテンツのため。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性の健康・栄養アドバイス記事であり、具体的な感染症の発生・症例数の報告ではない。特定の地域（バンガロール/カルナタカ州）への言及はあるが、これは研究引用の文脈であり、アウトブレイク発生地ではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: ICU में दवाएं क्यों हो रही हैं बेअसर? चौंकाने वाली रिपोर्ट, 25% मौतों की वजह बने सुपरबग्स
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why are medicines in the ICU becoming ineffective? Shocking report: superbugs responsible for 25% of deaths.
article.articleSummary: ICU mortality driven by multidrug-resistant (MDR) infections accounts for about 25% of deaths in Indian ICUs, with 94% of MDR infections acquired during hospitalization. A Kochi-based study at Amrita Institute of Medical Sciences and Research Center, published in the Indian Journal of Medical Research, analyzed 8,704 ICU samples from October 2022 to May 2025. Of these, 3,450 were positive (39%), and 750 were MDR (34.2% of positives). Among infected patients, 191 died (25.5% mortality). Of these deaths, 180 (about 94%) involved hospital-acquired MDR infections linked to ICU care. The study found 34% of ICU bacteria were carbapenem-resistant, with Klebsiella pneumoniae and Acinetobacter baumannii as the most lethal pathogens. The article cites ICU deaths in Jajpur, Odisha, highlighting rampant resistance driven by antibiotic overuse and lapses in infection control.

triage.headline_ja: ICUで薬が効かなくなっているのはなぜか？衝撃的な報告：スーパーバグが死亡の25%の原因に
triage.triage_reason: 薬剤耐性菌（AMR）に関する重要な研究報告だが、単一施設の後方視的研究であり、新規アウトブレイクや急性の公衆衛生イベントではないため、フルRRAではなく継続的な監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事は病院内感染・多剤耐性菌（AMR）に関する研究報告であり、特定のアウトブレイクイベントではない。ケララ州コーチのAmrita Institute発の研究データに基づく。オディシャ州ジャジプルの症例にも言及があるが、詳細な地域的アウトブレイク情報はなし。継続的なAMR動向のモニタリング対象として扱うのが適切。

article.articleHeadline: 106 Babi dari Manado Dikirim ke Raja Ampat, Barantin Pastikan Negatif ASF dan PMK
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 106 Pigs from Manado Sent to Raja Ampat, Barantin Confirms Negative for African Swine Fever and Foot-and-Mouth Disease
article.articleSummary: 106 live pigs were moved from Manado, North Sulawesi to Raja Ampat, West Papua, after health checks and laboratory tests by Indonesia’s quarantine authorities. Barantan (Badan Karantina Indonesia) via the North Sulawesi Animal, Fish, and Plant Quarantine Office (Karantina Sulut) confirmed on Sept 5, 2026, that samples tested at an accredited lab were negative for African Swine Fever (ASF) and Foot-and-Mouth Disease (PMK). A pre-shipment health assessment and inter-regional risk analysis deemed the shipment’s disease risk controlled, allowing entry into Raja Ampat. Biosecurity steps included disinfection of livestock and transport vehicles. After health clearance, quarantine documents were issued to permit movement, in line with Law No. 21 of 2019 on Animal, Fish, and Plant Quarantine. The measures aim to prevent disease spread and safeguard livestock health in the destination area.

triage.headline_ja: マナドから106頭の豚がラジャアンパットへ輸送、検疫当局がASFとPMK陰性を確認
triage.triage_reason: 検査結果は陰性であり、疾病発生ではなく検疫手続きが正常に機能していることを示す通常の行政報告であるため、シグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は疾病陰性確認と検疫手続きの遵守を報じるものであり、感染症発生事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تطلق خطة معدلة لمدة 180 يوما لتعزيز مكافحة وباء الإيبولا - بوابة الأهرام
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo launches a revised 180-day plan to bolster the fight against the Ebola outbreak - Al-Ahram Portal
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo launches a revised 180-day multisector plan to bolster the Ebola response, with support from the World Health Organization and Africa CDC and partners. As of 2026-09-07, the outbreak has reached 1,700+ confirmed cases and 600 deaths, with rapid local transmission ongoing. The response concentrates across 37 areas in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu; suspected cases have been reported in Kisangani (Kisangani in Tshopo province) and in Haut-Uele, signaling spread beyond the epicenter in Ituri. The new plan emphasizes intensified surveillance, enhanced contact tracing, improved patient care, and community engagement to accelerate containment and mobilize local communities for outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行対策強化のため180日間の改訂計画を発表 - アル・アハラム・ポータル
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行(1700+症例、600人死亡)が継続し、複数州へ拡大しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: WHOおよびAfrica CDCが支援する大規模対応計画。震源地イトゥリから北キブ・南キブ、さらにキサンガニ（チョポ州）やオートウエレへ拡大しており、国境を越える伝播リスクにも注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: West Bengal records over 500 new dengue cases in 7 days, total crosses 4,500
article.articleSummary: Dengue in West Bengal, India: Over 500 new dengue cases were detected in the past seven days, pushing the 2026 tally beyond 4,500 as intensified surveillance followed a September 2 SOP. Door-to-door surveillance and immediate blood testing were deployed for symptomatic individuals. Murshidabad remains the worst-affected district, recording 96 of the week’s cases and totaling about 870 this year out of 4,500+. Kolkata is second, with 402 total dengue cases this year, including 62 in the latest week. The rise tracks monsoon-season transmission, with confirmed cases climbing from 770 (April 30) to 1,946 (July 31) to 3,966 (August 31) before surpassing 4,500. Health officials emphasize lab-confirmed, authentic reporting under Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari’s directive not to classify dengue as unknown fever, to avoid underquoting.

triage.headline_ja: 西ベンガル州、7日間で500人以上の新規デング熱症例、累計4,500人超に
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州でのデング熱症例増加はモンスーン季節に伴う例年の流行パターンであり、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いが、症例数増加と行政の監視強化の動きから経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで毎年モンスーン期に流行する風土病であり、今回の報道は西ベンガル州（特にムルシダバード県・コルカタ市）での症例数増加と行政の監視強化・報告体制厳格化に関するもの。重症度（入院・死亡数）に関する情報は記事に含まれず不明。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: পুজোর আগে মাথা ব্যাথা বাড়াচ্ছে ডেঙ্গু আক্রান্তের সংখ্যা, সাতদিনে ৫০০ আক্রান্তের সন্ধান, শীর্ষে কোন জেলা?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Before Puja, the number of dengue patients is rising; 500 cases in seven days; which district tops the list?
article.articleSummary: West Bengal reports a dengue upsurge ahead of Puja, with over 500 new dengue infections in the past week. Health department data show the current year’s total dengue cases in the state crossing 4,500. Over the last seven days, Murshidabad accounted for the largest increase, recording about 96 new infections, taking its year-to-date total to roughly 870. Kolkata ranks second, with a year total of 402 cases and 62 new infections in the past week. Since April, the Bengal dengue tally has risen from about 770 to 1,946 by July 31, 3,966 by August 31, and surpassing 4,500 by early September. Authorities say SOPs introduced on September 2 have intensified surveillance, including house-to-house surveys and rapid blood testing for symptomatic individuals. Officials insist the figures are fully verified and not underreported; the Chief Minister has directed dengue be reported as dengue, not unknown fever.

triage.headline_ja: プジャ前にデング熱患者数が増加、7日間で500人の新規感染、最多の地区は?
triage.triage_reason: 季節性デング熱の増加であり、インド西ベンガル州における例年の流行パターンの範囲内と考えられるが、症例数増加が続いており経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱は西ベンガル州における季節性の流行であり、当局は監視強化・報告体制の是正（発熱の正確な報告指示）を実施中。重症度や死亡者数に関する情報が記事に含まれておらず不明。

article.articleHeadline: 流感｜流感仍處於高位　近300長者因重症死亡　盧寵茂籲盡快打針
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza | Influenza Remains at a High Level; Nearly 300 Elderly Have Died from Severe Illness; Lo Chung-mau Urges Vaccination as Soon as Possible
article.articleSummary: Seasonal influenza activity remains very high in Hong Kong, as of Sept 7, 2026. Health Secretary Lo Chung-mau urged rapid vaccination as the seasonal flu vaccination program starts next Thursday. Lab-positive tests show 11.17% positivity, with about 0.75 influenza infections per 10,000 patients in Hospital Authority care. Severe illness is centered in the elderly and children: 16 children have developed severe influenza, with 1 death; more than 450 elderly admitted with severe illness and nearly 300 deaths. The government has purchased 1.3 million vaccine doses; the first batch has arrived. Measures to facilitate vaccination include the eHealth Vaccine Electronic Consent platform, expanding the Doctor Vaccination Procurement Pilot and raising private doctors’ vaccine quotas from 100,000 to 300,000 doses. About 80,000 students have submitted consent; the public can use the system from Sept 17. 99% of schools participate in the new outreach program; 14 do not, and parents will be notified.

triage.headline_ja: 季節性インフルエンザ｜依然高水準　高齢者約300人が重症化により死亡　盧寵茂局長が早期接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザによる高齢者の重症死亡者数が約300人に達し、政府高官が緊急接種を呼びかけるなど公衆衛生上の影響と社会的関心が高いため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの流行状況で、香港特別行政区のデータは中国(China)に統合して集計。国際的な拡大やまん延防止措置の兆候は現時点では確認されないが、高齢者の重症・死亡数が多く、政府が積極的な対応（ワクチン接種拡大等）を取っている点が注目される。

article.articleHeadline: 香港季節性流感 已導致300名長者病亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seasonal influenza in Hong Kong has already caused 300 elderly deaths.
article.articleSummary: Seasonal influenza in Hong Kong has led to 300 elderly deaths since late June 2026, with more than 450 elderly hospitalized in severe condition. Among children, 16 have been admitted to intensive care for severe flu illness, including 1 death. Health authorities stress vaccination as the most effective prevention to reduce severe illness and mortality, urging especially for children and the elderly to receive the shot. A new round of influenza vaccination is scheduled to be rolled out on September 17, 2026. Health Secretary Lo Chung-mau, together with senior department heads, was vaccinated at a public ceremony to promote vaccination. The report does not provide laboratory confirmation details or infection source.

triage.headline_ja: 香港季節性インフルエンザ、高齢者300人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザによる死亡数は多いが、例年の季節性流行の範囲内である可能性があり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクの情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザによる重症例・死亡例の報告だが、通常の季節流行の範囲か異常な増加かの判断材料（過去比較データ等）がなく、また病原ウイルス株の情報もないため不明点が多い。政府はワクチン接種を推進しており管理体制は機能している模様。

article.articleHeadline: एक्सक्लूसिव: डेंगू-मलेरिया से बचना है तो करें यह काम, जिला मलेरिया अधिकारी ने बताई जरूरी सलाह
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Exclusive: To prevent dengue and malaria, do this—District Malaria Officer shares essential advice.
article.articleSummary: Badayun district, Uttar Pradesh, India, as of 7 September 2026 reports dengue and malaria cases this year are less than half of last year due to intensified monsoon-season campaigns. District Malaria Officer Amit Kumar Tiwari says rural health camps and targeted surveillance are ongoing. Anti-larval sprays and fogging are conducted through the Adh Panchayat; medicines are provided and fever cases can access free rapid diagnostic tests, with free government treatment if malaria is confirmed. Citizens are urged to test via ASHA workers and use nearest primary health centers rather than unlicensed doctors. Symptoms: malaria—high fever with chills and sweating; dengue—high fever, eye pain, headache, body and joint pains, vomiting. Dengue mosquitoes breed in clean water; remove standing water from homes (coolers, fridge trays, pots, old tires, containers). Use nets, stay hydrated, complete malaria treatment; wear long sleeves and consider repellents. Weekly Sunday campaign targets mosquitoes and larvae; schools to raise awareness.

triage.headline_ja: エクスクルーシブ:デング熱・マラリアを予防するには、これを実践してください―地区マラリア対策官が必須アドバイスを提供
triage.triage_reason: 今年の症例数は前年より半減しており、通常の季節性デング・マラリア予防啓発記事であり、異常性・重大性・国際的懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は地方自治体の予防啓発・保健当局の取り組みを紹介する内容であり、症例数は前年より減少していることから、シグナルとして識別する必要はない。

article.articleHeadline: Roma, la lebbra è in città. Ed è d'importazione
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rome, leprosy is in the city. And it's imported.
article.articleSummary: Rome reports Hansen's disease (leprosy) cases within the city; all Italian cases are imported with no local transmission since the 1970s. Fewer than ten new patients per year in Italy, with every case imported. Transmission is via droplets and nasal secretions of Mycobacterium leprae, requiring close, prolonged contact; after treatment, patients are no longer contagious. Spallanzani Institute and the Capitoline government note a subsidy of €33,273 in 2026 for 2025 expenses of affected individuals and their dependents. Globally, the WHO reported 182,815 new cases in 2023, with India, Brazil and Indonesia remaining the primary endemic areas. The article emphasizes that leprosy persists in Rome and Italy as imported cases with limited local transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ローマ、ハンセン病（レプラ）が都市部で確認。輸入例
triage.triage_reason: ローマ市内のハンセン病は全て輸入例で、1970年代以降現地感染はなく、既知の風土病の日常的報告に過ぎない。新規性・異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はイタリア（ローマ）における輸入例の状況説明であり、対象国リストのIndia/Brazil/Indonesiaは世界的な流行地としての背景情報として言及されているのみで、当該記事の発生地域としては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 다시 확산하는 DR콩고...질병청, 접경 9개국 검역 강화 - 신아일보
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreading again in DR Congo... KDCA strengthens border quarantine measures for nine neighboring countries
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak continues to spread, prompting KDCA to strengthen border quarantine measures with nine neighboring countries. The nine are Uganda, South Sudan, Rwanda, Burundi, the Central African Republic, Tanzania, Angola, the Republic of the Congo, and Zambia, designated as border quarantine management regions with country-specific risk controls. DR Congo reported 6,186 confirmed cases and 3,007 deaths as of July 31, up from 1,926 in mid‑July. WHO has classified DR Congo’s Ebola risk as ‘Very High,’ with the neighboring nine countries rated ‘High.’ KDCA will require health status declarations (via questionnaires or Q-CODE) for entrants, dispatch SMS guidance on preventive rules and symptom reporting, and link DUR-ITS with healthcare facilities for surveillance. Pre-departure and post-arrival screening of travelers departing DR Congo or transiting through airports will be followed by active surveillance for up to 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、DRコンゴで再び拡大…韓国疾病庁、隣接9カ国への検疫強化
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴでエボラ出血熱が急速に拡大し（6,186症例、3,007死亡）、WHOがリスクを「非常に高い」と分類。国境を越えた検疫強化措置が複数国で実施されており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ザンビアを含む9カ国は感染発生国ではなく、DRコンゴからの越境拡大に備えた検疫強化対象国として言及されているため、verified_locationsには含めていない。実際の発生国はDRコンゴのみ。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉死亡突破3000人！不到4個月確診逾6200例、蔓延6省　罕見病毒株至今沒有核准疫苗與特效藥
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in Congo surpasses 3,000! In under four months, more than 6,200 cases confirmed, spreading across six provinces; a rare Ebola virus strain has no approved vaccine or effective treatment to date.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo faces its worst Ebola outbreak to date, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus and spreading across six provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo, and Bas-Uele. In under four months, 6,207 cases and 3,000 deaths (roughly 50% case fatality) have been reported. By Aug 26, 5,794 cases and 2,786 deaths; WHO data on Aug 28 covered 60 health zones. The WHO has maintained the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Control is hindered by armed conflict, displacement, health-system collapse, PPE shortages, attacks on facilities, and community mistrust, causing substantial gaps in contact tracing. No vaccine or therapy specific to Bundibugyo exists; Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus vaccine) has arrived (~70,000 doses) for frontline workers, though protection against Bundibugyo is unproven. Two Bundibugyo vaccine candidates are in safety trials in the UK and Canada, with potential Congo efficacy trials in Oct–Nov. A $1.3 billion funding gap is urged.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が3000人を突破！4か月足らずで確診6200例超、6省に拡大　まれなウイルス株には現在も承認済みワクチン・特効薬なし
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる過去最悪規模の流行が発生し、致死率約50%・6省に拡大、WHOがPHEICを維持しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: WHOはPHEIC継続中。ワクチン・治療薬未承認で、資金不足（13億ドル）や武装紛争による対応困難が続いている。UK・Canadaでの安全性試験は当該国での流行ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Indonesia Kembangkan Vaksin Dengue Berbasis mRNA untuk Lawan Empat Serotipe Virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indonesia Develops an mRNA-Based Dengue Vaccine to Combat the Four Serotypes of the Virus.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia is developing an mRNA-based tetravalent dengue vaccine designed to cover DENV-1 to DENV-4, incorporating local dengue diversity with in silico mutation analysis and AI. The project is a collaboration among Universitas Indonesia (UI), the National Research and Innovation Agency (BRIN), LPDP, Etana Biotechnologies Indonesia, and Tsinghua University. At a UI workshop in Depok on August 27–28, 2026, researchers emphasized the need to bridge research to product via scale-up, GMP validation, preclinical/clinical testing, and regulatory pathways, supported by teaching factories that link labs to industry. BPOM’s GROW program provides early regulatory guidance. Early results show the vaccine candidate neutralizes all four serotypes, with some constructs outperforming wild type and Dengvaxia. While promising, further studies are required before clinical use, within a Pentahelix ecosystem and Technology Readiness Level guidance.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア、4血清型のデング熱ウイルスに対抗するmRNAベースワクチンを開発
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチン研究開発の進展に関する報道であり、実際の感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではないため、シグナルとしての基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の発生状況ではなく、mRNAワクチンの研究開発に関する内容であるため、感染症イベントとしての地域発生情報は該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: New Tick-Borne Virus Causing Flu-Like Illness Discovered in China
article.articleSummary: China reports identification of a previously unknown tick-borne virus that causes a flu-like illness in patients following tick exposure. Affected individuals present with fever, fatigue, headaches, muscle aches and gastrointestinal symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, and abdominal discomfort, with initial signs resembling the common cold or influenza. The virus could not be detected with standard vector-borne disease tests and was identified after deep genome sequencing of samples from patients with unexplained fevers. Epidemiological data point to local ticks as the primary hosts and transmission source to humans. After confirmation, patients received antiviral and antibacterial therapies with supportive care and recovered within about two weeks, with no long-term effects reported. Health authorities urge increased surveillance and physician awareness for unexplained fevers after tick bites, and advise precautions in wooded or grassy areas, including protective clothing, repellent, and tick checks.

triage.headline_ja: 中国でインフルエンザ様症状を引き起こす新種のマダニ媒介ウイルスを発見
triage.triage_reason: これまで知られていなかった新規のマダニ媒介ウイルスが中国で確認され、既存の検査法では検出できないため、病原体の特性やヒトへの感染拡大リスクが不明であり、フルリスク評価による確認が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 新規ウイルスは標準的な検査法で検出できず、深いゲノムシーケンスで同定された点が特徴的。ヒト-ヒト感染の有無や地理的拡大範囲については記事内に情報がなく不明。今後の続報や病原体特性の解明が重要。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: अमृतसर में स्वाइन फ्लू का बढ़ा खतरा, 15 मरीज पॉजिटिव, स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu threat rises in Amritsar; 15 patients test positive, Health Department on alert.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (influenza A H1N1) alerts Amritsar, Punjab, India, with 15 confirmed cases and rising. Health department and district medical college have intensified surveillance and prepared hospitals for isolation: Guru Nanak Dev Hospital around a 30-bed isolation ward; Civil Hospital also activated isolation facilities; senior doctors on duty. The government has directed increased monitoring of suspected cases, testing, and, if needed, sample testing and antiviral stock (oseltamivir), oxygen, and ventilator support. Flu-like symptom screening expanded across about 205 government health facilities via 'Flu Corner', with early identification of high-risk patients (cough, fever, sore throat, breathing difficulties). Lab data show Amritsar 15 and Jalandhar 10 confirmed cases; daily tests from both cities. Officials urge calm, adherence to guidelines, and prompt hospital care for respiratory distress. The focus remains on monitoring trends and potential clusters.

triage.headline_ja: アムリトサルで豚インフルエンザの脅威拡大、15人陽性、保健当局が警戒
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)としてインド・パンジャブ州で毎年報告されるパターンであり異常性は低いが、症例数が増加し当局が病床・抗ウイルス薬の準備を進めているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の毎年の流行パターンに該当する可能性が高く、地域保健当局のルーチン対応（隔離病床設置、抗ウイルス薬備蓄、フルコーナーでのスクリーニング拡大）が中心。重症度・死亡例に関する情報は本文になく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Число заболевших Эболой в ДР Конго превысило 6 тыс. человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in DR Congo has surpassed 6,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to surge. The National Institute of Public Health (INSP) reports 6,604 infections and 3,175 deaths since the outbreak began. In the last 24 hours, 82 new cases and 41 deaths were recorded, with the death toll having reached 3,072 by the end of last week. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus labeled this the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history, with transmission rates significantly higher than the 2014–2016 epidemic. Doctors interviewed by the Washington Post note that official statistics may undercount true figures, as many infections evade surveillance and a substantial number of patients die outside health facilities. The situation remains rapidly evolving within DR Congo as of 7 September 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が6000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: 致死率が高く、史上最速の拡大速度とWHOが表明するなど深刻かつ異常な大規模アウトブレイクであり、国際的拡大・支援ニーズも高いためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が史上最速のエボラ流行と発言。実際の感染者数は過小報告の可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Jaundice outbreak in Nainital: Over 100 fall sick, 2 dead as suspected water contamination sparks fear
article.articleSummary: Jaundice and diarrhoea outbreak in Jeolikote and neighboring villages in Uttarakhand's Nainital district sickened over 100 residents, with two deaths reported during treatment. Symptoms include diarrhoea, vomiting, and weakness, later linked to jaundice after medical testing. Patients are being treated across Nainital and Haldwani hospitals; some have been referred to larger facilities in Bareilly and Delhi. A woman reportedly died in treatment, and a 16-year-old also succumbed; the teenager was receiving care at Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital in Delhi. Health teams have set up screening camps, isolated the Durgapur water source after irregularities were flagged, and launched emergency chlorination with over 100 household storage units disinfected. Tanker-delivered potable water is being provided to affected villages. Water samples tested recently showed no bacterial traces; officials are inspecting sewerage and pipe networks to identify cross-contamination points.

triage.headline_ja: ナイニタールで黄疸の集団発生：水質汚染の疑いで100人以上が発症、2人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 水系感染症（黄疸/肝炎疑い）により100人以上が発症し2人が死亡、当局が水源汚染を特定し緊急対応中であり、重症度と流行しやすさの観点からWPRO基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウッタラーカンド州ナイニタール県のジェオリコテ及び周辺村落で発生。水源（Durgapur水源）の汚染が疑われ、当局は塩素消毒・タンカーによる給水・スクリーニングキャンプ設置など対応済み。黄疸症状からA型/E型肝炎の可能性が示唆されるが確定病原体は不明。地域限定的で国際的拡大リスクは低いが、国内公衆衛生上の関心は高い。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: UP makes H1N1 testing free at government health facilities
article.articleSummary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath ordered free Influenza-A (H1N1) testing at all government facilities and capped private testing charges at the prescribed rate. He directed stronger surveillance and treatment in districts with rising cases, plus separate flu facilities and ICU beds for serious patients. 685 laboratory-confirmed H1N1 cases have been reported in the state. Prevention and screening with ANMs and ASHA workers will identify and treat suspected cases promptly. Mild cases rest at home; serious cases require immediate care. Special attention to children, pregnant women, the elderly, and those with comorbidities. Hospitals should have flu counters and referral pathways; districts have flu desks, sample collection, flu OPDs, and RT-PCR kits; medical colleges provide testing facilities and isolation beds. Oseltamivir and H1N1 vaccines are stocked; public awareness campaigns will stress hygiene. H1N1 spreads via droplets; symptoms include fever, runny nose, cough, sore throat, headache, body aches, chills, red eyes.

triage.headline_ja: ウッタルプラデーシュ州、政府医療施設でのH1N1検査を無料化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザではあるが685例の検査確定例が報告され、州首相が監視強化・無料検査・専用ICU整備を指示するなど行政の高い関心が見られるため、フルRRAでの評価が望ましい。
triage.notes: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザの国内対応強化に関する報道。国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、州レベルでの症例増加と行政対応の強化が見られるため経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Australia flagged fake rabies vaccine months before India's latest alert
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccine Abhayrab, produced by Indian Immunological Ltd (IIL), accounts for about 40% of India’s annual supply. Australia’s ATAGI warned in December 2025 of a counterfeit batch KA24014 circulating in India, advising travellers who cannot confirm batch details to seek a replacement vaccine registered in Australia; a March 2025 Delhi Drugs Control advisory echoed safety concerns. In April 2026, Delhi Police and drug regulators seized Abhayrab vials labeled KE25012 from an unlicensed Mukherjee Nagar premises; the Central Drugs Laboratory (CDL) in Kasauli found the samples misbranded and not of standard quality, with potency failing. IIL contends the seized vials were not theirs, citing 17 differences with genuine KE25012. The genuine batch reportedly cleared government testing and had no market complaints. Rabies remains nearly always fatal once symptoms emerge; India records about 90 lakh animal bites annually and over 5,700 rabies deaths each year, two-thirds from dog bites.

triage.headline_ja: オーストラリア、インドの最新警告より数ヶ月前に偽造狂犬病ワクチンを警告していた
triage.triage_reason: インドで流通する偽造狂犬病ワクチンに関し、致死率がほぼ100%の狂犬病予防に直結する公衆衛生リスクがあり、オーストラリアが渡航者向けに国際的な警告を出すなど、複数のIHR基準に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 本件は感染症のアウトブレイクそのものではなく、偽造ワクチン流通による狂犬病予防効果の低下という薬事・規制上の問題が主題。オーストラリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。狂犬病自体はインドで既に風土病的に高い死亡数（年間5700人超）を記録しており、偽造ワクチンによる予防失敗のリスクが公衆衛生上の懸念となる。

article.articleHeadline: 40ปี ไทยกำจัด 'หัดเยอรมัน' สำเร็จ! WHO รับรองแล้ว
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand eradicates rubella (German measles) after 40 years; WHO has certified.
article.articleSummary: Thailand has been certified by the World Health Organization as having eliminated rubella (German measles) after 40 years of vaccination and surveillance. Eliminating rubella protects unborn children from congenital rubella syndrome (CRS), which can cause heart defects, hearing and vision impairment, and lifelong disability. Surveillance shows rubella and CRS cases have fallen sharply, with no endemic outbreaks since 2021. WHO criteria require no endemic transmission for more than 36 months and a high-quality system capable of detecting, investigating, and responding to cases. Nevertheless, imported infections remain a risk; Thailand must sustain population immunity, close vaccination gaps, and maintain rash and laboratory surveillance to prevent re-establishment of endemic transmission. The next target is measles, with strategies leveraging the MMR vaccine, while acknowledging that measles control also depends on factors beyond vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: タイ、風疹（先天性風疹症候群含む）の排除に成功 - 40年の取り組みをWHOが認定
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はタイが風疹の排除をWHOに認定されたという肯定的な公衆衛生成果の報告であり、新規の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は風疹排除達成という好意的なニュースであり、疾病の発生・流行を示すものではないため、対象国リストに該当する国があってもイベントとしてのverified_locationsは空とする。

article.articleHeadline: खांसी और सांस फूलने को न करें नजरअंदाज, हो सकते हैं स्वाइन फ्लू के लक्षण; बढ़ते मामलों के बीच डॉक्टरों की चेतावनी - swine flu symptoms shortness of breath key indicator in moradabad
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't ignore coughing and shortness of breath; they could be swine flu symptoms—doctors warn as cases rise. Swine flu symptoms: shortness of breath, a key indicator in Moradabad.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu cases are rising in Moradabad, India. Health officials say screening now targets breathlessness and other respiratory symptoms, not fever alone, at the district hospital. Suspected patients with fever plus shortness of breath or respiratory distress are flagged for testing and close monitoring to detect early lung involvement. So far, 16 identified cases reported cough and shortness of breath. Doctors warn that flu symptoms vary: some have fever with sore throat, cough, and body ache, while others develop breathing difficulties; CT chest is used by some physicians to assess lung involvement. High‑risk groups include the elderly, young children, pregnant women, and people with pre‑existing respiratory disease, diabetes, heart disease, or weakened immunity. Do not ignore cough or throat infection—seek prompt medical care to prevent complications.

triage.headline_ja: 咳や息切れを軽視しないで、スワイン・フル(豚インフルエンザ)の症状かもしれない――症例増加を受け医師が警告。モラーダーバードでは息切れが重要な指標に
triage.triage_reason: インド・モラーダーバード地区で豚インフルエンザ(H1N1)患者が16例確認され、呼吸器症状を重視したスクリーニングが行われているが、重症度・死亡例・地域拡大などの詳細情報が不足しており、季節性の局地的増加の域を出ない。
triage.notes: インドでは豚インフルエンザ(H1N1)は季節性に発生する疾患であり、今回の記事は地域の医療機関による症例増加への注意喚起・スクリーニング方針の変更を伝える内容。重症例数・死亡者数・感染拡大の地理的範囲についての情報がなく、フルリスク評価に進む根拠は現時点では弱いため、続報を注視するWATCHと判定した。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تطلق خطة معدلة لمدة 180 يوما لتعزيز مكافحة وباء الإيبولا - ستاد الأهلي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo launches an amended 180-day plan to bolster the fight against the Ebola outbreak - Al Ahly Stadium.
article.articleSummary: EBOLA outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues with 600 deaths and over 1,700 confirmed cases as of last Thursday, driven by rapid local transmission. Authorities launched an amended 180-day, multi-sector plan to strengthen response, supported by the World Health Organization and Africa CDC with partners. The plan emphasizes intensified surveillance, enhanced contact tracing, improved patient care, and community engagement to curb transmission. Africa CDC has described this outbreak as the fastest-spreading on record. The outbreak is concentrated across 37 areas in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, while suspected cases have been reported in Kisangani (Kisangani in Tshopo) and in Haut-Uele, indicating spread beyond the initial epicenter in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行対策強化のため180日間の修正計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行(600人死亡、1700人超の確定症例)が急速な地域伝播を伴い拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: Africa CDCが「史上最速の拡大」と表現するほどの深刻な流行。当初の震源地Ituriから北・南キブ、さらにTshopo(Kisangani)、Haut-Ueleへと拡大しており、国際的懸念が高い。WHO・Africa CDCが支援に関与している。

article.articleHeadline: 流感病毒活躍程度持續處於高水平　確診比率達11.17%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza virus activity remains at a high level, with a confirmed rate of 11.17%.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity remains high in Hong Kong since late June, with an 11.17% laboratory-confirmed rate and about 0.75 infections per 10,000 hospital patients. The Hospital Authority reports 16 children with influenza in intensive care, including 1 death, and 460 adults in severe condition, over 80% aged 65 or older. The seasonal vaccination program begins Sept 17, with 1.3 million doses purchased and the first batch already landed. Health officials highlight ongoing transmission and urge vaccination, including at the Sai Wan Ho Family Medicine Clinic. The Department of Health cautions that the WT1 “cancer vaccine” is experimental with no clinical data; inspections found unregistered injections but none detected. Separately, elevator shaft tilt at Mary Hospital’s new building may delay relocation and affect service rollout.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザウイルスの活動は依然として高水準を維持、陽性率は11.17%に達する
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの活動が高水準で継続し、重症例・死亡例も報告されているが、香港では例年見られる季節性流行の範囲内であり、異常性や国際的拡大の兆候は認められないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区は対象国リストのChina(1814991)に含めて集計。小児16例の集中治療、うち1例死亡、成人460例の重症例（80%以上が65歳以上）が報告されているが、季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行パターンとして扱われており、ワクチン接種プログラムも予定通り実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Uttarakhand Mystery Fever Outbreak Sparks Health Scare: 1 Dead, Dozens Sick as Contaminated Water Suspected
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of a mystery fever in Uttarakhand’s Nainital district (Jeolikote and eight nearby villages) has caused one death (Anita) and dozens of illnesses. Patients report jaundice and gastrointestinal symptoms; several children show very high liver enzymes. Officials suspect contamination of the local drinking-water network; the Durgapur water source has been isolated. Emergency measures include chlorination, cleaning of household water tanks, tanker-supplied water, medical camps, and closures of schools and Anganwadi centers. About 10–12 patients from the area were admitted locally, with several more arriving daily; severe cases have been transferred to facilities in Haldwani, Bareilly, and Delhi. Post-treatment water tests show no bacterial traces, but investigators continue inspecting sewerage and pipelines for entry points. Residents are advised to drink boiled or treated water and maintain hygiene; over 100 household water-storage units have been cleaned.

triage.headline_ja: ウッタラーカンド州で謎の発熱アウトブレイクが健康被害を懸念させる：1人死亡、数十人が発症、汚染水が疑われる
triage.triage_reason: 原因不明の発熱・肝機能障害を伴う集団発生で死亡例が出ており、汚染水由来の急性感染症の可能性がある。IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性）を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価へ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 黄疸・消化器症状・肝酵素上昇という臨床像から、汚染飲料水を介したA型/E型肝炎などの水系感染症が疑われる。地元当局は塩素消毒・給水車手配・学校閉鎖等の対応を開始しており、事案は現時点ではウッタラーカンド州内（Nainital地区）に限局。国際的な拡大や渡航制限の兆候はないが、原因病原体が未特定であり続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi man makes full recovery in over 2 years; survives six surgeries, rare skull bone TB
article.articleSummary: New Delhi, India: A 53-year-old man admitted to Fortis Hospital, Shalimar Bagh, after a spontaneous brain hemorrhage with severe brain swelling and low platelets on Ecosprin, underwent emergency decompressive craniectomy with a portion of skull left open. He required prolonged ventilation and a tracheostomy, remaining in ICU for nearly a month before regaining consciousness. Seizures necessitated skull re-replacement using his preserved skull bone; soon after, a new clot under the flap prompted another brain operation. Months later, wound discharge led to the diagnosis of skull-bone tuberculosis, an exceptionally uncommon complication after brain surgery. The infected bone was removed; prolonged anti-tuberculosis therapy started, with TB also involving brain and spine. The patient endured repeated neurological weakness, infections, thigh fracture, and optic neuritis—partial vision loss due to anti-TB meds. Skull reconstruction used a custom PEEK implant; care spanned nearly two-and-a-half years across multiple specialties, enabling independent life.

triage.headline_ja: デリーの男性、2年以上を経て完全回復―6回の手術を乗り越え、まれな頭蓋骨結核から生還
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の個人的な医療体験記であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や集団感染を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は個人の闘病記であり、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての意義はない。結核自体は既知の疾患であり、本症例は術後合併症としての稀な骨結核感染に関する医療事例報告。

article.articleHeadline: Manila declares leptospirosis epidemic; UST expert warns vs lesser-known risks
article.articleSummary: Manila declares leptospirosis an epidemic condition as the weekly attack rate hits 3.48%, up from 1.27%, with district hospitals reaching capacity following severe flooding, including at the University of Santo Tomas on Aug. 17. Leptospirosis is caused by Leptospira interrogans and is transmitted when skin or mucous membranes contact floodwater contaminated with urine from infected animals, especially rodents; the bacteria can survive in water for extended periods. Incubation ranges about one to three weeks, and symptoms can mimic dengue or flu—fever, severe calf muscle pain, abdominal pain, and in some cases no fever at all. Treatment varies by severity: antibiotics for mild cases; hospitalized care, dialysis, or respiratory support for severe disease. Prevention emphasizes post-exposure prophylaxis and immediate washing of exposed areas, followed by medical consultation regardless of symptom onset, particularly for workers exposed to floodwater. Keywords: outbreak, public health, flood-related illness.

triage.headline_ja: マニラがレプトスピラ症の流行を宣言、UST専門家があまり知られていないリスクについて警告
triage.triage_reason: マニラで洪水後にレプトスピラ症の攻撃率が急増し病院が満床となるなど公衆衛生への影響が深刻で、地域的な流行拡大と医療体制逼迫が確認されるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症流行で、地方病院が満床となるなど医療逼迫が顕著。デング熱との症状類似による診断遅延リスクも指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: ناميبيا تكثف جهودها لمكافحة الملاريا بعد تسجيل 32 ألف حالة إصابة منذ يناير الماضي - ستاد الأهلي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Namibia steps up its efforts to combat malaria after recording 32,000 cases since January last year - Al Ahly Stadium
article.articleSummary: Namibia intensifies malaria control in the Zambezi region after recording about 32,000 cases and 21 deaths since January, per Africa 24 TV. The Ministry of Health and Social Services is mobilizing communities to boost indoor residual spraying inside homes. Of 9,640 targeted households, only 2,710 have received treatment, while 2,644 refused access to health workers, giving 33% coverage versus an 85% target. To curb cross-border inflows, Namibia plans to formalize border surveillance, data sharing, and a coordinated response with neighbors Angola, Zambia, and Botswana. Malaria is a life-threatening parasitic disease caused by Plasmodium and transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes. The article notes ongoing transmission in Namibia and stresses improving coverage and regional cooperation to reduce cases and prevent imports.

triage.headline_ja: ナミビア、昨年1月以降3万2千件の感染確認後、マラリア対策を強化 - Al Ahly Stadium
triage.triage_reason: ナミビアのZambezi地域における既知の風土病マラリアの流行拡大であり、国境を越えた対策強化が言及されているが、対象国（ザンビア等）は近隣国としての言及に留まり、主題国ナミビアは対象国リストに含まれないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナミビア（Zambezi地域）のマラリア流行であり、ザンビア・アンゴラ・ボツワナは越境協力の文脈での言及にとどまるため、対象国リストにおける発生国としては該当なし。ナミビア自体は対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: ناميبيا تكثف جهودها لمكافحة الملاريا بعد تسجيل 32 ألف حالة إصابة منذ يناير الماضي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Namibia intensifies its efforts to combat malaria after recording 32,000 cases since last January.
article.articleSummary: Namibia steps up malaria control, focusing on the Zambezi region, after recording about 32,000 malaria cases and 21 related deaths since January. The Health and Social Services Ministry is mobilizing communities to improve coverage of indoor residual spraying. Of 9,640 targeted households, only 2,710 received treatment, while 2,644 refused access to health workers, yielding a 33% coverage against an 85% target. To curb imported cases, Namibia plans formal border surveillance, data sharing, and a joint response with neighboring southern African states Angola, Zambia, and Botswana. Malaria, caused by Plasmodium parasites, is a life-threatening disease transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes. The situation underscores ongoing transmission in border regions and the need for improved outreach, household engagement, and cross-border collaboration to reach the target and reduce fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: ナミビア、1月以降3万2000人の感染者を記録し、マラリア対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ナミビア国内でのマラリア流行拡大と対策の遅れが報告されているが、対象国（ザンビア等）での実際の感染発生は確認されておらず、越境協力の計画段階にとどまるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 主題はナミビアにおけるマラリア流行であり、対象国リストにナミビアは含まれない。ザンビア・ボツワナ・アンゴラは越境監視・共同対応の計画対象として言及されているのみで、これら諸国での実際の症例発生は記事内で確認できないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: ಡೆಂಗ್ಯೂ ಜ್ವರ: ಸಚಿವ ಜಿತನ್ ರಾಮ್ ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಗೆ ದಾಖಲು - Sanjevani
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever: Minister Jitan Ram admitted to hospital - Sanjevani
article.articleSummary: 82-year-old Jitan Ram Manjhi, Minister of Small and Medium Enterprises and former Chief Minister of Bihar, was admitted to New Delhi’s All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) with fever and breathing difficulties amid suspected dengue fever. He was brought to AIIMS emergency on Sunday evening and transferred to the ICU that night. Medical teams conducted tests; early indications point to dengue, with his condition described as under intensive care. He had previously been hospitalized in Patna last week for fever and severe weakness. As of the report, his condition is stated as stable, with the AIIMS medical board continuing treatment. No laboratory confirmation of dengue is noted in the article, though doctors are treating the illness as suspected dengue based on symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：ジタン・ラム閣僚が入院
triage.triage_reason: 特定個人（閣僚）のデング疑い入院に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の広範な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。デング熱はインドの流行地域で季節的に発生する既知の疾患であり単発の個人症例に留まる。
triage.notes: 著名人の個人的な健康状態に関する報道であり、検査確定もされていない疑い症例。デング熱自体はインドの流行地域では既知の疾患であり、本記事のみでは公衆衛生上の新たなシグナルとは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Tay chân miệng tăng mạnh, 7 địa phương ghi nhận số ca mắc cao nhất cả nước
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, foot, and mouth disease surges, seven localities record the highest number of cases nationwide.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) surges in Vietnam with nearly 100,000 cases in the first eight months of 2026, about 2.5 times higher than 2025. Seven localities report the highest counts: Ho Chi Minh City, Dong Nai, Dong Thap, Tay Ninh, Lam Dong, Da Nang, and Hanoi. Children under 5 account for over 87% of cases. HFMD is caused by enteroviruses Coxsackie A16 and Enterovirus 71 (EV71), the latter linked to potential neurological, cardiovascular, and respiratory complications. Symptoms include vesicles on the mouth, hands, feet, buttocks, and painful mouth ulcers; disease can worsen from day 2 to day 5 after onset. Red flags: fever ≥39°C for more than 2 days, abnormal behavior, seizures, or signs of neurologic or respiratory distress. Prevention emphasizes handwashing, surface disinfection, avoiding sharing items, and isolating cases for at least 10 days; the MOH has approved an HFMD vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病が急増、全国で7地域が最多症例数を記録
triage.triage_reason: 2026年ベトナムで手足口病（EV71関連）が前年比2.5倍に急増し、約10万例発生。IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常性」の2項目に該当し、フルリスク評価が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: EV71型は神経・心血管・呼吸器合併症のリスクがあり、5歳未満児が87%以上を占める。ホーチミン市、ドンナイ、ドンタップ、タイニン、ラムドン、ダナン、ハノイの7地域で症例数最多。ワクチンが承認済みだが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Cinco tipos de câncer podem ser evitados com vacinas; veja quais doenças estão relacionadas a vírus e bactérias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five types of cancer can be prevented with vaccines; see which diseases are related to viruses and bacteria.
article.articleSummary: Persistent infections by HPV, hepatitis B, and other agents are linked to about 10% of cancers. Vaccines against HPV and HBV are safe, effective, and part of Brazil’s SUS; the HPV vaccine has been in the National Immunization Program since 2014. HPV types 16/18 cause about 70% of cervical cancers; INCA projects 19,310 new cervical cancer cases in Brazil in 2026. Cervical cancer is the third most incident cancer among women, with higher burden in the North and Northeast due to access gaps. A Lancet Global Health study (2019–2023) in 20–24-year-olds found HPV vaccination associated with a 58% reduction in cervical cancer incidence and a 67% reduction in CIN3. The SUS adopted DNA-HPV testing for screening in 2024, with 2025 guidelines favoring primary testing; cytology remains during transition. HPV is also linked to cancers of penis, vagina, vulva, anal canal, and oropharynx, mostly after 60; oropharyngeal cancer is more common in men. HBV transmission via blood/fluids and perinatal exposure; chronic HBV increases risk of cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma.

triage.headline_ja: 5種類のがんはワクチンで予防可能:ウイルスや細菌と関連する疾患とは
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はHPV・HBVワクチンによるがん予防に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、急性の公衆衛生上の脅威やアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルにおけるHPV/HBVワクチンとがん予防に関する疫学的・啓発的内容であり、感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルではない。慢性疾患・予防医療に関する話題のため対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Malária se concentra na Amazônia e expõe desigualdades de saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria is concentrated in the Amazon and exposes health inequalities.
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains highly concentrated in Brazil’s Amazon region, where over 99% of cases are reported. In 2025, Brazil recorded 118,037 malaria cases and 39 deaths, with transmission linked to Anopheles mosquitoes in rural, riverside, and Indigenous communities near borders. The infection highlights health inequities and limited access to services; delayed diagnosis and treatment sustain transmission. Since 2024 the SUS has offered tafenoquine (single-dose) to prevent relapses, alongside expanded diagnostics, testing, and treatment. Diagnosis is by simple blood test; hallmark symptoms include high fever, chills, sweating, severe body aches, and headache 8–30 days after a bite. Environmental factors—higher temperatures, humidity, deforestation, and forested areas—boost vector survival. Cross-border movement from Venezuela, Colombia, and Peru raises risk; cases can be imported or autochthonous, with Anvisa guiding investigations when autochthonous transmission occurs. Prevention relies on nets, suitable clothing, and repellents, plus rapid care access.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアはアマゾンに集中し、健康格差を露呈する
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アマゾン地域におけるマラリアの継続的な流行と健康格差を扱う内容だが、新規性・突発性のあるアウトブレイクではなく既知の地域流行状況の報告であるため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・アマゾン地域における既知のマラリア流行状況（健康格差、SUSの対策）を報告する内容であり、ベネズエラ・コロンビア・ペルーは越境移動リスクの文脈で言及されているのみで、これらの国での発生が主題ではないため対象国リストには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: DOH logs over 15k dengue cases from Aug 2 to 15, higher than previous period
article.articleSummary: Philippines' Department of Health logged 15,763 dengue cases nationwide for Aug 2–15, up from 14,409 in the prior two weeks; total dengue cases in 2026 reach 128,634, while the current figure is 39% lower than 209,631 reported in the same period in 2025. The epidemiological report is dated Aug 29, 2026. Dengue is a viral infection transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, common in tropical countries such as the Philippines. Public health guidance urges prompt medical consultation for symptoms (sudden high fever, severe body aches), avoidance of floodwater, good hygiene, and removal of standing water to cut breeding sites. Authorities say they are stocked for blood banks and laboratory testing in anticipation of potential surges. There are four serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4); people can be infected with more than one serotype. No specific dengue treatment exists; management emphasizes fluids and monitoring for severe dengue; secondary infection with a different serotype increases risk.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン保健省、8月2日〜15日のデング熱症例が1万5千件超と報告、前期間より増加
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンで例年見られるデング熱の定期報告であり、症例数は増加傾向だが前年同期比では減少している。地域流行病として継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンで毎年流行する風土病であり、前年同期比では39%減少している。保健当局は血液バンクや検査体制を整備済みと報告しており、管理可能な状況と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Bé trai 4 tuổi sốt 40 độ C liên tục, phát hiện nhiễm Adenovirus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 4-year-old boy with a persistent 40°C fever, adenovirus infection detected.
article.articleSummary: Adenovirus infection causing persistent high fever in a 4-year-old boy from Ninh Bình, Vietnam, treated at the National Hospital for Tropical Diseases in Hanoi. The child had 2 days of fever up to 40°C with sore throat, poor appetite, vomiting, and mild cough; exam showed red throat and bilateral tonsillar pseudomembranes. COVID-like? No—viral test confirmed Adenovirus; C-reactive protein was mildly raised; chest X-ray showed no pneumonia. Managed with fever control, fluid replacement, and supportive care; fever subsided after 5 days, symptoms improved, and the patient was discharged on day 7 after two afebrile days. Clinicians caution against judging severity by fever alone; monitor temperature, overall condition, appetite, and breathing. Transmission occurs via respiratory secretions, direct contact, hands, and contaminated objects; emphasize hand hygiene and avoiding shared items. Advise rest, adequate fluids, appropriate antipyretics, and prompt medical care for persistent high fever, lethargy, poor intake, rapid breathing, or hypoxia.

triage.headline_ja: 4歳の男児が40℃の持続的発熱、アデノウイルス感染と判明
triage.triage_reason: 単発の小児アデノウイルス感染症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常性・重大性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: COVID-19として分類されているが、実際はアデノウイルス感染の単発小児症例報告。疾患名タグの誤りに留意。

article.articleHeadline: Punjab H1N1 cases reach 220 as first suspected death reported
article.articleSummary: As of 7 September 2026, Punjab has 220 confirmed H1N1 (swine flu) cases this year and reports its first suspected swine flu death of the season. An 85-year-old man from Jalandhar died after treatment at Civil Hospital, presenting with breathing problems and a history of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Officials say the death has not yet been definitively diagnosed as H1N1; a health audit will determine the cause. The confirmed H1N1 caseload has risen since August. Health authorities urge vigilance for flu symptoms but caution against unnecessary panic; older adults and those with underlying respiratory conditions may experience more severe illness from seasonal influenza. H1N1 is a seasonal influenza virus that can cause respiratory complications in susceptible patients.

triage.headline_ja: パンジャブ州でH1N1症例が220人に到達、初の疑い死亡例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1の症例増加と疑い死亡例の報告があるが、死因は未確定であり、季節性インフルエンザとして既知の病原体であるため国際的拡大リスクは低いと考えられる。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既知の病原体であり、新規性は低い。死亡例は基礎疾患（COPD）を持つ高齢者で、H1N1との直接的因果関係は健康監査待ちの状態。続報で死因確定や症例数の推移を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: মশার লার্ভার হটস্পট টালিগঞ্জ, কসবা, নিউ আলিপুর! রাজ্যজুড়ে ডেঙ্গু আক্রান্ত প্রায় ৪ হাজার
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mosquito larva hotspots: Tollygunge, Kasba, New Alipore! Nearly 4,000 dengue cases across the state.
article.articleSummary: Nearly 4,000 dengue cases reported across West Bengal as of 7 September 2026, with Kolkata intensifying transmission after a three-day 'Cleanliness Welcome' dengue elimination drive. Hotspots include Tollygunge, Kasba, and New Alipore; fever clusters are prominent in Shyambazar, Hatibagan, and Shobhabazar. Authorities say door-to-door fever surveys will be conducted through mid-October, and anyone with fever lasting two days or more and dengue-like symptoms should be referred to a health facility. In Kolkata, Ward 2 records 35 fever cases; Ward 9 (Alipore, Ekbalpur, Chetla, Mominpur) 31; Ward 10 shows the highest mosquito larvae at 326 sites across areas including New Alipore, Tollygunge, Kasba, Rath Tala, Dhakuria, Gariahat, Lake Gardens, and Tollygunge Victory Garden. Ward 11 has 217 larval sites; Ward 14 has 146. Investigations identified 76 construction sites with standing water, 56 vacant plots, and 28 waterlogged ponds; breeding sites include discarded ice-cream cups and tires.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊の幼虫発生地はトーリーガンジ、カスバ、ニューアリポール！ 西ベンガル州全体でデング熱感染者約4000人
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州で季節性のデング熱が例年通り発生しており、地方当局が防除活動を実施中。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、感染継続の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱は西ベンガル州（コルカタ含む）で例年発生する季節性感染症であり、当局が家庭訪問調査や蚊の幼虫駆除活動を実施中。重症度・死亡者数の記載はなく、外部支援の必要性も示されていない。
