article.articleHeadline: Türkiye'de de kullanılan dozları üreten şirket tek tek toplatıyor: Kuduz aşıları sahte çıktı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The company that produces the doses used in Turkey as well is recalling them one by one: rabies vaccines turned out to be fake.
article.articleSummary: Indian Immunologicals Ltd (IIL) rabies vaccine Abhayrab batches are being recalled after India’s CDSCO found a batch ineffective and potentially counterfeit. A KE25012 batch of 83,370 vials was identified; samples were taken by CDSCO from a residence in Delhi’s Mukherjee Nagar. IIL says products from authorized channels are unaffected. The Kasauli Central Drug Laboratory found the sampled lot non-standard and falsely labeled, with 17 discrepancies in labeling, QR codes, cap color, packaging, and other details; efficacy did not meet requirements, implying insufficient protection and increased death risk for bite victims. Four people were detained by Delhi Police; investigation ongoing. This is not the first incident; January 2025 batch KA24014 was also flagged, with US/UK/Australia warnings for travelers. India’s 2024 ICMR-NIE estimate: about 5,726 rabies deaths. Abhayrab is exported to more than 40 countries, including Turkey, South Africa, UAE; regulator says none of this batch was exported.

triage.headline_ja: トルコでも使用されている製薬会社の製品が回収に:狂犬病ワクチンが偽造と判明
triage.triage_reason: インド製狂犬病ワクチン(Abhayrab)の偽造・効能不足バッチが発見され、咬傷被害者の死亡リスク増加が指摘されている。40カ国以上への輸出実績があり、複数国で過去に警告が出された事例で、国際的な公衆衛生・薬事安全上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 本件は狂犬病そのものの流行ではなく、インド製狂犬病ワクチン(Abhayrab)の偽造・品質不良バッチ発見によるリコール事案。トルコ・南アフリカ・UAE等は輸出先国として言及されているが、規制当局は当該不良バッチは輸出されていないと説明しており、対象国リストにも該当しないため verified_locations には含めていない。過去(2025年1月)にも同様のバッチ問題が発生しており、継続的な品質管理上のリスクとして注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Tăng cường tiêm chủng cho trẻ, giám sát chủ động để phòng nguy cơ bại liệt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strengthening vaccination for children, active surveillance to prevent the risk of poliomyelitis.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's Ministry of Health strengthens polio vaccination and active surveillance to prevent poliomyelitis, focusing on border areas with Lao PDR. Provinces are instructed to implement Plan 447/KH-BYT (2026) to ensure vaccination, surveillance, and rapid response, prioritizing border communes, ethnic minorities, remote regions, and migrants. Key targets include maintaining ≥95% routine immunization coverage for children under 1 with bOPV and IPV, conducting catch-up and booster doses, and ensuring vaccine supply, staffing, equipment, and safe transport of specimens. Intensified AFP (polio-like) surveillance with proactive case finding and record reviews, including two adequate stool samples per suspected case, is required. For border provinces, aim to achieve at least 2 non-polio AFP cases per 100,000 children under 15 per year in high-risk areas and ensure cross-border information sharing with Laos and WHO, plus hospital readiness and staff training.

triage.headline_ja: 子供へのワクチン接種強化、ポリオリスク予防のための積極的サーベイランス
triage.triage_reason: 実際のポリオ症例発生の報告ではなく、ラオスとの国境地域を中心とした予防的なワクチン接種・サーベイランス強化策についての記事であり、現時点で確認された症例情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事はベトナム保健省による予防的な政策文書（Plan 447/KH-BYT）に基づく対応強化の報告であり、確定的なポリオ症例の発生は記載されていない。ラオスとの国境地域における急性弛緩性麻痺（AFP）サーベイランス強化が主眼。続報でのポリオ症例確認有無を注視する必要がある。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Punjab's H1N1 Cases Cross 200; First Suspected Death Reported
article.articleSummary: Punjab reports 220 confirmed H1N1 cases in 2026 with the first suspected death: an 85-year-old man from Jalandhar. High-risk groups include the elderly, children, pregnant women, and those with chronic conditions. Symptoms resemble seasonal influenza (fever, cough, sore throat, body aches, fatigue); warning signs such as new or worsening breathlessness, chest pain, or falling oxygen saturation require urgent medical assessment. Antibiotics do not treat influenza; early antiviral treatment can benefit high-risk or progressive cases. Doctors urge vigilance and caution against viewing H1N1 as routine flu. Most patients recover, but a sudden deterioration after initial improvement may indicate complications like pneumonia. Seek urgent care if breathing changes or severe symptoms occur. Date: 2026-09-07.

triage.headline_ja: パンジャブ州でH1N1感染者が200人を超え、初の疑い死亡例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1の増加と初の疑い死亡例が報告されているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは確認されておらず、現時点では地域内の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の地域的増加であり、国際的緊急性は低いが、死亡例増加や重症化兆候の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: अस्पताल में कैसी व्यवस्था? मलेरिया-मीजल्स का आउट ब्रेक, दो और बच्चों की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What arrangements are there at the hospital? Malaria-Measles outbreak, two more children dead.
article.articleSummary: Balaghat district’s Baghanchal in Madhya Pradesh is grappling with a three-month outbreak of measles–rubella, malaria, and malnutrition, with child deaths rising. Government claims compensation to 24 children; Congress cites 30 deaths. Recently, two more malaria deaths occurred: one child died after treatment by a quack, another died en route to hospital after referral, unable to reach care. District hospital has scaled beds from 50 to 138 and appealed for more staff to handle rising patients. Civil Surgeon Nilay Jain cites environmental factors, unsafe water, and malnutrition, plus measles–rubella attacks, as drivers, with the epidemic at a peak in Birsa block villages and expected to ease within a month. So far, 5,480 people have been surveyed, 1,029 identified; 593 treated at home, 436 hospitalized. Malaria 379, diarrhea 180, fever with rash 243, skin diseases 227.

triage.headline_ja: 病院の対応は?マラリア・麻疹の集団発生、さらに2人の子どもが死亡
triage.triage_reason: インド・マディヤプラデシュ州で麻疹・マラリア・栄養失調による子どもの死亡が続く3ヶ月にわたる複合アウトブレイクで、政治的論争も生じており社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: マラリア・麻疹風疹・栄養失調が複合的に絡む地域アウトブレイクで、地方病院の対応能力（ベッド数拡張）と政治的論争（死者数を巡る与野党対立）が確認できる。国際的拡大リスクは低いが、地域内の公衆衛生上の懸念は継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Counterfeiters now target vaccines as fake rabies shot case exposes growing threat- Moneycontrol.com
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccine Abhayrab from Indian Immunologicals Ltd (IIL), which holds ~40% of India's domestic rabies vaccine market, was targeted by counterfeiters. A batch KE25012 seized from a Delhi residential premises was found not of standard quality and misbranded; IIL asserts it did not originate from its facility. The Central Drugs Laboratory reported 17 differences between the seized vials and retained samples, with over 83,000 vials from this batch distributed only through authorised channels. Four people have been arrested as authorities trace the source. The case highlights a widening counterfeit drug threat, now including vaccines and other medicines, amid inter-state organised crime concerns and calls for stronger Drugs and Cosmetics provisions and fast-track courts. Regions with high incidents include Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Uttarakhand, Rajasthan and Punjab. A 2025 ASPA-Crisil report estimates about 28% of pharmaceutical products may be counterfeit, up from 20% in 2022, noting post-Covid emphasis on vaccines and supply chains.

triage.headline_ja: 偽造犯がワクチンを標的に―偽の狂犬病ワクチン事件が拡大する脅威を露呈 - Moneycontrol.com
triage.triage_reason: 偽造狂犬病ワクチンの摘発・逮捕事案であり、感染症の発生・拡大を報じるものではないため、感染症危機管理上のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症流行に関するものではなく、偽造医薬品（狂犬病ワクチン）流通事件についての報道。医薬品規制・薬事犯罪の観点から関係省庁の関心はあるが、公衆衛生上の感染症イベントではないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: MSF Ebola response: Testimony from a nurse
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with more than 6,000 confirmed cases and over 3,000 deaths, declared a little over three months ago. MSF nurse Martina Marchiò describes the human toll behind the numbers, including 64-year-old Jean Louis, a teacher who lost his wife and two daughters; his youngest daughter, aged 20, died days later. A tiny pink coffin seen on a roadside personalizes the tragedy. Symptoms noted include diarrhea, weakness, and bleeding. Frontline realities are stark: heat inside a yellow protective suit, meticulous hand-washing, and a constant risk of infection from a single lapse. Beyond medicine, the piece stresses community trust, psychological support, prevention, and clear communication. MSF calls for global mobilization of funds and resources to treat the sick, protect healthcare workers, prevent new infections, and reach remote communities in the DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: MSFのエボラ対応：ある看護師の証言
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例6,000人超、死者3,000人超という大規模なエボラ出血熱流行が続いており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態であるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきと判断する。
triage.notes: 感染者数・死者数が非常に多く、既に大規模流行が3ヶ月以上継続。MSFが国際的な資金・資源動員を要請しており、国際支援の必要性は明確。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限については記事内で言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Trang bị 'lá chắn kép' để chủ động ứng phó dịch sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Equipping a 'double shield' to proactively respond to the dengue fever outbreak.
article.articleSummary: By the 2026 rainy-season peak, dengue fever is rising in Ho Chi Minh City with complex transmission and increasing hospitalizations. Health authorities urge a double shield of dengue control: larval source reduction (eliminating larvae and breeding sites), mosquito bite prevention, and vaccination. Ho Chi Minh City Children's Hospital treated two children with dengue shock syndrome: a 10-year-old from An Giang and a 7-year-old resident of the city; both required aggressive IV fluids, vasopressors, blood products, and organ support (ventilation, dialysis, plasmapheresis), with gradual recovery after weeks. A pregnant patient, 23-year-old from Dong Nai, at term developed severe dengue with postpartum hemorrhage and multi-organ failure, undergoing cesarean, massive transfusion, plasma exchange, ventilation, and ultimately hysterectomy to control bleeding and infection. Cases have involved patients from Mekong Delta, Central Vietnam, and the Central Highlands, reflecting a year-round risk exacerbated by climate change and urbanization; late presentation and folk remedies worsen outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: 『二重の盾』でデング熱流行に積極的に対応
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ホーチミン市で季節性のデング熱増加と重症例（デングショック症候群、妊婦の多臓器不全）が報告されているが、地域限定的な季節性流行であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: 雨季ピークにおける季節性デング熱流行で、重症例が複数報告されているが、ベトナム国内の年次流行パターンの範囲内と考えられる。続報での症例数推移や地域拡大状況を注視。

article.articleHeadline: Deteksi Dini Tuberkulosis Lewat Skrining Jemput Bola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early Detection of Tuberculosis Through Door-to-Door Screening
article.articleSummary: September 7, 2026 — Residents in Kendari, Southeast Sulawesi, Indonesia participated in door-to-door tuberculosis (TB) screening organized by the Kendari City Health Office at the Alolama Kelurahan Office. The outreach aims to identify individuals with TB indicators so they can receive treatment per health standards and to curb transmission within the community. The effort emphasizes early case detection and prompt care, though no TB case counts, laboratory confirmations, or infection sources are reported. There is no mention of imported or exported TB cases. This public health measure reflects proactive TB control by mobilizing mobile screening to reach at-risk populations in Kendari.

triage.headline_ja: 巡回検診による結核の早期発見
triage.triage_reason: 通常の公衆衛生活動としての結核スクリーニングであり、症例数や異常な流行状況の報告がなく、既知の風土病対策の一環に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の日常的な検診活動を報じるものであり、症例数・感染源・異常な流行状況の記載はない。対象国リストのIndonesiaが発生地域に含まれるが、記事内容は通常の公衆衛生プログラムであり特筆すべき感染症イベントとは言えないため、verified_locationsも該当なしと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: DOH warns public vs ILI threat
article.articleSummary: Influenza-like illness (ILI) remains a public health concern during the rainy season, with the DOH reporting a slight uptick in cases. ILI is defined by fever ≥38°C with cough within 10 days, plus symptoms such as runny nose, weakness, body aches, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, or chills. Prevention emphasizes full family vaccination, hand hygiene, avoiding crowded places, proper ventilation, masking when sick, and covering coughs/sneezes. For those affected, stay home, limit contact with high-risk individuals (65+, underlying conditions, pregnant women, children ≤4), rest, fluids, and fever-reducing meds; seek care for fever >40°C or breathing difficulties. August data show ILI rose to 5,847 in Aug 2–15 (up 7% from Jul 19–Aug 1), and 86,113 total as of Aug 29—22% lower than 110,978 in 2025. Regions under watch: Western Visayas, Mimaropa, Central Visayas, Northern Mindanao.

triage.headline_ja: DOH、インフルエンザ様疾患（ILI）の脅威について国民に注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のILI増加に関する定例的な公衆衛生広報であり、2025年比で症例数は22%減少している。異常性や重症度の高まりを示す情報はなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: DOHによる季節性ILIの定例的な注意喚起記事。前年比で症例数は減少しており、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: DOH: More than 128,000 dengue cases reported
article.articleSummary: Dengue in the Philippines reached 128,634 cases in the first eight months of 2026, per the Department of Health. This total is 39% lower than the 209,631 cases recorded in the same period last year, but weekly counts have risen, with 15,763 cases reported August 2–15, 2026 — up 9% from 14,409 cases July 19–August 1, 2026. Dengue is an acute viral infection transmitted by the Aedes aegypti mosquito. Symptoms include high fever, joint and muscle pain, retro-orbital pain, weakness, skin rashes, nosebleeds as fever subsides, abdominal pain, vomiting dark material, dark stools, and breathing difficulty. DOH urges those with symptoms to seek medical care promptly. Prevention emphasizes the 4Ts: turn over, shake out, dry, and cover water containers; use mosquito repellent and wear long sleeves and pants.

triage.headline_ja: DOH: デング熱症例が12万8000件を超えて報告される
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンにおけるデング熱の季節性流行に関するルーチンの症例報告であり、前年同期比では39%減少している。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、通常のサーベイランス情報の範囲内である。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンで毎年流行する風土病であり、DOHによる定期的な症例報告記事。週次増加傾向は見られるが、前年同期比では大幅減少しており、緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Lebbra a Roma: spuntano nuovi casi importati. Il dossier dello Spallanzani e l'allarme dell'Oms: infezioni aumentate
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leprosy in Rome: new imported cases have emerged. The Spallanzani dossier and the WHO alert: infections have increased.
article.articleSummary: Leprosy in Italy is imported, not endemic, with about ten new Italian cases annually; in Rome, cases are managed at the Lazzaro Spallanzani National Institute for Infectious Diseases in Lazio. In 2025 Rome authorities documented subsidies for affected individuals and families totaling 33,273 euros, with Regione Lazio approving continued support in 2026. Leprosy, caused by Mycobacterium leprae, spreads mainly via droplets and nasal secretions, but contagiousness is very low; prolonged close contact is usually required. Specialists emphasize the disease is not limited to the poor and is curable, with patients becoming non-contagious quickly after treatment. Globally, the WHO recorded 182,815 Hansen's disease cases in 2023, a 5% increase, concentrated in endemic countries such as Brazil, India, and Indonesia. Most recent Italian cases are imported, necessitating diagnosis and specialist care.

triage.headline_ja: ローマでハンセン病：新たな輸入症例が発生。スパランツァーニ研究所の報告書とWHOの警鐘：感染者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: イタリア（ローマ）における輸入例の報告であり、非流行地域での散発的・管理された事例。国際的拡大やヒト-ヒト感染のリスクは低く、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はイタリア（ローマ）における輸入ハンセン病例の管理状況であり、対象国リストに含まれない。ブラジル・インド・インドネシアはWHOの世界的な流行国として言及されているのみで、記事の発生地域ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: DPRD Kota Bogor Desak Pemkot Percepat Penanganan Lonjakan Kasus HIV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bogor City DPRD Urges City Government to Accelerate Handling of the Surge in HIV Cases
article.articleSummary: Bogor City DPRD warns of a rising HIV burden in Bogor City, urging rapid action. Over the past five years about 2,000 new HIV-positive cases were recorded, including 599 in 2025. The five-year average is roughly 400 per year; about 1,400 people are on antiretroviral therapy. More than 84% of cases involve men (16% women), with most linked to high-risk sexual behaviors, including LGBT. The DPRD calls for accelerated implementation of the P4S Regional Regulation (Pencegahan dan Penanggulangan Penyakit Sosial), stronger public education, and higher funding in the 2027 APBD. They plan to send a letter to the Mayor due to the missing implementing regulation (Perwali). In the meantime, prevention programs—education in schools, families, and communities—should proceed, supported by increased KUA-PPAS funding for early detection and prevention, and youth protection.

triage.headline_ja: ボゴール市議会、HIV症例急増への対応加速を市政府に要求
triage.triage_reason: HIVは既知の慢性感染症であり地域的な症例増加を示すが、急性の公衆衛生上の緊急事態や国際的拡大リスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 地方議会レベルでの行政対応要請記事であり、HIVの慢性的・地域的な症例増加についての政治的関心を示すが、急性の感染症危機シグナルとは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: 602 leptospirosis beds available in 20 DOH hospitals in NCR
article.articleSummary: 602 leptospirosis beds available in 20 DOH hospitals in Metro Manila (NCR) as of Sep 3, 2026, with 260 surge beds included; 562 beds currently in use. DOH is redistributing patients to facilities with capacity, prioritizing dialysis and higher-level care. As of Sep 4, 1,204,200 doxycycline capsules augmented in affected regions, 2,624,089 capsules available across Centers for Health Development, and 40,812 capsules in DOH-retained Metro Manila facilities. A total of 6,253 leptospirosis cases have been recorded in 2026, 12% lower than 2025’s 7,084 in the same period; 824 cases were registered Aug 2–15, up 77% from Jul 19–Aug 1. Monitoring spans SOCCSKSARGEN, Central Visayas, Western Visayas, CAR, Negros Island Region, Bicol, Cagayan Valley, and Metro Manila, Ilocos, Central Luzon, CALABARZON, Northern Mindanao, Davao Region after repeated thresholds. DOH coordinates with LGUs for screening and prophylaxis of floodwater exposure; infection arises from bacteria in infected animal urine, transmitted via contaminated water/soil, with symptoms from fever to potentially severe disease.

triage.headline_ja: NCRのDOH病院20施設でレプトスピラ症用病床602床が利用可能
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンで季節性のレプトスピラ症流行が継続しているが、症例数は前年より減少しており異常性は低い。病床逼迫や重症例の存在から経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 毎年季節的に発生する洪水関連レプトスピラ症で、2026年の症例数は前年同期比12%減。DOHが病床・抗生剤の確保など通常の公衆衛生対応を実施中。死亡者数や重症度の詳細は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Los equipos funerarios del ébola en Congo enfrentan ira, fatiga y miedo al contagio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola funeral teams in Congo face anger, fatigue and fear of contagion.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 September 2026, nearly 3,200 people have died from Ebola out of more than 6,600 confirmed cases in the Ituri epicenter of the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The six eastern provinces are affected, with Bunia and Ituri bearing the heaviest burden. Frontline burial teams, including Yuma Adolphe, perform safe, dignified funerals for Ebola victims at roughly $20 per day, amid mounting workloads and hostility from communities restricted from traditional rites. Ebola bodies can remain highly infectious, spreading via contact with blood or body fluids. Health workers and funeral teams have faced attacks; authorities warn offenses will be prosecuted. The crisis is intensified by conflict, displacement, weak surveillance, and limited lab capacity. Vaccination with Evrebo is used for frontline workers, though its effectiveness against Bundibugyo ebolavirus is not proven. Official counts likely understate the true scale, with the outbreak potentially exceeding the 2014–2016 West Africa death toll (>11,000).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ埋葬チーム、怒り・疲労・感染への恐怖に直面
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例6,600件超、死者約3,200人という大規模かつ拡大中のエボラ流行であり、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を超える可能性が指摘されている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域として付与されているが、記事本文では言及されていないため除外。イトゥリ州・ブニアはDRC国内の行政区分として扱う。ワクチン(Evrebo)のBundibugyoエボラウイルスに対する有効性は未証明との記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: La province du Nord-Kivu confrontée à une forte hausse des nouveaux cas d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The North Kivu Province faces a sharp rise in new Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, shows a sharp rise. Confirmed Ebola cases in Nord-Kivu increased from 836 on Aug 30 to 969 by Sep 4, a gain of 133 cases (about 16%). Since Aug 31, daily confirmations have ranged 20–32. The province now includes 16 of 34 health zones with Ebola, including Kayna, and is the only province to gain a new zone in this five-day window. Fatalities are high: 638 of 969 diagnosed have died, a case-fatality rate near 66%, versus about 48% nationally. Treatment centers with 220 beds have been over capacity for six consecutive days; on Sep 3 more than half of patients were treated in facilities not dedicated to Ebola. Ituri remains the national epicenter, but Nord-Kivu now shows the most evident outbreak expansion.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:北キブ州でエボラ新規感染が急増
triage.triage_reason: 北キブ州でのエボラ感染者数が5日間で16%急増し、致死率約66%と非常に高く、治療施設が定員超過するなど公衆衛生上深刻な影響が確認されているため、IHR基準を2つ満たしフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はイトゥリ州が全国的な流行の中心である一方、北キブ州が最も顕著な感染拡大を示していると報告。感染拡大の国際的広がりに関する情報は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Two Dead, Over 250 Hospitalised By Suspected Water Contamination In Uttarakhand
article.articleSummary: Uttarakhand's Nainital district is facing a suspected waterborne fever outbreak linked to contaminated drinking water in Jeolikote and eight nearby villages. Two deaths have occurred and over 250 people are hospitalised with fever, diarrhoea, jaundice and suspected liver infection. 16-year-old Ritesh Jeena died after vomiting and fever; Neema Joshi died after jaundice and liver infection. Investigations have not yet identified the contamination source. Residents and local leaders say cases of diarrhoea, jaundice and typhoid have persisted for months, calling for inspections of water sources and supply lines. Emergency measures include medical camps, water disinfection, chlorination, and boil-water advisories. Four extra beds have been added at Jeolikot PHC, and doctors and duty hours expanded. Authorities urge boiling water, avoiding open sources, and maintaining hygiene; Jal Sansthan and health department coordinating with affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: ウッタラーカンド州で疑わしい水質汚染により2人死亡、250人以上が入院
triage.triage_reason: インド・ウッタラーカンド州で水系感染症（チフス含む）により死亡2名、250人以上が入院しており、公衆衛生への影響が深刻かつ汚染源が未特定で曝露が継続している。
triage.notes: 汚染源は未特定で、数ヶ月にわたり下痢・黄疸・チフスの症例が継続しているとの住民証言あり。現時点では地域限定的だが、水源対策の進捗を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Satu Dapur Terkontaminasi, Beribu Anak Teracuni
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One Contaminated Kitchen, Thousands of Children Poisoned
article.articleSummary: September 2024 in Tuscany, Italy saw a centralized school catering outbreak: Salmonella enterica serovar Strathcona ST2559 contaminated cherry tomatoes caused 224 cases and 26 hospitalizations; three Qualità & Servizi officials faced investigation for hygiene neglect. The same risk chain appears in Japan’s Yashio (June 2020): a single supplier’s lunch program for 15 schools sickened 2,958 of 6,732; E. coli O7:H4 carrying astA traced to fresh salad ingredients, including red alga Gigartina tenella. Germany, September 2012, reported about 11,000 gastroenteritis cases across 390 institutions linked to a single lot of frozen strawberries from China; 22 tons prompted a recall of 1,136 boxes, with the RKI estimating prevention of ~11,000 further cases. Tokyo, 2017: four norovirus outbreaks in 10 schools affected 4,209 people, 1,193 symptomatic; kizami nori seaweed from one producer carried norovirus GII.17 with matching genomes. Toyama, Japan, June 2021: >1,800 people across 25 schools affected by milk from one factory; pasteurization reportedly at 128°C.

triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2012年ドイツ、2017年・2020年・2021年日本、2024年イタリアの過去の学校給食関連食中毒事例をまとめた歴史的レビュー記事であり、新規の感染症発生イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue Cases in the Philippines Drop 39% in 2026, DOH Urges Continued Vigilance
article.articleSummary: Dengue in the Philippines shows a 39% drop in 2026 compared with the same period in 2025, when 209,631 cases were recorded. The Department of Health (DOH) cautions that the current tally may still change due to delayed reporting. The DOH urges continued vigilance for dengue symptoms and stresses preventive measures against mosquito breeding, emphasizing that public cooperation is essential for controlling transmission. Households are advised to regularly cover containers and remove stagnant water where mosquitoes may lay eggs. Measured relative to 2025's 209,631 cases for the same period, the 2026 tally reflects a reduction in transmission, pending updated figures.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンのデング熱症例、2026年は前年比39%減少 保健省は引き続き警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数は前年より39%減少しており、異常事態や新たな公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではなく、定例的な公衆衛生広報の内容である。
triage.notes: デング熱は当該地域で毎年流行する既知の風土病であり、本記事は症例減少と予防啓発を伝える定例的な内容。

article.articleHeadline: ভরা বর্ষায় ডেঙ্গির চোখ রাঙানি, ডেঙ্গি কখন প্রাণঘাতী হয়ে ওঠে? কোন উপসর্গগুলি 'রেড অ্যালার্ট'? জানাচ্ছেন চিকিৎসক
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue's menace during the monsoon season: When does dengue become life-threatening? Which symptoms are 'red flags'? A doctor explains.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Kolkata rises during the monsoon, with water stagnation for five to seven days, fostering Aedes aegypti larvae and vector growth. Dengue is a virus transmitted by Aedes aegypti; after feeding on an infected person, the virus multiplies in the mosquito, and 8–10 days later a bite can transmit dengue to a healthy person. If a mosquito that fed on an infected person bites another, dengue can develop after 6–8 days. Common symptoms include high fever, headaches, eye pain, and pains, plus vomiting and rash; weakness is common. The critical phase usually begins 3–7 days into illness and can occur as fever subsides, so a falling fever is not a sign of recovery. Red flags include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding from nose or gums, blood in vomit or dark stools, weakness, restlessness or confusion, skin, reduced urine, or deterioration after fever ends. Adults require close monitoring.

article.articleHeadline: RDCongo.- RDC eleva a más de 6.400 los casos y a 3.175 los muertos a...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC - DR Congo raises the number of cases to more than 6,400 and the death toll to 3,175 to...
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) climbs to 6,604 confirmed cases and 3,175 deaths as of Sep 7, 2026, with 82 new infections and 9 deaths in the previous 24 hours; 1,548 recoveries. Case fatality rate 48.1%; contact tracing 85.7%. Epicenter in Ituri province (northeast), which accounts for about 80.6% of detections, with six provinces affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, and Tshopo. Uganda reported 20 cases and 2 deaths; outbreak there ended on Aug 27 after 42 days without new cases. This remains the deadliest Ebola outbreak in DRC history, potentially surpassing past African outbreaks; comparisons are drawn to the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (28,616 cases, 11,325 deaths) per WHO data. DRC ended a Kasai outbreak in Dec 2025 and has longstanding Ebola experience since 1976 (Yambuku, near the Ebola River).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国 - コンゴ(DRC)、エボラ流行によるコレラ症例数が6,400人以上、死者数が3,175人に増加
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.1%、6,600例超・死亡3,175人に達する史上最悪規模のエボラ流行であり、複数州に拡大しウガンダにも越境。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20例・死亡2例が報告されたが、当該アウトブレイクは8/27終息済み。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRC史上最も致死的なエボラ流行とされ、2014-2016西アフリカ流行との比較が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Barito Utara perkuat deteksi dini TBC di Lapas Muara Teweh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Barito Health Office Strengthens Early TB Detection at Muara Teweh Prison
article.articleSummary: Muara Teweh, Central Kalimantan — The Barito Utara Regency Health Office intensified tuberculosis control by conducting active case finding (tracing) integrated with the Free Health Check program at Muara Teweh Class II-B Prison. Health Director Simamoraturahman said the initiative aims to identify TB cases and assess inmates’ and staff health early, as early detection is crucial to interrupt transmission in the prison setting where interactions are close. TB is contagious but curable when detected promptly and treated to completion; delays raise transmission risk. In addition to TB tracing, the effort is integrated with Free Health Check to enable broader health screenings. The plan relies on multi-sector collaboration with the prison administration, health workers, and participants to encourage uptake and truthful reporting. The emphasis is on ongoing case finding, monitoring, treatment, and prevention of transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 北バリト保健局、ムアラテウェ刑務所での結核早期発見を強化
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内での通常の結核対策（積極的症例発見）活動を報じる内容であり、異常性・重篤性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地域保健当局による通常の結核スクリーニング活動の報告であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。対象国リストのIndonesiaが発生地域だが、内容が定常的な公衆衛生活動のためDISMISS判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : à Lita, la capacité du centre de traitement renforcée face à l'afflux des malades
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: in Lita, the treatment center's capacity has been strengthened to cope with the influx of patients.
article.articleSummary: In Ituri's Lita health zone, the Ebola Treatment Center (CTE) capacity is being expanded as the outbreak evolves. A September 5 press visit showed bed occupancy at the center exceeding 100%, with the same building handling both suspected and confirmed Ebola cases. With support from WHO and partners, tents have been erected for suspected cases, while confirmed patients are treated in separate areas to reduce cross-contamination. Professor Thierno Baldé, head of WHO's response operations in the DRC, said separation was essential and that, within about a week, teams reorganized to relieve congestion. Extensions nearing completion should raise intake capacity and decongest hospital services, with new medical equipment to improve care for patients needing close monitoring. Strengthening treatment facilities remains a key challenge as the DRC outbreak continues to strain responses across multiple areas.

triage.headline_ja: イツリのエボラ出血熱：リタでは患者急増に対応するため治療センターの収容能力を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州で進行中のエボラ流行があり、治療センターの病床占有率が100%を超えるなど公衆衛生上深刻な影響とWHOによる国際支援の必要性が確認されるため。
triage.notes: 既知のDRCエボラ流行の継続報道。治療センターの病床占有率100%超・WHO支援継続中であり、既存アウトブレイクの進展としてフルRRA対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza tops Phuket communicable disease
article.articleSummary: Week 35 surveillance at Vachira Phuket Hospital shows 347 reported communicable-disease cases, led by influenza with 119 cases and one death; acute diarrhoea (68), COVID-19 (64), pneumonia (35) and dengue fever (16) complete the top five. These five conditions account for 302 of the week’s cases; the remaining 45 involve other monitored diseases such as RSV, hand-foot-and-mouth disease, syphilis, gonorrhoea, acute hepatitis B, conjunctivitis, scarlet fever, chickenpox and food poisoning. Among 347 patients, 161 were male and 186 female. Geographically, Mueang Phuket District bore 243 cases, followed by Thalang (53) and Kathu (40); 11 cases originated from other provinces. Separate surveillance for dangerous communicable diseases found no PUI, no confirmed cases, and no deaths during the week; the influenza death is included in the overall counts. Ongoing weekly surveillance and a dashboard are used for feedback.

triage.headline_ja: プーケットの感染症サーベイランス、インフルエンザが首位
triage.triage_reason: 地域の定例サーベイランス報告であり、季節性疾患の通常範囲内の数値で異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 定例の週次感染症サーベイランス報告。インフルエンザによる死亡1件が報告されているが、危険感染症（PUI・確定例・死亡）はゼロと明記されており、通常の地域公衆衛生モニタリングの範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: RDC eleva a más de 6.400 los casos y a 3.175 los muertos a causa del brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC raises Ebola outbreak cases to more than 6,400 and deaths to 3,175.
article.articleSummary: 6,604 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,175 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as of 7 September 2026. In the last 24 hours: 82 new cases and 9 deaths; 32 recoveries, total 1,548. Case fatality rate 48.1%; contact tracing 85.7%. Ituri province in the northeast is the epicenter, with about 80.6% of infections. Six provinces are affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele (Upper Uele), Bas-Uele (Lower Uele), and Tshopo. Uganda reported 20 cases and 2 deaths; its outbreak ended on 27 August after 42 days with no new cases. This outbreak is the deadliest in DRC history, potentially surpassing West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) and exceeding 2018–2020. DRC has long Ebola experience, with Kasai’s outbreak ending December 2025; Ebola was first identified in 1976 at Yambuku.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクの症例数を6,400人以上、死者数を3,175人に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪規模とされるエボラ流行で症例6,604例・死亡3,175例、CFR48.1%と極めて高く、複数州に拡大かつウガンダにも波及しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行は既に終息（8月27日）と報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。西アフリカ諸国（ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネ）は過去流行との比較のため言及されているのみで現在の発生国ではない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 Surge in Punjab: Cases Cross 200 as Influenza A Claims First Suspected Death
article.articleSummary: Punjab, India reports an H1N1 influenza surge with 220 confirmed cases this year and its first suspected death: an 85-year-old man from Jalandhar died after testing positive. Early symptoms mimic seasonal flu—fever, cough, sore throat, body aches, headache, chills, and fatigue—but progression to lower respiratory tract infection raises pneumonia risk. Delaying medical assessment is a major danger, with warning signs including new or worsening breathlessness, chest pain, falling oxygen saturation, persistent high fever, confusion, bluish lips, sudden deterioration, or relapse after initial improvement. Antibiotics do not treat H1N1 unless a bacterial coinfection is present; antivirals may help for those with severe or progressive disease or at higher risk, ideally started early. Health officials urge against treating H1N1 as routine flu, highlighting increased risk for older adults and individuals with underlying conditions.

triage.headline_ja: パンジャブ州でH1N1感染急増：症例200人超、インフルエンザAによる初の疑い死亡例
triage.triage_reason: インドのパンジャブ州でH1N1感染者数が220人に達し、初の疑い死亡例（85歳男性）が報告されており、重症化リスクへの注意喚起がなされているため、社会的関心とWPRO基準の一部該当によりピックアップと判断する。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして定着しているが、死亡例発生と症例数急増により地域の医療当局が注意喚起を行っている。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなく、現時点では地域限定の公衆衛生イベントとみられる。続報での重症例数・死亡者数の推移を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: 香港流感仍處高水平 16名小童感染流感入深切治療部 | 港澳話題 | 兩岸 | 經濟日報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza in Hong Kong remains at a high level; 16 children infected with influenza have been admitted to the ICU.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 September 2026, influenza activity in Hong Kong remains at a very high level. Influenza test positivity is 11.17%, well above baseline. The Hospital Authority reports 16 children with severe influenza admitted to intensive care units, including one death, and about 460 adult critical admissions, with more than 80% aged 65 or older. Health Secretary Lo Chung-mau and other officials visited Sai Wan Ho Family Medicine Clinic to receive seasonal influenza vaccines. The government has procured 1.3 million doses for this year’s vaccination program, which starts next Thursday; high-risk groups are urged to vaccinate. The eHealth platform now supports electronic consent for child influenza vaccination, with roughly 80,000 submissions to date. The current flu season began in late June and remains at elevated levels across the territory.

triage.headline_ja: 香港のインフルエンザ活動は依然高水準、小児16人がICUに入院
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザではあるが、小児ICU入院16例・死亡1例、高齢者中心の重症入院約460例など重症度が高く、長期間にわたり住民が曝露し続けている点、および政府・メディアの高い関心がWPRO基準・社会的関心の両方に該当するため。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの年次流行報告であり、病原体自体は既知・予測可能な範囲内。ただし重症例・死亡例の報告および政府によるワクチン接種推進など社会的対応が活発なため、経過観察・情報収集の観点からピックアップと判定した。

article.articleHeadline: 5cm寄生蟲藏腦內7年！　女子生飲山泉水釀禍
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 5 cm-long parasite hid in her brain for seven years! A woman's drinking of unboiled mountain spring water triggered the disaster.
article.articleSummary: Guangxi, China: A 56-year-old woman developed intracranial cysticercosis after seven years of progressive neurological decline. Beginning in 2017 with facial droop, gait instability, and slurred speech, she was repeatedly misdiagnosed as stroke or brain tumor until 2019 when intracranial parasitic infection was confirmed. Over subsequent years she suffered headaches, right‑sided numbness, and later left‑leg weakness with worsening balance; speech deteriorated. In August, imaging and cerebrospinal fluid tests supported cysticercosis, and doctors performed an awake craniotomy to remove a 5 cm parasitic worm. The operation successfully extracted the worm. Family history notes she lived as a farmer and drank unfiltered stream water and mountain spring water without boiling until around 2015. Doctors warn that consuming raw water and undercooked meat are major routes of cysticercosis, which can cause chronic brain inflammation, edema, and progressive neurological injury, even death.

triage.headline_ja: 5cmの寄生虫が脳内に7年間潜伏！　女性が生の山泉水を飲んだことが原因
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の個別医療事例であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりを示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 個人の生活習慣（生水飲用）に起因する単発の嚢虫症症例報告であり、アウトブレイクや集団感染の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Tăng cường tiêm chủng, giám sát chủ động để phòng nguy cơ bại liệt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strengthening vaccination and active surveillance to prevent the risk of poliomyelitis.
article.articleSummary: Poliomyelitis prevention in Vietnam intensified as Laos reports a regional outbreak of vaccine-derived poliovirus type 1 (VDPV1). Laos recorded a VDPV1 case by late August 2025 and two additional positive cases among 28 healthy children; on 17 October 2025, Laos declared a national polio outbreak. WHO classifies the Lao outbreak as regional, urging border-sharing countries to respond. Vietnam's Ministry of Health directs provinces, especially those along the Laos border, to mobilize resources for surveillance, vaccination, and outbreak readiness. Key actions: ensure funding, vaccines (bOPV and IPV), laboratory supplies, and specimen transport; maintain ≥95% routine immunization coverage for under-1s at commune level; conduct catch-up vaccinations; and implement risk communication in local languages. Hospitals must secure staff, medications, equipment, infection control, and establish active AFP surveillance and rapid case management; cross-border information sharing is emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: ポリオ発生リスク予防のためワクチン接種と能動的サーベイランスを強化
triage.triage_reason: ラオスでワクチン由来ポリオウイルス1型(VDPV1)による地域規模の流行がWHOにより宣言され、国境を接するベトナムへの越境拡大リスクが高いためフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はラオスで発生したVDPV1流行（WHOが地域規模と分類）であり、ベトナムは予防的対応（サーベイランス強化・ワクチン接種強化）を行っている段階で、ベトナム国内での症例は報告されていない。ラオスは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: 华兰疫苗(301207.SZ)：新型流感病毒mRNA疫苗获临床试验批准，系国内首家
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hualan Vaccines (301207.SZ): A novel influenza virus mRNA vaccine approved for clinical trials, the first in the country.
article.articleSummary: On September 7, 2026, Hualan Bio Vaccines Co., Ltd. (Stock: 301207.SZ) announced that the National Medical Products Administration approved a clinical-trial permit for a novel influenza virus mRNA vaccine, classified as preventive biologics 1.2. The vaccine uses mRNA to deliver sequences encoding influenza antigens, eliciting in vivo immune responses. mRNA influenza vaccines offer flexible antigen design and shorter production timelines, with potential to address antigenic drift. China currently has no influenza mRNA vaccine approved for market, and Hualan becomes the first domestic company to obtain an implicit license to conduct such a trial. Globally, Moderna’s influenza mRNA vaccine had already been approved by the U.S. FDA in August 2026. The company cautions that vaccine development is challenging and lengthy, requiring further clinical trials and regulatory filings, with uncertain prospects for eventual approval and market launch.

triage.headline_ja: 華蘭疫苗(301207.SZ)：新型インフルエンザウイルスmRNAワクチンが臨床試験承認を取得、国内初
triage.triage_reason: 感染症の発生・流行に関する情報ではなく、ワクチン開発企業の臨床試験承認に関する企業ニュースであるため、公衆衛生上の緊急対応を要するシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症の発生事例ではなく、中国企業によるmRNAインフルエンザワクチンの臨床試験承認に関する企業発表。発生地域として挙げられた米国・中国は疾病発生国ではなく、ワクチン規制・開発の文脈で言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : la Tanzanie envoie 52 tonnes de kits médicaux pour soutenir la riposte dans l'Est
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Tanzania sends 52 metric tons of medical kits to support the response in the East.
article.articleSummary: 52 tonnes of medical kits from Tanzania arrived in Kinshasa to bolster the Democratic Republic of Congo's (DRC) response to its 17th Ebola outbreak in the East. The aid, delivered by Tanzania's Deputy Health Minister Dr. Florence Georges, landed at Ndjili International Airport and includes community medical kits, personal protective equipment for healthcare workers, medicines, intravenous fluids, and other supplies worth about 220 million Tanzanian shillings (~$88,000). The package aims to protect frontline clinicians, improve patient care, and interrupt transmission chains in affected areas. This regional cooperation underscores a shared health security approach as the DRC intensifies containment efforts, with Tanzania pledging ongoing collaboration with the DRC, African Union, Africa CDC, WHO, and partners. Tanzania becomes the second African country, after Egypt, to provide direct aid to the DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak, according to INSP Director General Dieudonné Mwamba.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行:コンゴ民主共和国 タンザニアが東部の対応支援のため医療キット52トンを送付
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラアウトブレイクに関する国際支援の報道であり、疾患の重篤性から継続的なリスク評価対象となる。
triage.notes: 本記事はDRCの第17次エボラアウトブレイクへのタンザニアからの支援物資到着に関する報道。新規発生の報告ではなく既存アウトブレイクへの国際協力の続報だが、疾患の重篤性からモニタリング継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: E. coli presence in bottled water in Keralam's Kochi points at need to ensure water traceability
article.articleSummary: E. coli and coliform bacteria were detected in bottled drinking water in Kochi, Kerala, prompting contamination-control measures and a push for water traceability. Most probable number (MPN) values ranged from 17 to 1,600 per 100 ml, with zero MPN expected in drinking water. To improve safety, the Kochi Corporation plans to mandate hotels use only Kerala Water Authority (KWA) water, enabling source tracing via a QR code linked to the My Kochi app. A stakeholder meeting will be held to trace water sources and take action. Contamination was found during surprise checks by the Health Department, Kochi Corporation, Food Safety Department and police. While routine checks have not always shown E. coli in bottled water, officials will focus more on cans; a Kalamassery-area fungal-growth complaint is under test. KHRA notes ISI-marked bottled water is used; tracing water sources remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララ州コーチのボトル入り飲料水からE.coli検出、水の追跡可能性の必要性を指摘
triage.triage_reason: ボトル入り飲料水の水質汚染事案であり、公衆衛生への影響は限定的で人-人感染や国際的拡大の可能性は低いが、行政の対応強化の動きがあり経過観察対象とする。
triage.notes: 食品安全・水質管理に関する行政対応の記事であり、感染症アウトブレイクの明確な症例報告はない。継続的な水質検査結果を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 香港流感仍處高水平 16名小童感染流感入深切治療部
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza in Hong Kong remains at a high level; 16 children infected with influenza were admitted to the ICU.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in Hong Kong remains at a very high level. The Centre for Health Protection reports 16 children with influenza in intensive care units, with one death; 460 adult ICU admissions, over 80% of them aged 65 and above. Influenza test positivity is 11.17%, well above baseline, and among Hospital Authority inpatients, about 0.75 per 10,000 are influenza-positive. Health Secretary Lo Chung-mau, along with health officials and Hospital Authority leaders, visited the Sai Wan Ho Family Medicine Clinic to receive the seasonal flu vaccine. The vaccination program will start on 2026-09-10, with 1.3 million doses procured; high-risk individuals are urged to vaccinate promptly. The eHealth platform now supports electronic consent for child vaccination submissions, with roughly 80,000 submissions to date.

triage.headline_ja: 香港のインフルエンザ活動は依然高水準、16名の小児がインフルエンザで集中治療室に入院
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザではあるが、小児・高齢者のICU入院多数と死亡例が報告され、重症度・継続的曝露・流行しやすさの基準に該当し、政府高官の視察等社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの流行だが、ICU入院・死亡例の増加と政府の積極的なワクチン接種対応が報告されており、経過観察の価値がある。香港特別行政区はChinaに統合して集計。

article.articleHeadline: DOH: Increased influenza-like illness cases recorded in first two weeks of August
article.articleSummary: Influenza-like illness (ILI) cases rose in the Philippines in early August per the DOH. From August 2–5, 5,847 ILI cases were recorded, up from 5,450 in July 19–August 1, with Western Visayas, MIMAROPA, Central Luzon, and Northern Mindanao monitored for increases versus 2025. By August 29, total ILI reached 86,113, about 22% below 2025’s 110,978. WHO describes ILIs as contagious illnesses caused by various viruses or bacteria affecting the nose, throat or lungs; typical symptoms include fever ≥38°C and cough lasting ≥10 days, plus sore throat, runny nose, headache, body aches and fatigue. In food- and water-borne diseases, DOH logged 411 acute bloody diarrhea cases Aug 2–15 (up 15% from 358); Jan 4–Aug 29 total 6,456 (down 32% vs 9,520 in 2025). Cholera rose 40% (20→28) Aug 2–15; total 428 in 2026 vs 1,283 in 2025. Typhoid fell from 740 to 590 Aug 2–15; Jan 4–Aug 29 totals 10,708 in 2026 vs 18,014 in 2025, with higher typhoid in Bicol, Davao and Metro Manila.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省（DOH）：8月前半にインフルエンザ様疾患（ILI）症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン保健省の定期疾病サーベイランス報告であり、ILI症例は一部地域で増加傾向だが、コレラ・チフス等の年間累計は前年より減少しており、特段の異常事態や社会的関心の高まりは見られない。
triage.notes: 定期的な疾病サーベイランスデータの報告であり、ILI・コレラは一部増加も年間累計は前年比減少。継続的な定点モニタリングの範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Kendari cek kesehatan gratis dan pelacakan TB untuk deteksi dini
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kendari offers free health checks and tuberculosis tracing for early detection.
article.articleSummary: Kendari, Sulawesi Tenggara, Indonesia, launches free health checks with integrated tuberculosis (TB) tracing for residents of Alolama Kelurahan, Mandonga District. Kendari City Government Secretary Amir Hasan says the program brings essential health services closer and enables rapid TB detection and treatment to curb transmission. Residents are encouraged to seek assessment, especially if experiencing a persistent cough, to overcome barriers to care. In addition to TB tracing, the city provides complimentary general medical examinations. The initiative promotes adherence to clean and healthy living (PHBS) and strengthens preventive health services at the local level. Integrated tracing is expected to yield more accurate health data, allowing targeted medical interventions and reducing TB spread, supporting Kendari’s goal of a healthier, more productive city.

triage.headline_ja: ケンダリ、早期発見のため無料健康診断と結核追跡調査を実施
triage.triage_reason: 定例的な公衆衛生プログラム（無料健診・結核追跡）の紹介記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク等の基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 地域の結核対策プログラムの通常運用に関する記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Misbranded rabies vaccines seized in Delhi: What was found, why it matters
article.articleSummary: Misbranded Abhayrab rabies vaccine batch KE25012 seized in Delhi after potency testing failed, triggering CDSCO alerts. On April 22, Delhi Police Crime Branch recovered vials from an unlicensed residence in Mukherjee Nagar as part of an interstate racket involving diversion and relabelling. Four people were arrested; medicines worth about ₹6 crore, including rabies vaccines, insulin and hepatitis-B vaccines, were recovered. Central Drugs Laboratory in Kasauli found KE25012 potency below the required standard, classifying the batch as Not of Standard Quality and misbranded. IIL, maker of Abhayrab, says the seized vials were not produced by it; 17 differences with genuine retention samples suggest relabelling. KE25012 aligns with a genuine Abhayrab batch released with CDL/2025/8392 (83,370 vials distributed through an authorised network); no market complaints or exports. Earlier counterfeit KA24014 was identified in January 2025; ATAGI guidance followed in January 2026 and December 2025 warnings noted packaging differences.

triage.headline_ja: デリーで偽装された狂犬病ワクチンが押収：何が見つかり、なぜ重要なのか
triage.triage_reason: 感染症の発生・アウトブレイクではなく、偽造・誤表示された医薬品（ワクチン）の押収という薬事規制・犯罪捜査に関する事案であり、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本件は感染症の流行事例ではなく、偽造・誤表示された狂犬病ワクチン（Abhayrabバッチ）の摘発に関する薬事規制ニュース。CDSCOおよび警察による医薬品偽造犯罪の取締り事案であり、感染症サーベイランスのシグナルとしての意義は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 해외여행·유학 앞뒀다면... '수막구균' 예방접종 점검해야
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: If you're planning international travel or studying abroad, you should check your meningococcal vaccination.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-07, meningococcal disease risk rises for travelers, exchange students, and dorm residents. It spreads via droplets from coughs, sneezes, and close contact, with a 10–15% case fatality and up to 20% post-recovery sequelae. Serogroups A, B, C, W, and Y predominate. Domestic cases in Korea were about 12 last year; overseas outbreaks include March's UK Kent cluster (21 cases, 2 deaths). The US classifies dorm entrants as high-risk; many universities require or recommend vaccination. In Vietnam, a popular destination for autumn travel, 95 cases were recorded last year, and 24 in early April this year, with serogroups A–Y circulating. Korea offers two vaccines: Bexsero (MenB) from 2 months and Menveo (ACWY) from 2 months to 55 years; vaccination with both covers five serogroups. KDCA advises vaccination for travelers to outbreak regions, those needing certificates, and incoming dorm freshmen; consult healthcare providers about destinations and living situations.

triage.headline_ja: 海外旅行・留学を予定しているなら…『髄膜炎菌』予防接種を確認すべき
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は海外渡航者・留学生向けの髄膜炎菌ワクチン接種を推奨する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、新規の異常な発生や急性のアウトブレイクを報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン接種推奨の啓発情報であり、ベトナムの症例数（昨年95件、今年4月時点24件）は背景データとして言及されているに過ぎない。UK Kentクラスターも既知の過去事例として引用されており、対象国リスト外（UK）のため除外。英国・米国・韓国国内の情報も背景として扱い、対象国に該当しないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: '콜록콜록' 가을 따라온 독감
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Cough-Cough' influenza that comes with autumn.
article.articleSummary: Flu activity surges among children in the Gyeonggi-Incheon region as autumn weather arrives, with daily highs dropping below 30°C since late last month. In Suwon, a pediatric clinic tested 39 for influenza last Saturday, about 30% positive (roughly 13 cases). Similar crowding was reported at pediatric facilities in Dongtan City and Incheon, where clinics were crowded and feverish children wore masks. Nationwide sentinel surveillance shows rising influenza-like illness: in week 35 (Aug 23–29), 13.3 per 1,000 outpatients had influenza-like illness, up from 9.2 previously and 6.4 in the same period last year. Age distribution peaks at 7–12 years (36.5 per 1,000), followed by 1–6 years (22.6 per 1,000). The Gyeonggi-do Education Office has issued guidance urging home-based prevention; COVID-19 activity is also observed.

triage.headline_ja: 「ゴホンゴホン」秋とともにやってきたインフルエンザ
triage.triage_reason: 韓国国内での季節性インフルエンザの流行報告であり、対象国リストに該当する国はなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 発生地域は韓国（京畿道・仁川）であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行報告。

article.articleHeadline: Pune Blood Shortage: Blood Banks Face 50% Stock Drop as Dengue Raises Platelet Demand
article.articleSummary: Pune’s blood banks report a nearly 50% stock drop, with 35 banks serving about 780 hospitals. Daily blood need is estimated at 1,500 units, while current collection runs 700–800 units, widening the gap between demand and supply. The shortage is aggravated by rising dengue cases, which drive higher platelet demand as the illness affects patient counts. Regular transfusion-dependent conditions, such as thalassemia, add to ongoing pressure on blood components. Platelets are increasingly required during dengue illness, underscoring the urgency of maintaining component stocks. Health authorities urge regular blood donations to sustain stocks during periods of spike in component-specific demand, highlighting the need for sustained donor turnout across Pune. (Published 2026-09-07)

triage.headline_ja: プネーの血液不足:デング熱による血小板需要増加で血液バンクの在庫が50%減少
triage.triage_reason: デング熱によるプネー市内の血小板需要増加が地域の血液供給を逼迫させているが、症例数・重症度・死亡数など具体的な公衆衛生指標が不明であり、インドでは季節性のデング熱流行自体は珍しくないため、フルリスク評価に進むには情報不足。
triage.notes: 記事はプネー市の血液バンク供給不足に焦点を当てており、デング熱自体の感染規模や重症度データは記載がない。地域の医療資源逼迫という社会的関心はあるが、国際的な公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す明確な根拠は乏しい。

article.articleHeadline: الصين.. فيروس جديد ينقله القراد يسبب أعراضا شبيهة بالإنفلونزا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China: A new tick-borne virus causes flu-like symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Asian Longhorned Tick Nairovirus (ALTNV), a newly identified tick-borne orthonairovirus in China, can cause flu-like illness with fatigue and gastrointestinal symptoms, and is associated with thrombocytopenia and laboratory signs of hepatic injury. Since 2009, Chinese researchers have tracked patients with unusual illnesses, including severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS). ALTNV was detected in 10.4% of 3,163 patients bitten by ticks and co-circulates with Dabie Bandavirus (DBV), the SFTS agent. Seven deaths (18.4%) occurred during the study, with co-infection by ALTNV and DBV linked to increased respiratory and renal complications; this underscores the need for differential diagnosis in regions where SFTS is endemic. Symptoms may resemble influenza at onset. There are no specific antivirals for ALTNV; care is largely supportive. Prevention emphasizes avoiding tick bites: long clothing, repellents, and routine skin checks. Findings published in the New England Journal of Medicine this week.

triage.headline_ja: 中国：マダニ媒介の新規ウイルスがインフルエンザ様症状を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新たに同定されたマダニ媒介性オルソナイロウイルス（ALTNV）で、研究対象患者の18.4%が死亡するなど重症例が確認されており、SFTS原因ウイルスとの共感染も報告される異常な新興病原体であるため。
triage.notes: NEJM掲載の研究報告に基づく新規病原体の発見。マダニ媒介であり現時点でヒト-ヒト感染の証拠はないが、SFTS流行地域での鑑別診断の重要性が指摘されている。続報・公式機関の反応を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Moringa and Salmonella: What It Is, Why It Keeps Getting Contaminated, and Whether There Is a Common Source
article.articleSummary: Five Salmonella outbreaks linked to moringa leaf powder—one in 2015–2016 and four since 2025—have caused 219 illnesses and 59 hospitalizations, with at least 11 recalls since November 2025. Moringa oleifera leaves are dried into powder used in lactation products and green-powder supplements; a 2016 FDA finding tied the outbreak strain to organic moringa powder in RAW Meal, with the exporter placed on Import Alert 99-19. By October 2025, traceback pointed to Vallon Farmdirect PVT LTD of Jodhpur, India (batch VFD/ORG/MORP/L/24). In January 2026, 131 cases across 38 states prompted FDA to cite a common Indian manufacturer behind Live it Up and Why Not Natural, though it did not name the supplier. February Rosabella could not determine a source, though a single supplier was recalled; May MOGO traced mostly to one supplier. Recall activity spans Oct 2025–Sept 2026. Drying of moringa leaf powder—often open-air—facilitates Salmonella contamination in dried botanicals.

article.articleHeadline: Choléra à Kasongo : le bilan s'alourdit à 8 décès et 48 cas suspects
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera in Kasongo: toll rises to 8 deaths and 48 suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: Cholera in Kasongo, Maniema Province, Democratic Republic of Congo has risen to eight deaths and 48 suspected cases in the rural health zone as of September 7, 2026, prompting urgent calls for a strengthened response. Provincial deputy Lamolamo Radjabo urged authorities and humanitarian partners to swiftly supply medicines and other medical inputs to improve patient care, noting the health zone is overwhelmed. He previously reported at least seven deaths and 40 suspected cases, estimating a case fatality rate of about 17.5%, and urged increased support to Kasongo's health structures. The deputy emphasized intensified community awareness and urged health professionals to refer people with suspected cholera to facilities rather than treating at home. On September 5, Dr Mubwana Zamuda Byza warned of more than six deaths among 35 cases, with several river-adjacent health areas affected.

triage.headline_ja: カソンゴでのコレラ:死者8人、疑い症例48人に増加
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約17.5%と高く、医療体制が逼迫し外部支援が求められているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準双方で複数該当しフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 地元議員が人道支援団体に医薬品供給を要請しており、保健地域が対応能力を超えている状況。河川沿いの複数保健地区にも拡大が見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola/RDC : refus d'isolement, évasions et menaces, les goulots d'étranglement de la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola/DRC: Refusal to isolate, escapes and threats, bottlenecks in the response.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 September 2026, Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is hampered by persistent community resistance across provinces. Refusals to isolate, blocked post-mortem sampling, and threats to treatment centers disrupt detection, transfers, contact tracing, and safe burials. Ituri, including Bunia and Mandima, reports 17–21 isolation refusals. Bodies often go untested, complicating death attribution and exposure mapping; on 1 September, 42 corpses could not be swabbed, then 11, 9 and 7 in following days. In Haut-Uélé, a body was removed from a treatment center and released; 10 of 24 health zones are mapped as resistance. In Nord-Kivu, a household blocked decontamination in Butembo, staff were assaulted in Kalunguta, and a confirmed patient escaped in Katwa; another refused transfer in Lubero, with threats to burn a Katwa center. In Tshopo, rings around cases 20–22 remained unopened or unlocated due to opposition or missing addresses.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ/DRC：隔離拒否、逃走、脅迫—対応におけるボトルネック
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の対応が地域社会の抵抗（隔離拒否、遺体検査妨害、医療従事者への脅迫、患者逃走）により深刻に妨げられており、感染拡大・見逃し例の増加リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 既存のDRCエボラアウトブレイクにおける対応の妨げ（地域社会の抵抗、隔離拒否、遺体検査拒否、医療施設への脅迫等）を報告。複数州（Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo）にまたがり、接触者追跡や安全な埋葬が困難となっており、感染拡大リスクが高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: 《水滸》開篇為何先寫大瘟疫與「伏魔之殿」？(圖) - 文學世界 - 遠山
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why does the opening of Water Margin begin with a great plague and the 'Temple of Subduing Demons'? (Image)
article.articleSummary: Water Margin opens with a major plague in the Northern Song capital, Dongjing, in spring 1058 (Jiayou 3). Emperor Renzong’s early relief efforts fail, prompting Chancellor Fan Zhongyan to summon the Dragon-Tiger Mountain Celestial Master to perform rites to dispel the calamity. Envoy Hong Xin reaches the sealed Temple of Subduing Demons and releases 108 demon lords—36 Tian Gang and 72 Earth Fiends—foreshadowing the Liangshan heroes. The article explains qi (prayer) and reng (exorcism) as a traditional unity of heaven and governance, rooted in Tianren gan ying. The imperial response includes grand rites (Luo Tian Da Jiao), reduced meals, halted music, amnesty, and pilgrimages to temples; folk practices such as nuó and city-god processions persist. Medicine and ritual coexist: Zhang Zhongjing’s Shang Han Za Bing Lun; Sun Simiao’s pharmacopeia; Song’s Anle Fang and Anji Fang; Su Dongpo’s Hangzhou Anle Fang, funding hospitals and providing free care, later nationalized. The opening ties plague to governance, faith, and medical care.

triage.headline_ja: 『水滸伝』の冒頭はなぜ大疫病と「伏魔殿」から始まるのか？(画像)
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は古典文学『水滸伝』の文学的・歴史的解説であり、実際の現代の感染症発生事例ではないため、トリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 記事は11世紀の北宋時代の疫病を題材にした文学作品『水滸伝』の解説記事であり、現代の実際の感染症イベントではない。発生地域として抽出された中国の地名は物語の舞台設定に基づくもので、実際の感染症発生地ではないため verified_locations は空とする。

article.articleHeadline: विक्रमी तपासण्या; मलेरिया नियंत्रणाचे आव्हान कायम
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Record-breaking tests; malaria control remains a challenge.
article.articleSummary: Despite record malaria testing in Mumbai, malaria control remains a challenge. In 2025, the Mumbai Municipal Corporation expanded screening to 1,889,012 blood samples, yielding 10,163 malaria cases. The annual blood examination rate (ABER) rose to 14.5%, exceeding the long-standing 12% target, yet the annual parasite incidence (API) climbed from 0.3 (2022) to 0.5 (2023), 0.6 (2024), and 0.8 (2025), signaling ongoing transmission. Historical ABER hovered around 11.3–12.1% since 2015, with 2024 at 11.7%. In early 2026, 761,439 samples were tested, and 3,394 were positive. Experts caution that increasing tests alone won’t curb malaria; effective vector-control, timely diagnosis and treatment, and rapid action on transmission sources are essential to reduce API. Data surfaced via RTI activist Chetan Kothari from Mumbai authorities. Location focus: Mumbai, India; disease: malaria; key metrics: ABER, API, case counts, and testing trends.

triage.headline_ja: 記録的な検査数;マラリア対策の課題は依然として続く
triage.triage_reason: マラリアはムンバイの地域流行病であり、既存の対策枠組み内での経年推移に関する統計報告であって、異常な公衆衛生事象や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: API上昇傾向は継続的な媒介動物対策の課題を示すが、既知の風土病であり突発的な公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。RTI活動家によるデータ開示に基づく行政報告記事。

article.articleHeadline: شناسایی یک ویروس جدید منتقله از کنه با علائم شبیه آنفولانزا در چین
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Identification of a new tick-borne virus with influenza-like symptoms in China.
article.articleSummary: China researchers identify a new tick-borne virus, Asian longhorned tick–associated nairovirus (ALTNV), from the Orthonyairovirus family. In 3,163 tick-bitten patients, ALTNV was detected in 10.4% and can present with influenza-like illness—fever, myalgia, fatigue, and sometimes respiratory symptoms—along with thrombocytopenia and liver injury. ALTNV was distinguished from Dapyapanda virus (DBV), the agent linked to severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS). Co-infection with ALTNV and DBV occurred in 38 patients; this group showed higher respiratory and renal complications, with 7 fatalities (18.4%). Authors urge improved differential diagnosis in SFTS-endemic regions. Management is largely supportive; no antiviral therapies are widely available for tick-borne viruses. Preventive advice includes long clothing, repellents, and frequent tick checks. Findings published this week in the New England Journal of Medicine (NEJM).

triage.headline_ja: 中国でインフルエンザ様症状を呈するマダニ媒介性の新種ウイルスを同定
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新規のマダニ媒介ウイルス（ALTNV）が同定され、SFTS病原体との共感染例で死亡例（18.4%）が報告されており、IHR基準の『深刻な公衆衛生影響』と『異常性』の2項目に該当するため。
triage.notes: NEJMに掲載された新種のダニ媒介性ナイロウイルス（ALTNV）に関する報告。SFTS病原体（DBV）との共感染例で重症化・死亡例が確認されており、SFTS流行地域での鑑別診断強化が求められている。ヒト-ヒト感染の有無は不明であり、続報での確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: علماء في الصين يكتشفون فيروساً جديداً ينقله القراد يسبب أعراضاً شبيهة بالإنفلونزا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists in China discover a new tick-borne virus that causes influenza-like symptoms.
article.articleSummary: China researchers identify a new tick-borne virus causing influenza-like illness. The study notes infections with ALTNV and the Dabi Pandavirus (DBV) were linked to higher rates of respiratory problems and renal complications, with seven deaths (18.4%) during the study. Dr. Sharon Nachman of Stony Brook Children’s Hospital warns thrombocytopenia can cause bleeding, and mortality in Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS) with low platelets reaches about 30%. The findings stress the need to differentiate tick-borne viruses given overlapping symptoms and the lack of effective antivirals; treatment remains largely supportive and inappropriate antibiotics should be avoided. Preventive measures include wearing long clothing, using insect repellents, and regular skin checks after potential tick exposure. Results were published this week in the New England Journal of Medicine.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の科学者、インフルエンザ様症状を引き起こす新種のマダニ媒介ウイルスを発見
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新規のマダニ媒介ウイルス（ALTNV/DBV）がNEJMに報告され、死亡率18.4%・SFTS類似の重症化例が確認されており、異常性と重篤性の両基準を満たすためフルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: 本記事はNEJM掲載の学術研究報告であり、実際の集団発生イベントではなく新規病原体の発見・臨床像記述が主題。ヒト-ヒト感染の有無や感染規模など疫学的詳細は不明であり、続報・原著論文の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: नलों से 'जहर' की सप्लाई! दूषित पानी पीने से 2 की मौत, क्षेत्र में 250 से ज्यादा लोग बीमार, स्वास्थ्य महकमा नदारद
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Poison flowing from taps! Two die after drinking contaminated water, over 250 people sick in the area, health department absent.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 September 2026, contaminated tap water in the Jyoli Kot area of Nainital district, Uttarakhand, India has caused at least two deaths and more than 250 illnesses, including jaundice and typhoid. A 16-year-old student, Ritish Jeena, died during treatment after vomiting, diarrhea and fever, having been referred from Haldwani to Delhi. Neema Joshi also died, with fever followed by liver infection and confirmed jaundice, after which she succumbed at Bareilly’s Ram Murti Hospital. The report notes roughly three months of diarrheal and infectious cases in the area, with authorities described as dormant and failing to take effective action. The outbreak has left hundreds ill and under treatment; the article provides no details on the contamination source or laboratory confirmation beyond these outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: 水道から「毒」が供給！汚染水を飲んで2人死亡、地域で250人以上が病気、保健当局は対応せず
triage.triage_reason: 汚染された水道水により2名が死亡、250人以上が発症する集団感染が3か月にわたり継続しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と管理不全（保健当局の不作為）が確認されるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 汚染源や検査確認の詳細は記事に記載なし。ウッタラーカンド州ナイニタール県での水道汚染による腸チフス・黄疸の集団発生。保健当局の対応不備が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: DRC: In Bukavu, the school year begins despite the threat of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in eastern DRC casts a shadow over the new school year in Bukavu, where Alfajiri College opened on 01 September with about 90% attendance. No suspected Ebola cases were reported at the school as preventive measures were implemented: water points, distancing, hand sanitizers, and constant infirmary monitoring for fever. Principal Father Tika Dieudonné, S.J., said fear had eased after awareness messages, but vigilance is still essential to prevent transmission and to maintain clear communication with parents amid social-media sensationalism. The broader outbreak persists in the region; on 23 August Pope Leo XIV urged international solidarity. Bukavu, a border town with Rwanda, remains under M23 control since February 2026, though the situation is calmer than before.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:ブカブでは、エボラの脅威にもかかわらず新学期が始まる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が東部DRCで継続しており、国境地帯（ルワンダ国境）かつ紛争地域（M23支配下）という国際的拡大リスクが高い状況。教皇による国際連帯の呼びかけなど社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事は学校再開が主題だが、背景として東部DRC（南キブ州ブカブ）でのエボラ流行継続、M23支配下の国境地帯という不安定な状況、教皇による国際支援の呼びかけが述べられており、既知のエボラアウトブレイクの継続状況を示す続報として重要。ルワンダは発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに無いためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: ویروس جدید کنه‌ای شناسایی شد / هشدار درباره بیماری ناشناخته در انسان
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new tick-borne virus identified / Warning about an unknown disease in humans.
article.articleSummary: Researchers in Beijing identified a new tick-borne Orthonairovirus, ALTNV, in the blood of patients with tick bites, linked to Haemaphysalis longicornis ticks in China. The study screened 3,163 patients with symptoms resembling Dabie bandavirus (DBV) infection. About 10.4% were ALTNV-negative despite symptoms, prompting search for other pathogens. ALTNV was detected, with co-infections of ALTNV and DBV in 38 patients; those with both showed more severe illness, including respiratory and renal dysfunction, and 7 deaths occurred among co-infected individuals. DBV is associated with Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS); co-infection may heighten severity. No specific therapy for ALTNV exists, underscoring the importance of timely diagnosis for tick-bite–related illnesses. Findings published in the New England Journal of Medicine, highlighting the need for enhanced tick-borne disease surveillance in China.

triage.headline_ja: 新種のマダニ媒介ウイルスを確認／ヒトにおける未知の疾患に対する警告
triage.triage_reason: 中国・北京で新種のマダニ媒介性オルソナイロウイルス（ALTNV）が発見され、既知のSFTS（Dabie bandavirus）との共感染例で重症化・死亡が報告された。新規病原体であり公衆衛生上の深刻性・異常性の両基準に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 本報告はNEJMに掲載された研究論文に基づくもので、3,163人の患者を対象とした後ろ向きスクリーニング調査。急性アウトブレイクというより新規病原体発見の性質が強いが、共感染による重症化・死亡例があり、マダニ媒介性疾患のサーベイランス強化が必要とされている。ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: الصين.. اكتشاف فيروس جديد ينقله القراد بأعراض شبيهة بالإنفلونزا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China: Discovery of a new tick-borne virus with flu-like symptoms.
article.articleSummary: China researchers report a new tick-borne virus, ALTNV (Asiatic Long-Horned Tick Narovirus), in the Orthonairovirus group, causing flu-like illness with fever, myalgia, fatigue, gastrointestinal symptoms, and sometimes respiratory symptoms. In a study of more than 3,000 tick-bitten individuals, ALTNV was detected in 10.4% of cases and linked to thrombocytopenia and laboratory markers of liver injury. The virus is distinguished from the DaBi Panda virus, the agent behind Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTSV). Co-infection with ALTNV and SFTSV correlated with higher rates of respiratory problems and kidney complications, with seven deaths among co-infected patients during the study. No antiviral specific to ALTNV; treatment is supportive, and antibiotics are ineffective against viruses. Prevention emphasizes covering skin, tucking pants into socks, using repellents, thorough skin checks, and prompt tick removal after outdoor exposure. Findings published in the New England Journal of Medicine.

triage.headline_ja: 中国:インフルエンザ様症状を呈するマダニ媒介新規ウイルスの発見
triage.triage_reason: 新規ダニ媒介ウイルス(ALTNV)がNEJMで報告され、血小板減少・肝障害・死亡例を伴うなど重症度が示唆されるため、WPRO基準(異常性・重症度・曝露継続)に複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 新規ウイルス(ALTNV)はSFTSVと近縁のOrthonairovirus属で、ダニ媒介性であり現時点でヒト-ヒト感染の証拠は示されていない。研究報告段階であり、実際の症例集積・地理的拡大状況の続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: В Иркутской области начали массово уничтожать скот из-за вспышки инфекции. Одна из местных жительниц на этом фоне пыталась покончить с собой, утверждают активисты -- Новая газета
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Irkutsk Oblast, mass culling of livestock has begun due to an outbreak of infection. One of the local residents, in light of this, attempted to take her own life, activists say — Novaya Gazeta.
article.articleSummary: Mass culling of cattle has begun in Irkutsk Oblast after an outbreak of contagious nodular dermatitis in cattle. On September 4, authorities declared a quarantine in the Irkutsk Municipal District, with outbreaks reported across 25 farms. Residents claim confiscation of cattle, including visibly healthy animals, while laboratory tests have not yet confirmed the disease. Officials say measures follow a plan by the regional veterinary service and urge residents to cooperate. One farm owner in the villages of Oyok, Butyrki and Koty reportedly attempted suicide amid the slaughter and was hospitalized. Veterinarian Svetlana Shchepetkina suggested symptoms could indicate foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) and noted that protective gear was not changed between diseased and healthy farms during inspections. The incident echoes a similar mass-slaughter controversy earlier this year in Novosibirsk Oblast, where authorities cited dangerous infections but farmers contested the extent of culling.

triage.headline_ja: イルクーツク州で感染症の発生により家畜の大量殺処分が開始。これを受けて地元住民の一人が自殺を図ったと活動家が主張——ノーバヤガゼータ紙
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州における牛の伝染性結節性皮膚炎（口蹄疫の疑いも）に関する家畜疾病の記事であり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当する発生国が存在しないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 発生地域にIndonesia(West Nusa Tenggara)が含まれているが、記事本文はロシア・イルクーツク州の家畜疾病（伝染性結節性皮膚炎・口蹄疫疑い）に関するものであり、Indonesiaは主題ではないため除外。人への健康影響は報告されておらず、動物疾病としての地域的騒動が中心。

article.articleHeadline: RSV ở trẻ nhỏ có thể "lưu hành" quanh năm, tăng mạnh vào thu đông: Không ra khỏi nhà, trẻ vẫn có thể nhiễm bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) in young children may circulate year-round, rising sharply in autumn and winter: Even when staying at home, children can still become infected.
article.articleSummary: RSV, a longstanding respiratory pathogen, continues to circulate in young children, often presenting like a cold but capable of causing bronchiolitis and pneumonia in infants. In Hunan Province, China, RSV occurs year-round with sharp rises from October through April. Health experts advise evaluating the use of long-acting monoclonal antibodies to provide protection before the autumn-winter peak; the antibody mentioned is nirsevimab, used for millions of infants globally. In Hunan, deployment began on 1 September 2026 in some facilities, reflecting local seasonality. Monoclonal antibodies offer passive immunity to reduce the risk of severe disease and hospitalization—not complete infection prevention. Parents should continue basic measures: hand hygiene, ventilated spaces, and limiting close contact with ill household members; seek medical care promptly if infants show rapid breathing, chest recessions, cyanosis, poor feeding, or other respiratory distress. Even with antibodies, infection can occur.

triage.headline_ja: 乳幼児のRSVは一年中「流行」しうる、秋冬に急増：家から出なくても子どもは感染しうる
triage.triage_reason: RSVは季節性の既知の呼吸器感染症であり、一般的な予防啓発記事であるため、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 既知の季節性RSV流行に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、新規性や異常性は認められない。
