article.articleHeadline: Denmark: Gonorrhea cases rise among men who have sex with men, 3 Ceftriaxone-resistant cases detected
article.articleSummary: Denmark reported 5,134 gonorrhea cases in 2025, with 3,747 among men and 1,387 among women; 343,224 test episodes were completed. Incidence continues to rise among men who have sex with men (MSM) while heterosexual transmission stabilizes. In 2025, the country of infection was known for 4,013 episodes (78%), and 8% were acquired abroad, largely in Spain, Germany, Thailand, Sweden and the United Kingdom; men had a higher abroad-acquisition proportion (10%) than women (5%). By orientation, MSM abroad accounted for 9-10%. Twelve cases involved female-to-female transmission. Gonorrhea was detected at 20 non-traditional sites (eyes, joints, blood). Ceftriaxone-resistant gonococci were found in two men infected in Southeast Asia in 2025 and a third in January 2026; sources include Cambodia and Vietnam. No further spread of these resistant strains has been detected in Denmark; all three were treated with ceftriaxone without treatment failure, and DNA analyses show unrelated strains.

triage.headline_ja: デンマーク：男性間性交渉者(MSM)における淋菌感染症例が増加、セフトリアキソン耐性株3例を検出
triage.triage_reason: セフトリアキソン耐性淋菌の出現は薬剤耐性の観点で注視すべき事象だが、実際の症例はデンマークで検出されており、対象国(ベトナム・タイ・カンボジア)は感染源として言及されているのみで現地での発生・流行を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はデンマークにおける淋菌感染とセフトリアキソン耐性株の検出であり、対象国(ベトナム・タイ・カンボジア)は感染源として言及されているに過ぎず、現地での症例増加や流行を示す情報はないため verified_locations には含めない。デンマーク国内でも耐性株のさらなる拡散は確認されておらず、治療失敗例もない。

article.articleHeadline: Mainpuri News: मलेरिया व डेंगू पर नियंत्रण पाने को टीमें रवाना
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mainpuri News: Teams dispatched to bring malaria and dengue under control.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-07, Mainpuri Health Department launched a campaign to curb malaria and dengue under the Vector Borne Disease Control Programme. Chief Medical Officer Dr. R.C. Gupta dispatched six teams to Shringar Nagar, Punjabi Colony, Raja ka Bagh, Awas Vikas, Pal Nagar, and Shakti Nagar to carry out anti-larvae (larvicidal) spraying. Accompanying officials included ACMO Dr. Anil Kumar Verma, Deputy Chief Medical Officer Dr. Surendra Kumar, District Administrative Officer Ritesh Kumar Singh, Assistant Malaria Officer Vijay Kumar, Malaria Inspector Vikresh Yadav, and District Health Education Officer Ravindra Singh Gaur. The operation emphasizes vector-control measures to reduce transmission of malaria and dengue in Mainpuri city, addressing these diseases through targeted larval interventions and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: メインプリニュース：マラリアとデング熱を抑制するためチームが出動
triage.triage_reason: 地方保健当局によるルーチンのベクター対策（幼虫駆除・防除活動）の実施報告であり、異常な流行拡大や重症例急増を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州メインプリ市における通常の季節的ベクター対策活動を報じるもので、症例数や重症度に関する具体的データは記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Penularan Flu Singapura di Malinau, Dinkes Perketat Pengawasan Faskes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be on alert for Singapore flu transmission in Malinau as the Health Office tightens surveillance of health facilities.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 September 2026, Malinau Regency's Health Office in East Kalimantan instructs all health facilities to tighten surveillance for Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD), commonly called Singapore flu. The focus is on preventing transmission to children under 10, and avoiding a materially epidemiological outbreak (KLB). The plan assigns tasks: primary clinics (puskesmas) trace active cases; hospitals stand by to treat severe patients. Transmission occurs easily via close contact, droplets from coughing or sneezing, and contaminated surfaces, with daily child-activity settings such as households, daycare, and schools identified as high-risk. Recognize symptoms: fever, painful oral ulcers, difficulty eating/drinking, followed by vesicles or red spots on hands and feet. Parents should not bring symptomatic toddlers to Posyandu; sick children should stay home and seek medical care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: マリナウでシンガポール風邪（手足口病）の感染拡大に警戒、保健局が医療施設の監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病（エンテロウイルス71型）の予防的な監視強化に関する行政通達であり、現時点で大規模な集団発生や重症例の報告はないが、10歳未満の子どもを中心に感染リスクがあるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は地方保健局による予防的な注意喚起・監視強化の通達であり、確定症例数や重症度についての具体的データは記載されていない。KLB（集団発生）への発展を防ぐための予防措置段階。

article.articleHeadline: "القرّاد" في دائرة الاتهام.. الصين: فيروس جديد أعراضه تشبه الإنفلونزا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "The tick" in the dock... China: a new virus whose symptoms resemble influenza.
article.articleSummary: A new tick-borne virus in China, named ALTNV, belongs to orthonairoviruses. It causes influenza-like symptoms along with hepatitis signs and thrombocytopenia. ALTNV was identified during long-term monitoring of patients with high fever and unusual disturbances since 2009. The virus is genetically distinct from dabie bandavirus (DBV), though both are transmitted by ticks. Screening thousands of samples showed ALTNV in about 10% of patients bitten by ticks; cases with both viruses had more frequent respiratory and renal complications, and some deaths occurred in co-infected patients. Dr. Sharon Nachman of New York emphasizes that thrombocytopenia can drive severe bleeding, and that antivirals for influenza are not effective against most tick-borne viruses; treatment remains supportive, and antibiotics should be avoided. Preventive measures include avoiding tick bites: long clothing, repellents, skin checks after outdoor activity, as longer tick attachment increases transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: 「マダニ」が容疑者に…中国：インフルエンザに似た症状を示す新型ウイルス
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新規のダニ媒介性ウイルス(ALTNV)が同定され、重症化・死亡例も報告されており、異常性と一定の重篤性からIHR基準を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価に進める。
triage.notes: ALTNVは2009年から長期監視されてきたウイルスであり、突発的アウトブレイクではなく研究報告的側面が強い。ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠はなく、ダニ媒介のみとされる点に留意。米国ニューヨークの専門家コメントは発生地ではなく解説者としての引用のため、発生地域には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 天塌了！全是上亿细菌！家家户户天天在用，别不知道了！快看看！_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The sky has fallen! It's full of hundreds of millions of bacteria! Every household uses it every day—don't stay in the dark! Take a look now!
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-07, routine kitchen items harbor massive bacterial loads and can raise risks of acute gastroenteritis and related symptoms. German microbiology studies and Chinese CDC data show a dishwashing sponge used for a week can contain hundreds of billions of bacteria per cubic centimeter, with more than 300 species present; kitchen cloths may total hundreds of billions. Wooden cutting boards with deep knife marks trap residues and moisture, hosting billions of bacteria plus mold and mycotoxins. Common culprits include Escherichia coli, Staphylococcus aureus, and Salmonella; molds like Aspergillus can produce persistent mycotoxins inside wood. Bamboo or wooden chopsticks and damp chopstick holders concentrate bacteria at the root ends. Mop heads retain moisture and foster microbes. Recommendations: replace sponges every 2–4 weeks, use separate boards for raw meat and produce, dry items thoroughly, wash cloths weekly or monthly, and consider disposable wipes to reduce cross-contamination.

triage.headline_ja: 天が崩れた！何億もの細菌がいっぱい！どの家庭も毎日使っているのに、知らないでいてはダメ！今すぐチェック！
triage.triage_reason: 台所用品の衛生に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、特定の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生イベントを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 特定の発生地域や具体的な症例数の報告はなく、家庭衛生に関する一般的な啓発記事。ドイツの研究や中国CDCデータへの言及があるが、実際のアウトブレイクではないため対象国に該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Apply for Community-Based TB Prevention and Care (Ghana) - fundsforNGOs
article.articleSummary: UNICEF Ghana seeks a qualified CSO/NGO to strengthen community-based TB prevention, screening, contact tracing, referral, and linkage to care in high-burden areas of Ghana, in collaboration with the National TB Control Programme. The initiative targets earlier TB identification, diagnostic completion, and timely treatment, with emphasis on children, household contacts, and underserved populations facing access barriers. Objectives include expanding community TB awareness, targeted screening, presumptive case identification, enhanced contact tracing, referral to diagnostics, completion of diagnostic processes, and linkage to treatment, plus documentation of lessons for scale-up. Activities cover community education, screening, identification of presumptive TB, household contact tracing, referral and follow-up, and ensuring confidentiality while coordinating with TB and health-system stakeholders. The program aims to strengthen the full pathway from community awareness to diagnosis and care, reducing delays and missed opportunities in Ghana's high-burden settings.

triage.headline_ja: コミュニティベースの結核予防・ケア事業への応募案内（ガーナ） - fundsforNGOs
triage.triage_reason: これはUNICEFガーナによるNGO向け助成金応募案内であり、新規の異常な感染症発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核対策プログラムの助成金公募案内であり、アウトブレイクや症例急増を示す内容ではないため対象国としても計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Bunia : renforcement de dispositifs de lavage de mains dans une école - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Bunia: strengthening handwashing facilities in a school - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 7 September 2026, in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Shalom School Complex in Bunia is reinforcing Ebola virus disease prevention at the start of the school year. Administrators have expanded handwashing stations and ensured water availability to facilitate hygiene for students and staff, and they have stationed guards at the entrance to enforce mandatory temperature checks. Alain Uwonda, prefect of studies at Shalom, said the measures aim to support adherence to the barrier precautions recommended by health authorities for pupils, teachers, and other personnel. These actions are part of the school's efforts to provide a safer learning environment amid the ongoing presence of Ebola in Ituri. Students and staff are urged to consistently use the facilities and follow hygiene guidelines to reduce contamination risk.

triage.headline_ja: ブニアでのエボラ:学校における手洗い設備の強化 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC・イツリ州における既知のエボラ流行の継続を背景とした学校での予防策強化の報道であり、新規感染拡大や症例数増加等の具体的情報がないため、フルRRAではなく継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は学校における手洗い設備強化等の予防措置に関する内容で、新規感染者数や症例詳細の記載はない。イツリ州における既存のエボラ流行状況の一環として報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Riposte d'Ebola : la vaccination obligatoire des volontaires de la Croix-Rouge annoncée à Kisangani - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Response: Mandatory Vaccination of Red Cross Volunteers Announced in Kisangani
article.articleSummary: As of September 7, 2026, in Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo Province in northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, the Red Cross has announced mandatory vaccination for volunteers involved in the Ebola response. Franck Gefeu Molanga, provincial president, said no field volunteer may continue operations without vaccination to prevent becoming a transmission channel. The policy also covers Safe and dignified burials (EDS) volunteers who handle bodies of Ebola victims. About 150 Red Cross volunteers are engaged across five Kisangani zones and the Bafwasende health zone, near Ituri, the epicenter of the 17th Ebola outbreak. Vaccination is planned over the weekend, though the first doses have already run out; the Everbo vaccine is being used for frontline responders. The government emphasizes oversight and counters rumors to protect the population.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応:キサンガニで赤十字ボランティアへのワクチン接種義務化を発表
triage.triage_reason: 進行中の第17次エボラ流行に関連し、対応要員へのワクチン接種義務化やワクチン不足など、重症度・国際的懸念が高い公衆衛生上の課題を含むためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行（イトゥリ州震源）に関連したキサンガニでの対応措置。ワクチン初回分が既に枯渇しているとの記述があり、供給体制への懸念が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: الصين.. فيروس جديد ينقله القراد يسبب أعراضا شبيهة بالإنفلونزا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China: A new tick-borne virus causes flu-like symptoms.
article.articleSummary: A newly identified tick-borne virus in China, Asian Longhorned Tick Nairovirus (ALTNV), from the Orthonairovirus group, causes flu-like illness with fever, myalgia, fatigue, and may show thrombocytopenia and liver inflammation markers. Since 2009, Chinese researchers tracking unusual diseases found ALTNV in 10.4% of 3,163 patients who had been bitten by ticks. ALTNV and Dabie bandavirus (DBV), the agent of severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS), circulate in the same regions and share tick vectors, underscoring the need for improved differential diagnosis in SFTS-endemic areas. Seven deaths (18.4%) occurred among patients infected with both ALTNV and DBV during the study, though ALTNV alone was not linked to severe bleeding or mortality. There are no specific antivirals for ALTNV; most patients receive supportive care, with caution against inappropriate antibiotics. Emphasis is placed on tick-bite prevention and accurate virus identification to guide treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 中国：新種のマダニ媒介ウイルスがインフルエンザ様症状を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: 新種のマダニ媒介ウイルス（ALTNV）の存在が報告されているが、これは2009年からの累積研究データの発表であり、新規アウトブレイクではない。単独感染では重症化・死亡との関連は認められていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2009年以降に蓄積された研究データに基づく新種ウイルス(ALTNV)の学術的報告であり、急性アウトブレイクの報告ではない。SFTS流行地域における鑑別診断の重要性が指摘されている。ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠はなく、ダニ媒介感染症としての管理は既存の枠組みで対応可能と考えられる。続報および中国当局の公式発表を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Нови сој еболе шири се Конгом: За 24 часа 82 нова случаја
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola strain spreading through Congo: 82 new cases in 24 hours.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa reports a widening Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC): 6,604 confirmed cases and 3,175 deaths to date, per the National Institute of Public Health. In the last 24 hours, 82 new cases and 41 deaths were recorded. The true number may be higher, as frontline doctors and humanitarian workers told The Washington Post that many infections evade surveillance and numerous deaths occur outside medical facilities, especially in Ituri and North Kivu. There is currently no officially licensed vaccine or therapy for the new Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, though laboratory data indicate that the Ervebo vaccine may offer some protection. The outbreak response is challenged by under-detection and the lack of licensed countermeasures.”}{

triage.headline_ja: 新型エボラ株がコンゴ全土に拡大：24時間で82人の新規症例
triage.triage_reason: 新種のエボラ(Bundibugyo株)による大規模アウトブレイクで致死率が高く、公認ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 感染者数6,604人、死者3,175人と極めて深刻。既存の公認ワクチン・治療薬がない新種株（Bundibugyo strain）である点、サーベイランスをすり抜けた症例・死亡が多い点も懸念材料。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: Entenda por que os casos dispararam e os riscos para os não vacinados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: Understand why cases have surged and the risks for the unvaccinated.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks surge in the Americas, with 47,459 regional cases reported through July 18—the highest in more than two decades and more than triple 2025’s total. In Brazil, São Paulo state records 26 measles cases in 2026, of which 19 patients had no vaccination history or incomplete vaccination; the three most recent cases are in the capital and also unvaccinated. Measles is highly transmissible and can remain airborne for up to two hours after an infected person leaves a room, underscoring vaccination as the only effective way to interrupt transmission. The article stresses vaccination for both children and adults without documented immunity; adults should verify their vaccination records. Maintaining the immunization schedule protects individuals and communities and helps prevent measles reestablishment in Brazil and across the Americas.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：なぜ症例が急増しているのか、そして未接種者へのリスクとは
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「異常・予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」の2つに該当し、ブラジル・サンパウロ州で未接種者を中心とした麻疹症例が増加、米州全体でも過去20年で最多の症例数が報告されている。
triage.notes: スペイン（カナリア諸島）も発生地域に含まれるが対象国リスト外のため除外。記事の主題はブラジル・サンパウロ州および米州全体の麻疹症例急増。重症度（入院・死亡等）や具体的な国際支援要請の有無については記事に記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: 香港季节性流感致300名长者病亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seasonal influenza in Hong Kong has claimed the lives of 300 elderly people.
article.articleSummary: By 7 September 2026, Hong Kong reports very high seasonal influenza activity. Since late June, over 450 elderly have been hospitalized with severe influenza, including 300 deaths, and 16 children are in intensive care with influenza, one death among them. Influenza test positivity is 11.17%, well above baseline. Among Hospital Authority patients, about 0.75 per 10,000 are infected with influenza. The seasonal vaccination program begins 17 September 2026, with officials urging rapid immunization to reduce risk of severe disease and death. Circulating strains are predominantly influenza A(H3) (>70%), and no new variant detected. Surveillance shows hospitalization rates for children aged 0–5 remain high; with school resumption, transmission is expected to accelerate.

triage.headline_ja: 香港の季節性インフルエンザにより高齢者300人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザとしては例外的に高い死亡数（300人）と重症例が報告されており、学校再開に伴う感染拡大が懸念されるため、WPRO基準複数該当・社会的関心もありフルRRAへの移行を検討すべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 香港はChina(1814991)として集約。流行株はA(H3)で新規変異株は検出されていないが、陽性率11.17%、高齢者死亡300人、小児ICU例16人など重症度が高く、学校再開による感染拡大が懸念される。ワクチン接種プログラムが9月17日開始予定。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en la RDC supera los 6.600 casos confirmados y deja 3.175 fallecidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC surpasses 6,600 confirmed cases and leaves 3,175 dead.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola virus disease outbreak remains active. As of 5 September 2026, 6,604 confirmed cases and 3,175 deaths (case fatality 48.1%). In the last 24 hours, 82 new confirmed cases and 41 deaths were reported: 32 community deaths and 9 in Ebola treatment centers (5 in Ituri, 4 in North Kivu). New cases by province: Ituri 49, North Kivu 31, Alto Uele 2. Ituri continues to dominate transmission, with 80.6% of all confirmed cases and 59.8% of recent cases. No expansion to new health zones; 61 of 151 zones remain under epidemiological impact (40.3%). Ituri has 28/36 zones affected, North Kivu 16/34, Alto Uele 6/13. Recoveries: 32; total 1,548; 851 patients in isolation or treatment. Suspected cases investigated 100%; contact tracing 85.7%. Ongoing community transmission, especially in Ituri and North Kivu, necessitates early detection, rapid referral, and strengthened infection control and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、確定症例6,600例超・死者3,175人に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.1%の大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、複数州にまたがる地域的拡大とヒト-ヒト感染が続いており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 既知の継続中アウトブレイクの経過報告であり新規発生ではないが、症例数・死者数が引き続き増加しており継続的なリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: പശ്ചിമ ബംഗാളിൽ ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി വ്യാപനം ; പ്രതിരോധമാർ​ഗങ്ങളും മുൻകരുതലുകളും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread of dengue fever in West Bengal; preventive measures and precautions.
article.articleSummary: West Bengal, India faces a dengue fever surge caused by Aedes mosquitoes. In the last seven days, the state reported over 500 new dengue cases, pushing the year-to-date (monsoon period) total beyond 4,500. Health authorities have issued a Standard Operating Procedure for enhanced surveillance and vector control, including house-to-house inspections and urgent blood testing for symptomatic individuals. Dengue virus is transmitted when an infected Aedes mosquito bites a person; the virus incubates in the mosquito for 8–10 days, then is transmitted to humans on a subsequent bite. After an incubation of 3–14 days (typically 3–4 days), patients develop fever and symptoms. Reported symptoms include abrupt high fever, severe headache, retro-orbital pain, loss of appetite, vomiting, dizziness, and taste disturbances. Preventive guidance emphasizes removing standing water around homes and protecting against bites during the day.

triage.headline_ja: 西ベンガル州でデング熱が拡大;予防策と注意点
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州でデング熱症例が急増し当局が対策を強化しているが、季節性の流行であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はインド・西ベンガル州で毎年季節的に流行する疾患であり、今回の報告は症例数増加と行政対応に関するもの。国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いが、症例数の推移は継続的に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: बीएचयू के बाद अब वाराणसी मंडलीय चिकित्सालय में दो स्वाइन फ्लू के मरीज भर्ती - two swine flu patients admitted to parish hospital after bhu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two swine flu patients admitted to Varanasi Divisional Hospital after BHU.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 September 2026, two elderly patients in Varanasi tested positive for Swine Flu (H1N1) after BHU RT-PCR confirmation, admitted to the Swine Flu Ward at Shiv Prasad Gupta Multispeciality Hospital. A 78-year-old from Kajjatpura and an 80-year-old from Bhadohi were moved to isolation with treatment; both are stable. In the past week, 23 suspected cases from Mandliya Hospital were sent to Banaras Hindu University (BHU) for testing, yielding 10 positives; eight recovered, two remain under treatment. CMOs have alerted all district hospitals; fever help desks and dedicated OPDs are being organized, and drug supplies are being ensured. Preventive guidance includes masking, regular hand hygiene, avoiding crowds, and covering coughs or sneezes. Seek testing at a government hospital if symptoms persist beyond three days, especially for the elderly, children, and immunocompromised individuals.

triage.headline_ja: BHU後、ヴァラナシ管区病院にもスワインフル患者2名が入院
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1（豚インフルエンザ）の局地的なクラスターであり、地域当局が対応中だが、国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いと考えられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: H1N1はインドで季節性に発生する既知の疾患であり、高齢者2名は安定、重症例情報はなし。地元病院・保健当局が発熱外来設置など通常の対応を実施しており、国レベルでの深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta por dengue en Argentina: el Super Niño podría preparar el terreno para un nuevo brote
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue alert in Argentina: the Super Niño could pave the way for a new outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Dengue poses a renewed threat in Argentina as El Niño strengthens. The Servicio Meteorológico Nacional expects a 100% chance that El Niño will continue through Sep–Nov 2026, with strong to very strong intensity, bringing increased rainfall and higher temperatures that favor Aedes aegypti and dengue transmission. A September 2025 Nature Communications analysis of 57 countries (1980–2024) linked ENOS-driven climatic shifts to up to 63% of interannual dengue variation, with temperature as the primary driver and rainfall effects varying by region; impacts can persist up to two years after Niño events. For 2023–2024, the model estimated about 9.6 million additional global cases versus seasonal expectations. Argentina currently reports only two imported dengue cases from Brazil at season start and must watch for DENV-3 genotype III, lineage B3, related to Brazil and the Caribbean. Preparedness should emphasize vector control, surveillance, differential diagnosis, and vaccination when indicated; fumigation alone is insufficient—eliminate water-holding containers and maintain prevention throughout the season, with regional collaboration highlighted by Latam Dengue Forum.

triage.headline_ja: アルゼンチンでデング熱警戒:スーパーエルニーニョが新たな流行の土壌を作る可能性
triage.triage_reason: 記事はアルゼンチンにおけるエルニーニョ現象によるデング熱流行リスクの予測・警戒情報であり、対象国であるブラジルは輸入症例の由来として言及されるのみで、実際の発生国はアルゼンチン（対象国リスト外）である。
triage.notes: 本記事の主題はアルゼンチンにおける今後のデング熱流行予測であり、ブラジルは輸入症例2件の由来国として言及されるのみで、ブラジル国内での流行拡大を主題とする記事ではないため、対象国としてのブラジルは verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Gần 100.000 ca mắc tay chân miệng trong 8 tháng đầu năm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nearly 100,000 cases of hand, foot and mouth disease in the first eight months of the year.
article.articleSummary: Nearly 100,000 hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) cases were recorded in the first eight months, with the last four weeks showing high counts in Ho Chi Minh City, Dong Nai, Dong Thap, Tay Ninh, Lam Dong, Da Nang, and Hanoi. HFMD predominantly affects children under 5 (87.3%), who are most exposed in daycares and preschools. The Ministry of Health warns cases may continue to rise, alongside risks from dengue fever and COVID-19. September–October typically see HFMD surges as schools reopen and contact increases, underscoring the need for strict hygiene. Deputy Health Minister Do Xuan Tuyen has urged the Education Ministry and provincial authorities to strengthen prevention in educational facilities, focusing on under-5s. Measures include enhanced surveillance, awareness for teachers and parents about signs and prevention, thorough cleaning of classrooms and toys, and maintaining the “3 clean” principle: clean eating, clean living, and clean hands; early detection to limit spread in schools and communities.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年最初の8か月間で手足口病の症例数が約10万件に達した
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで手足口病の季節的増加が報告されているが、重症度や異常性の明確な言及はなく、例年の流行パターンの範囲内とみられるため、続報を注視する段階と判断した。
triage.notes: 本記事は保健省による季節性の手足口病発生状況報告であり、9〜10月の学校再開時期に伴う増加への注意喚起が主目的。デング熱・COVID-19リスクにも言及されているが、詳細な症例数や重症度データは記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: الإيبولا يعود إلى شرق الكونغو.. إصابة جديدة بعد أسابيع من إعلان انتهاء التفشي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola returns to eastern Congo... a new case weeks after the outbreak was declared over.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease re-emerges in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo after a new case was reported in areas controlled by the M23 rebel group. The case was detected in Kaina Health Zone, North Kivu, near Lubero. The patient is a 21-year-old man who arrived from Butembo, in government-controlled territory; the infection source remains unclear. He was flagged as a suspected case at a health checkpoint and, after transfer to a dedicated isolation facility, laboratory testing confirmed Ebola the next day. Health authorities intensified contact tracing and surveillance to contain spread. M23-controlled areas had declared Ebola-free in late June after 21 days without new cases, reporting only four cases since mid-May. The case highlights the difficulties of outbreak response amid conflict, population movement, and access constraints.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部にエボラ出血熱が再燃…流行終息宣言から数週間後に新たな感染例
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の終息宣言後に新規症例が確認され、紛争地域での対応困難さも伴うため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: M23反政府勢力支配地域での発生であり、アクセス制約・人口移動が感染制御を困難にしている。感染源は不明であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo registra mais de 58 mil casos de dengue e 42 mortes em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo records more than 58,000 dengue cases and 42 deaths in 2026.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo state, Brazil, Reports 58,683 confirmed dengue cases in 2026 with 42 deaths and 30 under investigation. Most infections are non-severe (57,402), 1,180 present warning signs, and 101 are classified as dengue grave. Alarm-sign symptoms include abdominal pain, vomiting, and bleeding; severe cases may progress to shock, respiratory distress, hemorrhage, or organ involvement. Taubaté records the highest dengue mortality in the state, totaling 11 deaths (7 aged 10–79 and 4 over 80). The Health Secretariat maintains heightened surveillance during the October–May peak transmission period, identifying high-risk regions and monitoring epidemiological trends. Measures include supporting municipalities in surveillance and healthcare network organization, tracking medication and supply stocks, and ensuring contingency plans are updated; healthcare capacity could be expanded if demand rises.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、2026年にデング熱5万8千件以上・死者42人を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州における季節性デング熱流行の定期報告で、死亡例・重症例は一定数あるが、例年の流行パターンの範囲内とみられ、異常性や国際的拡大の明確な兆候はない。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年10月〜5月に流行する季節性感染症であり、本記事は保健当局による定期的な症例報告・サーベイランス状況の共有に該当する。外部支援の必要性や国際的拡大の兆候は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola : 78,7 millions de livres sterling de Londres pour soutenir la riposte en RDC | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola: £78.7 million from London to support the response in the DRC | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: On 7 September 2026, the United Kingdom pledged £78.7 million to bolster the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with funds also earmarked for Uganda and regional coordination to prevent cross-border spread. Africa CDC welcomed the new commitment as international support remains crucial to stop transmission and protect affected communities. The announcement follows Addis Ababa talks between Africa CDC Director Dr. Jean Kaseya and UK Development Minister Kirsty McNeill on the ongoing response and regional collaboration. Funding will strengthen key response sectors: epidemiological surveillance, laboratory capacity, infection prevention and control, patient care, community engagement, and cross-border preparedness. Kaseya emphasized close coordination with the DRC, neighboring countries, and partners to halt transmission and support frontline health workers, underscoring Africa-led leadership and aligned international partnerships.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：英国がコンゴ民主共和国の対応支援に7,870万ポンドを提供
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準の複数（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、国際的な資金支援・社会的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ対応への英国の資金支援と、ウガンダ・地域連携への対応強化を報じている。ウガンダ、エチオピア、英国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Pesquisadores da USP criam 'vacina inteligente' e mais segura contra Chikungunya - Ciol - Cidades Interligadas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Researchers from USP create an 'intelligent' vaccine that is safer against Chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya vaccine: Researchers from the University of São Paulo (USP) with German collaborators developed an 'intelligent' vaccine using a genetically modified Chikungunya virus that can replicate only once, training the immune system to produce antibodies without causing disease. In initial mouse tests, a single dose protected the animals, indicating a novel vaccine platform that could be adapted to other diseases. Published in npj Vaccines, the work contrasts with the current live-attenuated Chikungunya vaccine, which FDA approved in 2025 after a suspension but with restrictions: not indicated for very young children, elderly, immunocompromised, or those with certain comorbidities due to adverse effects. The Brazilian-German collaboration highlights a potential safer approach for Chikungunya and related pathogens as of 2026-09-07.

triage.headline_ja: USPの研究者、チクングニアに対するより安全な「インテリジェントワクチン」を開発
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチン開発に関する研究成果報告であり、実際の感染症発生・アウトブレイクに関する情報ではないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判断する。
triage.notes: 記事はマウス実験レベルのワクチン研究開発に関する内容であり、ヒトでの疾病発生事例ではない。ブラジルでの実際のチクングニア流行状況についての言及はなく、発生地域として記載されたBrazilやGermanyは研究機関の所在地・共同研究先を示すものであり、感染症発生地としての言及ではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: ข่าวสาร : ขอเชิญเจ้าของสุนัขและแมวที่มีอายุ 3 เดือนขึ้นไป ร่วมกิจกรรมฉีดวัคซีนป้องกันโรคพิษสุนัขบ้า โดยไม่มีค่าใช้จ่าย เนื่องใน วันป้องกันโรคพิษสุนัขบ้าโลก ประจำปี 2569 - มหาวิทยาลัยเชียงใหม่
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News: Invitation for dog and cat owners aged 3 months and older to join a free rabies vaccination activity in observance of World Rabies Day 2026 - Chiang Mai University.
article.articleSummary: Chiang Mai University’s Faculty of Veterinary Medicine hosts a free rabies vaccination event for dogs and cats aged 3 months and older, in line with World Rabies Day 2026. The drive takes place Sunday, 13 September 2026, from 09:00 to 16:00, at the Dog IV Fluids Room, 1st floor of the Veterinary Medicine Building, Northern Center for Veterinary Health Promotion and Learning (NOVEL CMU). Capacity is limited to 100 animals. Registration: https://cmu.to/AY3Sk. For inquiries, call 0 5394 8071. The event aims to immunize pets against rabies and support regional disease prevention efforts.

triage.headline_ja: お知らせ：生後3ヶ月以上の犬猫の飼い主を対象に、2026年世界狂犬病デーを記念した無料狂犬病ワクチン接種活動へのご招待 - チェンマイ大学

article.articleHeadline: 내가 먹은 참치회는 괜찮나?"...브라질 가다랑어서 기생충 우르르
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Is the tuna sashimi I ate okay?" ... Parasites swarm in Brazilian skipjack tuna.
article.articleSummary: Parasitic infection risk in Brazilian skipjack tuna: Researchers from the Federal University of Santa Catarina, Brazil, examined 53 skipjack tuna caught in southern Brazilian waters and found parasites in 96% of them (about 51 fish). The 1,600 parasites were mainly in the gut, with numerous also detected in edible flesh; kidneys and heart were parasite-free. Ingesting parasite-contaminated or undercooked tuna can cause nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea. To prevent parasites moving from intestines to meat, the study advocates promptly gutting fish immediately after capture. Because parasites are not readily visible, freezing at −20°C or colder for a specified period before consuming raw fish, or ensuring thorough cooking to the center, is recommended. The findings concern tuna used for sashimi, canned tuna, and tuna flakes and stem from southern Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: 「私が食べたマグロの刺身は大丈夫？」...ブラジルのカツオから寄生虫がぞろぞろ
triage.triage_reason: 研究報告に基づく食品安全に関する一般的注意喚起であり、ヒトの感染事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、緊急対応の必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 研究機関による水産物の寄生虫汚染調査結果であり、実際のヒト感染症の発生を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Chinese scientists identify new tick-borne virus causing flu-like symptoms
article.articleSummary: ALTNV, a newly identified tick-borne orthonairovirus in China, causes flu-like illness with fatigue, gastrointestinal symptoms, thrombocytopenia, and possible liver involvement. In a study of 3,163 tick-bitten patients, ALTNV was detected in 10.4%. Infected individuals reported fever, muscle pain and sometimes respiratory symptoms. Co-infection with Dabie bandavirus (DBV) was associated with higher rates of respiratory problems and kidney complications; seven co-infected patients died, a mortality of 18.4% in that subgroup. Dr. Sharon Nachman of Stony Brook Children's Hospital noted that thrombocytopenia raises bleeding risk and recalled a roughly 30% fatality rate for severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome. There are no approved antivirals for tick-borne viruses; treatment remains supportive and antibiotics should be avoided unless bacterial infection is suspected. The report emphasizes accurate diagnosis to distinguish tick-borne viruses. Findings appear in the New England Journal of Medicine this week (2026).

triage.headline_ja: 中国の科学者、インフルエンザ様症状を引き起こす新種のマダニ媒介性ウイルスを同定
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新種のダニ媒介性オルソナイロウイルス(ALTNV)が同定され、既知のSFTSウイルスとの共感染例では致死率18.4%に達するなど重症化リスクがあり、NEJMに掲載された新興感染症として監視対象とすべき。
triage.notes: 現時点ではダニ媒介性でヒト-ヒト感染の証拠はないが、新種病原体の発見であり、SFTSウイルスとの共感染による重症化・死亡例が報告されているため、続報を含めたフルリスク評価が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Ebola di Kongo meningkat jadi 6.604 kasus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Kongo rise to 6,604 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 6,604 confirmed cases and 3,175 deaths, per the National Institute of Public Health (INSP) of the Congo. In the last 24 hours, 82 new cases and 41 deaths were reported. Doctors and humanitarian workers in Ituri and North Kivu indicate official counts may understate true burden, with many infections unrecorded and deaths occurring outside medical facilities. There is no licensed vaccine or treatment yet for the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, but laboratory data suggest the Ervebo vaccine may offer protection. On 20 August, the World Health Organization shipped 70,000 doses of Ervebo to the Congo for protecting healthcare workers and for clinical testing. The WHO notes this outbreak is the second-largest in history.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ症例数が6,604例に増加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目の規模となるエボラ流行が継続しており、致死率が高く、公式集計が過小評価されている可能性が指摘されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州は発生地域の詳細情報であり、国としてはDRCのみが対象国リストに該当する。WHOはこの流行を史上2番目の規模と評価しており、既に7万回分のワクチンを供給済み。ワクチン・治療薬の正式承認はまだない点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: الصين.. فيروس جديد ينقله القراد يسبب أعراضا شبيهة بالإنفلونزا - سواليف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China... A new tick-borne virus causes flu-like symptoms - Sawaleef
article.articleSummary: China reports a previously unknown tick-borne virus, ALTNV, linked to flu-like illness. In a cohort from 3163 patients bitten by ticks, ALTNV was detected in 10.4% during surveillance of unusual cases that began in 2009. ALTNV causes fever, myalgias, fatigue, and may include gastrointestinal or respiratory symptoms, with laboratory findings of thrombocytopenia and liver cell injury indicators. Genetically, ALTNV is distinct from DBV, the Dabie bandavirus associated with Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS). Co-infection with ALTNV and DBV led to more severe disease, featuring respiratory problems and renal complications, and seven deaths (18.4%) were recorded in that co-infected group during the study. By contrast, ALTNV alone was not linked to severe hemorrhage or death. There is no antiviral treatment yet; management is supportive.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で新種のマダニ媒介ウイルスが発見、インフルエンザ様症状を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: 新規のマダニ媒介ウイルス(ALTNV)の発見報告であり、SFTSウイルスとの共感染時に重症化・死亡例が見られるが、これは2009年からの既存コホートの再解析結果であり、現在進行中の急性アウトブレイクを示すものではないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は2009年から実施されていたマダニ咬傷患者コホートの分析結果に基づく新規ウイルス(ALTNV)の報告であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクを示すものではない。SFTS原因ウイルス(DBV)との共感染時に重症化・死亡例(18.4%)が見られる点は注視すべきだが、単独感染では重症例は報告されていない。継続的な情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dungarpur Swine Flu : डूंगरपुर में मिला स्वाइन फ्लू का तीसरा मरीज, चिकित्सा विभाग अलर्ट, जानिए लक्षण | Dungarpur Third Swine Flu Patient Found Medical Department Alert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dungarpur Swine Flu: Third Swine Flu Patient Found in Dungarpur, Medical Department on Alert, Know the Symptoms
article.articleSummary: Dungarpur district, Rajasthan, confirms a third Swine Flu (H1N1) case: a 24-year-old woman from Tadi Obri tested positive after visiting her parental home in Udaipur and was treated at Maharana Bhupal Government Hospital, Udaipur; she has been discharged and is at home. Earlier, two others aged about 80 and 56 were confirmed; the 80-year-old was referred to Udaipur for advanced care, while the 56-year-old remains in Dungarpur. Both cases’ samples were sent to Jaipur for testing, with Sunday results positive. From January–August 2026, Rajasthan reported 146 swine flu infections. Common symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, body aches and fatigue. Health officials advise avoiding crowded places, masking as needed, and practicing hand hygiene, with medical consultation sought for persistent symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥーンガルプル・スワインフル：ドゥーンガルプルで3人目のスワインフル患者確認、医療当局が警戒、症状を知る

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bangkok closely monitors the COVID-19 situation, intensifies preparedness for surveillance and preventive measures; urges Bangkok residents to maintain strict health practices.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 remains active in Bangkok, with 41,709 cumulative cases and 0 deaths from Jan 1–Aug 31, 2026; 38,427 outpatient and 3,282 inpatient. The highest incidence is in Huai Khwang, followed by Watthana, Khlong San, Phra Nakhon, and Phaya Thai, across all ages but mainly working-age adults. The Bangkok Health Office and Bangkok Medical Administration are boosting surveillance, hospital readiness, rapid testing, medications, beds, and patient transfers to prepare for surges, prioritizing the elderly (60+), those with comorbidities, pregnant women, and young children; emphasis on schools and elder care facilities. Personal prevention stresses frequent handwashing, proper masking, distancing, and avoiding crowded, poorly ventilated spaces. The MOH Emergency Operations Center monitors NB.1.8.1 and other strains in real time, maintains vaccine stockpiles for seasonal COVID-19, measles, influenza, and diarrhea. Promote ATK testing; positives should isolate and seek care. Bangkok Doctor app and 1646 hotline operate 24/7.

article.articleHeadline: Thailand: Hand, foot, and mouth disease warning issued
article.articleSummary: HFMD in Thailand shows a cumulative 53,362 cases and 1 death as of Sept 1, 2026 (mortality 0.002 per 100,000), with 5,408 hospitalizations; cases in 2026 remain lower than the previous year. The disease predominantly affects children aged 0–4 years, followed by 5–9 and 10–14. The main symptoms are fever with mouth sores or red blisters in the mouth, and rashes or clear blisters on hands, feet, body, or buttocks; young children may be irritable, refuse fluids, or drool. During the rainy season and school start, outbreaks in schools and childcare centers are likely due to close contact and shared objects. Prevention measures include daily screening, immediate parent notification, classroom cleaning with detergents/bleach, ample handwashing facilities, and not sharing personal items. Sick children should stay home for 5 working days or until recovered; seek urgent care if high fever, poor intake, lethargy, seizures, vomiting, or breathing problems occur.

triage.headline_ja: タイ:手足口病に関する注意喚起が発令
triage.triage_reason: タイの手足口病は毎年発生する季節性疾患であり、2026年の症例数は前年より少なく、致死率も極めて低いため特段の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性・毎年発生するHFMDの定例的な注意喚起であり、前年より症例数減少、死亡率も低い。学校・保育施設向けの予防策周知が主目的で緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: The world has a new weapon to fight mpox
article.articleSummary: New weapon to fight mpox signals progress in outbreak response. Two years ago, in the same region of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) that is currently the epicentre of the Bundibugyo Ebola disease outbreak, mpox sparked global concern. The mpox emergency of 2024 made headlines worldwide, with cases detected in … The article frames this countermeasure within the region’s layered outbreak context, noting how mpox activity in the DRC region and the ongoing Bundibugyo Ebola situation have shaped international public health responses. Specifics on the weapon, including case counts, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, and any imported or exported cases, are not provided in the excerpt.

article.articleHeadline: Delhi govt holds workshop for councillors on H1N1, dengue prevention
article.articleSummary: Delhi government conducted a workshop at the Delhi Secretariat on Sept 7, 2026 for councillors and public representatives to prevent and manage seasonal influenza H1N1 and dengue. Health Minister Pankaj Kumar Singh urged community participation to curb spread, stressing prevention beyond hospitals and the need to avoid panic or self-diagnosis. Key measures include handwashing, respiratory etiquette, masking in crowded places, and early detection. For dengue, emphasis on eliminating mosquito breeding sites during monsoon and post-monsoon, with breeding in small quantities of stagnant water in coolers, flowerpots, rooftops, water tanks, discarded items, and tyres. Residents should inspect surroundings, keep containers covered, scrub water-holding items weekly, and remove items that collect water. RWAs, schools, market associations and sanitation teams should assist; avoid self-medication. Delhi facilities provide dengue testing/treatment and influenza testing/isolation. Success hinges on ground action rather than outbreaks.

triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザとデング熱の予防啓発ワークショップに関する内容であり、具体的な異常な発生や重症例の報告はなく、通常の公衆衛生活動の範囲内である。

article.articleHeadline: SP tem mais de 58 mil casos de dengue desde o início do ano; Guarulhos tem 348 casos - Click Guarulhos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SP has more than 58,000 dengue cases since the start of the year; Guarulhos has 348 cases - Click Guarulhos.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in São Paulo state totals 58,683 cases with 42 deaths this year, 30 of which are under investigation. Of the cases, 57,402 are classic dengue, 1,180 with warning signs, and 101 severe dengue. More than 297,000 suspected cases have been discarded; 7,256 remain under analysis. Taubaté reports the most fatalities (11 total: seven aged 10–79 and four over 80). Guarulhos records 348 confirmed dengue cases as of September 3. In 2025, confirmed cases dropped 93.2% versus 2024, with 5,469 cases through week 51 of 2025 compared with 80,893 in 2024. Educational actions in Guarulhos involve 5,111 students across nine institutions; seven more units to join by September 11. July ADL results: 23,462 properties surveyed; 9,724 addressed; overall index 1.13 (alert). State measures include an El Niño health plan, prioritization of regions, and ongoing stock/contingency efforts; more than R$1.5 billion since 2024 to strengthen primary care. Population guidance: inspect yards biweekly, eliminate standing water, and seek care for high fever, headache, retro-orbital or body pains, rash, or fatigue.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、年初から58,000件以上のデング熱症例；グアルーリョスは348件
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州における例年のデング熱流行状況の定例報告であり、2025年は前年比93.2%減と減少傾向にある。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルの風土病であり、本記事は州保健当局による定例的な症例数報告。前年比で大幅減少しており、特段の異常事態を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Kongo surge to 6,604 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri and North Kivu) total 6,604 with 3,175 deaths, per INSP. In the last 24 hours, 82 new cases and 41 deaths were recorded. Data may undercount, as many infections go unreported or deaths occur outside facilities. The outbreak is centered in Ituri and North Kivu.

article.articleHeadline: KDC'deki Ebola salgınında can kaybı 3 bin 95'e yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll in the Ebola outbreak in the DRC rises to 3,095
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) declared May 15 has now caused 3,095 deaths and 6,436 confirmed cases across six provinces and 60 districts. Ituri Province remains the outbreak’s core, while South Kivu has recorded no new confirmed cases for 95 consecutive days. Case fatality rate stands at 48.1%. The initial flare emerged in a village near the Ebola River, prompting declaration after Ituri reported 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant involved has no approved treatment or vaccine. Historical context: Ebola first emerged in 1976 in Nzara, Sudan, and Yambuku, DRC; the 2014–2017 West Africa outbreak infected about 30,000 people with over 11,000 deaths. Public health measures continue to target containment and monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、死者数3,095人に上昇
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で6省60地区に拡大するエボラ流行（致死率48.1%、承認済み治療薬・ワクチンなし）であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: पूर्वांचल में स्वाइन फ्लू के कुल मरीजों की संख्या 55 पहुंची, वाराणसी मंडल में सर्वाध‍िक तो आजमगढ़ मंडल में भी कम मरीज नहीं - total number of swine flu cases in purvanchal reaches 55 hospitals on high alert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Total swine flu cases in Purvanchal have reached 55, highest in Varanasi Division, with Azamgarh Division not far behind.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) in Purvanchal, Uttar Pradesh, has reached 55 cases as of 7 September 2026, with Varanasi Division reporting the highest tally and Azamgarh Division not far behind. Two elderly patients—78-year-old resident of Kazzatpura and an 80-year-old from Bhadohi—tested positive at Mandaliy Medical College Hospital; samples were sent to BHU for RT-PCR confirmation and both were moved to swine flu wards with stable conditions. Over the past week, 23 suspected samples from Mandaliya Hospital were sent to BHU, yielding 10 positives; 8 patients have recovered, 2 remain under treatment. District-wise totals: Mirzapur 4, Sonbhadra 2, Varanasi 17, Azamgarh 7, Ballia 8, Bhadohi 1, Chandauli 3, Ghazipur 3, Jaunpur 6, Mau 4; total 55. Authorities alerted all hospitals with fever desks and separate OPDs; recommendations include masks, hand hygiene, avoiding crowds, and prompt testing for suspected cases.

triage.triage_reason: ウッタル・プラデーシュ州プールヴァーンチャル地域で複数県にわたりH1N1感染が拡大しており（計55例）、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性と持続的曝露が疑われるため、社会的関心（病院の高度警戒）とあわせてフルRRAへの移行基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : l'OMS renforce la riposte dans la zone de santé de Lita
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: WHO strengthens the response in the Lita Health Zone.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Lita Health Zone, Djugu territory, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is receiving intensified WHO support as of September 7, 2026. The WHO incident manager for Ebola response, Dr. Thierno Paldé, reports improvements at the Lita Ebola Treatment Center, including tents for suspected and confirmed cases, and a 12-bed capacity operated by ALIMA. The Ministry of Health has deployed additional staff to strengthen response teams, and the WHO has trained teams for dignified and safe burials. A high-flow borehole delivering over 30,000 liters is being installed to supply the ETC, the Lita General Reference Hospital, and surrounding households. An ambulance was delivered to boost transport and referral. Since the outbreak was declared in May, Lita has recorded 220 confirmed cases, 120 deaths, and 100 survivors.

triage.headline_ja: イチュリ州エボラ：WHOがリタ保健地区での対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行（確定220例、死亡120例）でWHOが対応強化中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ルーマニアの地名(Lita, Cluj)はBluedotの誤マッチと思われ、実際の発生地はDRCイチュリ州リタ保健地区のみ。致死率は約54.5%と高く、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola salgınında can kaybı 3 bin 95'e yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll in the Ebola outbreak has risen to 3,095.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 September 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused 3,095 deaths among 6,436 laboratory-confirmed cases across six provinces and 60 districts. Ituri Province remains the outbreak’s epicenter, while South Kivu has reported no new confirmed cases for 95 days. The outbreak was officially declared on 15 May after 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths were reported in Ituri. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is currently no approved treatment or vaccine. Ebola’s history includes initial 1976 outbreaks in Nzara, Sudan and Yambuku, DRC, and the 2014-2017 West Africa epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) with over 30,000 infections and more than 11,000 deaths. Ongoing surveillance and public health measures are critical to containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、死者数3,095人に上昇
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模エボラ流行が継続中で死亡者数・感染者数が非常に多く、治療薬・ワクチンが未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルスが原因であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはSudan, Sierra Leone, Liberia, Burundi, Guineaなど歴史的・過去の流行地も含まれるが、記事本文は現在DRCで進行中のエボラ流行についてのみ述べているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola burial teams battle community anger, fatigue and fear of infection
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Congo's Ituri province continues with nearly 3,200 deaths among more than 6,600 confirmed cases, as six eastern provinces are affected. Burial teams in Bunia, including Yuma Adolphe, perform safe and dignified burials for frontline outbreak victims, paid around $20 a day, facing increasing workload and community anger over prohibitions on traditional rites. Ebola spreads via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids; bodies remain highly infectious, and authorities rely on health workers to handle the remains. Since May, burial teams have been attacked by bereaved families, underscoring social tensions amid the outbreak. The crisis is worsened by rebel violence, displacement, weak healthcare and surveillance, limited contact tracing and lab capacity. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo virus; Evrebo is used for frontline workers with uncertain protection. WHO warns the true scale may be three times official and could surpass West Africa’s 2014–16 toll of over 11,000.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ埋葬チーム、地域住民の怒り・疲労・感染への恐怖と闘う
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ・イツリ州で6600例以上・死亡3200人超という大規模エボラ流行が継続し、6州に拡大、WHOは実際の規模がさらに大きい可能性を警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではイツリ州・ブニアなどDRC国内の状況のみが主題であり、Angolaでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Este país logra erradicar la rabia humana transmitida por perros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This country has eradicated human rabies transmitted by dogs.
article.articleSummary: Bhutan has become the first country in Southeast Asia to eliminate human rabies transmitted by dogs as a public health problem, according to the World Health Organization, which certified the achievement last Friday. No human rabies deaths have been recorded in Bhutan since June 2023. Certification followed a two-phase assessment, including document review and a field mission to national and regional health facilities and the India border area, under WHO’s One Health approach that coordinates human, animal, and ecosystem health. Bhutan’s efforts—vaccinating dogs, managing the canine population, and community awareness, aided by volunteers—enabled this progress. India remains heavily affected, with about 59,000 rabies deaths annually. Cross-border coordination with Indian states continues. Bhutan’s National Accelerated Dog Population Management and Rabies Control Programme aims to sterilize all stray dogs, microchip the sterilized, and achieve zero human rabies cases by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: この国がイヌ媒介性のヒト狂犬病の撲滅に成功
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブータンがWHOにより犬媒介ヒト狂犬病の撲滅国として認定されたという達成報告であり、新規の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の脅威を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: ブータンは対象国リストに含まれない。インドは記事内で狂犬病による年間死亡者数（約59,000人）の背景情報として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題（新規イベント）ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : un déplacement sur deux part d'une zone de transmission active
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: half of all movements originate from an active transmission zone.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo shows mobility-driven transmission. Between Aug 17–23, 2026, one-half of recorded movements originated from zones with active Ebola circulation, with 4.5% traveling from Ituri to other provinces, Uganda, or Kenya. The 16th situation report (covering Aug 24–30) notes ongoing mobility fueling transmission and records 165 corpses intercepted at checkpoints since the response began. Displacement is vast: over 50 IOM-managed sites in Ituri and Nord-Kivu shelter about 400,000 people, plus roughly 1.5 million in host communities and 2.3 million returned, aggravating water, sanitation, health, and shelter gaps that heighten spread. July–August 2026 saw an 82% rise in cases and a 99% rise in deaths. By Sep 5, 2026, cumulative totals reached 6,604 confirmed cases and 3,175 deaths (CFR 48.1%), with Ituri at 5,326/2,398 (80.6% of cases). Bas-Uélé displays weak contact tracing (18.9%), elevating risk to CAR and South Sudan; Congo River surveillance reports 150+ entry points to Kinshasa, with Congo River Without Ebola launched. On Sep 5, 258,604 people passed entry points; 98.2% were screened; only 31.8% of points are functional nationally (Ituri 9.1%). Nine alerts were reported at Pluto (Mongbwalu, Ituri) on Sep 5, with one validated and referred to a center.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：移動の半数が活発な感染拡大地域から発生
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、致死率48.1%、累計6,604症例・3,175死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、周辺国（ウガンダ、ケニア、中央アフリカ、南スーダン）への越境拡大リスクも高いため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 大規模な人口移動（避難民約400万人規模）、国境地帯での接触追跡の弱さ（Bas-Uéléで18.9%）、検問所の機能率の低さ（全国31.8%、Ituriは9.1%）など、感染拡大の制御が困難な状況が続いている。IOM・国際機関による大規模対応（Congo River Without Ebolaなど）が既に稼働中。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi govt holds workshop for MLAs, councillors on H1N1 and dengue prevention
article.articleSummary: Delhi government held a 7 September 2026 workshop at the Delhi Secretariat for MLAs and councillors to bolster awareness and prevention of H1N1 influenza and dengue at the neighbourhood level. Led by Health Minister Pankaj Kumar Singh, the session emphasized community involvement through resident welfare associations, schools, markets and local groups to disseminate health messages. Officials warned against equating every fever with H1N1 or dengue and urged seeking medical advice rather than self-diagnosis. Preventive guidance for seasonal influenza included handwashing, cough etiquette, masks in crowded places, and avoiding unnecessary antibiotics; ill individuals should rest and stay hydrated. For dengue, residents were advised to eliminate mosquito breeding by draining or scrubbing water-holding containers, covering water tanks, and removing waste. The government highlighted year-round prevention and that Delhi facilities provide dengue testing and influenza testing/isolation, aiming to extend the impact beyond outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: デリー政府、H1N1とデング熱予防に関するMLA・議員向けワークショップを開催
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防啓発ワークショップに関する記事であり、新規の異常発生や重症例急増を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ・デング熱の予防啓発活動に関する行政ニュースであり、具体的な症例数増加や異常な流行状況の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Health crisis kills over 20 children in a tribal community in Balaghat
article.articleSummary: Over 20 tribal children died in Birsa, Balaghat district, Madhya Pradesh, amid a surge of illness among Baiga and Gond communities. Hundreds of children have been hospitalised in recent weeks. Five days earlier, Adivasi organisations held a general strike signaling government indifference. An official assessment cites measles, malaria, co-infections, respiratory distress, dehydration, malnutrition, anaemia, and shock as contributing factors, highlighting poverty, isolation, and weak healthcare access rather than a single disease. Authorities have since intensified monitoring, door-to-door visits, malaria testing, vaccinations, nutrition and treatment, and referral of serious cases to specialised facilities. The Catholic Church’s Garratola mission (since 1970) is noted as a trusted link to vulnerable families, though it cannot replace public health systems. A call for closer cooperation aims to bring care nearer villages, bolster prevention, nutrition, and primary healthcare.

triage.headline_ja: インド・バラガートの部族コミュニティで健康危機、20人以上の子どもが死亡
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹・マラリアの重複感染等により部族コミュニティで20人以上の子どもが死亡し、多数が入院するなど公衆衛生上深刻な影響が確認され、脆弱な人口集団でのアウトブレイクの可能性がある。
triage.notes: 麻疹とマラリアの共感染に加え、栄養失調・貧困・医療アクセスの弱さが複合的要因とされる。国際的な波及は確認されないが、脆弱な部族コミュニティでの高い死亡率と流行しやすい環境からフルリスク評価が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Salgın kontrolden çıktı ölümcül virüs hızla yayılıyor: Can kaybı 3 bin 95'e yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The outbreak is out of control as the deadly virus spreads rapidly: death toll rises to 3,095.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies, with Ituri Province at the epicenter and spread across six provinces and 60 districts. Confirmed cases reach 6,436 and deaths 3,095, a case fatality rate of 48.1%. The outbreak, declared on 15 May, began in Ituri near the Ebola River. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called it the second-largest and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record. South Kivu has had no new confirmed cases for 95 days. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant driving the outbreak has no approved treatment or vaccine. Background notes Ebola first emerged in 1976 in Nzara, Sudan, and Yambuku, DRC; the 2014-2017 West Africa outbreak infected about 30,000 people and killed over 11,000.

triage.headline_ja: 感染拡大が制御不能に、致死性ウイルスが急速に拡大：死者数3,095人に上昇

article.articleHeadline: وباء الإيبولا يتفاقم في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic is worsening in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak continues to worsen with 6,436 laboratory-confirmed cases and 3,095 deaths (case fatality rate 48.1%), across about 60 localities in six provinces. Ituri Province remains the epicenter, while South Kivu has reported no confirmed cases for 95 days. The epidemic is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, which has no approved treatment or vaccine to date, unlike other Ebola strains that have vaccines. The outbreak was declared on May 15 after 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths in Ituri. Background notes: Ebola fever first emerged in 1976 in Nzara, Sudan, and Yambuku, DRC; the 2013–2017 West Africa outbreak affected Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone, with roughly 30,000 cases and over 11,000 deaths. No timeline exists for a Bundibugyo-specific treatment or vaccine, and no details are provided on current international support (WHO/AU).

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde Ebola alarmı: Can kaybı 3 bin 95'e çıktı

article.articleSummary: As of 7 September 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 3,095 reported deaths and 6,436 confirmed cases. Declared on 15 May, the outbreak remains active across six provinces and 60 districts. Health authorities from the DRC Ministry of Health report ongoing response efforts by medical teams, including patient care, surveillance, and containment activities, as transmission persists across multiple regions. The figures underscore the sustained scale of the outbreak and the continued need for robust case management, contact tracing, vaccination where available, and community engagement to interrupt transmission. The report highlights the geographic breadth and the ongoing public health response across affected areas.

article.articleHeadline: India News | Delhi Govt Holds Workshop for MLAs, Councillors on H1N1 and Dengue Prevention
article.articleSummary: Delhi held a sensitisation workshop for MLAs and councillors at the Delhi Secretariat to strengthen awareness and prevention of seasonal influenza (H1N1) and dengue during monsoon and post-monsoon months. Health Minister Pankaj Kumar Singh emphasized that prevention must involve elected representatives, resident welfare associations, schools, markets, and community groups to reach residents with accurate information and prompt medical care, not to cause panic. Participants discussed recognizing symptoms, early detection, and management; common viral infections can mimic H1N1/dengue, so avoid self-diagnosis and seek professional advice. Key precautions include regular handwashing, covering coughs, masks in crowded places, and avoiding antibiotics unless advised. For dengue, stop mosquito breeding by inspecting water containers (coolers, pots, rooftop tanks), covering tanks, scrubbing and emptying water-holding containers weekly, and removing water-collecting waste. Aedes mosquitoes can breed in tiny stagnations. Schools should reinforce hygiene and fever reporting. Delhi government facilities provide dengue testing and seasonal influenza testing/isolation.

article.articleHeadline: Virus Mematikan Menyebar, Tim Pemakaman Jadi Sasaran Kemarahan Warga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly virus spreads, funeral teams become targets of residents' anger.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri Province since mid-May 2026 threatens patients, health workers, and especially funeral teams. These teams dig graves, prepare the deceased, and ensure safe burials, earning about US$20 per day. They face exhaustion, fear of infection, and anger from grieving families who are barred from touching bodies or performing traditional burial rites. Yuma Adolphe, a funeral-team member, says they push beyond limits to protect others. Justine Habineno, a 36-year-old choir member who died of Ebola, highlights tensions: her mother Sofia Wanito could only view the body from a hospital window. Attacks on health workers and burial teams have occurred, with authorities warning such assaults carry legal penalties. In a setting of armed conflict, displacement, weak health systems, and high population movement, outbreak control remains challenging.

triage.headline_ja: 致死性ウイルスが拡大、埋葬チームが住民の怒りの標的に
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州でエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、埋葬チームへの暴力、紛争・避難民・脆弱な保健システムなど流行制御を困難にする要因が複数存在するためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。

article.articleHeadline: В России зафиксировали 500 случаев завоза опасных инфекций -- Вечерняя Казань
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Russia, 500 cases of imported dangerous infections were recorded — Evening Kazan.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-07, Russia recorded 500 imported infectious-disease cases this year, with none resulting in local transmission, according to Rospotrebnadzor head Anna Popova. The imports span malaria, typhoid fever, a range of fevers, as well as Zika, dengue, and chikungunya. Despite the variety of pathogens, implemented countermeasures have prevented spread, and border controls have been strengthened to form a robust 'sanitary shield.' By contrast, last year saw 300 imported cases. Popova noted a globally unsettled epidemiological situation. In summer, Russia also identified an imported case of melioidosis in a tourist from Thailand, with the patient hospitalized in serious condition. The report underscores heightened vigilance at points of entry and ongoing public-health measures to avert international-to-local transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで危険な輸入感染症500件を記録——ヴェチェルニャヤ・カザン
triage.triage_reason: ロシア国内における輸入感染症例の統計報告であり、現地伝播はなく、対象国（タイ等）での発生事例ではないため、トリアージ対象外と判断。
triage.notes: タイへの言及はロシア人旅行者がタイ滞在後にメリオイドーシスの輸入症例として確認されたものであり、タイ国内での発生事例ではないため対象国から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dehşete düşüren bilanço açıklandı: Binlerce vaka, 3 binden fazla can kaybı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Terrifying toll announced: thousands of cases, over 3,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues, with the Ministry of Health reporting 3,095 deaths and 6,436 confirmed cases. The outbreak, declared on May 15, 2026, remains active across 6 provinces and 60 regions, indicating broad geographic spread. Latest figures show increases in both case counts and fatalities since the initial declaration. This update, attributed to DHA, underscores sustained transmission across a wide area and highlights the ongoing public health challenge posed by Ebola in the DRC.

triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCの6州60地域に拡大し、死者3,095人・症例6,436人と極めて深刻。IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ移行すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Choléra : six morts en un jour à Kasongo, dans une province classée hors foyers
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera: six deaths in one day in Kasongo, in a province classified as outside outbreak zones.
article.articleSummary: Cholera in Kasongo, Maniema, Democratic Republic of the Congo: six deaths in 24 hours (Sept 5, 2026) with 35–36 suspected cases, yielding ~17% case fatality for that day. National 2026 cholera lethality is 2.94%. The WHO epi bulletin Week 33 lists five persistent foci (Sud-Ubangi, Mai-Ndombe, Kongo Central, South Kivu, Tanganyika); Maniema is not among active zones, though it appeared in 2025 lists. Kasongo's outbreaks affect six health zones: Kachura, Kauta Demufala, Kabeya, Kiyogo, Kankumba, Lubaya. Many cases are managed in the community; shortages of protection and treatment kits in local facilities prompt calls for government and partner intervention. Across 20 July–16 August 2026, endemic provinces reported 3,702 cases and 52 deaths (CFR 1.40%), non-endemic 2,157 cases and 114 deaths (CFR 5.29%), with Maniema in the latter group. Year-to-date by Aug 17, 2026: 41,279 suspected cases and 1,214 deaths (CFR 2.94%). Kasongo is not covered by recent vaccination perimeters or cross-border plans.

triage.headline_ja: コレラ:非流行地域とされる州のカソンゴで1日に6人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 非流行地域とされていたマニエマ州カソンゴで致死率17%という異常に高いコレラ死亡が発生し、資機材不足による管理体制の脆弱性も指摘されているため、IHR基準（重大性・異常性）を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: マニエマ州は2026年時点でWHO週報上の持続的流行地域5州（南ウバンギ、マインドンベ、コンゴ中央、南キブ、タンガニーカ）に含まれておらず、非流行地域としては致死率5.29%と高く、通常の流行地域（1.40%）より深刻。カソンゴは最近のワクチン接種計画や国境対策の対象外である点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en el Congo: el brote supera los 6.600 casos y deja miles de muertos | TN8
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo: the outbreak surpasses 6,600 cases and leaves thousands dead | TN8
article.articleSummary: As of Sept 7, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 6,600 cumulative cases and 3,170 deaths (case fatality rate 48.1%). Ituri province accounts for more than 80% of national cases. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, with community transmission also reported in North Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo; the virus has crossed into Uganda. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in May to mobilize resources, vaccines, and medical supplies. Major challenges include armed conflict, mass displacement, and poor water and sanitation in camps, hindering case finding and contact tracing. There are no specific therapeutics for Bundibugyo; early vaccine trials are underway, while Congo uses Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus vaccine) due to possible cross-protection. In Uganda, the outbreak was declared over on Aug 26, with 20 infections and 2 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱：発生件数が6,600件を超え、数千人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.1%、6,600例超・3,170人死亡の大規模流行でWHOがPHEIC宣言済み、ウガンダへの越境例もあり国際的拡大リスクが高い。
