article.articleHeadline: rekha gupta led government asks mlas councillors to boost local awareness as h1n1 cases rise in Indian cities dengue swine flu prevention
article.articleSummary: H1N1 (swine flu) and dengue are the focus as cases rise in Indian cities, with a Delhi-driven push to bolster local awareness. Delhi Health Minister Pankaj Kumar Singh chaired a workshop that brought elected representatives and senior health officials together to discuss symptoms, prevention, early detection, and treatment. The effort aims to shift some responsibility for preventing seasonal illnesses from hospitals to the community, leveraging local networks to disseminate verified health information and preventive measures. Ministers urged participation from MLAs, resident welfare associations, schools, market bodies, and community groups to ensure timely outreach reaches people at the ground level. The initiative underscores the government’s emphasis on community engagement and coordinated action across jurisdictions to curb transmission of H1N1 and dengue in urban centers.

triage.headline_ja: レカ・グプタ政権、インド都市部でH1N1患者増加を受けMLAや議員に地域啓発強化を要請 デング・豚インフルエンザ予防へ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1・デング熱に対するインド・デリー市の啓発キャンペーンに関する内容であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性感染症（H1N1、デング熱）に対するデリー市の地域啓発・予防強化策に関する行政報告であり、具体的な患者数や重症度データは記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo registra mais de 58 mil casos de dengue e 42 mortes em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo records more than 58,000 dengue cases and 42 deaths in 2026.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo State reports 58,683 dengue cases in 2026, with 1,180 alerts, 101 severe cases, and 42 deaths; 30 deaths are under investigation. Taubaté municipality has the highest lethality from dengue, transmitted by female Aedes aegypti. Warning signs include vomiting, abdominal pain, and mucosal bleeding; severe dengue features shock, respiratory distress, heavy bleeding, or organ impairment. Control measures stress continuous monitoring and intensified focus from October through May, the higher transmission period. The state recently launched the State Health Preparation and Response Plan for the El Niño phenomenon to adapt actions for an anticipated rise in dengue, identifying priority regions, strengthening care facilities, and aiding municipalities in surveillance and care networks. Additional steps include regular stock checks of medicines and supplies and urging municipalities to update local contingency plans.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、2026年のデング熱症例が58,000件超、死者42人を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで例年発生するデング熱の流行報告であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、死亡者数・重症例が一定数あり、国内対策強化が継続中のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで季節性・地域流行的に毎年発生しており、州政府が既に対応計画（El Niño対応含む）を策定・実施中。国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いが、症例数・死者数の推移は継続注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: बालाघाट न्यूज: बालाघाट: खुले प्लाटों में भरे पानी से संक्रमण का खतरा, कार्रवाई में खानापूर्ति | Balaghat: Risk of infection from water-logged open plots; action taken is merely a token gesture.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Balaghat News: Balaghat: Risk of infection from water-logged open plots; action taken is merely a token gesture.
article.articleSummary: Balaghat, Madhya Pradesh, India reports rising infection risk from water-logged open plots around residential areas due to poor drainage. Rainwater has filled plots into ponds with residents observing toxic organisms in the stagnant water, raising concerns of infections among locals. No effective action has been taken; plot owners remain unidentified, hindering enforcement. Areas affected include Narmada Nagar, Budhi, Bhatera, Devtola, Bypass Road, and Saraswati Nagar, where cleanliness and drainage have deteriorated. Authorities have previously carried out only token measures. Residents urge immediate identification of plot owners and active drainage clearance to mitigate health risks. The situation underscores governance gaps and urgent public health concerns from unattended water accumulation in Balaghat city.

triage.headline_ja: バラガット・ニュース：バラガット：空き地に溜まった水による感染リスク、対応は形だけ
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症の発生ではなく、排水不良による将来的な感染リスクへの懸念を報じる地域ニュースであり、具体的な症例や病原体の情報がない。
triage.notes: 実際の感染症症例報告ではなく、滞留水による衛生・インフラ問題を扱う地方報道。疾患名も『Unknown Illness』であり具体的な健康被害の報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: Bobby Nasution Targetkan Sumut Bebas Rabies, Perkuat Vaksinasi Hewan Peliharaan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bobby Nasution Aims for Rabies-Free North Sumatra, Bolsters Pet Vaccination.
article.articleSummary: North Sumatra Governor Bobby Nasution aims to make the province rabies-free by vaccinating 80% of pets. The program strengthens the management of animal bite cases (GHPR), with treatment indicators reaching 96% compliance in 30 of 33 districts/cities, surpassing the initial 82% target. Vaccination efforts prioritize pets in tourist areas to prevent bites and protect visitors, acknowledging human–pet coexistence. The initiative accompanies Bulan Bakti Peternakan and World Rabies Day 2026, led by PDHI Sumut with the provincial Agriculture and Food Security Office, seeking to raise pet vaccination to 80% and eliminate rabies. A mass vaccination drive targets 15,000 Rabies-Transmitting Animals (HPR) across all districts and may set a Museum Rekor-Dunia Indonesia (MURI) record. The event will occur at Lapangan Astaka, Medan Sport Center, Deliserdang, on September 26–27, 2026, drawing Gov. Nasution and stakeholders to bolster animal-health literacy and safe, wholesome animal products.

triage.headline_ja: ボビー・ナスション氏、北スマトラ州の狂犬病撲滅を目指し、ペットワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: 既存の狂犬病対策プログラムに関する行政広報であり、突発的な公衆衛生上の異常事態や新規アウトブレイクの兆候は認められない。
triage.notes: 地方政府による狂犬病予防のためのワクチン接種キャンペーンおよび啓発イベントの告知記事であり、新規感染事例やアウトブレイクの報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : un plan de 180 jours pour contenir Ebola, avec 1,3 milliard $ à mobiliser
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: A 180-day plan to contain Ebola, with $1.3 billion to be mobilized.
article.articleSummary: DRC launches a 180-day, $1.3 billion Ebola containment plan targeting the Bundibugyo virus to intensify case detection, epidemiological surveillance, contact tracing, and patient care across affected provinces, with Kinshasa coordinating with partners to strengthen logistics, risk communication, community engagement, and provincial readiness. As of September 2, the outbreak has surpassed 6,300 cases and 3,000 deaths, underscoring resource and operational needs. The plan emphasizes integrating Ebola response into broader humanitarian action and calls for sufficient, flexible, and predictable funding. UN Resident Coordinator Damien Mama underscored this integration. The plan complements ongoing measures, including a June WHO/Africa CDC continental plan ($518M) and targeted DRC/Uganda efforts such as the Congo River corridor initiative, Fleuve Congo Sans Ebola, to curb cross-region spread.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ封じ込めのための180日計画、13億ドルを動員へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクが6,300症例・3,000人以上の死者に達し、大規模な国際支援・資金動員が行われている重大な公衆衛生事案であるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダとの国境地域（コンゴ川回廊）での越境拡大防止策も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。致死率が高く（約48%）、大規模な国際支援体制（WHO/Africa CDC、UN）が既に動員されている。

article.articleHeadline: ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി ആശങ്കയിൽ പശ്ചിമ ബംഗാൾ; മൺസൂൺ കാലത്ത് രോഗബാധിതർ 4,500 കടന്നു - ഇവാർത്ത | Evartha
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Smallpox concerns in West Bengal; infections surpass 4,500 during the monsoon - Evartha
article.articleSummary: West Bengal, as of September 7, 2026, reports a dengue fever surge during the monsoon, with confirmed cases exceeding 4,500. Over the last seven days, more than 500 new infections have been recorded. Health authorities have issued a standard operating procedure and intensified house-to-house surveys and urgent blood testing for individuals with dengue symptoms. Vector-control efforts targeting Aedes mosquitoes have been strengthened to curb transmission. Dengue virus, transmitted via infected Aedes bites, typically produces fever and body pains within a few days of exposure. Citizens are urged to eliminate standing water around homes and maintain cleanliness to reduce mosquito breeding. Public cooperation and awareness are deemed critical to halt the outbreak as health officials monitor ongoing cases in West Bengal.

triage.headline_ja: 西ベンガル州でデング熱への警戒；モンスーン期の感染者数が4,500人を突破
triage.triage_reason: デング熱感染者が4,500人を超え、直近7日間で500人以上の新規感染が確認されており、持続的な媒介蚊への曝露と流行しやすさの基準に該当し、当局・住民の関心も高いため。
triage.notes: モンスーン期に例年発生するデング熱の季節的増加であり、重症度・死亡例に関する情報は記事に記載なし。今後の症例数推移と重症化情報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue em SP: estado tem mais de 58 mil casos e 42 mortes em 2026 | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue in São Paulo: the state has more than 58,000 cases and 42 deaths in 2026 | CNN Brasil.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo state reports 58,683 confirmed dengue cases and at least 42 deaths in 2026, with 30 more fatalities under investigation. Among confirmed infections, 57,402 are dengue without warning signs, 1,180 dengue with warning signs, and 101 severe dengue. Taubaté municipality records the most deaths (7), including victims aged 10–79 and four over 80. Over 297,000 suspected cases were discarded, and 7,256 remain under analysis. The State Health Secretariat will monitor the October–May transmission window and launched the State Plan for Health Preparedness and Response for the El Niño phenomenon to adapt actions for a probable rise in cases—prioritizing regions, strengthening situational rooms, and aiding municipalities in surveillance and care networks. Projections link El Niño to higher transmission in 2027; Brazil could see about 1.7 million dengue cases. INMET expects El Niño to be moderate to strong from H2 2026, with warmer temperatures and rainfall shifts boosting Aedes aegypti breeding.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州のデング熱：2026年に5万8000人以上の症例と42人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はブラジルで季節性の風土病であり異常事象とは言えないが、症例数・死亡者数が多く、エルニーニョによる今後の感染拡大が懸念されるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジル国内の風土病であり、州政府が独自にエルニーニョ対応計画を発動済み。国際的な支援要請や渡航制限の情報はなし。今後の感染拡大傾向を継続的に監視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: DA: ASF fear caused pork price drop
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-07, fears of African swine fever (ASF) in the Philippines triggered early hog sales, increasing supply and driving pork prices down despite limited imports in Mindanao. Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. said producers rushed selling before the rainy season to avoid ASF, a move described as a 'fastbreak.' Last year’s ASF outbreak had raised pork belly prices to about P490/kg and shoulder to ~P400/kg. Philippine Statistics Authority data show Q2 pork production up 5.6% year-on-year to 412,280 MT, while farmgate prices fell nearly 19% to P172.44/kg from P211.91. For 2026, import volume is expected to drop by around 50,000 MT from 851,760 MT due to stronger local production and processor imports in 2025. A confirmed ASF vaccine by the Bureau of Animal Industry could enable expansion, stabilize supply, and reduce import reliance.

triage.headline_ja: 農業省:ASFへの懸念が豚肉価格下落を引き起こした
triage.triage_reason: 記事はアフリカ豚熱（ASF）への懸念による豚肉市場・価格動向を扱う経済記事であり、動物疾患であるため人の公衆衛生上の新規シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: ASFは動物（豚）の疾患であり人獣共通感染症ではないため、人の公衆衛生リスクとしての評価対象外。記事内容は市場価格・供給動向に関する経済報道。

article.articleHeadline: Producers rush sale of hogs due to ASF fears
article.articleSummary: ASF fears prompt Philippine hog raisers to rush sales ahead of the rainy season, increasing supply and depressing farmgate prices. Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. said producers liquidate to avoid outbreaks after last year’s high prices spurred expansion. A DA investigation found the rush to sell was the main driver of price declines. Second-quarter hog production rose 5.6% to 412,280 MT; however, the average farmgate price fell about 19% to P172.44 per kg from P211.91. As of Sept. 7, local ham sells for P350/kg vs imported P240; local pork belly P370/kg vs imported P300. The BAI projects meat imports to fall about 50,000 MT from 851,760 MT in 2025. ASF has been detected in 76 of 82 provinces. A BAI-approved ASF vaccine will be commercially rolled out, and a vaccine-producing lab at Central Luzon State University is due next year to stabilize supply and bolster food security.

triage.headline_ja: ASFへの懸念から生産者が豚の販売を急ぐ
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）はヒトに感染しない動物疾病であり、記事内容も食肉価格・流通など経済的影響が主題であるため、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: ASFはヒト感染性のない動物疾病であり、既に82州中76州で確認済みの既知の流行状況。記事は経済的側面（価格下落、輸入減少、ワクチン展開）が中心で、公衆衛生上の新規シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết gia tăng, Hà Nội đối mặt nguy cơ dịch phức tạp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever on the rise, Hanoi faces the risk of a complex outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Hanoi has risen, with 2,175 cases across 117 wards/communes since the start of the year, and 91 outbreaks identified, 30 of which remain active, as of 2026-09-07. Hanoi CDC warns the trend may continue due to seasonal factors and the return of students from other provinces, increasing density and contact. The virus is transmitted mainly by Aedes aegypti; temperature, rainfall, and humidity influence mosquito breeding. Risk is not confined to the rainy season; heavy rains can alternate with heat, leaving small water containers in homes and urban spaces that sustain vectors. Breeding occurs in buckets, vases, barrels, tires, and other receptacles. Control relies on environmental sanitation and source reduction, with insecticide spraying as needed but not a substitute for removing breeding sites. Community involvement, including schools and dormitories, is essential. Dengue has no specific antiviral treatment; seek medical care for sudden high fever, headache, or rash.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱が増加、ハノイは複雑な流行拡大のリスクに直面
triage.triage_reason: ハノイでデング熱症例・アウトブレイクが増加傾向にあり季節要因や人口移動により拡大の可能性があるが、重症度や医療体制への深刻な影響についての情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムを含む東南アジアで毎年季節的に流行する疾患であり、本件はハノイ地域における通常の季節性流行拡大の報告と考えられる。重症例数や死亡数、医療体制の逼迫状況など詳細情報が不明なため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Sivaganga health authorities deploy medical camps to contain fever outbreak in villages
article.articleSummary: As of 7 September 2026, an eight-year-old girl died of suspected influenza in Kattunedungulam, Sivaganga district, Tamil Nadu, after fever developed last week; she was a third-grade student at Kattunedungulam Government School and died on arrival at a government hospital following private treatment. Three additional children in the village and several adults have fever and missed school/work. Health authorities launched medical camps near Kattunedungulam, distributed treatment, and collected blood samples from children; sanitation drives with disinfectants were conducted in coordination with the local panchayat. Medical teams were also dispatched to the neighboring village of Sundaranadappu after reports of viral fever spreading there. District Health Officer Meenakshi confirmed preliminary tests indicate the deceased child was infected with influenza virus, while investigations continue into possible underlying conditions. Other children remain in stable condition, and containment measures are ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: シバガンガ保健当局、村落での発熱アウトブレイクを封じ込めるため医療キャンプを展開
triage.triage_reason: 小児1名の死亡例があるが局地的な発熱アウトブレイクで、現時点で国際的拡大や渡航制限の懸念は認められないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 死亡児のインフルエンザ感染は予備検査に基づくもので、基礎疾患の有無を含め調査継続中。近隣村への拡大報告もあり、続報での重症度・感染範囲の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis breaches epidemic level in Manila
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in Manila has breached the epidemic threshold, reaching 982 total cases and 35 deaths; 12 new cases were reported yesterday as district hospitals including Ospital ng Maynila, Sta. Ana Hospital, and Justice Jose Abad Santos General Hospital reach capacity. San Lazaro Hospital reports admissions waning but expects another surge related to flooding on Aug 29–30 following Aug 17 floods. Mayor Isko Moreno ordered free doxycycline distributed from 44 health centers and seven district hospitals to flood-affected residents. As of Aug 29, eight nearby cities—Caloocan, Malabon, Navotas, Parañaque, Pasig, San Juan, Valenzuela, and Quezon City—exceeded epidemic thresholds. Separately, chikungunya cases rose 38% year-to-date to 887 (Jan 4–Aug 15) with no deaths this year; top affected regions are Eastern Visayas (399), Ilocos Region (259) and Calabarzon (81). WHO notes severe chikungunya outcomes are rare, typically in vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: マニラでレプトスピラ症が流行レベルを超える
triage.triage_reason: マニラ首都圏でレプトスピラ症が流行閾値を超え982症例・35死亡、病院が収容能力に達しており、周辺8都市でも流行閾値超過と社会的関心・行政対応が確認されるため。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は洪水後にフィリピンで季節的に発生する既知のパターンだが、死亡者数・病院逼迫の規模から重症度が高い。チクングニア熱も併記されているが死亡例なく重症度は低い。ヒト-ヒト感染がないため国際的拡大リスクは低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Catholic media on front line as Ebola spreads through DR Congo | ICN
article.articleSummary: DR Congo faces a major Ebola resurgence—the 17th outbreak—caused by the Bundibugjo (Bundibugyo) strain, officially declared on May 15, 2026. The northeast Ituri province remains the epicenter, with spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, and Bas-Uele. As of 2026-09-07, there are over 2,700 deaths and 6,800 confirmed cases. Government measures include checkpoints, quarantine, screening, and a ban on handling corpses, but these have not halted transmission. Public trust in authorities is low, hindering containment and risk of cross-border spread. Catholic media—led by Br Nicaise Mundurame CSsR and Common Home TV Africa—reports from the front line and emphasizes awareness and community engagement. Pope Leo XIV has called for urgent international mobilization, and Caritas Congo urges closer coordination among church structures, public authorities, technical and financial partners, and humanitarian actors. The piece underscores the need for public discipline and trust to curb the outbreak within DRC and beyond.

triage.headline_ja: カトリックメディアがコンゴ民主共和国で拡大するエボラ出血熱の最前線に立つ | ICN
triage.triage_reason: DRCで第17次エボラ流行が発生し、6,800症例・2,700人以上の死亡と大規模な人的被害が出ており、複数州へ拡大し国境を越える波及リスクもあるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 教皇や国際機関による国際的な支援呼びかけがあり、致死率・拡大範囲ともに深刻。フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Phase II Clinical Trial of SYH2085 Tablets for the Treatment of Uncomplicated Influenza in Adults Officially Initiated in China
article.articleSummary: Phase II clinical trial of SYH2085 tablets for uncomplicated influenza in adults has been officially initiated at the first centre in China. SYH2085 is a small-molecule inhibitor targeting the influenza virus RNA polymerase PA subunit, registered as a Class 1 chemical drug; in vivo it converts to active metabolite SYH2085A-01207, which inhibits PA endonuclease activity and suppresses viral replication. The National Medical Products Administration approved clinical trials in December 2025. The Phase II study is multi-centre, randomized, double-blind, and placebo-controlled to evaluate efficacy and safety in Chinese adults with uncomplicated influenza, with recruitment and screening actively underway. Phase I results in healthy Chinese participants showed favorable safety, pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic profiles, good single-dose safety, compliance, and a low risk of drug resistance.

triage.headline_ja: 新薬「SYH2085錠」の成人単純性インフルエンザ治療に関する第II相臨床試験が中国で正式開始

article.articleHeadline: Thailand Eliminates Rubella as a Public Health Problem
article.articleSummary: Thailand was verified by the World Health Organization (WHO) on 2026-09-07 for eliminating rubella as a public health problem, marking a milestone in protecting children, women, and families from a vaccine-preventable disease. Rubella, or German measles, is a contagious viral infection; infection during pregnancy can cause miscarriage, stillbirth, or congenital rubella syndrome—lifelong birth defects. Safe, effective, and affordable vaccines can prevent rubella. Thailand becomes the seventh country in WHO's South-East Asia Region to achieve rubella elimination, joining Bhutan, DPR Korea, Maldives, Nepal, Sri Lanka, and Timor-Leste. In the same region, four countries—Bhutan, DPR Korea, Maldives, and Timor-Leste—have eliminated both measles and rubella. This achievement underscores regional progress toward measles and rubella control through vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: タイ、風疹を公衆衛生上の問題として排除達成
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はWHOによるタイの風疹排除認定という肯定的な公衆衛生成果の報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はアウトブレイク報告ではなく、WHOによる風疹排除達成の認定に関する好意的なニュース。他の対象国（ネパール、モルディブ等）は比較対象として言及されているのみで、対象国リストに含まれる国はタイのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Con chó từng tấn công 4 người ở Đắk Lắk dương tính với virus dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The dog that previously attacked four people in Đắk Lắk has tested positive for rabies.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 September 2026, Đắk Lắk Province health authorities report a dog in Bình Kiến ward tested positive for rabies after biting four people. The two dogs in the household were unvaccinated; the golden-colored dog showed anorexia, ataxia, red eyes, hiding in shadows, lethargy, and biting objects, and was killed on 1 September. Its rabies-positive status was confirmed by the Central Veterinary Diagnostic and Testing Station II. Of the bite victims, three were bitten between mid- and late June 2026 and had completed the three-dose vaccine. The owner, Mrs. Đ.T.M., was bitten on the right big toe on 25 August, did not vaccinate, and was advised to receive vaccination. Local authorities disinfected with 2% Chloramine B, monitored cases, alerted nearby households, and urged vaccination for the remaining dog and ongoing animal surveillance. Dr. Huỳnh Lê Xuân Bích notes Dak Lak’s rabies burden due to low vaccination rates.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク省で4人を襲った犬が狂犬病ウイルス陽性と判明
triage.triage_reason: 個別事例としては管理下にあり被害者の多くはワクチン接種済みだが、ベトナムの狂犬病流行地域における継続的なリスクとして経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 地元当局により消毒・監視・啓発対応済み。ダクラク省でのワクチン接種率の低さが狂犬病負担の背景として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: 白露至，秋渐浓，谨防呼吸道疾病"偷袭"__新快网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From White Dew to Autumn Deepening, Be Wary of Respiratory Diseases 'Ambush' — Xin Kuai Net
article.articleSummary: In China, during the White Dew and early autumn, respiratory diseases rise due to dry, windy air and 8–10°C day–night temperature swings that weaken mucosal barriers and facilitate viral spread. Common cold and influenza predominate, with symptoms such as nasal congestion, runny nose, sore throat, cough, and fever. Symptomatic treatment with Lianhua Qingwen Capsules or similar remedies is suggested for relief of fever, myalgia, nasal symptoms, cough, and sore throat. Preventive focus includes influenza vaccination, rigorous hand hygiene, social distancing, cough etiquette, and adequate indoor ventilation. Protective measures emphasize staying warm without overheating, protecting the neck, back, and feet, and maintaining indoor humidity at 50–60%. Hydration with warm water, moderate, non-spicy foods (pear, white fungus, lily bulb, lotus root, honey), and regular sleep plus mild outdoor exercise bolster immunity. Special caution applies to older adults, children, and those with chronic diseases, who should avoid excessive chilling; adapt to seasonal changes accordingly.

triage.headline_ja: 白露から秋深まる頃、呼吸器疾患の『不意打ち』に注意 — 新快網

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hardoi News: H1N1 Swine Flu RT-PCR Testing Starts at Hardoi Medical College | Hardoi News: Don't take cough and fever lightly, H1N1 testing has started at Hardoi Medical College.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) RT-PCR testing has started at Hardoi Medical College in Hardoi, Uttar Pradesh. From Monday, 7 September 2026, around 5:30 pm, samples from suspected patients with cough, fever and respiratory symptoms will be collected and tested in the college's microbiology laboratory, enabling on-site confirmation. Previously, lack of local testing forced diagnosis and treatment based on clinical signs. A dedicated team—Principal Dr. J.B. Gogoi; media in-charge Dr. Shivam Yadav; Head of Microbiology Dr. Aditi Garg; Senior Residents Dr. Sushil Mishra and Dr. Ekta Singh; Lab technicians Avanish Kumar, Kamlesh Kumar, Avinash Kumar, Sarvesh Kumar; Lab Assistant Abhay Kumar—will handle sampling and testing. The facility aims to shorten reporting times, allow timely treatment, and spare patients from traveling to other centers for confirmation.

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Face à la progression d'Ebola, les enseignants de Mambasa demandent la suspension des cours
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: As Ebola spreads, teachers in Mambasa call for the suspension of classes.
article.articleSummary: Public primary schools in Mambasa 3 subdivision, Ituri province, DRC, are urged to suspend classes or switch to distance learning as Ebola spreads in the Niania health zone, about 350 km southwest of Bunia. The appeal by the Mambasa 3 primary teachers' union came at a September 5 general assembly. Teachers cited rising confirmed Ebola cases and community deaths in Niania and criticized insufficient prevention measures in several schools. They asked for temporary closures or remote teaching in line with the Ministry of Education. The provincial Department of Education for Ituri 1 urged continuing classes while enforcing Ebola prevention; distance learning would only be considered if a school is directly affected. In Djugu territory, some Nizi schools have not resumed, with parents reluctant to send children. The provincial education administration says efforts to strengthen prevention and response continue with partners.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ拡大を受け、マンバサの教師らが休校を要求

article.articleHeadline: Pesquisa liga desmatamento a Chagas e leishmaniose no interior do Acre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A study links deforestation to Chagas disease and leishmaniasis in the interior of Acre
article.articleSummary: Deforestation in Cruzeiro do Sul, interior Acre, Brazil, is linked to altered vector behavior for Chagas disease and leishmaniasis. In a study of 20 sites across a rural settlement, researchers compared preserved versus cleared landscapes. For Chagas disease, triatomine bugs infected with Trypanosoma cruzi were found in palm trees near homes, indicating that vegetation loss brings natural transmission foci closer to residents and raises contact risk. For leishmaniasis, Nyssomyia antunesi sandflies dominated collections, with abundance tied to how long and how extensively an area has been occupied and modified by humans, allowing persistence even where forest remains partly intact. In Cruzeiro do Sul, cutaneous leishmaniasis averages about 3 cases per 10,000 inhabitants per year, causing skin ulcers that can affect the nose and mouth in some cases. The findings suggest deforestation reshapes interactions among vectors, wildlife, and people, increasing transmission potential; a 2025 study noted degraded Amazon areas also raise malaria risk.

triage.headline_ja: 研究がアクレ州内陸部における森林伐採とシャーガス病・リーシュマニア症の関連を示す
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は森林伐採とベクター媒介感染症リスクの関連性を扱う学術研究の紹介であり、急性の公衆衛生イベントや症例急増の報告ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・アクレ州における森林伐採とシャーガス病・皮膚リーシュマニア症のベクター生態変化に関する研究報告。既知の風土病であり突発的な流行報告ではないため、継続的な監視対象としての価値は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: What Outbreak Metrics Can and Cannot Tell Us About the Ebola DRC Response | Infection Control Today
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 6,271 confirmed cases and 3,041 deaths, with case fatality near 50%. Four transmission metrics show cautious improvement: slower case growth, daily incidence below the late-July peak, two consecutive weekly declines, and a declining Rt, though doubling time remains most reliable. Yet gaps persist in contact tracing, testing, safe burial coverage, and treatment capacity in hard-hit areas. On Aug 31, 43 of 57 confirmed deaths occurred in the community (75.4%), and 63% of the last 14 days’ 719 deaths were community deaths, underscoring burial and care gaps. Vaccination and trials include 70,000 Ervebo doses to frontline workers (20,000 for Bundibugyo protection), plus Bundibugyo candidates in UK (Jul 24) and Canada (Aug 3) trials. R estimates: basic ~2.51; Rt ranged 1.25–1.32 (mid-Jun–mid-Jul), 1.68 (late-Jul), 1.96 (peak), ~1.0 (late-Aug); surveillance delays blur interpretation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ対応について、アウトブレイク指標が示せること・示せないこと

triage.notes: 英国・カナダでのワクチン治験や『Bundibugyo』への言及は流行株・治験実施国に関するものであり、実際のアウトブレイク発生国はDRCのみ。ウガンダでの症例発生は記事上確認できないため対象国から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Hindistan'dan İthal Edilen Kuduz Aşıları Toplatılıyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies vaccines imported from India are being recalled.
article.articleSummary: Counterfeit Abhayrab rabies vaccines imported from India are being recalled after regulatory testing found potency failures and mislabeling. Indian Immunologicals Ltd (IIL), the producer, said the lot under review by CDSCO did not originate from the company and that the original product distributed through authorized channels—about 83,370 vials—remains unaffected. Samples were reportedly collected from an unauthorized residential address in Delhi’s Mukherjee Nagar. Central Drug Laboratory in Kasauli found the sample failed potency tests and differed from the authentic product at 17 packaging points, including labeling, visual design, QR code verification, cap color, licensing information, and packaging text. The KE25012 batch is being withdrawn; counterfeit doses could be unsafe for post-exposure rabies protection. Abhayrab is exported to more than 40 countries, including Turkey, South Africa, and the UAE. Four people were detained by Delhi Police; Australia had a prior similar issue.

triage.headline_ja: インドから輸入された狂犬病ワクチンが回収されている

triage.notes: 本件は感染症の直接的な発生ではなく、偽造狂犬病ワクチンの品質問題・回収事例。ただし狂犬病曝露後予防の失敗は致死的結果を招くため公衆衛生上の重大リスクとして扱う。トルコ・南アフリカ・UAE・オーストラリアは輸出先として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: West Nile, un vecchio antimicotico frena il virus nel cervello dei topi: il miconazolo apre una nuova strada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Nile virus, an old antifungal slows the virus in the brains of mice: miconazole opens a new pathway.
article.articleSummary: A decades-old antifungal, miconazole, inhibits West Nile virus replication in neuronal cells and partially protects mice from fatal brain infection, according to a July 21, 2026 study by researchers at Shanghai's Naval Medical University and published in Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology. In a screen of 722 FDA-approved compounds capable of crossing the blood–brain barrier, miconazole achieved near-complete inhibition of West Nile virus at 20 μM, with modest effects on cell viability; it also showed dose-dependent activity against yellow fever, Japanese encephalitis, and tick-borne encephalitis viruses in vitro. In vivo, ten mice intracerebrally inoculated with lethal WNV and treated orally with 50 mg/kg/day for five days survived 66.7% versus 0% in controls, with lower brain viral loads and less weight loss. Silencing TXNL1 (thioredoxin-like protein 1) reduced infection; overexpression increased replication, implicating TXNL1 as a host factor. Limitations include the artificial infection model and immediate treatment; human applicability requires pharmacokinetic/safety data and clinical trials.

triage.headline_ja: ウエストナイルウイルス、古い抗真菌薬が脳内でウイルス増殖を抑制:ミコナゾールが新たな治療の可能性を開く
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマウスを用いた基礎研究（薬剤スクリーニング）であり、実際の感染症発生・アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性や社会的関心の高まりは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Launches 180-Day Ebola Response Plan as It Seeks $1.3 Billion
article.articleSummary: DRC launches a 180-day Ebola response plan (Sept 4) to curb an outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus, aiming to strengthen surveillance, contact tracing and patient care, with emphasis on logistics, risk communication, community engagement and preparedness in provinces at risk. As of Sept 2, authorities reported more than 6,300 cases and over 3,000 deaths, underscoring the resource needs for human resources, equipment and logistics. The plan, coordinated with partners, seeks flexible, predictable funding and integration into the broader humanitarian response, per UN resident coordinator Damien Mama. Complementary measures include WHO/Africa CDC’s June $518 million continental preparedness and response plan to bolster early detection in at-risk countries, and targeted operations like the Congo River Without Ebola to enhance surveillance along the river corridor.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、13億ドルを求め180日間のエボラ対応計画を開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）による大規模流行で6,300例超・死亡3,000人超が報告され、国際支援を要する大規模対応計画が発動されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率が非常に高く（死亡数が症例数の約半数）、大規模な国際資金調達（13億ドル）を要請している点から、既に大規模かつ深刻な流行と判断される。続報でWHOの正式な国際的懸念表明の有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Santé infantile Choléra : un appel à protéger des millions d'enfants en Afrique
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Child health: cholera — a call to protect millions of children in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Cholera severely affects children in Africa, with 44% of cases under 10 years in the Central African Republic; in Chad nearly two-thirds of infections are under 15; in Cameroon the median patient age is 10. The outbreaks span six countries, driven by seasonal rains, population movement and floods that contaminate water sources and damage sanitation infrastructure. Since Jan 1, 2026, Nigeria reports over 50,000 cholera cases and 338 deaths. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, over 30,400 cases and about 700 deaths, the highest death toll among affected countries. UNICEF warns the epidemic is no longer border-limited, moving along shared river basins and trade routes, endangering millions of children. Transmission concentrates along two corridors: the Lake Chad basin (Chad, Cameroon, Nigeria) and the Congo Basin (DRC, Republic of the Congo, RCA).

triage.headline_ja: 小児の健康、コレラ：アフリカで数百万人の子どもを守るための呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ6カ国にまたがるコレラの広域流行で、ナイジェリア5万人超・DRC3万人超の感染と多数の死者が報告されており、国境を越えた拡大と重症化（死亡）が確認されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 対象国リストの中で発生が確認できるのはDRCのみ。他の発生国（中央アフリカ、カメルーン、チャド、コンゴ共和国、ナイジェリア）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。DRCは死者数最多（約700人）で特に重症度が高い。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu outbreak in Haryana rises; 31 new H1N1 cases reported.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu outbreak in Haryana, India, as of 7 September 2026, with 31 new H1N1 cases, bringing the total to 331 since the season began. Of these, 198 have recovered and 130 remain infected, with 68 hospitalised. Three deaths occurred among patients with comorbidities in Hisar, Panipat, and Panchkula. Faridabad reports the highest count (81), followed by Hisar (48), Gurgaon (42), and Karnal (30). Nine cases of influenza A(H3N2) are also detected. Health authorities issued a prevention advisory: avoid public places when symptomatic, maintain distance, avoid handshakes, refrain from spitting, and not take medicines without medical advice. Ongoing transmission linked to seasonal change; monitoring continues.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤーナ州でスワイン・フル（H1N1）の流行拡大、新たに31例確認

triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1/H3N2）の国内流行で、地方保健当局が予防勧告を発出済み。重症例は基礎疾患保有者に限定され、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは考えにくいが、症例数の増加傾向は継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Otkriven novi virus koji prenose krpelji: Simptomi nalikuju na običnu gripu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new virus transmitted by ticks has been discovered: Symptoms resemble the common flu.
article.articleSummary: Beijing’s State Key Laboratory researchers report a newly identified human pathogen—Asian longhorned tick–transmitted nairovirus (ALTNV)—discovered after analyzing 3163 patients with Dabie bandavirus (DBV)–like illness; 10.4% tested negative for DBV, prompting additional blood testing in Haemaphysalis longicornis‑exposed individuals and revealing ALTNV. ALTNV causes influenza‑like illness with high fever, fatigue and gastrointestinal symptoms. Co-infection with DBV worsens disease; ALTNV and DBV co-circulate in similar regions and share the same tick vector, underscoring differential diagnostic needs. DBV itself causes severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) with up to 30% mortality; antibiotics are ineffective, and outcomes rely on host immunity. In the study, 38 patients carried both viruses, with markedly worse respiratory and renal injury; seven deaths occurred. The Asian longhorned tick is widespread in China; no specific antiviral therapy exists. Travelers should seek medical care for suspicious symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 新種のマダニ媒介ウイルスを発見：症状は通常のインフルエンザに似る
triage.triage_reason: 北京の研究機関がマダニ媒介の新規ナイロウイルス(ALTNV)を発見し、既知のSFTS(Dabie bandavirus)との共感染で重症化・死亡例が報告されており、公衆衛生上の影響および病原体の異常性の両面でIHR基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 本記事は査読前後の学術研究報告に基づくもので、ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠はなく、主にマダニ媒介感染症として報告されている。中国国内でのSFTSとの共感染による重症化・死亡例（7例）が確認されており、今後の疫学的広がりについて続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sixteen new swine flu cases detected; Balod's ADMs also infected; total infected has reached 251.

Raipur district remains the hardest hit with 108 cases, followed by Durg 36, Bilaspur 35, Korba 16, and Raigarh 12; other districts report scattered infections. Currently 89 active cases statewide, with 67 hospitalized and 22 in home isolation under medical supervision. As weather changes, swine flu risk rises; authorities urge people with fever, cough, cold, high fever, sore throat, or breathing difficulties to get tested at the nearest health facility and seek medical advice. The health department has intensified surveillance across the state.

article.articleHeadline: स्वाइन फ्लू की दस्तक, लेकिन अस्पतालों में बचाव की तैयारी नदारद
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu knocks at the door, but hospitals lack protective measures.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A(H1N1) swine flu has been confirmed in Raebareli district, India, prompting concerns over hospital infection-control readiness. Despite confirmed cases, hospitals reportedly lack essential safeguards such as cleanliness, routine masking, patient isolation, adequate ventilation, and limited contact, as outlined by WHO and the state health department. Family members of infected patients are seen in contact without masks, elevating transmission risk. Outpatient department screening for cough and fever is reportedly inadequate, crowds are not controlled, and suspected cases are not consistently segregated from others. Guidelines call for screening flu-like patients at health facilities and hospital admission based on illness severity after clinical assessment. In Raebareli, the district hospital is reported to have admissions arrangements for infected patients, while other facilities have not clarified their compliance. Situation raises in-hospital transmission concerns as of 7 September 2026.

triage.headline_ja: スワインフルーがノック、しかし病院には感染防止対策が欠如
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1（豚インフルエンザ）確定例であり、既知の病原体で新規性は低いが、病院の感染管理体制不備により院内感染拡大のリスクが指摘されているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: H1N1は既知の季節性インフルエンザであり、IHR基準への該当は低いが、病院内の感染対策不備が報じられており、地域内での二次感染拡大の可能性がある点は要注視。

article.articleHeadline: Deuil au Cap-Vert, exode au Nigeria, Ebola en RDC : l'Afrique face à une nouvelle série de crises - Cameroun24.net infos actus news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mourning in Cape Verde, exodus in Nigeria, Ebola in the DRC: Africa faces a new series of crises - Cameroun24.net infos actus news
article.articleSummary: Cabo Verde reports a bus crash on Fogo island that killed 25 people, including 12 children, with 12 children hospitalized; two days of national mourning declared and flags at half-mast after what authorities call the archipelago’s deadliest road accident this century. In Katsina State, Nigeria, residents of at least 15 villages in the Dandume district have fled amid intensified Boko Haram/ISWAP-linked attacks, with more than 100 civilians abducted in two weeks and disruptions to farming and trade. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola response faces violence and distrust; at least 45 aid workers were subjected to 76 incidents in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, including assaults and arson against clinics. Community burial practices and suspicions toward outsiders complicate surveillance and may fuel transmission.

triage.headline_ja: カーボベルデでの喪、ナイジェリアでの避難、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱：アフリカが新たな危機の連鎖に直面
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ対応が暴力や不信により妨げられており、監視体制の弱体化とヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスクが懸念されるため、WPRO基準の複数該当と社会的関心の高さからPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は複数のアフリカ危機（カーボベルデのバス事故、ナイジェリアの武装勢力による避難、DRCのエボラ対応妨害）を扱う複合記事。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。エボラ関連情報は主に対応妨害・暴力事案に焦点があり、感染者数や致死率など具体的疫学データは記載されていないため、詳細情報は不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: 3 dead, 60 reported cases: Jeolikote residents seek action over illness outbreak | Dehradun News
article.articleSummary: Diarrhoea, vomiting, typhoid and jaundice outbreaks in Nainital district’s Jeolikote area since late June have killed 3 and sickened 60-plus. Latest deaths: 16-year-old Ritesh Jeena (Sariyatal) and 26-year-old Neema Joshi (Jeolikote). Ritesh, with typhoid and liver failure, died after transfers to Delhi; Neema, with a liver infection and jaundice, died at Bareilly’s Ram Murti Hospital. Neema had helped raise the contamination alarm. Officials visited the water source, ordered shifting a sewage chamber, and pledged chlorination with fresh samples; schools are closed indefinitely. A joint Nainital–Sushila Tewari Hospital team is screening residents (95 in Jeolikote; 25 in Sariyatal; 20 in Chhida; 6 admitted). A Uttarakhand High Court PIL cites over 60 cases and three deaths across Beluwakhan, Jeolikote, Gethiya, Sariyatal and nearby areas, linking contamination to leaking sewers and pipelines; tests show total coliform and turbidity irregularities in raw water, notably from the Durgapur main source.

triage.headline_ja: 死者3名、報告例60件：Jeolikote住民が病気の集団発生への対応を要求 | デヘラドゥーン・ニュース
triage.triage_reason: インド・ナイニタール県の複数地域で下痢・腸チフス・黄疸が集団発生し3名死亡、60名以上罹患。水系汚染が原因で継続曝露リスクがあり、高裁PIL提訴など社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 汚染された水源（下水管・パイプラインの漏出）が原因とされ、複数地域（Jeolikote, Sariyatal, Gethiya, Beluwakhan等）で下痢・チフス・黄疸が同時発生。地域内の水系感染症であり国際的拡大の可能性は低いが、継続的な水質汚染により住民への曝露が続くリスクがある。

article.articleHeadline: Manila declares leptospirosis outbreak
article.articleSummary: Manila reports a leptospirosis outbreak with attack rate rising to 3.48% from 1.27% the previous week, saturating Ospital ng Maynila, Sta. Ana Hospital, and Justice Jose Abad Santos General Hospital. Mayor Francisco 'Isko Moreno' Domagoso orders intensified measures, including an aggressive information campaign. The city’s Health Department provides free doxycycline at 44 health centers and seven district hospitals and plans house-to-house doxycycline distribution for residents exposed to floodwaters from recent rains. Leptospirosis is a bacterial infection transmitted via water or soil contaminated by urine from infected animals, particularly rats, entering through cuts or mucous membranes. Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, and red eyes; severe cases can lead to kidney or liver failure. The update underscores flood-related exposure and ongoing capacity strain amid the outbreak in Manila as of 2026-09-07.

triage.headline_ja: マニラ市がレプトスピラ症のアウトブレイクを宣言
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症で罹患率が急上昇し、複数の病院が満床となるなど医療体制への負荷が生じており、市長主導で緊急対策が発令されるなど社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は洪水後にフィリピンで季節的に発生する既知の疾患であり、人-人感染はしないため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、罹患率の急上昇と病院の逼迫が確認されており、地域の公衆衛生対応能力の観点から注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Pork prices fall as farmers rush to sell amid ASF fears
article.articleSummary: ASF fears in the Philippines pushed pork prices down as hog raisers rushed to sell before the rainy season amid weather-linked outbreak concerns. Active ASF cases were recorded in 20 provinces across 12 regions as of Aug. 7. In Mindanao, prices declined despite limited pork imports. Farm-gate hog prices fell nearly 19% in Q2 2026 to PHP 172.44/kg from PHP 211.91/kg a year earlier. Last year’s ASF outbreaks had lifted liempo to PHP 450–490/kg and kasim to around PHP 400/kg. Pork production rose 5.6% to 412,280 MT in Q2, while imports totaled 541.41 million kg Jan–Jul 2026, up 10.3% YoY. BAI projects imports to drop about 50,000 MT in 2026 from 2025 due to higher local production and prior year’ import levels. DA notes BAI’s approval of commercial ASF vaccine could stabilize supply, with a vaccine manufacturing lab at Central Luzon State University due next year.

triage.headline_ja: ASFへの懸念から豚価格が下落、農家が売り急ぐ
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）はヒトに感染しない家畜疾病であり、記事内容も価格動向に関する経済ニュースが主体で、公衆衛生上の新規性・緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: ASFはヒトへの感染性がなく、公衆衛生的なリスク評価対象外。記事は既存の豚肉市場・価格動向に関する経済報道であり、感染症危機管理の観点からはモニタリング不要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo registra mais de 58 mil casos de dengue e 42 mortes em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo records more than 58,000 dengue cases and 42 deaths in 2026
article.articleSummary: Dengue in São Paulo state, Brazil: As of 7 September 2026, 58,683 dengue cases confirmed since year start, including 1,180 warning-sign and 101 severe dengue; 42 deaths, with 30 under investigation. There are 7,256 cases under investigation and 30 deaths under investigation, while 297,833 notifications have been discarded. The Greater São Paulo area accounts for most cases (12,919), concentrated in the capital (9,859); Taubaté records the most dengue deaths (14). In 2025, up to week 35, 855,132 cases were recorded (17,533 warning-sign, 1,424 severe) and 1,112 deaths, showing a 93.1% reduction in 2026. El Niño is forecast to be very strong (90% chance) Sep–Dec, with above-average rainfall and higher temperatures boosting Aedes aegypti breeding and transmission of dengue (also Zika and chikungunya). São Paulo’s plan includes post-rain checks of yards, gutters, pots, tires, and water tanks, plus drone-assisted surveillance and house-to-house visits; about 80% of foci are at residences.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、2026年にデング熱症例5万8000件以上、死亡42人を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの風土病であるデング熱の定例サーベイランス報告で、2025年比93%減少と状況は改善傾向にあり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルの風土病であり、州政府による監視・対策（家屋訪問、ドローン監視等）が既に実施中。エルニーニョによる媒介蚊増加が今後のリスク要因として言及されているが、現時点では前年比大幅減少で管理下にある。

article.articleHeadline: "Língua" eletrônica pode detectar gripe aviária em 6 minutos; entenda | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Electronic tongue can detect avian influenza in 6 minutes; understand
article.articleSummary: Electronic tongue, a multisensor platform developed by researchers at the University of São Paulo, detects antibodies against avian influenza (Influenza A H5N1) in about six minutes. It can track regions and species with prior exposure, enabling early outbreak detection and containment for clinical and veterinary use. The device, built at the IFSC (Institute of Physics of São Carlos) and published in Applied Nano Materials, uses plant-derived proteins—zein (corn), jacalin (jackfruit), and concanavalin A (ConA; from hog bean)—and sericin to modify gold nanoparticles. It measures electrical properties, with sensor responses forming a pattern that identifies substances in the sample. While promising, tests used commercial anti-H5N1 antibodies and fetal bovine serum enriched with these antibodies; human blood samples have not yet been tested. Calibration and durability challenges may be mitigated by artificial intelligence, and scale-up to thousands of devices must remain low-cost and reproducible.

triage.headline_ja: 「電子舌」が6分で鳥インフルエンザを検出可能に；その仕組みとは
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は鳥インフルエンザ検出用センサー技術に関する研究開発の紹介であり、実際の感染事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ対象外と判断する。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・サンパウロ大学の研究者が開発した鳥インフルエンザ抗体検出用の新技術（電子舌）に関する科学ニュースであり、実際の感染症発生報告ではない。ヒト検体での試験は未実施であり、技術開発段階の内容。

article.articleHeadline: Howrah reels under dengue attack, cases touch 115
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Howrah rose to 115 cases this week from 94, signaling ongoing transmission but still below last year’s level. The spike is tied to alleged poor coordination between the district health department and Howrah Municipal Corporation (HMC) health wing. CMOH Kishalay Dutta accused HMC OSD Ashutosh Kundu of non-compliance with Swasthya Bhavan directives, potentially widening infection pockets. Residents complained of testing-kit and medicine shortages and selective testing, while Kundu reportedly urged staff to conserve kits and test only high-fever patients. Dutta denied shortages and said Swasthya Bhavan supplies as needed; Kundu was unavailable for comment. A senior HMC official denied the allegations but admitted staff shortages, deficient data collection, and irregular larvicide spraying by VBD/VCM workers. HMC plans drone-based larvicide spraying in high-incidence areas. District magistrate P. Deeppappriya will review persistent problems as MLAs criticized spraying, drain-cleaning, and data gaps in dengue-control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ハウラーでデング熱が猛威、症例数115件に
triage.triage_reason: インド国内(ハウラー)でのデング熱症例増加だが、季節性流行の範囲内で国際的拡大リスクは低い。行政対応の不備が指摘されており今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 地方自治体間の連携不足や検査キット不足など、対応管理上の課題が報じられているが、これはインド国内の地域的な公衆衛生問題であり国際的な懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Health dept intensifies dengue surveillance
article.articleSummary: Dengue surveillance intensified in Kolkata as health officials report a slight uptick in fever cases despite the dengue burden remaining lower than in previous years. The state health department has ordered line listing of admitted dengue patients, sharing of patient addresses and family contact numbers with civic bodies to identify and eliminate transmission sources. Private hospitals must comply via a dedicated portal, and daily fever-clinic footfall and testing data must be uploaded for analysis of possible clustering. Dengue observer teams—comprising doctors, nurses and paramedics—will visit facilities with high case loads to support management. All government blood centers have been asked to ensure platelet availability, though current demand is not rising. This year has recorded around 4,500 dengue cases across the state with seven official deaths. Officials caution that a further spike may occur in coming weeks, but stress action rather than panic.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局、デング熱サーベイランスを強化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱流行に対する通常のサーベイランス強化措置であり、症例数・死亡数とも例年より少なく、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで毎年発生する風土病であり、今回の記事は例年より低い流行状況下でのルーチンなサーベイランス体制強化を報じるもの。外部支援の必要性や社会的関心の高まりを示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Swine flu death in Moga; 5 test positive
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-07, in Punjab's Moga district, swine flu (H1N1) infections rose to five positives and one death amid a surge. A 60-year-old woman died; the five active cases include a four-year-old child and are classified as mild and under home isolation. District health authorities have deployed contact-tracing teams across Moga, Baghapurana, Nihal Singh Wala and Kot Ise Khan to conduct door-to-door surveys. A four-bed isolation ward has been established at Moga government hospital to manage potential severe cases. Officials say close contacts have been screened and show no symptoms so far. No current hospitalisations; facilities prepared for possible admissions if needed. The public health response continues with surveillance and tracing to curb transmission during the ongoing surge.

triage.headline_ja: モガ郡で豚インフルエンザによる死亡、5人が陽性
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1による散発的な1死亡・5陽性例で、地域保健当局が対応中。異常性・国際的拡大リスクは低いが死亡例があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: インド・パンジャブ州モガ郡での季節性H1N1流行の一環と考えられる。地元当局が接触者追跡・隔離対応を実施中で、国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'daki Ebola salgınında can kaybı 3 bin 95'e yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll in the Congo Ebola outbreak rises to 3,095.
article.articleSummary: As of May 15, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 3,095 deaths and 6,436 confirmed cases, with a case fatality rate of 48.1%, according to the Ministry of Health. The epidemic remains active across six provinces and 60 districts. The Ituri Province is the main hotspot, while South Kivu has not reported a newly confirmed case for 95 days. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved specific treatment or vaccine. The virus was first identified in 1976 in Nzara, Sudan and in Yambuku, DRC, and the name Ebola derives from the Ebola River near the outbreak’s origin in Ituri. (Source: İlka/İLKHA)

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、死者数が3,095人に増加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率48.1%のエボラ出血熱が6州60地区にわたり継続的に拡大しており、死者数・症例数ともに深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を及ぼしているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: スーダン（Nzara）およびブルンジは1976年の初発見地としての記述であり、現行流行地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外。現在の活動地域はコンゴ民主共和国（特にイツリ州、南キブ州）に限定。

article.articleHeadline: Jeceaba registra morte por febre maculosa e investiga outros dois óbitos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jeceaba records a death from Rocky Mountain spotted fever and is investigating two other deaths.
article.articleSummary: Rocky Mountain spotted fever has claimed one death in Jeceaba, a town of about 6,000 in central Minas Gerais, with two additional suspected deaths under investigation. The city’s concerns stem from tick-borne transmission, aided by the presence of capybaras near the river and possible tick exposure on domestic animals. In Minas Gerais overall, 36 confirmed cases and 11 deaths had been reported as of August 27; the death toll represents a 57% increase versus all of 2025, when seven people died. Key symptoms include high fever, severe headache, nausea, vomiting, muscle pain, diarrhea, and abdominal pain; severe cases can progress rapidly to death. Prevention measures in Jeceaba include closing public spaces near risk areas and distributing warning posters after confirmation of the case.

triage.headline_ja: ジェセアバでロッキー山紅斑熱による死亡例を記録、他2件の死亡も調査中
triage.triage_reason: ミナスジェライス州で紅斑熱による死亡者数が前年比57%増加しており、地域行政が公共空間の閉鎖など対応を強化していることから、WPRO基準（異常性・重症度・曝露継続）と社会的関心（行政対応）の双方が該当する。
triage.notes: 紅斑熱（Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever）はダニ媒介性でヒト-ヒト感染はないため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、ミナスジェライス州内での死亡数急増と地方自治体の対応強化が確認されており、続報を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ghaziabad News: बैक्टीरियल संक्रमण में स्वाइन फ्लू का खतरा बढ़ रहा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ghaziabad News: Risk of swine flu rising in bacterial infections.
article.articleSummary: Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, India — Bacterial infections are rising in city hospitals. On Monday, more than 1,000 patients presented with fever, cough, and breathing difficulty, indicating rapid spread of seasonal infections. Swine flu (swine influenza) cases rose to 42, with a new patient reported from Lal Kuan. MMG Hospital registered 3,045 patients on Monday: 1,522 women, 1,037 men, and 486 children; United Hospital treated 892 patients: 374 men and 518 women. Across both facilities, over 1,000 patients sought care for fever, cough, and breathing trouble. These figures reflect concurrent bacterial infections and an emerging swine flu cluster in Ghaziabad as of 7 September 2026 (Monday).

triage.headline_ja: ガーズィヤーバード:細菌感染症の中で豚インフルエンザのリスクが高まる
triage.triage_reason: インドの一都市で季節性感染症（細菌感染・豚インフルエンザ）の患者増加が報告されているが、重症度や公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大の兆候は明確でなく、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 季節性の豚インフルエンザ（H1N1）と細菌性感染症の混在した地域的な患者数増加であり、国際的な緊急性を示す情報はない。42例という数字も地域の季節性流行の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Focus RDC : Ebola entre défiance, vaccins et riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC Focus: Ebola amid mistrust, vaccines, and the response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has caused more than 3,000 deaths, with response efforts unfolding on multiple fronts. In North Kivu’s Beni, mistrust fuels transmission risks after five suspected patients fled a transit center within three days; two were later confirmed positive and returned to communities before treatment. In Kisangani, Tshopo province, vaccination is expanding, with over 200 people receiving the Ervebo Ebola vaccine at Cinquantenaire Hospital, prioritizing frontline healthcare workers. The government reports more than 50,000 vaccine doses available to bolster efforts in affected provinces. Experts underscore that community trust and effective risk communication are critical alongside medical tools, including tackling rumors and aligning with local realities. The response combines vaccination, surveillance, and community outreach to end one of the DRC’s deadliest Ebola outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: DRC特集：エボラ、不信感・ワクチン・対応の狭間で
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱によるDRCでの3000人以上の死亡、地域拡大及び住民の不信感によるヒト-ヒト感染継続リスクがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 北キブ州ベニでの患者逃亡や地域社会の不信感が感染拡大リスクを高めており、既に3000人以上の死者を出している大規模流行として継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Lala Lajpat Rai Hospital begins testing for patients with symptoms of H1N1 swine flu | Kanpur News
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-07, Lala Lajpat Rai Hospital in Kanpur began round-the-clock testing for patients with symptoms of H1N1 swine flu, with samples processed locally in the hospital's 24-hour pathology unit in the maternity block. The arrangement is designed to accelerate identification and treatment of suspected infections and reduce reporting delays amid rising H1N1 cases. Health authorities have stepped up vigilance and expanded testing after infections were confirmed in several districts near Kanpur. GSVM Medical College principal Sanjay Kala announced the facility, noting that it will bring relief to people in nearby districts as well. The initiative enables faster laboratory confirmation to guide clinical decisions for suspected H1N1 cases in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ラーラー・ラージパト・ラーイ病院、H1N1豚インフルエンザ症状患者の検査を開始 | カーンプルニュース
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1（豚インフルエンザ）の症例増加に伴い地域医療機関が検査体制を強化した内容であり、既知の疾患であるため異常性は低いが、症例増加の状況を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既知の疾患であり、周辺地域での症例増加に対する地元医療機関の対応強化が主内容。重症度や死亡者数など詳細情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Identifying severe influenza: Fever with dry cough, sore throat & nasal congestion
article.articleSummary: During the post-monsoon surge in Kollam, India, clinicians distinguish severe influenza from dengue and routine viral fevers. Influenza typically presents with sudden high fever, dry cough, sore throat, and nasal congestion, while dengue commonly lacks respiratory symptoms and features abrupt fever with bone and joint pains, retro-orbital pain, and thrombocytopenia. Early differentiation hinges on the speed of onset and the nature of pain; routine viral fevers tend to rise gradually. Given overlapping symptoms, patients are advised to seek early medical consultation. Should every fever trigger H1N1 testing? No. Most cases are guided by clinical evaluation and standard blood work, with management focused on symptomatic care—rest, hydration, and antipyretics—without routine lab confirmation. This guidance emphasizes Kollam-based practice and the importance of distinguishing influenza from dengue during the ongoing post-monsoon period. Published 2026-09-07.

triage.headline_ja: 重症インフルエンザの見分け方：発熱に乾いた咳、喉の痛み、鼻づまりを伴う場合
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザとデング熱の臨床的鑑別に関する一般的な医療情報記事であり、異常な集団発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はケララ州コラム地区における季節性の発熱疾患（インフルエンザ・デング熱）の臨床的鑑別に関する啓発記事であり、具体的な感染者数や集団発生、異常な流行状況の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue larvae found in 12 Phase-9 houses; checks intensified | Chandigarh News
article.articleSummary: Dengue drive in Mohali, Punjab intensified as the district health department launched house-to-house checks every Monday in addition to the routine Friday campaign. In a special Phase-9 inspection, health teams found dengue larvae in about 12 houses, including flower pots, coolers and other containers with stagnant water. Civil surgeon Dr Sangeeta Jain, who led the operation, urged residents to prevent water accumulation and routinely inspect potential breeding sites; Monday checks follow Punjab government directives targeting high-risk areas. Teams sprayed insecticide and addressed breeding sites in coolers, pots, refrigerators and other water-holding locations. Dr Jain emphasized that Aedes mosquitoes breed in clean stagnant water and bite by day; residents were told to keep surroundings dry and empty water-holding containers. For symptomatic individuals (high fever, severe headache, body ache, retro-orbital pain, nausea, vomiting), timely medical care is advised. Dengue testing and treatment are free at government facilities; helpline 104 for assistance.

triage.headline_ja: 12軒でデング熱の幼虫を発見、点検を強化 | チャンディーガル・ニュース
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の幼虫発見に伴う通常の予防的対策(家屋点検・殺虫剤散布)であり、患者発生や重症例の報告はなく、異常性や国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による定例的なデング熱対策活動の報道であり、症例数や重症度に関する情報は記載されていない。季節性のルーチン対応と考えられる。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Early antivirals, not antibiotics key to fighting H1N1
article.articleSummary: H1N1 influenza requires immediate antiviral therapy within the first 48 hours to halt viral replication and prevent deep lung injury. Indian clinicians from Kollam (Kerala) and Bengaluru (Karnataka) describe a pattern where patients with fever and myalgia are treated with antibiotics, later presenting in tertiary centres with hypoxemic respiratory failure or ARDS. Start empirical oseltamivir based on clinical presentation for high-risk influenza-like illness, without waiting for RT-PCR. Severe cases show chest CT bilateral patchy ground-glass opacities indicating viral pneumonia. High-risk groups include uncontrolled diabetes, chronic kidney disease, cardiovascular disease, COPD, pregnancy, and the elderly. Red flags for urgent care are severe dyspnea, chest pain, confusion, or cyanosis. Monsoon/post-monsoon transmission is amplified by crowded, poorly ventilated indoor spaces; humidity effects are complex.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1との闘いには抗生物質ではなく早期の抗ウイルス薬投与が鍵
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザの臨床管理・診療ガイダンスに関する啓発記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。既知の疾患パターンについての医療従事者向け情報提供が主旨。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の臨床診療における注意喚起であり、新規のアウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象を報告するものではない。モンスーン時期の毎年の感染増加パターンについての医療専門家向け解説記事。WPRO基準は複数該当するが、これは季節性疾患の一般的特性によるものであり、新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低いと判断。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Influenza: In kids, symptoms can be misleading
article.articleSummary: Influenza A (H1N1) caused viral pneumonia in a 10-year-old in Kochi, India, after fever and dry cough rapidly progressed to respiratory distress within 72 hours. Pediatric influenza often presents with fever and cough but can include vomiting, diarrhea, or loss of appetite, and infants may deteriorate quickly. High-risk groups—young children, pregnant women, and those with asthma or diabetes—have a lower threshold for lower respiratory tract invasion, risking deep lung inflammation and respiratory failure. Warning signs include fast or difficult breathing, cyanosis, persistent chest pain, extreme lethargy, or inability to drink; relapse after fever relief warrants urgent evaluation. Schools are major transmission sites, but closures require careful judgment; symptomatic students should be sent home with emphasis on ventilation and hygiene. Prevention relies on annual vaccination for children and maternal vaccination to protect newborns, and avoiding risky home practices like forced steam inhalation.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ：子供の症状は見分けにくいことがある
triage.triage_reason: 単発の小児インフルエンザ症例に関する啓発・注意喚起記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般向け健康情報記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : l'OMS renforce la riposte dans la zone de santé de Lita
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: WHO steps up the response in the Lita health zone.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease response intensified in Lita health zone, Ituri's Djugu territory, as WHO steps up support. On Sept 5, 2026, WHO incident manager Dr. Thierno Paldé outlined actions over recent weeks to strengthen care at the Lita Ebola Treatment Center (ETC). Tents have been erected to separate suspected and confirmed cases, and July site improvements increased capacity to 12 beds, with care provided by NGO ALIMA. The Ministry of Health has deployed additional personnel to reinforce response teams. WHO also trained teams for dignified, safe burials. A high-capacity borehole delivering over 30,000 liters of water was installed to feed the ETC, Lita General Referral Hospital, and surrounding households, with UNICEF and WHO support. An ambulance was handed to the zone to improve patient transport and referral. Since May, Lita recorded 220 confirmed cases, 120 deaths, and 100 surviving patients.

triage.headline_ja: イツリでのエボラ出血熱：WHOがリタ保健地域での対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州でエボラ出血熱の継続的アウトブレイクがあり、220例確定・120死亡という深刻な公衆衛生影響とWHOによる国際支援が確認されるため、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに含まれる『Lita, Cluj, Romania』は地名の同名誤認（ジオコーディングエラー）と判断し、除外した。実際の発生地はDRCイツリ州ジュグ準州リタ保健地域のみ。

article.articleHeadline: 2 siblings die of suspected swine flu, reports sent for test | Kanpur News
article.articleSummary: Two siblings from Atwa Baik village in Unnao's Ganjmuradabad block died of H1N1 swine flu after testing positive. The 50-year-old man was admitted Aug 30 with fever and breathing problems; his H1N1 result was confirmed on Sept 2, and he died that night. His 56-year-old sister, admitted Aug 30 with similar symptoms, also tested positive on Sept 2 and died Sept 3. The family’s son emailed the health department on Saturday (Sept 5, 2026) with both deaths and attached positive test reports. Health officials collected swab samples from 16 villagers who had contact with the deceased, while a medical team was dispatched and samples were sent to Lucknow's KGMU for testing; hospital or laboratory reports had not been formally received yet.

triage.headline_ja: きょうだい2人が疑いのある豚インフルエンザで死亡、検査結果待ち｜カーンプル・ニュース
triage.triage_reason: ウッタル・プラデーシュ州の1家族内で2名がH1N1陽性とされ死亡したが、公式な検査結果は未確定であり、地域的な拡大の証拠もないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: H1N1はインドで季節性に発生する既知の疾患であり、今回の事例は単一家族内での発症・死亡に限定される。保健当局が接触者16名の検体採取と検査を実施中だが、公式な検査結果（KGMUでの確認）はまだ届いていない。続報で確定診断・追加症例の有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ministro da Educação cancela agenda em MG por surto de sarna humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minister of Education cancels schedule in Minas Gerais due to an outbreak of human scabies.
article.articleSummary: Alfenas, in southern Minas Gerais, Brazil, faces a scabies outbreak with more than 150 cases since late August. The Ministry of Education (MEC) canceled a visit by Minister Leonardo Barchini to Alfenas, including labs at Centro de Biologia Experimental (Cebioex) and the Center for Drug Prospecting in Fármacos, Fitofármacos e Novas Tecnologias (Profatec), as well as a visit to Unifal-MG’s Dentistry facilities and a World Literacy Day event at Escola Municipal Tereza Paulino da Costa. In the municipal network, about 50 cases have been confirmed among students and staff across five schools, with two daycares (Cemeis Dona Zinica and Dona Vanja) accounting for most cases. Preventive actions include school suspensions, cleaning, and guidance. A city committee was formed; the Sept 7 parade was suspended. At the prison, cases occurred about three months ago; none are symptomatic now. An Aug 28 meeting coordinated health, education, sanitation, epidemiology, and prison officials.

triage.headline_ja: 教育大臣、疥癬(人疥癬)の流行によりミナスジェライス州での予定をキャンセル
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は通常軽症で国際的拡大リスクは低いが、150例超の集団発生で学校閉鎖等の対応が取られており、社会的関心もあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 疥癬は接触感染性の皮膚寄生虫症で重症度は低いが、学校・保育所・刑務所など集団施設での拡大が見られ、教育大臣の訪問中止など行政対応・社会的関心が高い事例。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en Congo: el brote más letal supera los 3 mil muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: The Deadliest Outbreak Surpasses 3,000 Deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 September 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 6,604 cumulative Ebola virus disease cases and 3,175 deaths (case fatality rate 48.1%). In the last 24 hours, 82 new cases and 41 deaths were recorded, signaling ongoing rapid transmission. Ituri Province accounts for over 80% of cases, with the outbreak spreading to North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, and Tshopo, including the provincial capital Kisangani, about 600 km from the epicenter. A major challenge is the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no vaccines or treatments specifically approved; unlike the Zaire strain, which had therapeutic options. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) in May to mobilize global resources.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱：最も致死的な流行、死者3000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行で致死率48%、複数州に拡大中でIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はワクチン・治療薬未承認であり、対応がより困難。既にPHEIC宣言済みで国際的注目度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO coordinates expansion of Ebola treatment centre in DR Congo as death toll climbs
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-07, WHO coordinates expansion of the Lita Ebola treatment centre in Ituri, DR Congo, adding 42 beds and upgraded facilities to boost capacity amid a surge that has caused 3,007 deaths and 6,186 infections (1,409 recoveries; case fatality 48.6%). The deadliest DR Congo outbreak originated in Ituri and has spread to six provinces, in areas with weak state presence and ongoing insecurity. The Bundibugyo strain drives this epidemic, with no approved vaccine or treatment for it; multiple therapies and vaccines are under study. Zaire strain vaccines exist, and WHO is pursuing a phase-three trial using Ervebo against Zaire, though protection against Bundibugyo remains unconfirmed. A batch of 16,250 doses for frontline personnel arrived recently, with vaccination starting in Kisangani, capital of northeast Tshopo province.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、死者数増加を受けコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ治療センター拡張を調整
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が進行中で、死者3,007人・感染6,186人、致死率48.6%と深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、6州へ拡大し承認済みワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株が原因である点で異常性・国際拡大リスクも高い。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ株による流行であり、治安不安定な地域での対応困難さも懸念材料。WHOはザイール株用ワクチン（Ervebo）の第3相試験を実施予定だが、ブンディブギョ株への有効性は未確認。

article.articleHeadline: 北京启动本流行季流感疫苗接种工作
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beijing launches this season's influenza vaccination program.
article.articleSummary: Beijing, China launched the 2026-2027 seasonal influenza vaccination program on September 7, 2026. Free vaccination continues for priority groups: residents aged 60+, students, frontline workers in key sectors, and all children 6 months and older without contraindications. Vaccination sites will operate with extended hours and weekend services; Haidian district has begun weekend vaccination. Citizens can book via the JingTong app/mini-program, clinic phone lines, or on-site registration. The season offers 3-valent inactivated (IIV3) and 3-valent live attenuated (LAIV3) vaccines. IIV3 doses: 0.25 mL or 0.5 mL; LAIV3 for ages 3–17 at 0.2 mL per dose. Dosing: 6–9-year-olds with no prior vaccination require two doses; otherwise one; 9+ years and adults: one dose. Protection typically starts 2–4 weeks after vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 北京、今シーズンのインフルエンザワクチン接種事業を開始
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種プログラムの通常告知であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 定例のワクチン接種プログラム開始告知であり、疾病発生イベントではないため対象国リストへの計上も不要。

article.articleHeadline: Caso de meningite tira Cmei de desfile em Cascavel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningitis case pulls CMEI out of parade in Cascavel.
article.articleSummary: One confirmed case of meningococcal meningitis in a four-year-old in the Cataratas neighborhood led Cascavel authorities to pull CMEI Doce Infância from the Sept 7 civic parade on Avenida Brasil as a precaution. Health officials activated a sanitary blockade, providing preventive medications and monitoring 48 children and staff who had contact with the patient. The infected child remains under specialized medical care; no additional school-community cases were reported over the weekend, and active school surveillance continues. Meningococcal meningitis is a rapid-onset bacterial infection; symptoms include high fever, neck stiffness, and headaches, prompting early diagnosis. Authorities emphasize vaccination and updated vaccination records, and have set up a hotline and on-call service for families.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎の症例、カスカベルのパレードからCMEIを除外
triage.triage_reason: 単発の髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎症例で地域的な対応が取られているが、拡大の兆候はなく情報も限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 発生地域はブラジルのマトグロッソ・ド・スル州とされているが、記事本文はパラナ州カスカベル市の事例であり、対象国リストの都市・州の特定に矛盾がある。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、本イベントは単発の小児症例で公衆衛生上の重大な国際的懸念には至っていないため、verified_locationsには含めず経過観察とした。

article.articleHeadline: 流感仍處高水平 近300長者重症亡 盧寵茂：已購130萬劑疫苗 籲盡快接種 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza remains at a high level; nearly 300 elderly people have died after becoming critically ill. Lo Chung-mau: 1.3 million vaccine doses purchased, urging vaccination as soon as possible | am730.
article.articleSummary: Seasonal influenza remains at a very high level in Hong Kong, with a positivity rate of 11.17% versus a 4.94% baseline. Since summer began in late June, activity stays elevated; among Hospital Authority patients, influenza reaches about 0.75 per 10,000. There have been 16 pediatric severe cases with 1 death, and more than 450 elderly admitted for severe illness, with nearly 300 deaths—over 80% of fatalities are 65 or older. Health Secretary Lo Chung-mau announced the seasonal vaccination plan, with 1.3 million doses purchased; vaccination starts Sept 10, 2026. Vaccines available include inactivated, recombinant, and live attenuated nasal vaccines. An electronic consent feature on the eHealth platform has seen roughly 80,000 submissions; allocations to eligible doctors rise from 100,000 to 300,000 doses. More than 99% of schools participate in outreach; 14 do not. The government will stage about 100 vaccination events with district councils and care teams.

triage.headline_ja: 季節性インフルエンザが依然高水準、高齢者の重症例が近300人死亡。盧寵茂:130万回分のワクチンを購入、早期接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザによる高齢者の重症・死亡例が多数報告され、政府が大規模なワクチン接種キャンペーンを展開するなど社会的・行政的関心が高いため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区は中国（China, 1814991）に集約して報告。季節性インフルエンザとしては例年通りのパターンだが、重症・死亡数の多さと政府の積極的対応が社会的関心を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: SP tem mais de 58 mil casos de dengue neste ano; 42 mortes registradas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo has more than 58,000 dengue cases this year; 42 deaths registered.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 September 2026, São Paulo state has reported more than 58,000 dengue cases this year and 42 deaths, with 30 deaths under investigation. The state Health Secretariat lists 57,402 dengue cases since January, including 1,180 with alarm signs and 101 classified as severe. Alarm signs include vomiting, abdominal pain, and mucosal bleeding; severe dengue involves shock or respiratory distress, severe bleeding, and organ impairment. More than 297,000 suspected cases have been discarded, and about 7,300 are still under analysis. Taubaté is the municipality with the highest death toll, totaling 11 deaths—seven aged 10–79 and four over 80 years old.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、今年のデング熱症例数が5万8000人超、死亡42人を記録
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はブラジルで毎年流行する風土病であり、今回の報告は季節的な症例数・死亡者数の更新に過ぎず明確な異常性は認められないが、重症例・死亡者数が一定数存在するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで季節性・地方病的に発生しており、本記事は州保健局の定例報告に基づく症例・死亡者数の更新情報。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: ALTNV فيروس جديد... ينقله القراد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ALTNV: A new virus... transmitted by ticks.
article.articleSummary: Asian Longhorned Tick Nairovirus (ALTNV), a novel orthonairovirus transmitted by Asian longhorned ticks, was identified in China among tick-exposed patients. ALTNV causes influenza-like illness—fever, myalgia, fatigue, and occasionally respiratory symptoms—and is linked to thrombocytopenia and liver involvement on lab tests. While ALTNV infections do not universally cause severe bleeding or death, seven co-infected patients with Dabie Bandavirus (DBV, the agent of Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome) died (18.4%) during the study. In a cohort of 3,163 tick-exposed individuals, ALTNV was detected in 10.4%. Co-circulation with DBV in similar regions and shared tick vectors highlight the need for differential diagnosis between ALTNV and DBV in areas where SFTS is endemic. There are no ALTNV-specific antivirals; treatment is supportive, and antibiotics should be avoided unless bacterial infection is suspected. Laboratory confirmation is essential for accurate diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: ALTNV：新型ウイルス…マダニによって媒介される
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新規のダニ媒介性オルソナイロウイルス（ALTNV）が確認され、SFTSウイルスとの共感染例で18.4%の致死率が報告されており、IHR基準（重大性・異常性）を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断した。
triage.notes: ALTNV単独での重症化・死亡は稀だが、Dabie Bandavirus（SFTS病原体）との共感染例で高い致死率が報告されている。ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠はなく、主にダニ曝露による感染と考えられるため、国際的拡大リスクは現時点で低いと評価。新規病原体の発見であり、SFTS流行地域における鑑別診断の必要性が指摘されている点は監視継続の重要な理由となる。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Cruz mantém circulação da dengue mesmo durante o inverno
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Cruz maintains dengue transmission even during winter.
article.articleSummary: Dengue continues in Santa Cruz do Sul, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, with two new autochthonous cases since the last report (Aug 10), bringing 2026’s total to 30 local infections. As of 7 September 2026, 562 notifications were recorded; 529 discarded and 3 under investigation. Incidence rose from 23.4 to 24.9 per 100,000 inhabitants, but new confirmations in the past month remain low. The city is still classified as infested by Aedes aegypti, indicating ongoing local transmission during winter, outside the usual March–May peak (weeks 12–22) for the state. No dengue deaths in 2026. Age distribution centers on 20–29 years (9 cases) and 10–14 years (4); other adults include 30–39 (4), 40–49 (4), 50–59 (7), 60–69 (1), and 70–79 (1). Females predominate (18 cases, 60%); three cases remain under investigation. All confirmed cases are locally acquired; no imported cases reported.

triage.headline_ja: サンタクルスでは冬でもデング熱の感染が継続
triage.triage_reason: 冬季にもかかわらず地域感染が継続しているが、症例数・重症度は低く社会的関心の明確な高まりは確認できないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 冬季（3~5月ピーク以外）の継続的な自発感染はAedes aegyptiの定着を示すが、死亡例なく症例数も少ないため重大な公衆衛生上の影響は現時点で認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : des relais communautaires appelés à travailler dur pour éradiquer Ebola à Mangothe - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Community health volunteers urged to work hard to eradicate Ebola in Mangothe - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is active in Mangothe health area, Beni, North Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The area is described as in difficulty with high-risk contacts, suspected cases, and confirmed cases, placing it in a state of maximum alert and high surveillance as of 7 September 2026. A contact-tracing supervisor, M. Platon Corbeil, urged community health volunteers to intensify efforts to eradicate transmission by locating unvisited contacts and leveraging social networks to break the chain of transmission within the community. Community relays are identified as the first line of defense, bridging health teams and local populations. The briefing highlights intensified case-finding and vigilance as part of the ongoing Ebola response in Mangothe, Beni.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：マンゴテでのエボラ根絶に向け地域保健ボランティアに奮闘呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州でエボラ出血熱の確定例・疑い例・高リスク接触者が継続し、最大警戒レベルにあるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR Annex2の常時アルゴリズム適用対象疾患（ウイルス性出血熱）であり、DRC北キブ州ベニ地区マンゴテ地域で確定例・疑い例が確認され、コンタクトトレーシングと地域ボランティアによる封じ込め活動が継続中。既知の進行中アウトブレイク対応の一環だが、感染継続と国際的拡大リスクからフルリスク評価が妥当。
