article.articleHeadline: 15 test positive for swine flu in Amritsar - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: 15 swine flu (H1N1) cases confirmed in Amritsar, Punjab, triggering a surge in surveillance. Isolation wards set up at Guru Nanak Dev Hospital (about 30 beds) and at Civil Hospital. Health Department intensified monitoring across government facilities and directed hospitals to stay alert for swine flu-like symptoms, ensuring essential medicines, ventilators and oxygen support. Civil Surgeon Dr. Rashmi Vij urged residents not to panic and to follow guidelines. Officials will identify symptomatic patients early and arrange timely referral and treatment. Swine flu spreads via respiratory droplets; common symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, headache, body ache and laboured breathing. Preventive advice includes regular handwashing and masking during cough/cold periods. Ongoing outbreak response in Amritsar district emphasizes hospital readiness and surveillance measures.

triage.headline_ja: アムリトサルで15人が豚インフルエンザ陽性
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1の局地的増加であり、既知の疾患で公的な対応（隔離病棟設置・監視強化）も取られているが、今後の拡大有無を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既知の疾患であり、パンジャブ州アムリトサル地区での局地的な症例増加。地元保健当局が病床確保・監視強化で対応中。重症度や死亡者数の情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Scientists discover new tick-borne virus in China
article.articleSummary: China researchers from the Beijing State Key Laboratory of Pathogen and Biosecurity identify a new tick-borne orthonairovirus, Asian longhorned tick nairovirus (ALTNV). Discovered during investigation of Dabie bandavirus (DBV)–related tick-borne fever; confirmed by RNA sequencing and viral isolation; report published in the New England Journal of Medicine. In 3,163 hospitalized tick-bitten patients, ALTNV was detected in 10.4% (and 15.1% among DBV-negative patients). ALTNV presents with fever, fatigue, gastrointestinal symptoms, and abnormal labs; fatigue reported in 84%, GI symptoms in 80%, and 36% had elevated aminotransferases. DBV coinfection correlates with higher respiratory symptoms (61% vs 38%) and kidney impairment (84% vs 66%); seven coinfected patients died (18.4%). ALTNV RNA was found in about 47,428 ticks (1.3%) across 15 provinces. All ALTNV-positive patients recovered. DBV has a 10-30% case-fatality and is a WHO research priority.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で新種のマダニ媒介ウイルスを発見
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新規のダニ媒介性オルソナイロウイルス（ALTNV）がNEJMに報告され、既知のDBVとの混合感染で死亡例（18.4%）が見られるなど、新規病原体としての公衆衛生上の懸念があるため、フルRRAでの評価が望ましい。
triage.notes: ALTNV単独感染は全例回復しているが、DBV（既知のダニ媒介ウイルスで致死率10-30%）との混合感染例で死亡が報告されている。15省でダニからウイルスRNAが検出されており、地理的分布は広範。新規病原体として今後の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Inauguration mardi du centre de traitement Ebola à Kisangani - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuesday inauguration of the Ebola treatment center in Kisangani - ACP
article.articleSummary: An Ebola Treatment Center (ETC) in Kisangani, capital of Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, is scheduled to be inaugurated on Tuesday, 8 September 2026, after completion in record time funded by donors. The facility, located in the Plateau Medical neighborhood in Makiso commune, was visited by members of the risk communication for community engagement (CREC) who confirmed the construction is finished. Donatien Kalonji stated details would be provided at the inauguration ceremony. The article notes the ceremony will be held with provincial authorities leading the event. The development marks a key addition to Ebola response infrastructure in northeastern DRC, though no outbreak specifics or case counts are provided.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニでエボラ治療センターが火曜日に開設 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱に関する治療施設の新設であり、疾患自体の重篤性とドナー支援・行政関与が確認されるため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ治療センターの開設に関する内容であり、具体的な症例数やアウトブレイクの詳細は記載されていない。ただしエボラという疾患特性上、対応体制強化の背景に実際の発生・警戒があると推測されるため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kisangani : les personnes sourdes sensibilisées aux mesures de prévention contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kisangani: Deaf people informed about Ebola prevention measures - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 7 September 2026 in Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, deaf people were informed about Ebola prevention by the National Network of Sign Language Interpreters and Communicators in collaboration with the Red Cross. Gilbert Kazingufu, provincial president of the network, noted that while hearing individuals have been reached, deaf audiences had not, and urged partner support to avoid discrimination; interpreters are best placed to educate the deaf as their mouth and ears. Dr Le Blanc Monzepa, Red Cross Ebola response base lead in Kisangani, reviewed Ebola symptoms, transmission, and protection. Community engagement expert Bienvenue Bamfumu addressed rumors and misinformation fueling resistance to awareness efforts. The session allowed deaf participants to raise concerns, with responses provided on the spot or escalated to the appropriate authorities.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニ:聴覚障害者にエボラ予防対策について啓発活動 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 既存のエボラ対応活動に関する啓発報道であり新規感染や症例急増の情報はないが、エボラという重篤疾患の継続的対応地域であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ対応枠組み内での啓発活動報告であり、新規症例数や流行状況についての具体的情報は含まれていない。DRCにおける継続的なエボラ対応の一環として経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Philippines: Manila declares leptospirosis epidemic
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis outbreak in Manila has reached the epidemic threshold, with attack rate rising from 1.27% last week to 3.48% as of 2026-09-07. Manila City Mayor Francisco Isko Moreno Domagoso announced the shift to an epidemic, with hospital capacity strained at Manila General Hospital, Sta. Ana Hospital, and Justice Jose Abad Santos General Hospital due to sustained patient influx. In response, the Manila Health Department and city agencies intensified the campaign, including an aggressive public-information drive and free doxycycline capsules available at 44 health centers and 7 district hospitals under the Manila Government. The MHD and 896 barangays have mobilized to reach people affected by last week's flood, distributing doxycycline to those in need.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン:マニラでレプトスピラ症の流行を宣言
triage.triage_reason: マニラで洪水後のレプトスピラ症流行が閾値を超え、病院の収容能力が逼迫、市当局が流行を宣言し対応を強化しているため、WPRO基準複数該当かつ社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症流行はフィリピンで季節的に発生するパターンだが、今回は攻撃率が急上昇し病院の収容能力が逼迫している点で公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。国際的拡大の可能性は低いが、続報でのモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Haut-Uélé : 253 cas confirmés dont 129 décès et 57 guéris - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Upper Uele: 253 confirmed cases, including 129 deaths and 57 recoveries - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in Haut-Uélé, Northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, as of 6 September 2026, totals 253 confirmed cases, 129 deaths, and 57 recoveries. Six of Haut-Uélé’s 13 health zones are affected: Isiro (90 cases, 41 deaths), Wamba (83 cases, 50 deaths), Pawa (46 cases, 24 deaths), Boma (30 cases, 12 deaths), Rungu (2 cases, 1 death), and Gombari (2 cases, 1 death). Some patients originate from PK51 in Nya-Nya zone, arriving in critical condition. Transmission shows uneven progression: Gombari has 17 days without new cases; Rungu 4 days; Isiro 1 day; Boma 3 days; while Wamba and Pawa still reported new cases prior to the briefing. Lethality is about 51%, linked to delays in notification and initial care. Authorities urge rapid reporting of suspected cases, timely care, and youth engagement in the response.

triage.headline_ja: オートウエレ州でのエボラ出血熱：確定症例253例、うち死亡129例、回復57例
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的アウトブレイクで致死率約51%、複数保健地域に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 6つの保健地域（Isiro, Wamba, Pawa, Boma, Rungu, Gombari）に拡大しており、地域ごとに新規症例の発生状況が異なる。致死率51%は通報・初期治療の遅れが要因とされる。国境を越えた拡大の有無や渡航制限の情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : une formation à grande échelle nécessaire pour renforcer les relais communautaires - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Large-scale training is necessary to strengthen community relays - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola remains in Ituri province, North-East Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompting a push for large-scale training to empower religious and community actors as effective population relays for prevention. Mgr Wilfried Banga of the Africa Inland Church in Bunia advocates expanding training beyond a limited group to reach more religious and community leaders who can disseminate prevention messages within their networks, citing ongoing ignorance and the persistent health threat. Religious leaders are seen as key mobilizers capable of broadening outreach through regular church and community presence. Emphasis is placed on continuing preventive measures: thermoflash temperature checks, regular handwashing, physical distancing, and avoiding close greetings and large gatherings. Sensitization should persist as long as the threat endures, with active participation from churches and community structures. Partners are encouraged to sustain support for training to extend reach to more people.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州でのエボラ出血熱：コミュニティ・リレーの強化に大規模な研修が必要 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCイツリ州で依然として継続しており、地域社会への感染拡大防止のための研修拡大が求められている。重症度が高く、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があり、外部支援の必要性も示唆されているためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラ流行が継続中であり、新規発生ではないが、地域社会への教育・予防体制強化の必要性が指摘されている。続報でケース数や地理的拡大の有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: En Tucumán se registra predominio de rinovirus y virus sincicial respiratorio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Tucumán, Rhinovirus and Respiratory Syncytial Virus predominate.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-07, Tucumán reports predominance of rhinovirus and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) in respiratory illnesses; a slight uptick in reported influenza is noted nationally, while bronchiolitis consultations remain within expected levels in the province. A national alert notes two confirmed dengue cases in Buenos Aires residents with travel history to Brazil; five probable chikungunya cases in Salta. Tucumán currently has no locally acquired dengue or chikungunya this season. Preventive focus includes measles and rubella vaccination for children and adults per current guidelines, amid sustained measles activity in the Americas. Tucumán faces a bronchiolitis plateau, with a small rebound linked to lower temperatures; recommendations include hand hygiene, masking when appropriate, and avoiding crowded, poorly ventilated spaces around newborns. The health ministry reiterates vaccine availability for influenza and provides oseltamivir through public facilities, with hospital access for private patients. Ongoing surveillance and prevention actions are maintained.

triage.headline_ja: トゥクマン州でライノウイルスとRSウイルスが優勢に
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンでの季節性呼吸器感染症の通常の疫学報告であり、対象国（対象国リストにアルゼンチンなし）にも該当せず、深刻性・異常性も認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチン（トゥクマン州、ブエノスアイレス、サルタ州）での季節性呼吸器感染症・デング・チクングニアの状況報告。ブラジルへの渡航歴のあるデング症例言及があるが、発生自体はアルゼンチンであり、対象国リストにアルゼンチンは含まれないため verified_locations は空。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : la protection individuelle contre l'épidémie, un facteur majeur pour sécuriser la communauté(Un notable) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Personal protection against the epidemic, a major factor in safeguarding the community (A notable) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Isiro, North-East Democratic Republic of Congo (Haut-Uele), 7 September 2026: A Haut-Uele notable stresses personal protection against Ebola as a key safeguard for the community. Baltazar Anga urges individual responsibility and strict adherence to preventive measures, including not touching corpses, and calls youths to abandon risky habits. He emphasizes Ebola as a form of sanitary insecurity for families and urges respect for state health rules. Amid armed robberies and ADF incursions, he advocates strengthened collaboration among provincial authorities, security services, and residents to restore peace. He also condemns rogue soldiers and stresses unity to defeat both the Ebola epidemic and the rising insecurity threatening daily life in Isiro.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：感染症に対する個人防護がコミュニティの安全確保の重要な要素（有力者談）－ ACP通信
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（Haut-Uele州Isiro）で進行中とみられるエボラ出血熱について、地域有力者が個人防護と行政協力を呼びかける記事であり、治安悪化（武装強盗・ADFの侵入）が対応をさらに困難にしている点から、重篤な感染症×社会不安の複合リスクとしてフルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: 記事は感染拡大の新規性を示すものではなく、既存のエボラ流行下での啓発・治安関連の続報。感染者数・死亡者数など定量的情報が本文になく、詳細はフルRRAで確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nord-kivu:deux nouveaux guerris quittent le CTE à beni - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in North Kivu: two new recoveries leave the ETC in Beni - ACP
article.articleSummary: Two new Ebola virus disease (EVD) survivors were discharged from the Ebola Treatment Center at Beni General Hospital in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, on 7 September 2026. The two patients—one a healthcare worker—completed holistic care and will serve as community ambassadors to educate on EVD care and to dispel rumors about treatment at the ETC. Dr. Jérémie Katsavara praised the care teams and emphasized that survivor testimonies will bolster community trust. Dr. Ruffin Matofali of the International Medical Corps, a government partner, thanked all participants in the response. The discharged patients received dignity kits and recovery certificates. A nurse recounted contracting Ebola after treating a dying child, later recovering at the ETC, illustrating ongoing risks to frontline workers amid the region’s Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州のエボラ:ベニのETCから新たに2名の回復者が退所 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州で進行中のエボラ対応に関する続報（回復者退所）であり、新規発生や地理的拡大を示す情報はないが、ヒト-ヒト感染や医療従事者感染など継続的リスクがあるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は既知のエボラ流行対応における回復者退所の続報であり、新規シグナルというよりは既存アウトブレイクの進捗報告。国際医療支援団体(International Medical Corps)が関与しており、対応が継続中であることを示す。医療従事者への感染例が言及されており、感染拡大リスクは残存。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in the Philippines: Increasing trend reported in more than 100 cities
article.articleSummary: Dengue in the Philippines shows an increasing trend across more than 100 cities. From Jan 1 to Aug 29, 2026, 128,634 dengue cases were reported, a 39% decrease from 209,631 in the same period last year. Of these, 48,132 (37%) were laboratory-confirmed, 16,874 (13%) probable, and 63,628 (49%) suspected. Epidemic thresholds were breached at least twice in August in Ilocos Norte (Region I), Aurora (Region III), Albay, Camarines Sur, Camarines Norte, Catanduanes (Region V), Bohol and City of Lapu-Lapu (Region VII), Zamboanga Sibugay and Zamboanga City (Region IX), South Cotabato (Region XII), Basilan, Sulu, BARMM, Abra (CAR), and Agusan del Sur (Caraga). Clustering occurred in 2,760 barangays nationwide, with Region III (299 clusters, 11%), Region VII (277, 10%), and Region I (257, 9%) reporting the most. Total deaths: 510 (CFR 0.04%).

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンのデング熱：100以上の都市で増加傾向が報告
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンの毎年発生する風土病的デング熱の定期サーベイランス報告であり、前年同期比では39%減少しているものの、複数地域で流行閾値を超過しクラスターが発生しているため、地域拡大の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: CFRは0.04%と低く、前年比では症例数は減少しているため『増加傾向』という見出しは一部地域での流行閾値超過を指すものと考えられる。フィリピンは毎年デング熱が流行する国であり、既存の保健当局の対応体制内での事象と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: New Tick Virus Described in China Is Carried by a Species Already Established in 21 US States
article.articleSummary: ALTNV, a newly described Asian longhorned tick nairovirus, causes a flu-like illness and is carried by Haemaphysalis longicornis (Asian longhorned tick), now established in 21 US states and Washington, DC. In China, ALTNV was identified in 10.4% of 3,163 patients tested (RNA or antibodies); among Dabie bandavirus–negative patients, 15.1% were ALTNV-positive. Illness from ALTNV alone is typically non-severe: fatigue 84%, gastrointestinal symptoms 80%, thrombocytopenia 38%, elevated liver enzymes 36%, with complete recovery. Coinfection with Dabie bandavirus worsens disease (respiratory symptoms 61% vs 38%; kidney impairment 84% vs 66%), and 7 of 38 coinfected patients died. The Asian longhorned tick was first confirmed in New Jersey in 2017; US detections now span 21 states and DC. ALTNV RNA was found in 1.3% of 47,428 ticks across 15 Chinese provinces, highest in Asian longhorned ticks (1.8%); lab work shows ticks can transmit ALTNV to mice. No human US cases or surveillance/tests exist yet; general tick-bite precautions apply as of 2026-09-07.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で新たに報告されたダニ媒介ウイルス、米国21州に既に定着している種によって媒介される
triage.triage_reason: 新規に記載されたダニ媒介ウイルス（ALTNV）であり中国で一定の感染率が確認されているが、米国では媒介ダニは定着済みでも人での感染例は未確認であり、情報が限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 米国は媒介ダニ（Haemaphysalis longicornis）の生息域拡大が報告されているのみで、ヒト感染例は未確認のため対象国リストの米国は含まれず（そもそも対象国リストにも米国は無い）。中国での患者データ（10.4%陽性）が主要な発生地情報。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola/Nord-Kivu : deux patients guéris quittent le centre de traitement de Beni | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola/North Kivu: two recovered patients leave the Beni treatment center | mediacongo.net.
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola patients recovered and were discharged from the Ebola Treatment Center at Beni General Reference Hospital in North Kivu, as the outbreak continues in the province. One recovered patient is a nurse who contracted Ebola after caring for a child who died from the disease; he spent about ten days in care, then seven days in quarantine before transfer from Bundji Health Center to Beni, and has returned to his community. Dr. Rufin Mbusa, site chief, highlighted the value of rapid care. As of 4 September 2026, North Kivu reported 969 confirmed cases and 638 deaths (case fatality 65.8%), with 20–32 new cases daily since 31 August, signaling persistent community transmission. The outbreak spans 16 of 34 health zones: Katwa 440/286, Butembo 197/138, and Beni 157/115. Nationally, the Democratic Republic of the Congo recorded 6,522 confirmed cases and 3,134 deaths as of 4 September. Preventive measures are urged, and all contacts with infected individuals should be reported.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ／北キブ州：回復した患者2名がベニ治療センターを退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC北キブ州で継続的な地域感染を示し、致死率65.8%・確認例969件と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 既知の進行中エボラアウトブレイクの継続報告。国内感染は継続中で、新規症例が日々20〜32件発生しており、国際的拡大リスクを含めた継続監視・支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: குழந்தைகளுக்கு கை, பாதம், முகத் தொற்று அதிகரிப்பு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increase in Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease Among Children
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease is rising among children in Tamil Nadu, India. The illness is caused by Coxsackievirus A16; Enterovirus 71 can cause more severe disease. The current outbreak is mild, mainly affecting children under 5. Symptoms include fever, sore throat, mouth and tongue ulcers, and blisters or red patches on the hands, feet, and trunk; dehydration, vomiting, diarrhea, headaches, and loss of appetite may occur. It spreads easily between children via saliva, respiratory droplets, and contaminated fluids. Most children recover within about a week. Prevention tips include keeping affected children home for a week and cleaning the school if a case is identified; hygiene measures such as wiping children with water twice daily are advised. No cause for undue alarm.aution-backed awareness and basic hygiene are encouraged.

triage.headline_ja: 子供たちの間で手足口病感染が増加
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病はインドの子供たちの間で流行しているが、記事自体が軽症で過度の心配は不要としており、重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。小児の間で感染しやすいため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は軽症例が中心で、地域の学校での衛生対策等の基本的な予防策が紹介されているのみ。重症例やアウトブレイクの規模拡大を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: M'laya's pig trade faces ASF question
article.articleSummary: ASF outbreaks in Meghalaya, India, are examined in a Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology study covering July 2020–April 2025, with 115 outbreak events affecting 1,603 pigs in seven districts and direct losses around Rs 2.74 crore. Ri Bhoi and East Khasi Hills reported the most outbreaks; both districts are key pig-movement corridors. Meghalaya imports live pigs from Assam, Haryana, Punjab, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, and Mizoram to meet demand. Movement of animals, people and vehicles, notably via NH-6 to Assam, is cited as a potential spread factor. The study does not prove imported pigs caused outbreaks, and the first outbreak’s source remains unknown, but calls for enhanced surveillance, entry-point testing, quarantine, and stronger biosecurity in movement hubs. ASF does not infect humans but threatens livelihoods and pork availability; better checks are needed to trace sources and prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: メガラヤ州の養豚業がASF(アフリカ豚熱)の課題に直面
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインド・メガラヤ州における過去(2020年7月～2025年4月)のASF発生に関する学術研究のレビューであり、新規の急性アウトブレイクではない。ASFはヒトに感染しないため公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは低い。
triage.notes: ASF(アフリカ豚熱)はヒトに感染しない動物疾患であり、本記事は過去の発生データを分析した学術研究の紹介記事。畜産・経済への影響はあるが公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: 女孩穿上新鞋，突然高烧39℃不退，送医发现全身感染！这个习惯很多人都有
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A girl puts on new shoes, suddenly develops a persistent fever of 39°C; she is taken to hospital and found to have a systemic infection! This is a habit many people have.
article.articleSummary: In Zhejiang, China, a pediatric patient (alias Xiaohua) at Zhuji City People’s Hospital in early 2026 presented with two days of fever (39.3°C) and leukocytosis. Initial symptoms were fever and mild cough; a crucial clue appeared when clinicians found a bandage over the left heel from a new-shoe blister, not changed for several days. Wound inspection revealed a developing abscess under the adhesive; after incision and drainage, the fever subsided that afternoon. Bacterial culture identified methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) as the pathogen, explaining progression to a systemic infection. MRSA is common in children and can enter via skin wounds, especially when bandages are used in closed, damp environments. The case highlights rapid pediatric infection progression and the need for careful wound care. The article also dispels four band-aid misconceptions and outlines proper use: cleaning, appropriate size, correct placement, daily changes, and safe removal.

triage.headline_ja: 女の子が新しい靴を履いたところ、突然39℃の高熱が続き、病院で全身感染と判明！多くの人にあるこの習慣とは
triage.triage_reason: 単一の小児患者における局所創傷からのMRSA感染事例であり、公衆衛生上の重大性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクはいずれも認められない。健康啓発記事の性格が強い。
triage.notes: 個別症例報告であり、健康教育・創傷ケア啓発を目的とした記事。公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 手足口病进入高发期 孩子出现这些症状家长别忽视
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease Enters Peak Season; Parents Should Not Ignore These Symptoms in Children.
article.articleSummary: HFMD peaks in autumn in China; parents should not overlook symptoms in children. Caused by enteric viruses, HFMD is highly transmissible through three routes: fecal-oral via infected stool contaminating hands, objects or food; direct contact with saliva, vesicle fluid, or skin lesions; and respiratory droplets in closed, crowded settings. Four core prevention measures: 1) frequent handwashing with running water for at least 20 seconds; 2) ventilation and environmental disinfection—boil utensils, wipe surfaces with chlorine disinfectants, sun-dry fabrics, and avoid relying on alcohol-based disinfectants for enteroviruses; 3) keep sick children at home; schools should conduct health checks and exclude until recovery; 4) vaccination—EV-A71 inactivated vaccine reduces severe HFMD caused by EV-A71; recommended for children 6 months to 5 years, but does not cover all enterovirus serotypes. Common myths addressed: rash-only disease, lifelong immunity after one infection, and that mild cases require no medical care.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病がピークシーズンに突入、子どもに現れるこれらの症状を保護者は見逃さないで
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のHFMD流行に関する一般的な予防啓発記事であり、異常な増加や重症事例の急増等の具体的なアウトブレイク情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 毎年秋に発生する季節性HFMDに関する予防啓発記事で、特定の異常なアウトブレイクや死亡増加の報告はない。中国国内の一般啓発情報のため対象国リストに該当するが、シグナルとしての重要性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Số ca sốt xuất huyết ở Đắk Lắk tăng hơn 200%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of dengue fever cases in Dak Lak increases by more than 200%.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Dak Lak Province, Vietnam, surged in August with 1,339 cases, up 207% from July, bringing the year-to-date total to 5,700 cases and 252 outbreaks (88 active). By Sept 6, 60 new infections were recorded that day. Five localities are classified as very high risk: Cư M'gar Commune, Ea Tul Commune, Buôn Ma Thuột Ward, Hòa Phú Commune, and Tân Lập Ward; additional high-risk areas include Ea Drăng, Ea Súp, Ea Na, Krông Pắk, Ea Kao, Ea Ktul, and Sông Hinh Communes. A 31-year-old with severe dengue developed splenic rupture with intra-abdominal bleeding, requiring emergency splenectomy and transfusion (13 units of red cells, 5 units of FFP). Splenic rupture is rare but dangerous in dengue, potentially causing thrombocytopenia and multi-organ hemorrhage. Health authorities will intensify outbreak surveillance and control, and urge communities to eliminate mosquitoes and larval habitats and cooperate with authorities during interventions.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク省のデング熱患者数が200%以上増加
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数が前月比207%増加し、重症例（脾臓破裂）も発生しており、IHR基準の重大性・異常性の2項目に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱は蚊媒介性のため国際的な直接拡大リスクは低いが、症例急増と重症例発生により地域内公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。SFTSウイルスへの言及はタグに含まれるが記事本文には記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: PMC News: "डास मारा, साथरोग रोखा!" डेंग्यू, मलेरियाचा धोका रोखण्यासाठी महापालिका सतर्क; क्षेत्रीय कार्यालयांना निर्देश
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PMC News: "Kill mosquitoes, stop comorbidity!" To curb the threat of dengue and malaria, the municipality remains vigilant; directives to regional offices.
article.articleSummary: Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) Health Department has intensified measures to curb dengue and malaria in Pune during the monsoon. Actions include identifying mosquito breeding sites, conducting fogging, and regular surveys, with risk areas flagged for preventive measures. To strengthen control, each regional office will receive a dedicated tempo for fogging; contracted manpower is being boosted during the monsoon, including staffing for newly added villages. Coordination across departments—anti-encroachment, solid waste, sewerage, and building—and with private and other government entities, has been stressed. Regional offices must maintain stocks of larvicides. Dr. Rajendra Dighe, Assistant Health Officer, PMC, emphasizes these preparations to keep dengue and malaria in check through the monsoon.

triage.headline_ja: PMCニュース：「蚊を駆除し、感染症を防げ！」デング熱・マラリアのリスクを抑えるため市当局が警戒態勢、地域事務所へ指示
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング・マラリア予防対策に関する行政上の通常発表であり、異常な流行や重症例の報告はなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認されない。
triage.notes: モンスーン期における蚊媒介感染症の恒例的な予防措置報道。具体的な症例数や死亡者数の報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot Yogyakarta Siapkan 3.000 Vaksin Rabies Gratis untuk Hewan Peliharaan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Yogyakarta City Government Prepares 3,000 Free Rabies Vaccines for Pets.
article.articleSummary: Yogyakarta City Government is preparing 3,000 free rabies vaccine doses for pets during September 2026 to prevent rabies transmission and maintain the city’s rabies-free status. City Department of Agriculture and Food Service staff vaccinated pets in Mantrijeron, Yogyakarta, on Monday, 7 September 2026. The program targets animals capable of transmitting rabies, notably cats, dogs, and monkeys, with pet owners able to access the free vaccination service during the program. The initiative aims to increase vaccination coverage and protect public health by reducing the risk of rabies. Officials emphasize continuing routine vaccination to sustain a rabies-free condition in the area. The effort reflects ongoing preventive measures to safeguard both animal and human health within Yogyakarta City.

triage.headline_ja: ジョグジャカルタ市政府、ペット用に無料狂犬病ワクチン3,000回分を準備
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病フリー状態を維持するための予防的な定期ワクチン接種活動であり、異常な発生や人的症例の報告はない。
triage.notes: 予防的な動物向けワクチン接種プログラムの通常広報であり、感染症の異常発生を示す情報はない。地域は対象国インドネシアだが、記事内容がルーチンの公衆衛生活動のためDISMISS判定。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة وفيات "إيبولا" بالكونغو إلى 3226 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 3,226.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa reports that Ebola has caused 3,226 deaths and 6,686 infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with totals confirmed as of September 6, per a September 8 statement from the Ministry of Information on X. The outbreak persists in a region long affected by armed conflict, alongside substantial humanitarian needs. The United Nations had urged on August 21 for additional resources to help curb Ebola. The report references confirmed infections and deaths but provides no details on recovered cases, transmission settings, laboratory confirmation methods, or any imported or exported cases. The figures underscore the severity of the outbreak amid ongoing instability in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱による死者数が3,226人に上昇
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による死者3,226人・感染6,686人という大規模な流行が継続しており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性）を2つ満たし、WPRO基準も複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事は死亡・感染数のみを報告しており、回復例、感染経路、検査方法、越境事例等の詳細情報は不明。国連が8月21日に追加資源支援を要請している点から国際支援の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة وفيات إيبولا بالكونغو إلى 3226 حالة - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in Ebola death toll in Congo to 3,226 cases - Ardu Point
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, 8 September 2026 — The Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 6,686 confirmed infections and 3,226 deaths, with figures up to 6 September as per a government post. The outbreak continues in a region long plagued by armed conflict, highlighting significant humanitarian needs. On 21 August, the United Nations warned of an urgent need for additional resources to control Ebola. The report underscores the gravity of the crisis and challenges in outbreak response amid insecurity and limited resources. The notice does not provide information on symptoms, laboratory confirmation methods, or infection sources. The numbers indicate a protracted crisis requiring intensified international support and sustained efforts to curb transmission and reduce mortality.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ死者数が3,226人に上昇 - アルドゥポイント
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（感染6,686例、死亡3,226例）が継続しており、治安不安の中で国際的な追加支援が求められているため、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 国連が8月21日に追加資源の緊急必要性を警告しており、武力紛争が続く地域でのアウトブレイク対応の困難さが強調されている。症状、検査方法、感染源についての情報は記事に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Death Toll From Ebola Virus In DRC Rises To 3,226
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains severe, with 6,686 confirmed cases and 3,226 deaths as of 6 September 2026, per the Congolese Ministry of Communication and Media. The dateline from Kinshasa accompanies the figures. The data indicate ongoing, exponential growth of the epidemic, triggering international concern. On 21 August 2026, United Nations senior responders issued an urgent appeal for immediate international resources to contain the outbreak in Congo. The report emphasizes the rising toll and case counts but provides no further details on transmission routes or laboratory confirmation beyond confirmed cases. Urgent international resources are sought to bolster the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラウイルスの死者数が3,226人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で死者数・症例数が急増しており、国連が国際支援を要請するなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 感染経路や検査確認の詳細は記事内で不明。症例数・死者数の急増と国連の緊急支援要請が明記されており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội ghi nhận 207 ca sốt xuất huyết trong một tuần
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi records 207 dengue fever cases in one week
article.articleSummary: During Aug 28–Sep 4, 2026, Hanoi recorded 207 dengue fever cases across 65 wards, down 61 from the previous week. Year-to-date dengue totals reached 2,382 cases in 117 wards with no deaths, and remain below the 2021–2025 average by 958 and below the same period in 2023. The city reported 11 new dengue clusters this week; since January there have been 106 clusters, with 26 still active. For hand, foot, and mouth disease, Hanoi reported 106 cases in 57 wards (down 9 week-on-week), mostly sporadic; cumulative 4,936 cases with no deaths; one community outbreak in Phú Nghĩa; 73 outbreaks this year, with 1 active. Measles: 1 case in Phú Thượng; cumulative 393; no deaths. COVID-19: 12 cases in 9 wards; cumulative 1,589; no deaths. Public health actions include enhanced surveillance, rapid case finding, outbreak containment, vaccination promotion, environmental hygiene, and coordination with animal health sectors.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイ、1週間でデング熱207例を記録
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・麻疹・COVID-19ともに例年並みまたは減少傾向にあり、死亡例もなく通常のサーベイランス報告の範囲内であるため。
triage.notes: デング熱症例数は前年同期比・過去5年平均比で減少傾向。麻疹・COVID-19も散発的で死亡例なし。定例のサーベイランス報告と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Batam Haze Alert: Respiratory Infections Rise 19.5% as Smoke Clouds City - Best Breaking News and Beyond: Singapore, Batam and some say JB
article.articleSummary: Batam reports a 19.5% rise in acute respiratory infection (ARI) cases in August 2026, totaling 7,245, up from 6,061 in July (increase of 1,184). Hazy conditions appeared across Batam in early September, with suspected links to forest and land fires in Indonesia, though authorities have not confirmed a direct cause. The Batam Health Office is coordinating with the Environmental Agency and a public health laboratory, awaiting updated Air Pollution Standard Index data. Vulnerable groups—children, the elderly, pregnant women, and individuals with asthma—face higher risks from smoke exposure, with symptoms including coughing, shortness of breath, throat irritation, irritated eyes or nose, and headaches. Residents are advised to reduce outdoor activity, wear effective masks outdoors, monitor air quality, and seek medical care for respiratory symptoms. Authorities continue surveillance and public education as hazy conditions develop and monitoring remains ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: バタム島でヘイズ警報:煙霧が街を覆う中、呼吸器感染症が19.5%増加
triage.triage_reason: 呼吸器感染症の増加は煙霧（森林・泥炭火災由来とみられる大気汚染）との関連が疑われる環境要因であり、感染性疾患のヒト-ヒト感染リスクは低いが、継続的な曝露と症例増加が見られるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本イベントは感染症というより煙霧（ヘイズ）による大気汚染が原因の急性呼吸器感染症（ARI）増加であり、病原体特定情報はなし。当局は原因究明中で、地域の大気質指数の更新を待っている状況。国際的な感染症拡大リスクは低いが、近隣国（シンガポール・マレーシア）への煙霧越境の可能性はある。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo reports 6,686 Ebola cases, 3,226 deaths
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's ongoing Ebola outbreak has reached 6,686 confirmed cases and 3,226 deaths, with 1,563 recoveries, according to the Ministry of Communication and Media via Qazinform News Agency. On its X account, the ministry says 819 patients are currently in isolation or hospitalized; case fatality rate is 48.3% and contact tracing is 85.3%. In the past 24 hours, 15 patients recovered; no new cases were reported in South Kivu, Tshopo or Bas-Uélé. Response is active in six provinces and 61 health zones, underscoring the geographic scale of the effort. Earlier reports indicated the country had begun vaccinating people against Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱6,686症例・3,226人死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.3%の大規模エボラ流行が6州61保健地区に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: 6州61保健地区での対応が継続中であり、致死率48.3%と非常に高い。ワクチン接種も開始されているが、依然として大規模な流行が続いている。

article.articleHeadline: देहरादून में स्वाइन फ्लू-कोविड और डेंगू के नए मरीज मिले, 336 पहुंची कुल संख्या; अलर्ट पर स्वास्थ्य विभाग - swine flu cases in dehradun 8 new patients and two covid 19 patients detected
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New swine flu, COVID-19 and dengue patients detected in Dehradun; total has reached 336; Health Department on alert.
article.articleSummary: As of September 7, 2026, Dehradun district reports multi-disease activity: Swine flu (H1N1), COVID-19, dengue, and chikungunya. H1N1 has 336 total cases; 8 new positives from 71 samples (4 in Dehradun, 4 from other districts) with 8 recoveries. Highest H1N1 incidence is in the 61–70 age group (58 cases); 185 men and 151 women affected. COVID-19 adds 2 new cases (1 Dehradun, 1 other district); 1 recovery. Dehradun’s total COVID-19 cases reach 43, with 4 active hospitalised and no deaths. Dengue reports 8 new cases (4 in Dehradun, 4 from other districts); 11 active cases and 8 recoveries; total dengue cases 138 with no deaths. Chikungunya stands at 4 cases, total 82. Dengue tests conducted: 804 in a day. Control efforts include 13,010 households surveyed, 71,515 containers checked, 274 with larvae.

triage.headline_ja: デヘラードゥーンで新たな豚インフルエンザ・COVID-19・デング熱患者を確認、累計336人に；保健当局が警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の複合感染症（H1N1、COVID-19、デング熱、チクングニア熱）の通常規模の推移報告であり、死亡例なし・重症度も限定的だが、地域での継続的な発生状況のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 死亡例なし、地域保健当局による通常の監視・対策（幼虫調査等）が継続中。複数疾患の季節的流行であり、現時点で異常性・重症度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: കേരളത്തില്‍ പനിബാധിതരുടെ എണ്ണം കുത്തനെ ഉയരുന്നു: ഇന്നലെ മാത്രം ചികിത്സ തേടിയത് പതിനായിരത്തിലേറെ പേര്‍ | news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Number of fever patients in Kerala rising sharply: More than ten thousand people sought treatment just yesterday | news
article.articleSummary: 8 September 2026: Kerala reports a sharp rise in fever and vector-borne diseases. Yesterday, 10,943 people with fever sought care in government hospitals, Malappuram recording the highest at 2,496. In September, 73,679 patients have been treated so far. Beyond fever, dengue (31 confirmed yesterday) and chikungunya (12 confirmed yesterday) are spreading; this month dengue has reached 432 cases with one death. Districts reporting fever cases include Thiruvananthapuram 678, Kollam 388, Pathanamthitta 415, Alappuzha 518, Kottayam 235, Idukki 282, Ernakulam 890, Thrissur 1,036, Palakkad 965, Kozhikode 937, Wayanad 514, Kannur 732, Kasaragod 857. Higher temperatures and climate change are believed to boost mosquito populations. Health officials face criticism for sanitation and vector-control lapses; urgent containment measures are urged to curb breeding and transmission. Hepatitis A is also a concern in the state.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州で発熱患者数が急増：昨日だけで1万人以上が治療を受ける
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア・A型肝炎を含む媒介感染症の症例数が急増し死亡例も出ており、WPRO基準の複数該当と社会的関心の高まりが確認されるため。
triage.notes: ケララ州は毎年季節性のデング・チクングニア流行が見られる地域であり、異常性は低いが、今回は症例数・死亡例の増加と衛生管理への批判が報じられており、続報の経過観察及びリスク評価が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: [NNA] 콜레라와 AWD, 미얀마 양곤 및 각지에서 재유행 | 아주경제
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera and AWD: Reemergence in Yangon, Myanmar and elsewhere
article.articleSummary: Cholera and acute watery diarrhea (AWD) have reemerged in Yangon, Myanmar, and neighboring regions, according to the UN Health Cluster led by the WHO. As of Aug 31, 2026, cases are reported in Yangon and across western Rakhine’s Sittwe, eastern Mon, and central Ayeyarwady, echoing 2024 outbreaks. In Yangon, 750+ cholera/AWD cases were documented from Aug 1–22, with more than 300 severe; by Aug 18, about 500 hospitalizations and roughly 150 cholera positives, with at least one death. Sittwe recorded over 150 cases, about half severe, and four deaths. Mon State has four cases, two recently visiting AWD areas in Yangon. Flooding affects Sagaing (16 townships), Magway (four), Ayeyarwady (three), with AWD emerging in these flood-impacted zones, affecting 470,000+ people. Malaria and dengue are rising; shortages of bed nets and other supplies are reported in eastern Kayah, southern Tanintharyi, northern Kachin, western Chin, and Sagaing.

triage.headline_ja: コレラとAWD、ミャンマー・ヤンゴンおよび各地で再流行
triage.triage_reason: ミャンマー複数州でコレラ/AWDが再流行し、重症例・死亡例が多数報告され、洪水被害地域で47万人以上に影響が及んでいるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Back-to-School Season: Be Alert to the Risks of Three Categories of Infectious Diseases
article.articleSummary: On September 8, 2026, Fujian Province's health authorities warn that the back-to-school period heightens risk of three infectious disease categories in campuses across Fujian, China: vector-borne diseases, respiratory infections, and enteric/foodborne illnesses. Vector-borne threats include dengue fever and chikungunya transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes; hemorrhagic fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome from ticks; and scrub typhus from chigger mites, presenting fever, rash, myalgia, and a characteristic black eschar. Respiratory infections such as influenza and COVID-19 can spread in crowded schools, with fever, cough, throat pain, and fatigue. Enteric diseases include norovirus, hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD), and bacterial foodborne illnesses, driven by warm, wet Septembers, causing vomiting, abdominal pain, and diarrhea. Four protective barriers: vector control (eliminate standing water, wear protective clothing, use repellents); food safety (handwashing, separate raw/cooked, proper storage and reheating); environmental hygiene (disinfection and daily ventilation); and health management (sleep, nutrition, vaccination, and prompt medical care/reporting exposure).

article.articleHeadline: 陸男淋巴結腫大疑結核　醫師追問「接觸過貓嗎」揪出真正病因
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mainland Chinese man with enlarged lymph nodes suspected of tuberculosis; doctor asks, "Have you had contact with cats?" to identify the real cause.
article.articleSummary: A 43-year-old man from Henan province presented with progressive neck lymphadenopathy. Pathology showed granulomas and two TB-related tests (PPD and T-SPOT) were positive, initially leading clinicians to suspect tuberculous lymphadenitis. In Wuhan, clinicians reviewed exposure history and asked about contact with cats, especially wild cats. After genetic testing, the diagnosis was Bartonella henselae infection, known as cat scratch disease, not tuberculous lymphadenitis. Following symptomatic treatment, the wound and enlarged nodes gradually improved. Cat scratch disease is transmitted among cats by fleas; humans can become infected after a cat scratch, bite, or licking of broken skin, and cats may be asymptomatic. Physicians emphasize including animal contact history in persistent lymphadenopathy with fever, with treatment decisions depending on symptom severity and whether other organs are involved.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Back-to-school season coincides with a high incidence of hand, foot, and mouth disease. How can it be prevented? The most effective method is this.
article.articleSummary: HFMD remains highly incident as students return to school in China; on Sept 8, 2026, the China CDC issued a health alert highlighting high incidence and urging transmission interruption. Beijing-based Capital Children’s Medical Center infectious-disease specialist Zhang Ning warns children aged 6 months to 5 years are most susceptible, advocating early full vaccination with the inactivated EV71 vaccine to prevent severe HFMD. HFMD is an enteric virus with high transmissibility, spreading via respiratory droplets, contact with blister fluid or contaminated objects, and fecal–oral routes. Symptoms include sore throat and a rash on hands, feet, and buttocks; infants may have painful swallowing, drooling, and poor appetite. There is no specific antiviral; management is supportive. Seek care for persistent high fever, lethargy, tremors, or rapid breathing. Vaccination, good hand/respiratory hygiene, and avoiding crowded, poorly ventilated places are key. The season also brings herpangina and mumps; EV71 reduces risk, and MMR helps prevent mumps.

article.articleHeadline: Bé trai 7 tuổi sốt, co giật không ngờ viêm não do Epstein-Barr Virus (EBV)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 7-year-old boy with fever and seizures unexpectedly develops encephalitis caused by Epstein-Barr Virus (EBV).
article.articleSummary: Seven-year-old boy, previously healthy, developed prolonged fever and seizures and was diagnosed with Epstein-Barr virus (EBV)–associated encephalitis. At Children’s Hospital No. 2, he presented with fever, epigastric pain, leukocytosis, and elevated liver enzymes, leading to admission on day 2 with broad-spectrum IV antibiotics for suspected bacterial infection. Fever persisted beyond seven days, followed by multiple generalized seizures and declining consciousness. Cerebrospinal fluid showed pleocytosis but initial tests did not identify a pathogen. Reassessment revealed small scattered cervical lymph nodes and prolonged fever; EBV infection was suspected. CSF PCR for EBV was positive, confirming EBV-related encephalitis. Antibiotics were discontinued; he received supportive care including measures for cerebral edema, seizure prevention, neurological complication management, nutrition, and electrolyte balance. After 15 days, mental status improved, seizures stopped, and he was discharged. EBV (HHV-4) is common, transmitted via saliva, with rare CNS complications; no vaccine or routine antiviral therapy; management is supportive.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guangdong Rotavirus Peak Season Approaching; Experts Urge First-Time Parents to Seize the Vaccination Window - Hong Kong Commercial Daily.
article.articleSummary: Rotavirus in Guangdong, China, is entering a prolonged autumn-winter peak season, with double peaks: a small peak in Oct-Nov and a peak from Dec to Feb, potentially extending to April. Officials urge first-time parents to vaccinate within a strict window of 6 to 32 weeks after birth, administering three oral doses. Rotavirus remains the leading cause of diarrhea in children under five; globally diarrhea is the second-leading cause of death in under-5, with about 35% of rotavirus diarrhea deaths. Transmission is fecal-oral, with possible respiratory droplets and close contact; R0 is second only to measles. There is no specific antiviral; management relies on rehydration and zinc. Four oral vaccines are available in China (one imported, three domestic). P[8] genotype is most associated with hospitalization. Emphasis on combining multiple vaccines to reduce clinic visits; vaccination should be prioritized due to climate-related risk increases in Guangdong.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 7 days, 500 new cases... Dengue heightens tension in West Bengal, Murshidabad most affected, prevention measures.
article.articleSummary: West Bengal reports a dengue surge, with more than 500 new cases in the past seven days and the season’s total exceeding 4,500, with Murshidabad and Kolkata worst affected. Murshidabad has over 870 cases, including 96 in recent days. From 770 cases by 30 April to about 1,946 by late July, and around 4,000 by August end, the rise prompted door‑to‑door surveys and intensified testing. Dengue begins with sudden high fever (102–104°F) and can include retro-orbital pain, bone and joint pain, severe headache, weakness, nausea, vomiting, and a rash. Do not self-medicate with antibiotics or NSAIDs; use only plain paracetamol and seek medical advice. The critical phase is days 3–5 after fever onset; warning signs include severe abdominal pain, repeated vomiting, bleeding, lethargy, breathing trouble, and very low urine output. Prevention focuses on eliminating stagnant water, covering tanks, long sleeves, repellents, nets, and hydration. Community involvement is essential.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AIDS is spreading despite awareness; 129 new patients; five deaths in three months; ongoing treatment in the district since 1976.
article.articleSummary: Bulandshahr district, Uttar Pradesh, sees rising HIV/AIDS cases despite awareness campaigns. Between April and July, 129 HIV-positive individuals were identified, with counseling and treatment started for all; five deaths occurred in this period. Over the past five years more than 40 people have died due to AIDS; a total of 1,976 AIDS patients have been treated in the district since 1976, about 1,500 of whom were infected through unsafe sex, including 920 women. HIV testing and free antiretroviral therapy have been available locally at Kalyan Singh Government Medical College since 2019, reducing the need to travel to Meerut for care. ARV nodal officer Dr. Hemant Rastogi notes women account for a larger share of infections, with transmission to women being comparatively more efficient through genital routes. Ongoing awareness camps and screening, along with counseling, are part of prevention, alongside programs like Ayushman Arogya Mela and TB screening campaigns.

The vaccine is already included in Brazil’s national program, and authorities expect it to help India address a high-demand, crowded urban setting.

article.articleHeadline: Un garçon de 7 ans traité avec succès d'encéphalite due au virus Epstein-Barr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 7-year-old boy successfully treated for encephalitis caused by the Epstein-Barr virus.
article.articleSummary: As of September 8, 2026, in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, a 7-year-old boy was successfully treated for encephalitis linked to Epstein-Barr virus (EBV). He was admitted with fever, epigastric pain, leukocytosis and elevated liver enzymes; initial management included IV broad-spectrum antibiotics. Fever persisted for over seven days, followed by multiple generalized seizures and progressive impaired consciousness. CSF analysis showed leukocytosis, but initial tests failed to identify a pathogen. Reassessment noted cervical lymphadenopathy and sustained symptoms, prompting consideration of EBV. PCR finally detected EBV in the CSF, providing strong evidence that EBV caused the encephalitis. Antibiotics were stopped, and he received supportive care targeting cerebral edema, seizure prevention, monitoring of neurological complications, and maintenance of nutrition and electrolytes. After 15 days, he regained consciousness, remained seizure-free, resumed eating, and was discharged stable.

triage.headline_ja: EBウイルスによる脳炎、7歳男児の治療に成功
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の治療成功例であり、EBウイルス脳炎は一般に流行性・国際的懸念を伴わない散発性疾患であるため、公衆衛生上の重大性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は単一の治療成功例に関する臨床報告であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生や国際的懸念は認められない。疾患名にClassical Swine Feverが含まれるが記事内容とは無関係。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: कानपुर में H1N1 का बढ़ा खतरा, एक मौत से हड़कंप, अस्पताल में बेड-वेंटिलेटर रिजर्व
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising H1N1 threat in Kanpur, panic after one death, hospital has beds and ventilators on standby.
article.articleSummary: H1N1 (swine flu) outbreak in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, with one death and multi-age infections. A 30-year-old Kannauj resident admitted Aug 28 with fever and abdominal pain at a private hospital in Kanpur died Sept 1; postmortem confirmed H1N1. Additional infections include a four-year-old child in Kanpur and a 53-year-old woman from Unnao. Hospitals have reserved beds: Hallett Hospital 30 beds; Ursla Hospital 15–20 beds; KPM and Kanshiram Hospitals 10 beds each; plus 5 beds at each of 10 community health centers. GSVM Medical College has dedicated testing and treatment arrangements, including ventilator-equipped wards with 10 adult and 10 pediatric beds. Medicines stock is adequate; Medicine Chest and Respiratory departments are on alert. Officials urge vigilance for fever, cough, or breathing difficulty and timely treatment, especially for children, the elderly, and severe cases. Continuous monitoring and readiness to scale resources are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: カンプールでH1N1の脅威拡大、1人死亡でパニック、病院がベッド・人工呼吸器を確保
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1（豚インフルエンザ）による地域限定的な発生で死亡1例・複数年齢層の感染が報告されているが、既知の病原体であり国際的拡大の兆候はない。地域内の医療対応は進んでいるため継続的な経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザの地域アウトブレイクであり、既知の病原体・パターン内。ウッタル・プラデーシュ州カンプール周辺での病床確保など地域内対応が進んでいるため、外部支援や国際的懸念には至っていない。

article.articleHeadline: Inovasi Rusia Kembangkan Alat Tes Diagnostik Ebola hingga Sumbangkan ke Kongo-Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia's innovations develop Ebola diagnostic test tools to donate to Kongo-Uganda
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-08, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 6,500 cases with over 3,000 deaths, according to government reports. Russia has developed and donated 7,000 Ebola diagnostic test kits to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda, both affected by the outbreak. The diagnostic tools were developed by the Central Research Institute of Epidemiology (CRIE) of Rospotrebnadzor, Russia's public health agency. The article highlights international support to bolster outbreak response, though it provides no details on symptom profiles or transmission chains. The aid aims to enhance laboratory capacity, improving case confirmation in the DRC and Uganda during ongoing transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの技術革新、エボラ診断検査キットを開発しコンゴ・ウガンダへ寄贈
triage.triage_reason: DRCで6,500例超・死亡3,000人超という深刻なエボラアウトブレイクが継続しており、国際的な支援が行われるなどIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアからDRC・ウガンダへの診断キット寄贈が主題だが、対象国リストにウガンダ・ロシアは含まれないためDRCのみを検証済み地域とした。DRCのアウトブレイク規模（6,500例超、死亡3,000人超）は極めて深刻であり、既存の進行中エボラ危機として引き続き注視・評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Concurrent Rasmussen aneurysm and pulmonary embolism in a patient with cavitary pulmonary tuberculosis
article.articleSummary: In Canada, a 68-year-old immigrant from the Philippines presented with cough, weight loss and intermittent hemoptysis. Sputum smear was acid-fast positive; MTB PCR was positive and cultures confirmed M. tuberculosis susceptible to first-line drugs. CT showed bilateral upper-lobe cavitations (5 cm left, 4.5 cm right) with tree-in-bud nodularity and right-upper-lobe pulmonary embolism, plus two ~5-mm Rasmussen aneurysms. TB therapy began with isoniazid, rifampin, pyrazinamide and ethambutol; rifampin was switched to rifabutin to permit anticoagulation with apixaban. LMWH was used; after 10 days, small-volume hemoptysis led to withholding anticoagulation and tranexamic acid; CT later showed near-resolution of the PE. Massive hemoptysis occurred; bronchoscopy supported Rasmussen aneurysm bleeding and was controlled with tranexamic acid without embolization or surgery. After 9 months of TB therapy, smear conversion occurred by 2 months and radiographs normalized by 9 months; post-treatment CT showed PE resolution with scarring/bronchiectasis and thrombosis of the feeding vessel upstream of the aneurysms. Contact tracing identified 25 exposed individuals.

triage.headline_ja: 空洞性肺結核患者におけるラスムッセン動脈瘤と肺塞栓症の合併例
triage.triage_reason: カナダでの単一症例報告（フィリピン出身移民患者の臨床経過）であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や集団発生を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核とラスムッセン動脈瘤・肺塞栓症合併に関する臨床症例報告（CMAJ掲載）。患者はフィリピン出身の移民だが発症・受診はカナダで、感染症の集団発生や公衆衛生上のシグナルではないため、対象国での発生事例に該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh nhi 7 tuổi mắc viêm não sau nhiều ngày sốt cao
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 7-year-old child develops encephalitis after several days of high fever.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-08 in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, a 7-year-old child was treated at Children’s Hospital 2 for encephalitis after several days of fever. Initial presentation included fever, epigastric pain, leukocytosis, and elevated liver enzymes; despite broad-spectrum IV antibiotics, fever persisted for over 7 days, with generalized seizures and deteriorating consciousness. CSF analysis showed pleocytosis, but no pathogen was initially identified. Reassessment revealed cervical lymphadenopathy and prolonged fever; Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) infection was suspected. EBV PCR in CSF returned positive, confirming EBV-associated encephalitis. Antibiotics were stopped; the patient received supportive care (cerebral edema management, seizure prophylaxis, management of neurological complications, nutrition, and electrolytes). After 15 days, consciousness improved and seizures did not recur; the child was discharged. Clinicians note rising encephalitis activity from May–September, with etiologies including Japanese encephalitis or others. No specific antiviral therapy exists; prevention emphasizes vaccination and mosquito-control measures.

triage.headline_ja: 7歳の小児、数日間の高熱後に脳炎を発症
triage.triage_reason: 単一の小児例でEBV関連脳炎と確定診断され、治療により回復・退院している。アウトブレイクや異常な集団発生を示す情報はなく、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は個別の小児症例報告であり、EBV関連脳炎と確定診断済み。日本脳炎など季節性脳炎活動の増加への一般的言及はあるが、具体的な集団発生やアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: DRC's Ebola Outbreak Nears 6,700 Cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) has 6,686 confirmed cases and 3,226 deaths, with 1,563 recoveries and a 48.3% case-fatality rate as of Sept 8, 2026. The epidemic spans six provinces, led by Ituri, with a new area in North Kivu; no new cases were reported in South Kivu, Tshopo or Bas-Uélé in the prior 24 hours, and 15 more recovered. As of Sept 6, 819 patients remain in isolation or hospital care; contact tracing coverage is 85.3%. Began in May, it is the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, spreading rapidly to about 5,000 cases in the first 100 days. The Bundibugyo strain complicates response because vaccines and treatments were developed for Zaire. The government declares the 17th Ebola epidemic; WHO has a PHEIC. Insecurity and displacement hinder operations; MSF employs 1,700+ staff across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé and Tshopo. U.S. risk remains low; no confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、感染者数6,700人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行で、致死率48.3%、6州に拡大しており、IHR基準を複数満たす重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 米国では確定症例なくリスクは低いとされているため、United Statesはverified_locationsから除外。Bundibugyo株のためZaire株用のワクチン・治療薬の有効性に懸念があり、対応が複雑化している。

article.articleHeadline: Lam Dong Refuerza La Prevención Escolar Contra Mano-pie-boca
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lam Dong Reinforces School-Based Prevention Against Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease.
article.articleSummary: Lam Dong province, Vietnam, on September 8, 2026, ordered reinforced school-based prevention and control of hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) and expanded surveillance for other school infections. The Provincial People’s Committee directs departments and local administrations to implement uniform measures across all educational institutions to rapidly detect cases, curb transmission, and protect young children. Transmission occurs through close contact, respiratory secretions, saliva, skin lesions, and feces, so the plan emphasizes daily health monitoring, rigorous cleaning of classrooms, toilets, dining areas, toys, and surfaces; good ventilation; and avoiding shared utensils. Handwashing with soap and water, access to clean water and hygiene products, and age-appropriate guidance are prioritized. Suspected cases should stay home and be evaluated; return only when permitted. Families must report fever, mouth ulcers, or hand-foot rashes, and ill children should not attend class. HFMD is usually mild but can cause dehydration or more serious symptoms; rapid information sharing and updated records support control.

triage.headline_ja: ラムドン省、学校での手足口病予防を強化
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ラムドン省での手足口病(EV71)に対する学校での予防強化措置に関する行政的発表であり、深刻な流行拡大や異常事態を示す情報はないが、小児における感染症であり経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 手足口病(HFMD)は通常軽症だが、EV71型は重症化リスクがあるため注視が必要。具体的な症例数や重症例の情報は記事に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: La question liée à l'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC s'invite à la session ordinaire du Conseil des droits de l'homme à Genève
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is on the agenda at the UN Human Rights Council's regular session in Geneva.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo faces its 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, officially declared in May 2026 in Ituri province and now expanding to six provinces and over 60 health zones, making it one of the most serious and rapid-to-date outbreaks in the country. Uganda has interrupted transmission, but the DRC continues to experience spread amid insecurity, population displacement, strained health systems, and community mistrust, hindering surveillance and case management. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo. The outbreak is a key backdrop to a UN Human Rights Council session in Geneva, with calls to strengthen multilateral cooperation for health. In Kinshasa, authorities, with WHO, the UN system, Africa CDC, and partners, launched a revised 180-day multisectoral plan on Sept 4, 2026 to intensify surveillance, case management, and community interventions to save lives and interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行問題、ジュネーブの国連人権理事会通常会期の議題に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で第17次エボラ流行（ブンディブギョウイルス）が6州60超の保健地域に拡大し、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、治安不安・住民不信により対応が困難という深刻な公衆衛生事案であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準複数該当かつ国連人権理事会での議題化という社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは伝播を遮断済みと記載されているが、記事の主題はDRCの流行拡大。ジュネーブ・スイスは会議開催地であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة وفيات "إيبولا" بالكونغو إلى 3226 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in Ebola death toll in Congo to 3,226 cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 6,686 confirmed infections and 3,226 deaths as of September 6, according to a ministry statement posted on X. The update highlights the ongoing outbreak in a region grappling with armed conflict for three decades and extensive humanitarian needs. On August 21, the United Nations warned that additional resources are urgently required to control the epidemic. The report underscores the severity of the situation in eastern DRC and the pressure on health and humanitarian operations amid persistent instability. No details are provided on the infection source, transmission chains, or specific localities within the country in the available briefing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ死者数が3,226人に上昇
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで死者3,226人・感染6,686人と大規模拡大しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際支援の必要性が明確なためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 武力紛争地域における人道支援ニーズの高まりとUNによる資源不足の警告があり、既存の大規模流行の悪化を示す続報。

article.articleHeadline: Mengenal Bakteri E.coli, Staphylococcus aureus dan Bacillus cereus yang Bisa Picu Keracunan Makanan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Getting to Know Escherichia coli, Staphylococcus aureus, and Bacillus cereus that can cause food poisoning
article.articleSummary: On February 12, 2024, 59 students at SMK Muhammadiyah 3 Gemolong, Sragen, Central Java, suffered food poisoning after snacks were shared to 330 pupils during a gathering; items included bottled water, arem-arem, and cake. Hygiene issues—staff not wearing gloves or reusing gloves—were cited as exposure risks. The report notes that Escherichia coli, Staphylococcus aureus, and Bacillus cereus are common food-poisoning culprits, widespread in the environment and humans, with some strains causing illness directly or via toxins. E. coli strains (ETEC, EHEC/STEC, UPEC) can be contracted from contaminated meat, raw vegetables, or unpasteurized dairy, or via contact with animals or contaminated surroundings. Symptoms can include urinary tract infection signs such as painful urination and fever. References include GOV.UK/FSA and a 2025 BMC Infectious Diseases study.

triage.headline_ja: 食中毒を引き起こす可能性のある大腸菌、黄色ブドウ球菌、セレウス菌について知る
triage.triage_reason: 2024年2月の一過性の学校での食中毒事例に関する教育的解説記事であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクや新規性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は2024年2月に発生した過去の学校での食中毒事例を例に、細菌性食中毒の一般教育的解説を行うもので、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: کشف ویروس جدیدی که کنه‌ها به انسان منتقل می‌کنند؛ ۷ نفر جان باختند
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Discovery of a new virus transmitted to humans by ticks; seven people have died.
article.articleSummary: Researchers in China identified a new tick-borne pathogen, ALTNV, an Asian tick-associated nairovirus in the Orthonairovirus genus, transmitted by Haemaphysalis longicornis. After screening 3,163 patients with symptoms previously attributed to Dabie bandavirus (DBV, the agent of Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome, SFTS), they found ALTNV in individuals with a history of tick bites. ALTNV causes influenza-like illness with fever, fatigue, and gastrointestinal upset. Co-circulation with DBV in similar regions and sharing the same tick vector underscores the need for better differential diagnosis in SFTS-endemic areas. In a study of 38 patients with ALTNV and DBV, severe respiratory and renal complications occurred, and 7 died. DBV can reach up to 30% mortality; there is no specific antiviral treatment, and antibiotics are ineffective. The report urges preventive travel measures and prompt medical evaluation for influenza-like illness after tick exposure.

triage.headline_ja: マダニが人に媒介する新種ウイルスを発見；7人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新規のマダニ媒介性ウイルス（ALTNV）が発見され、重症化・死亡例（7名）が報告されており、異常性と一定の公衆衛生インパクトが認められるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事は研究報告（新規ウイルスALTNVの発見）に基づくもので、現時点でヒト-ヒト感染や大規模流行の証拠はない。既存のSFTS流行地域との重複や鑑別診断の必要性が指摘されており、今後の情報更新（症例数、地理的拡大、二次感染の有無）を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: กทม. พบผู้ป่วยโควิด สะสม 41,709 ราย ไม่มีเสียชีวิต สั่งเฝ้าระวังเข้ม
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bangkok reports 41,709 cumulative COVID-19 cases, no deaths; strict surveillance ordered.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 remains active in Bangkok with 41,709 cumulative cases from Jan 1–Aug 31, 2569, and no related deaths. Outpatients 38,427; inpatients 3,282. Huai Khwang District has the highest incidence, followed by Wattana, Klong San, Phra Nakhon, and Phaya Thai, with cases across all ages, especially working adults. Bangkok’s Bureau of Public Health maintains surveillance and hospital readiness—beds, rapid tests, medicines, and referral systems—prioritizing the elderly (60+), those with comorbidities, pregnant women, and young children. Surveillance also targets schools, early-childhood centers, elderly homes, and Bangkok facilities; NB.1.8.1 and other variants are monitored in real time. Vaccine stockpiling supports seasonal protection, including COVID-19, measles, influenza, and acute gastroenteritis viruses. Personal measures: distancing, mask-wearing, handwashing; ATK testing if symptomatic; positive cases isolate and seek care. Telemedicine via the Mo Bangkok app and 1646 24/7 hotline available.

triage.headline_ja: バンコクでCOVID-19累計41,709例、死亡者なし、厳重な監視体制を指示
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の通常の定点監視報告であり、死亡者なし、新規異常なパターンも見られず、既存の公衆衛生対応の範囲内であるため。
triage.notes: バンコク都保健局による定例のCOVID-19サーベイランス報告。死亡者ゼロで、既存の監視・医療体制の範囲内。NB.1.8.1変異株のモニタリングも通常業務として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Avian influenza surveillance in poultry environments and pneumonia patients
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza viruses continue to circulate in China's poultry-human interfaces despite vaccination and culling reducing H5 and H7 lineages. A two-year surveillance (Dec 2021–Dec 2023) in three cities collected environmental samples from live poultry markets, slaughterhouses, and farms, alongside 840 respiratory specimens from hospitalized pneumonia of unknown etiology (PUE). Real-time RT-PCR tested 8,335 environmental samples for influenza A and subtype assays for H5, H7, H9, and H10. Overall, 32.2% were influenza A positive; H9 dominated at 20.1%, H5 at 7.1%, H10 at 0.2%, and H7 was not detected. Autumn and winter had higher positivity for H5 and H9. Rates were higher in live markets and slaughterhouses than farms/backyards. H5 showed no significant difference across sample categories, while H9 had a higher median positive rate across categories. Findings indicate persistent, low-level viral circulation at the human-animal interface, with ongoing clade 2.3.4.4b H5 presence.

triage.headline_ja: 家禽環境および肺炎患者における鳥インフルエンザサーベイランス
triage.triage_reason: 中国3都市での鳥インフルエンザ環境サーベイランス研究であり、H5・H9系統の持続的な低レベル循環が確認されているが、新規の人への感染例や急性アウトブレイクの報告はなく、過去データに基づく学術研究の性質が強い。
triage.notes: 本記事は2021年12月〜2023年12月の環境サーベイランスおよび原因不明肺炎（PUE）患者検体の研究成果報告であり、H7型は検出されず、H9型が最多（20.1%）、H5型（7.1%）は依然として2.3.4.4bクレードとして存在。ヒトへの感染確認例は明記されていない。生体家禽市場・と畜場でのウイルス検出率が高く、ヒト-動物インターフェースでの持続的リスクを示唆するが、現時点で緊急対応を要する新規アウトブレイクではない。
